sentences.zh: 四月，瓜洲以我軍圍攻久，勢頻危，乃出背城計，水陸並撲，戰土橋西里鋪，不勝；

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Guazhou, because our army besieged long and the situation was frequently perilous, then used a fight-with-the-back-to-the-wall plan; land and water together pressed the attack at Tuqiao Xilipu and did not prevail;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, with the long siege turning desperate, Guazhou's garrison made a last stand, attacking by land and water at Tuqiao Xilipu without success;

sentences.zh: 復以戰艦分兩路進：一沿港助勢，一渡江他擾，均為我水師所殲。

translations.literal: they again sent warships in two routes to advance: one along the harbor to aid momentum, one crossing the river to harass elsewhere—both were destroyed by our naval force.
translations.idiomatic: they sent warships in two columns, one up the harbor and one across the river, but the fleet destroyed both.

sentences.zh: 寇之聚溧水者，屢招援黨攻大營，死萬餘，復於鄔山築壘數十以抗我軍。

translations.literal: Rebels gathered at Lishui repeatedly called relief bands to attack the grand camp; over ten thousand died; they again built several tens of fortifications at Wushan to resist our army.
translations.idiomatic: The Lishui rebels repeatedly summoned reinforcements against the grand camp. After more than ten thousand dead they built dozens of forts at Wushan.

sentences.zh: 五月，總兵傅振邦破其外壘，繼以火攻城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Brigadier Fu Zhenbang broke their outer fortifications and followed with fire to attack the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Brigadier Fu Zhenbang stormed the outer works and set fire to the walls.

sentences.zh: 副將虎坤元乘內亂，斬守城悍酋而入，遂復其城。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Hu Kunyuan exploited internal disorder, beheaded fierce defending chiefs and entered, and the city was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Hu Kunyuan exploited disorder inside the walls, killed the fierce defenders, broke in, and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 溧水既克，和春進規句容，與溧水相犄角。

translations.literal: After Lishui was taken, He Chun advanced plans for Jurong, horn to horn with Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: With Lishui secure, He Chun turned on Jurong, paired with Lishui as a pincer.

sentences.zh: 寇結外援，聲勢尚壯。

translations.literal: Rebels joined outside relief; their momentum was still strong.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels still had strong outside support.

sentences.zh: 國樑會軍圍攻，而自帥親兵衝入，刺黃衣悍目數名，寇奔潰。

translations.literal: Guoliang joined forces in siege and himself led personal troops in a charge, stabbing several fierce yellow-clad officers; rebels fled in collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang joined the siege and led a charge himself, killing several yellow-clad rebel officers; the garrison broke.

sentences.zh: 和春進衝內壕，國樑首先登城，寇尸山積。

translations.literal: He Chun advanced against the inner moat; Guoliang was first to ascend the wall; rebel corpses piled like mountains.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun pressed the inner moat while Guoliang was first on the wall; rebel dead heaped the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 閏五月二十五日，收復縣城。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary fifth month, the county seat was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth of the intercalary fifth month the county seat was retaken.

sentences.zh: 九月，鎮江寇出城至甘露寺，逕撲大營，和春迎剿敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Zhenjiang rebels came out of the city to Ganlu Temple and pressed straight on the grand camp; He Chun met and suppressed them in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhenjiang rebels sallied to Ganlu Temple and struck the grand camp; He Chun routed them.

sentences.zh: 寇欲西竄接應金陵，國樑密於高資增營扼塞，寇亦築壘，運糧河北。

translations.literal: Rebels wished to flee west to link with Jinling; Guoliang secretly added camps at Gaozi to block them; rebels also built fortifications and transported grain north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels tried to break west toward Nanjing. Guoliang secretly reinforced Gaozi to block them while they fortified and moved grain north of the river.

sentences.zh: 國樑遣參將余兆青等毀其砲臺，而自率親兵渡河，會水陸諸軍鏖戰六晝夜，沉巨船十餘艘，削壁壘二，生擒魏長仁等六名，斬俘無數。

translations.literal: Guoliang dispatched Regiment Commander Yu Zhaoqing and others to destroy their batteries, while he himself led personal troops across the river, joined land and naval forces in six days and nights of fierce battle, sank over ten great vessels, cut down two cliff fortifications, captured alive six including Wei Changren, and beheaded and captured without number.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang sent Regiment Commander Yu Zhaoqing to destroy the batteries, crossed with his personal guard, and with land and naval forces fought six days and nights, sinking more than ten large boats, taking two cliff forts, and capturing six men including Wei Changren.

sentences.zh: 寇之踞瓜洲者，遙聯金陵，近接鎮江，阻官軍進剿之路，歷五年矣。

translations.literal: Rebels holding Guazhou linked distantly with Jinling and closely with Zhenjiang, blocking the government army's route of advance and suppression—for five years.
translations.idiomatic: Guazhou's rebels linked with Nanjing and Zhenjiang and blocked imperial advance for five years.

sentences.zh: 適南岸寇援創於和春，德興阿乘其隙，檄大軍踰城而入，遂下瓜洲。

translations.literal: Just then south-bank rebel relief was wounded by He Chun; De Xing'a seized the opening, ordered the great army over the walls to enter, and Guazhou then fell.
translations.idiomatic: With south-bank relief beaten by He Chun, De Xing'a seized the moment, sent the main force over the walls, and Guazhou fell.

sentences.zh: 十二月，國樑大捷於瓜洲南岸，陣斬偽王，奪壘十七，遂圍鎮江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Guoliang won a great victory on the south bank of Guazhou, slew a false king in battle, seized seventeen fortifications, and then besieged Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Guoliang won a great victory south of Guazhou, killed a false king in battle, took seventeen forts, and besieged Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 秀全四遣眾援，均為虎坤元所破。

translations.literal: Xiucheng four times dispatched masses to relieve them; all were defeated by Hu Kunyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sent relief four times; Hu Kunyuan defeated every column.

sentences.zh: 國樑督軍攻四門壞垣，奪復其城，逸出者沿江搜殺近萬人。

translations.literal: Guoliang supervised the army in attacking broken walls at the four gates, recovered the city, and those who escaped were hunted and killed along the river—nearly ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang stormed the broken walls at all four gates, retook the city, and hunted down nearly ten thousand fugitives along the river.

sentences.zh: 惟吳如孝潰圍遁入金陵，復竄聚安慶。

translations.literal: Only Wu Ruxiao broke the encirclement and fled into Jinling, again fleeing to gather at Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Only Wu Ruxiao broke out and fled to Nanjing, then gathered again at Anqing.

sentences.zh: 而潛山太湖之寇又陷霍山，旋退出，欲從羅田、麻城上竄，踞獨山、西河口為營。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Qianshan and Taihu rebels again seized Huoshan, then soon withdrew, intending to flee upriver from Luotian and Macheng, holding Dushan and Xihekou as camps.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Qianshan and Taihu rebels took Huoshan, withdrew, and tried to break upriver through Luotian and Macheng from camps at Dushan and Xihekou.

sentences.zh: 官文調馬步軍兼程馳防豫、皖交界之處，以固楚疆。

translations.literal: Guan Wen transferred cavalry and infantry by forced marches to guard the Henan-Anhui border area and secure the Chu frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen rushed cavalry and infantry to the Henan-Anhui border to secure Hubei.

sentences.zh: 八月，皖寇糾豫捻謀援金陵，犯商、固，擾光州、六安，窺伺隨、棗一路。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Anhui rebels colluded with Henan Nian to aid Jinling, invaded Shang and Gu, harassed Guangzhou and Lu'an, and spied on the Suizhou-Zaoyang route.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Anhui rebels joined Henan Nian bands to aid Nanjing, raided Shangcheng and Gushi, harassed Guangzhou and Lu'an, and threatened the Suizhou-Zaoyang line.

sentences.zh: 而太湖、渡石牌等處寇黨連營三十里，眾六七萬，乘我軍度歲，竄近蘄州，尋又竄荊橋、好漢坡諸處。

translations.literal: Meanwhile rebel bands at Taihu, Dushipai, and elsewhere linked camps for thirty li, numbering sixty or seventy thousand; taking advantage of our army's year-end, they fled near Qizhou, then again fled to Jingqiao, Hao Hanpo, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel camps stretched thirty li around Taihu and Dushipai with sixty or seventy thousand men. They struck near Qizhou during the new year, then shifted to Jingqiao and Hao Hanpo.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿迎剿，敗之仙田鋪、風火山，追抵太湖，連營宿、太以扼寇衝。

translations.literal: Dolonga met and suppressed them, defeated them at Xiantian Shop and Fenghuo Mountain, pursued to Taihu, and linked camps at Susong and Taihu to block rebel thrusts.
translations.idiomatic: Dolonga met them, routed them at Xiantian Shop and Fenghuo Mountain, pursued to Taihu, and linked Susong and Taihu camps to block their advance.

sentences.zh: 而秦日綱遣其黨北趨，避實擊虛，謀犯蘄州。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Qin Rigang sent his band north, avoiding the solid and striking the weak, plotting to invade Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Rigang sent a column north to avoid strong points, strike weak ones, and threaten Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 蘄水、六安之寇亦併力上竄，陷英山縣，分七路竄羅田。

translations.literal: Qishui and Lu'an rebels also combined strength to flee upriver, seized Yingshan county, and divided into seven columns to flee through Luotian.
translations.idiomatic: Qishui and Lu'an rebels pushed upriver together, took Yingshan, and split into seven columns through Luotian.

sentences.zh: 羅田知縣崔蘭馨連日鏖戰，收復英山。

translations.literal: Luotian Magistrate Cui Lanxin fought day after day in fierce battle and recovered Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Luotian Magistrate Cui Lanxin fought day after day and retook Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 守備梁洪勝等督楚軍擒偽丞相韋朝綱。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander Liang Hongsheng and others supervised Chu troops and captured the rebel chancellor Wei Zhaogang.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander Liang Hongsheng and other Chu officers captured the false chancellor Wei Zhaogang.

sentences.zh: 寇出黃花嶺，竄楚境楓樹坳等處。

translations.literal: Rebels came out Huanghua Ridge and fled to Fengshu'ao and other places in Chu territory.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels slipped out by Huanghua Ridge toward Fengshu'ao in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 都興阿遣將往南陽河迎擊。

translations.literal: Du Xing'a dispatched generals south to the Nanyang River to meet and strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xing'a sent generals to the Nanyang River to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 寇築壘北岸，我軍潛伏北岸山谷中，而列陣南岸。

translations.literal: Rebels built fortifications on the north bank; our army lay in ambush in north-bank valleys while forming battle lines on the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fortified the north bank. Imperial troops hid in the north-bank valleys while drawing up on the south bank.

sentences.zh: 寇渡河而南，我軍邀擊之，乘勝北渡。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the river southward; our army intercepted them and, taking advantage of victory, crossed north.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels crossed south, imperial forces struck them and pursued across the river.

sentences.zh: 寇陣山腰，潰寇踵至，伏兵起，斃寇無數。

translations.literal: Rebels formed battle lines on the mountainside; routed rebels followed in succession; ambush troops rose and killed rebels without number.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels formed on the slope; as fugitives piled up, the ambush rose and slaughtered them.

sentences.zh: 楚軍勢大振，宿、太諸營始紓後顧憂。

translations.literal: Chu Army momentum greatly revived; Susong and Taihu camps at last eased rearward worries.
translations.idiomatic: Chu morale surged, and the Susong-Taihu camps were at last freed from worry to the rear.

sentences.zh: 時秀全大會諸黨，飭陳玉成為前軍主將，以潛、太、黃、宿為根據，敵我上游楚師；

translations.literal: At that time Xiucheng held a great assembly of all bands, ordering Chen Yucheng as front-army chief commander, with Qianshan, Taihu, Huangmei, and Susong as bases to oppose our upstream Chu army;
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng then convened the rebel chiefs and made Chen Yucheng front-army commander, basing on Qianshan, Taihu, Huangmei, and Susong to block the upstream Hubei army;

sentences.zh: 楊輔清為中軍主將，以殷家匯、東流為根據，敵我中路曾軍；

translations.literal: Yang Fuqing as middle-army chief commander, with Yinjiahui and Dongliu as bases to oppose our middle-route Zeng army;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing middle-army commander, basing on Yinjiahui and Dongliu against Zeng's central force;

sentences.zh: 李侍賢為左軍主將；

translations.literal: Li Shixian as left-army chief commander;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian left-army commander;

sentences.zh: 李秀成為五軍主將。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng as commander of the five armies.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Xiucheng commander of all five armies.

sentences.zh: 二月，和春攻破秣陵關，關為金陵南面外蔽，寇所嚴守者也。

translations.literal: In the second month, He Chun broke Moling Pass; the pass was Jinling's outer screen on the south, which rebels strictly guarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month He Chun took Moling Pass, the southern outer defense of Nanjing that the rebels had held tightly.

sentences.zh: 三月，和春率張國樑等圍攻金陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, He Chun led Zhang Guoliang and others to besiege Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month He Chun and Zhang Guoliang besieged Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 會秀全張筵飲群黨酒，流丸墜秀全膝下，群駭愕。

translations.literal: It happened that Xiucheng spread a banquet to drink wine with the rebel host; a stray bullet fell at Xiucheng's knees and the assembly was startled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng was feasting with his chiefs when a stray bullet struck near his knees and terrified the hall.

sentences.zh: 秀全曰：「予已受天命，縱敵兵百萬，彈丸雨下，又將如予何！

translations.literal: Xiucheng said: "I have already received Heaven's mandate; even if enemy troops number a million and bullets rain down, what can they do to me!
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng said, "Heaven has chosen me. Let a million enemies rain bullets—what can they do to me?

sentences.zh: 況和春非吾敵也，諸將弄彼如小兒，特供一時笑樂耳，奚恐為？

translations.literal: Moreover He Chun is not my match; the generals toy with him like a child, merely supplying a moment's laughter—why fear?"
translations.idiomatic: And He Chun is no match for me. My generals toy with him like children. Why should we fear?"

sentences.zh: 」初，寇屢伺我軍懈，悉銳出犯，冀解其圍，而雨花臺爭之尤力。

translations.literal: Earlier, rebels repeatedly watched for our army's slackness and sent all elite troops out to attack, hoping to lift the siege; contention for Yuhuatai was especially fierce.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had repeatedly probed for slackness and sallied in force to break the siege, fighting hardest for Yuhuatai.

sentences.zh: 和春嚴為防儆，寇果由雨花臺攻大營，大敗之。

translations.literal: He Chun strictly guarded against them; rebels indeed attacked the grand camp from Yuhuatai and were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun was on guard. The rebels attacked from Yuhuatai and were routed.

sentences.zh: 和春、張國樑作長圍困寇，度地勢險夷，溝而垣之，鑿山越水，周城百餘里。

translations.literal: He Chun and Zhang Guoliang made a long encirclement to trap rebels, gauging terrain's steepness and ease, ditching and walling it, cutting through mountains and crossing water, encircling the city for over one hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun and Zhang Guoliang built a long encirclement around the city—more than a hundred li of trenches and walls across mountains and streams.

sentences.zh: 諸營大小相維，絕寇應援，秀全大懼，誡各門嚴備。

translations.literal: Camps large and small linked together, cutting off rebel relief; Xiucheng was greatly afraid and warned each gate to prepare strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Linked camps cut off relief. Xiucheng was terrified and ordered every gate to brace for attack.

sentences.zh: 潛結壘於壽德州，屢突長圍，不克，死者枕藉。

translations.literal: They secretly built fortifications at Shoude Prefecture, repeatedly burst the long encirclement without success, and the dead lay piled.
translations.idiomatic: They built secret bases at Shoude and repeatedly tried to break the encirclement, leaving heaps of dead.

sentences.zh: 當是時，石達開在蜀，楊輔清竄閩，林紹璋敗於湘，林啟榮圍於九江，黃文玉坐困於湖口，張朝爵、陳得才孤守皖省，陳玉成坐守小孤山、華陽鎮一帶，秣陵又陷，金陵老巢聲援殆絕。

translations.literal: At that time Shi Dakai was in Shu, Yang Fuqing fled to Fujian, Lin Shaozhang was defeated in Hunan, Lin Qirong was besieged at Jiujiang, Huang Wenyu was trapped at Hukou, Zhang Chaojue and Chen Decai held Anhui alone, Chen Yucheng held the Little Gushan and Huayang Town stretch, Moling had fallen, and Jinling's old nest was nearly cut off from support.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai was in Sichuan, Yang Fuqing in Fujian, Lin Shaozhang beaten in Hunan, Lin Qirong besieged at Jiujiang, Huang Wenyu trapped at Hukou, Zhang Chaojue and Chen Decai holding Anhui alone, Chen Yucheng at Little Gushan and Huayang, Moling lost—Nanjing was nearly cut off.

sentences.zh: 而糧食尚充足，上游諸州縣皆為寇據，呼吸可通，故寇雖危蹙而未遽顛覆。

translations.literal: Yet grain was still ample; upstream prefectures and counties were all held by rebels and could communicate in a breath, so though rebels were in peril they did not quickly collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Grain still held, upstream counties remained in rebel hands, and lines of communication stayed open, so Nanjing did not fall at once.

sentences.zh: 我軍屢圍金陵，玉成多方抗拒，而秀成出陷杭州，以掣圍師之肘，我軍不動。

translations.literal: Our army repeatedly besieged Jinling; Yucheng resisted on many fronts while Xiucheng went out to seize Hangzhou to pull at the besieging army's elbow—our army did not move.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces kept the siege on Nanjing while Yucheng held them off and Xiucheng took Hangzhou to divert attention—the besiegers did not stir.

sentences.zh: 玉成乃自潛山、太湖下江浦，伺官軍之虛，悉眾攻大營，以冀解圍。

translations.literal: Yucheng then came down from Qianshan and Taihu to Jiangpu, watched for gaps in government forces, and with all his masses attacked the grand camp hoping to lift the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng marched from Qianshan and Taihu to Jiangpu, found a gap, and threw his whole force at the grand camp to break the siege.

sentences.zh: 蘇、常相繼而陷。

translations.literal: Suzhou and Changzhou fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou and Changzhou fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 四月，李續賓、楊載福會攻九江，九江為金陵犄角，南岸肅清，專力攻九江。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Li Xubing and Yang Zaifu jointly attacked Jiujiang; Jiujiang was Jinling's horn; the south bank was cleared and they focused force on Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Xubing and Yang Zaifu besieged Jiujiang, the horn of Nanjing's defense, after clearing the south bank.

sentences.zh: 城寇被圍久，以數千人攖城，植蔬種麥供軍食，其守愈暇，頻傷攻城軍士。

translations.literal: City rebels, besieged long, used several thousand to harass the walls, planted vegetables and sowed wheat to supply army food; their defense grew more leisurely and frequently wounded storming soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison, long besieged, farmed inside the walls and killed many attackers while holding firm.

sentences.zh: 嗣地道成，城破而復完。

translations.literal: Later a tunnel was completed; the wall broke but was repaired again.
translations.idiomatic: A mine breached the wall, but the rebels repaired it.

sentences.zh: 楊載福督水陸十六營攻四門，地雷再發，城崩百餘丈，諸軍躍登，斃寇萬六七千。

translations.literal: Yang Zaifu supervised sixteen land and naval camps attacking the four gates; mines exploded again; the wall collapsed for over a hundred zhang; all armies leaped up; over sixteen or seventeen thousand rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zaifu attacked all four gates with sixteen battalions. Mines blew a hundred-zhang breach; troops stormed in and killed sixteen or seventeen thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 出城者水師扼之，俘斬無遺。

translations.literal: Those who came out were blocked by the naval force; none were spared captive or beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Fugitives were cut down by the fleet; none escaped.

sentences.zh: 林啟榮、李興隆均敗死，磔其屍。

translations.literal: Lin Qirong and Li Xinglong both died in defeat; their corpses were dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qirong and Li Xinglong were killed and their bodies dismembered.

sentences.zh: 九江既克，寇黨無固志。

translations.literal: After Jiujiang was taken, rebel bands had no firm will.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiujiang fell, rebel morale collapsed.

sentences.zh: 楚南軍先後收復新淦、崇仁，下撫州，克安樂、宜黃、安豐、新城諸縣，收復建昌。

translations.literal: Chu southern armies successively recovered Xingan and Chongren, descended on Fuzhou, took Anle, Yihuang, Anfeng, Xincheng and other counties, and recovered Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Chu forces retook Xingan, Chongren, Fuzhou, and counties including Anle, Yihuang, Anfeng, and Xincheng, and recovered Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 國荃攻吉安，旁克吉水、萬安二縣。

translations.literal: Guoquan attacked Ji'an and on the flanks took Jishui and Wan'an counties.
translations.idiomatic: Guoquan besieged Ji'an and took Jishui and Wan'an on the flanks.

sentences.zh: 於是江西陷城收復八九矣。

translations.literal: Thus eight or nine of Jiangxi's fallen cities were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Eight or nine of Jiangxi's lost cities were back in imperial hands.

sentences.zh: 寇黨畏懾，金陵寇亦窮蹙。

translations.literal: Rebel bands were cowed; Jinling rebels were also cornered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel bands wavered, and the Nanjing garrison was cornered.

sentences.zh: 秀全力圖外擾，乃命寇將竄皖南北及閩、浙諸省，冀大軍分援，以牽我師。

translations.literal: Xiucheng strove for external harassment and ordered rebel generals to flee into north and south Anhui and Fujian and Zhejiang provinces, hoping the great army would divide relief and tie down our armies.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sought outside distractions, sending raids into Anhui, Fujian, and Zhejiang to split imperial forces.

sentences.zh: 玉成勾結捻首張洛行、龔瞎子，眾號十萬人，踞麻城，四門築五十八壘，溝塹重疊，據險自固。

translations.literal: Yucheng colluded with Nian chiefs Zhang Luoxing and Gong Xiazi; their force claimed one hundred thousand; they held Macheng, built fifty-eight fortifications at the four gates, overlapping moats and ditches, holding difficult terrain to fortify themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng joined Nian leaders Zhang Luoxing and Gong Xiazi with a host said to number one hundred thousand at Macheng, ringed by fifty-eight forts and layered trenches.

sentences.zh: 而安慶暨英、霍諸寇又陷黃安，冀窺漢陽、德安，取道北竄。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Anqing and Ying and Huo rebels again seized Huang'an, hoping to spy on Hanyang and De'an and take a route fleeing north.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing and Ying-Huo rebels took Huang'an, threatening Hanyang and De'an and a northern breakout.

sentences.zh: 官文檄續賓上援，以紓麻城之患。

translations.literal: Guan Wen ordered Xubing upriver to relieve the trouble at Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen ordered Xubing upriver to relieve Macheng.

sentences.zh: 先是秀全命賴漢英掠江西，皖寇入福建，陷政和縣、邵武府，遂陷浦城，分擾建寧。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiucheng had ordered Lai Hanying to raid Jiangxi; Anhui rebels entered Fujian, seized Zhenghe county and Shaowu Prefecture, then seized Pucheng and harassed Jianning in separate groups.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiucheng had sent Lai Hanying into Jiangxi while Anhui rebels entered Fujian, took Zhenghe and Shaowu, then Pucheng, and raided Jianning.

sentences.zh: 五月，我軍克復黃安、麻城，斬偽丞相指揮數十人；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, our army recovered Huang'an and Macheng and beheaded dozens of false chancellors and commanders;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month imperial forces retook Huang'an and Macheng and beheaded dozens of false chancellors and commanders;

sentences.zh: 追至商城，並進剿太湖、潛山、英山、霍山諸寇。

translations.literal: pursued to Shangcheng and jointly advanced to suppress rebels in Taihu, Qianshan, Yingshan, and Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: pursued to Shangcheng and swept Taihu, Qianshan, Yingshan, and Huoshan.

sentences.zh: 其黨竄踞東安者，圖為江南北聲勢。

translations.literal: Their band fled to hold Dong'an, plotting to link north and south Jiang momentum.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel band held Dong'an to link the Yangtze north and south.

sentences.zh: 和春督軍立復縣城，金陵寇愈形危蹙，急思潰竄。

translations.literal: He Chun supervised the army and quickly recovered the county seat; Jinling rebels looked ever more cornered and urgently thought to break and flee.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun retook the county seat quickly. The Nanjing garrison grew desperate to break out.

sentences.zh: 和春派水師分剿繁昌，毀其堅壘土橋，進破峨橋、魯港等處。

translations.literal: He Chun dispatched the naval force to suppress Fanchang in separate columns, destroyed their firm fortifications and earthen bridges, and advanced to break E Qiao, Lugang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun's fleet cleared Fanchang, destroyed its bridges and forts, and broke E Qiao and Lugang.

sentences.zh: 城寇憤恚，出太平、神策門分犯大營，張玉良、馮子材等陷陣敗之，寇退。

translations.literal: City rebels, furious, came out Taiping and Shence gates to attack the grand camp in separate columns; Zhang Yuliang, Feng Zicai, and others fell in battle and defeated them; rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged city rebels sallied from Taiping and Shence gates. Zhang Yuliang and Feng Zicai met them and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 遂攻金川門，悉毀東北城外壘柵。

translations.literal: They then attacked Jinchuan Gate and destroyed all northeast outer fortifications and palisades.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed Jinchuan Gate and destroyed the northeast outer works.

sentences.zh: 石達開乃自廣豐陷江山縣，金華、衢州、處州三府屬邑焚掠殆遍。

translations.literal: Shi Dakai then from Guangfeng seized Jiangshan county; counties under Jinhua, Quzhou, and Chuzhou three prefectures were burned and plundered nearly throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai took Jiangshan from Guangfeng and ravaged the counties of Jinhua, Quzhou, and Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 浙軍敗之壽昌七里亭。

translations.literal: Zhejiang forces defeated them at Qili Pavilion, Shouchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang troops defeated them at Qili Pavilion in Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 六月，寇竄全椒，踞滁州、九洑洲等處，浙軍大敗之，進克武義、永康、常山、江山、開化、縉雲、宣平，衢圍亦解。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, rebels fled to Quanjiao, held Chuzhou, Jiufuzhou, and other places; Zhejiang forces greatly defeated them, advanced to take Wuyi, Yongkang, Changshan, Jiangshan, Kaihua, Jinyun, and Xuanping, and the Quzhou siege was also lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month rebels held Chuzhou and Jiufuzhou. Zhejiang forces routed them, retook a string of counties, and lifted the siege of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 寇悉竄處州，陷之，周天受督軍克復。

translations.literal: Rebels all fled to Chuzhou, seized it; Zhou Tianshou supervised the army and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Chuzhou and took it until Zhou Tianshou retook the city.

sentences.zh: 會閩寇蜿蜒猖獗，所復各城旋失，又陷松溪、崇安、建陽等縣，建寧府亦被圍。

translations.literal: Just then Fujian rebels wound rampant; recovered cities were soon lost again; they also seized Songxi, Chong'an, Jianyang and other counties, and Jianning Prefecture was also besieged.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian rebels surged again, retook lost cities, seized Songxi, Chong'an, and Jianyang, and besieged Jianning.

sentences.zh: 浙江巡撫晏端書檄將馳援閩省，又出師江山界，剿浦城寇巢。

translations.literal: Zhejiang Governor Yan Duanshu ordered generals to hurry relief to Fujian and also sent troops on the Jiangshan border to suppress the Pucheng rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yan Duanshu sent relief to Fujian and struck the Pucheng nest from Jiangshan.

sentences.zh: 是時，上以浙、閩寇並起，乃起曾國藩率江西湘軍援浙，旋命改援閩。

translations.literal: At that time, with Zhejiang and Fujian rebels rising together, the Emperor recalled Zeng Guofan to lead Jiangxi Xiang Army to aid Zhejiang, then soon ordered him to shift relief to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: With rebels rising in Zhejiang and Fujian, the emperor recalled Guofan to aid Zhejiang, then ordered him to Fujian instead.

sentences.zh: 國藩自鉛山進軍，寇大懼，圖牽制之計，分萬餘人犯江西，圍廣豐、玉山，入踞安仁。

translations.literal: Guofan advanced from Qianshan; rebels were greatly afraid and plotted a tying-down plan, dividing over ten thousand to invade Jiangxi, besiege Guangfeng and Yushan, enter and hold Anren.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan marched from Qianshan. The rebels, alarmed, sent more than ten thousand men into Jiangxi to besiege Guangfeng and Yushan and seize Anren.

sentences.zh: 閩軍遂克光澤，收建陽，解順昌圍，連復松溪、政和、寧化、崇安，破浦城老巢。

translations.literal: Fujian forces then took Guangze, recovered Jianyang, lifted the Shunchang siege, and in succession recovered Songxi, Zhenghe, Ninghua, and Chong'an, breaking the Pucheng old nest.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian troops took Guangze, retook Jianyang, relieved Shunchang, recovered Songxi, Zhenghe, Ninghua, and Chong'an, and broke Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 復邵武府，閩省肅清。

translations.literal: Shaowu Prefecture was recovered; Fujian Province was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Shaowu was retaken and Fujian was cleared.

sentences.zh: 國藩移軍弋陽，親督水陸各軍克復安仁縣城。

translations.literal: Guofan shifted army to Yiyang and personally supervised land and naval forces to recover Anren county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan moved to Yiyang and personally led the retaking of Anren.

sentences.zh: 八月，克吉安，擒偽先鋒李雅鳳、偽丞相翟明海，正法。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Ji'an was taken; false vanguard Li Yafeng and false chancellor Zhai Minghai were captured alive and put to death according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Ji'an fell. The false vanguard Li Yafeng and false chancellor Zhai Minghai were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 江西列城皆復。

translations.literal: Jiangxi's array of cities was all recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's cities were back under imperial control.

sentences.zh: 進攻太湖，前月寇陷廬州，巡撫翁同書告急於續賓，官文以太湖方血戰有功，疏留之。

translations.literal: They advanced the attack on Taihu; the previous month rebels had seized Luzhou; Governor Weng Tongshu urgently appealed to Xubing; Guan Wen, as Taihu was still in bloody battle with merit, memorialized to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed Taihu. Luzhou had fallen the month before; Weng Tongshu begged Xubing for help, and Guan Wen kept him at Taihu.

sentences.zh: 時寇於東岸及楓香鋪、小池驛、東山頭各築營壘，續賓等分段攻城，焚其火藥庫，寇眾駭散，遂克太湖，乘勝抵潛山。

translations.literal: At that time rebels on the east bank and at Fengxiang Shop, Xiaochi Post, and Dongshantou each built fortifications; Xubing and others attacked the city in sections, burned their powder magazine, rebels scattered in alarm, and Taihu was then taken; pressing the advantage they reached Qianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fortified the east bank and key posts. Xubing stormed in sections, blew up their powder magazine, took Taihu, and pushed on to Qianshan.

sentences.zh: 潛山石牌為南北要衝，寇屢集黨與援應，抗我東征之師。

translations.literal: Qianshan Shipai was the north-south vital pass; rebels repeatedly gathered bands for mutual relief, resisting our eastward expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Shipai at Qianshan was a vital pass where rebels repeatedly gathered to block the eastern advance.

sentences.zh: 都興阿等營北門彰法山，馬步並進，寇敗潰，斃七八千，遂復縣城。

translations.literal: Du Xing'a and others encamped at north gate Zhangfa Mountain; cavalry and infantry advanced together; rebels were defeated and collapsed; seven or eight thousand were killed; the county seat was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xing'a camped at Zhangfa Mountain north of the city, attacked with horse and foot, killed seven or eight thousand, and retook the county.

sentences.zh: 我軍分二路平上下石牌老巢。

translations.literal: Our army divided into two routes to pacify the upper and lower Shipai old nests.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces in two columns cleared the upper and lower Shipai strongholds.

sentences.zh: 九月，玉成自潛、太會九洑洲群寇下江浦，伺官軍之虛，疾攻浦口，以冀解金陵之圍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Yucheng from Qianshan and Taihu joined Jiufuzhou bands down Jiangpu, watched for gaps in government forces, swiftly attacked Pukou, hoping to lift the Jinling siege.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yucheng came down from Qianshan and Taihu with Jiufuzhou bands, struck Pukou swiftly, and tried to break the Nanjing siege.

sentences.zh: 我軍進退爭一橋，遂大挫。

translations.literal: Our army contested advance and retreat for one bridge and suffered great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces fought for a single bridge and were badly beaten.

sentences.zh: 和春派兵來援，寇分軍綴之，仍力撲浦口。

translations.literal: He Chun dispatched troops to relieve them; rebels divided forces to delay them and still pressed Pukou hard.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun sent relief, but the rebels delayed it and kept hammering Pukou.

sentences.zh: 江北大營遂失陷。

translations.literal: The Jiangbei grand camp was then lost and fallen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangbei grand camp fell.

sentences.zh: 迭陷江浦、天長、儀徵。

translations.literal: In succession Jiangpu, Tianchang, and Yizheng fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangpu, Tianchang, and Yizheng fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 並分攻六合，德興阿遁。

translations.literal: They also divided forces to attack Liuhe; De Xing'a fled.
translations.idiomatic: They also attacked Liuhe, and De Xing'a fled.

sentences.zh: 揚州賊破南門入，揚州陷。

translations.literal: Yangzhou bandits broke through the south gate and entered; Yangzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels broke through Yangzhou's south gate and took the city.

sentences.zh: 進犯邵伯縣，國樑率軍渡江。

translations.literal: They advanced to invade Shaobo county; Guoliang led troops across the river.
translations.idiomatic: They raided Shaobo county, and Guoliang crossed the river with troops.

sentences.zh: 會北軍克復府城，移攻儀徵，亦克之。

translations.literal: Just then northern forces recovered the prefectural city, shifted attack to Yizheng, and also took it.
translations.idiomatic: Northern forces retook the prefectural city and then Yizheng.

sentences.zh: 亟引兵救六合，阻於寇，不得驟進。

translations.literal: They urgently led troops to save Liuhe but were blocked by rebels and could not advance quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang hurried to relieve Liuhe but was blocked and could not advance quickly.

sentences.zh: 寇穿地道陷城，補用道溫紹原赴水死。

translations.literal: Rebels tunneled through and the city fell; Acting Circuit Intendant Wen Shaoyuan went to his death in the water.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels mined the walls and took the city. Acting Intendant Wen Shaoyuan drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 寇渡江陷溧水，築壘江藍埠諸處，為扼要持久計。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the river and seized Lishui, building fortifications at Jiang Lanbu and other places as a plan to hold key points long.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels crossed the river, took Lishui, and fortified Jiang Lanbu and other points for a long hold.

sentences.zh: 十月，和春遣總兵張玉良攻復溧水。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, He Chun dispatched Brigadier Zhang Yuliang to attack and recover Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month He Chun sent Brigadier Zhang Yuliang to retake Lishui.

sentences.zh: 寇夾攻高古山大營，國樑怒馬陷陣，斃寇五六千。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked on both sides at Gaogushan grand camp; Guoliang charged in fury, killing five or six thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck the Gaogushan camp from both sides. Guoliang charged in rage and killed five or six thousand.

sentences.zh: 合兵追抵江寧鎮，燬卡壁數十座。

translations.literal: Combined forces pursued to Jiangning Town and destroyed several tens of stockades and barriers.
translations.idiomatic: Combined forces pursued to Jiangning Town and destroyed dozens of stockades.

sentences.zh: 小丹陽以至采石磯老巢悉平。

translations.literal: From Xiaodanyang to the Caishi Ji old nest was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: From Xiaodanyang to Caishi the old rebel nests were cleared.

sentences.zh: 初，勝保率皖軍攻天長，捻首李昭壽以部眾二千降，勝保奏請賞給花翎三品銜，賜名世忠，使為內應，遂克縣城。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sheng Bao led Anhui army to attack Tianchang; Nian chief Li Zhaoshou surrendered with over two thousand followers; Sheng Bao memorialized to reward him with peacock feather and third-rank title, bestowed the name Shizhong, and made him an inside collaborator, and the county seat was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Sheng Bao attacked Tianchang. Nian chief Li Zhaoshou surrendered with two thousand men, was given the name Shizhong and third rank, served as an inside man, and Tianchang fell.

sentences.zh: 大軍之入皖也，克復桐城、舒城二縣，寇悉遁三河。

translations.literal: When the great army entered Anhui, Tongcheng and Shucheng two counties were recovered; rebels all fled to Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Anhui, imperial forces retook Tongcheng and Shucheng; rebels fled to Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 都興阿會水師盡掃安慶城外寇壘。

translations.literal: Du Xing'a joined the naval force and swept clean all outer rebel fortifications outside Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xing'a and the fleet cleared the outer works around Anqing.

sentences.zh: 續賓追至三河，玉成、秀成、侍賢連江浦、六合、廬江眾，又乞援捻匪，招潁、壽、光州群盜，合十餘萬，圍官軍三重，眾寡不能敵，續賓死之。

translations.literal: Xubing pursued to Sanhe; Yucheng, Xiucheng, and Shixian linked Jiangpu, Liuhe, and Lujiang masses, also begged Nian relief, recruited bandits of Ying, Shou, and Guangzhou, totaling over one hundred thousand, encircled government troops in three rings; numbers could not be matched; Xubing died.
translations.idiomatic: Xubing pursued to Sanhe. Yucheng, Xiucheng, and Shixian joined with Jiangpu, Liuhe, and Lujiang forces, called in Nian bands, and massed more than one hundred thousand to trap the imperial army in three rings. Outnumbered, Xubing was killed.

sentences.zh: 潰軍至桐城，前留防四城軍潰，不旬日，桐、舒、潛、太復陷。

translations.literal: Routed troops reached Tongcheng; the four-city garrison left behind collapsed; within ten days Tong, Shu, Qian, and Tai fell again.
translations.idiomatic: The broken force reached Tongcheng; the rear garrison collapsed, and within ten days Tongcheng, Shucheng, Qianshan, and Taihu were lost again.

sentences.zh: 都興阿收潰卒，由石牌駐軍宿松，進剿黃泥營寇眾，敗之；

translations.literal: Du Xing'a gathered routed soldiers, stationed at Susong by Shipai, advanced to suppress Huangni Camp rebels, and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: Du Xing'a gathered survivors, held Susong at Shipai, beat the Huangni Camp rebels,

sentences.zh: 復督鮑超、多隆阿大戰荊橋、陳家大屋，平三十餘壘，軍勢復振。

translations.literal: again supervised Bao Chao and Dolonga in great battle at Jingqiao and Chenjia Dawu, leveling over thirty fortifications, and military momentum revived.
translations.idiomatic: and with Bao Chao and Dolonga won a great victory at Jingqiao and Chenjia Dawu, leveling more than thirty forts.

sentences.zh: 玉成退還太湖，以為舒、桐已得而宿松不破，則安慶之守不固，與秀成謀再舉。

translations.literal: Yucheng retreated to Taihu, holding that with Shu and Tong already taken, if Susong were not broken then Anqing's defense would not be firm; he plotted with Xiucheng to strike again.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng fell back to Taihu. With Shucheng and Tongcheng taken, he argued Susong must fall before Anqing could be held, and planned another stroke with Xiucheng.

sentences.zh: 秀成知不可敵，不欲從，而玉成屢言有妙策，始與分道來犯，卒受大創而退。

translations.literal: Xiucheng knew they could not be opposed and did not wish to follow, but Yucheng repeatedly said he had clever plans and at last divided routes to invade, yet in the end suffered great wounds and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng knew the odds were bad and hesitated, but Yucheng insisted he had a clever plan. They attacked on separate routes and were badly beaten back.

sentences.zh: 玉成留軍太湖，而自還安慶。

translations.literal: Yucheng left troops at Taihu and himself returned to Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng left a garrison at Taihu and returned to Anqing.

sentences.zh: 秀成率黨還巢縣、黃山。

translations.literal: Xiucheng led bands back to Chaoxian and Huangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng led his followers back to Chaoxian and Huangshan.

sentences.zh: 是時江西寇復闌入閩界，蹂將樂縣，並陷浦城、永吉、建陽、順昌、寧化、長汀等城。

translations.literal: At that time Jiangxi rebels again crossed into Fujian, trampled Jiangle county, and also seized Pucheng, Yongji, Jianyang, Shunchang, Ninghua, Changting, and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels crossed into Fujian again, ravaged Jiangle, and took Pucheng, Yongji, Jianyang, Shunchang, Ninghua, Changting, and more.

sentences.zh: 國藩入閩，軍建昌。

translations.literal: Guofan entered Fujian and encamped at Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan entered Fujian and camped at Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 諸陷城以次復。

translations.literal: Fallen cities were recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Lost cities were retaken one by one.

sentences.zh: 寇復竄回江西，惟連城尚聚萬餘，復陷景德、東流，謀竄湖口、九江等處。

translations.literal: Rebels again fled back to Jiangxi; only Liancheng still gathered over ten thousand; they again seized Jingde and Dongliu, plotting to flee to Hukou, Jiujiang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled back to Jiangxi. Liancheng still held more than ten thousand, and they retook Jingde and Dongliu, threatening Hukou and Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 國藩檄調道員張運蘭倍道馳赴景德鎮，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Guofan ordered Circuit Intendant Zhang Yunlan to hurry by forced marches to Jingdezhen; repeated battles were all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan ordered Zhang Yunlan to rush to Jingdezhen and win a string of engagements.

sentences.zh: 初，寇踞景德鎮，勢燄薰熾，江右要衝之區，恣行無阻。

translations.literal: Earlier, rebels holding Jingdezhen had momentum blazing fierce; it was a vital district of Jiangyou and they marched without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdezhen had been a blazing rebel stronghold on a vital Jiangxi corridor.

sentences.zh: 國藩添派其弟國荃率湘軍五千八百赴鎮，助運蘭攻剿。

translations.literal: Guofan additionally dispatched his younger brother Guoquan leading five thousand eight hundred Xiang troops to the town to aid Yunlan in attack and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan sent his brother Guoquan with 5,800 Xiang troops to reinforce Yunlan.

sentences.zh: 寇夜襲艇師劉于淳，燃火彈拋燒簰卡無數。

translations.literal: Rebels raided by night the boat division under Liu Yuchun, igniting fire bombs and throwing them to burn countless raft stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels night-attacked Liu Yuchun's boats with fire bombs and burned countless raft barriers.

sentences.zh: 寇棄鎮竄浮梁，國荃等水陸進攻，復浮梁。

translations.literal: Rebels abandoned the town and fled to Fuliang; Guoquan and others advanced by land and water and recovered Fuliang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned Jingdezhen for Fuliang; Guoquan retook Fuliang by land and water.

sentences.zh: 寇走建德北去，江西稍定。

translations.literal: Rebels fled north from Jiande; Jiangxi was somewhat settled.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled north from Jiande, and Jiangxi calmed somewhat.

sentences.zh: 十一月，江南大營援軍直隸通永鎮總兵戴文英戰死寧國灣沚。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jiangnan Grand Camp relief army Zhili Tongyong Town Brigadier Dai Wenying died in battle at Ningguo Wanzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Brigadier Dai Wenying of the Jiangnan relief force was killed at Ningguo Wanzi.

sentences.zh: 次日，幫辦皖南軍務浙江提督鄧紹良，大營陷，死之。

translations.literal: The next day, Assistant Commander of South Anhui forces and Zhejiang Commander-in-Chief Deng Shaoliang's grand camp fell and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Assistant Commander Deng Shaoliang's camp fell and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 寧郡設防三百餘里，皆鄰寇巢，近則蕪湖、青陽、繁昌、銅陵，遠則無為、和州、滁州，渡江即至。

translations.literal: Ning Prefecture's defenses stretched over three hundred li, all neighboring rebel nests—near were Wuhu, Qingyang, Fanchang, and Tongling; far were Wuwei, Hezhou, and Chuzhou; crossing the river they arrived at once.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Prefecture's three-hundred-li defense line faced rebel nests from Wuhu and Tongling nearby to Wuwei, Hezhou, and Chuzhou across the river.

sentences.zh: 而祿口、秣陵、溧水敗寇，勾合太平金柱關、東西梁山黨眾，潛山、太湖、舒、桐及樅陽土橋敗黨，皆以寧國為通藪；

translations.literal: Meanwhile defeated rebels at Lukou, Moling, and Lishui colluded with Taiping Jinzhuguan and east-west Liangshan bands; defeated bands of Qianshan, Taihu, Shu, Tong, and Zongyang Tuqiao all used Ningguo as a thoroughfare;
translations.idiomatic: Defeated rebels at Lukou, Moling, and Lishui joined Taiping and Liangshan bands, while broken forces from Qianshan, Taihu, and Zongyang used Ningguo as their corridor.

sentences.zh: 防軍僅七千有奇，又多調援他處，寇眾兵單，故及於敗。

translations.literal: defense troops numbered only a little over seven thousand, and many were transferred elsewhere to relieve other places; rebels were numerous and troops few, hence the defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Only a little over seven thousand defenders remained, many detached elsewhere—too few against too many.

sentences.zh: 國藩疏陳目前緩急，宜先攻景德鎮，保全湖口，上是其議。

translations.literal: Guofan memorialized on present urgency and ease, holding that Jingdezhen should be attacked first to preserve Hukou; the Emperor approved his plan.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan argued that Jingdezhen must be taken first to hold Hukou, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼先以丁母憂回籍，會三河變起，朝旨迫起督師，十二月，渡江駐黃州。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi had earlier returned home on account of mourning for his mother; when the Sanhe crisis arose, court edicts urgently recalled him to supervise the army; in the twelfth month he crossed the river and encamped at Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi had gone home to mourn his mother, but after Sanhe the court recalled him. In the twelfth month he crossed the river and camped at Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 時寇之踞南安者有五支：一為偽翼府宰制陳亨容、傅忠信、何名標，一為偽渠帥蕭壽璜、蔡次賢，一為偽尚書周竹坡，一為偽軍略賴裕發，一為偽承宣劉逸才、張遂謀，眾七八萬，將由南康犯贛州，築偽城於新墟，設卡壘，踞村莊，綿亙二十餘里。

translations.literal: Rebels holding Nan'an had five columns: one the false Wing Mansion controllers Chen Hengrong, Fu Zhongxin, and He Mingbiao; one the false chieftains Xiao Shouhuang and Cai Cixian; one the false minister Zhou Zhupo; one the false strategist Lai Yufa; one the false herald Liu Yicai and Zhang Suimou—seventy or eighty thousand in all—about to invade Ganzhou from Nankang, building a false city at Xinxu with stockades and villages held for over twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Five rebel columns held Nan'an under false leaders including Chen Hengrong, Fu Zhongxin, He Mingbiao, Xiao Shouhuang, Cai Cixian, Zhou Zhupo, Lai Yufa, and Liu Yicai and Zhang Suimou—some seventy or eighty thousand men—preparing to strike Ganzhou from Nankang from a twenty-li belt of forts at Xinxu.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，國藩檄蕭啟江設伏赤石塘，敗寇，克新墟，進破南康池江、小溪、鳳凰城、長江墟寇壘，並克崇義、南安，進解信豐之圍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, Guofan ordered Xiao Qijiang to set an ambush at Chishitang, defeated rebels, took Xinxu, advanced to break Nan'an Chijiang, Xiaoxi, Fenghuang City, and Changjiangxu rebel fortifications, and also took Chongyi and Nan'an, advancing to relieve the siege of Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year's first month Guofan had Xiao Qijiang ambush rebels at Chishitang, take Xinxu, break a chain of Nan'an forts, retake Chongyi and Nan'an, and relieve Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 二月，江浦薛三元獻城降，進克浦口，陣斬偽天福洪方、偽立天豫莫興。

translations.literal: In the second month, Jiangpu's Xue Sanyuan surrendered the city; they advanced to take Pukou and slew in battle the false Heavenly Blessing Hong Fang and false Standing Heaven Yu Mo Xing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Xue Sanyuan of Jiangpu surrendered; imperial forces took Pukou and killed the false Heavenly Blessing Hong Fang and false Standing Heaven Yu Mo Xing.

sentences.zh: 寇覘李世忠擊高旺，乘虛再陷浦口。

translations.literal: Rebels watched Li Shizhong attack Gaowang, exploited the opening, and again seized Pukou.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Li Shizhong attack Gaowang, rebels slipped back in and retook Pukou.

sentences.zh: 世忠回軍再克之，浦口肅清。

translations.literal: Shizhong returned his army and again took it; Pukou was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong marched back and retook Pukou, clearing the route.

sentences.zh: 李秀成急率悍賊七八萬來犯，踞烏衣鎮汊河。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng urgently led seventy or eighty thousand fierce rebels to invade and held Wuyi Town and Chahe.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng rushed in with seventy or eighty thousand elite rebels and held Wuyi and Chahe.

sentences.zh: 秀成復要陳玉成自廬州來援。

translations.literal: Xiucheng again asked Chen Yucheng to come from Luzhou to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng again summoned Chen Yucheng from Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 烏衣鎮屬滁州、江浦交界鎖鑰，寇意在斷絕浦營餉道，為張國樑擊敗。

translations.literal: Wuyi Town belonged to the Chuzhou-Jiangpu border key; rebels intended to cut off the Pukou camp supply route and were defeated by Zhang Guoliang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyi, on the Chuzhou-Jiangpu border, was meant to sever Pukou's supply line until Zhang Guoliang defeated the attempt.

sentences.zh: 寇與閩、浙餘寇皆趨郴、桂，所謂石達開三十萬眾後圍寶慶者也。

translations.literal: Rebels with Fujian and Zhejiang remnants all headed to Chen and Gui—the so-called three hundred thousand of Shi Dakai later besieging Baoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels and Fujian-Zhejiang remnants moved toward Chenzhou and Guilin—the force later said to be Shi Dakai's three hundred thousand around Baoxing.

sentences.zh: 玉成由六合犯廬州，布政使李孟羣被執，不屈，死之。

translations.literal: Yucheng from Liuhe invaded Luzhou; Provincial Administration Commissioner Li Mengqun was seized, refused to submit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng invaded Luzhou from Liuhe. Li Mengqun was captured, refused to yield, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月，糾安慶黨圍撲定遠護城營，築堅壘數十以困我師。

translations.literal: In the third month, they rallied Anqing bands to besiege and assault the Dingyuan garrison camp, building several tens of firm fortifications to trap our army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they rallied Anqing rebels, besieged the Dingyuan garrison, and built dozens of strong forts.

sentences.zh: 勝保襲破其壘，秀成東走，而黨眾日增。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao raided and broke their fortifications; Xiucheng fled east while rebel numbers daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao stormed the forts. Xiucheng fled east, but rebel numbers kept growing.

sentences.zh: 國樑於定遠縣西築十里長牆禦之，其北路自九里山至浦口，三四十里，寇壘殆遍。

translations.literal: Guoliang built a ten-li long wall west of Dingyuan county to defend against them; the northern route from Jiuli Mountain to Pukou for thirty or forty li was nearly covered with rebel fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang built a ten-li wall west of Dingyuan. Rebel forts lined the thirty- to forty-li route from Jiuli Mountain to Pukou.

sentences.zh: 我軍日戰，副將鄭朝棟、張占魁皆歿於陣。

translations.literal: Our army fought daily; Vice Commanders Zheng Chaodong and Zhang Zhankui both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting was daily. Vice Commanders Zheng Chaodong and Zhang Zhankui were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 時浦口後路滁州、來安皆困於寇。

translations.literal: At that time Pukou's rear route through Chuzhou and Lai'an was both trapped by rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Chuzhou and Lai'an, the rear routes to Pukou, were both under pressure.

sentences.zh: 世忠自浦口繞道回援勝保，撤烏衣汊口防軍還定遠，其地復為寇踞。

translations.literal: Shizhong from Pukou made a detour to relieve Sheng Bao, withdrew the Wuyi Chakou garrison back to Dingyuan, and that place was again held by rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong detoured from Pukou to aid Sheng Bao, pulled the Wuyi garrison back to Dingyuan, and rebels reoccupied the ground.

sentences.zh: 和春慮江北軍單，遣馮子材渡江援應。

translations.literal: He Chun, fearing Jiangbei forces were too few, sent Feng Zicai across the river to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing Jiangbei was too weak, He Chun sent Feng Zicai across the river.

sentences.zh: 玉成度江浦、浦口未可力爭，分黨援六合；

translations.literal: Yucheng judged Jiangpu and Pukou could not be taken by force and divided bands to aid Liuhe;
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng saw Jiangpu and Pukou could not be forced and sent detachments to Liuhe;

sentences.zh: 又謀趨天長、揚州，渡江攻南營後路，並襲北營。

translations.literal: he also plotted to hurry to Tianchang and Yangzhou, cross the river to attack the southern camp's rear, and also raid the northern camp.
translations.idiomatic: he also planned to strike Tianchang and Yangzhou, cross the river against the southern camp's rear, and hit the northern camp.

sentences.zh: 於是寇眾四五萬東趨六合，蔓延來安、盱眙諸境。

translations.literal: Thus forty or fifty thousand rebels marched east toward Liuhe, spreading through Lai'an and Xuyi territory.
translations.idiomatic: Some forty or fifty thousand rebels marched east on Liuhe and spread through Lai'an and Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 四月，玉成圍揚州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Yucheng besieged Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Yucheng besieged Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 提督德安擊寇天長，失利，歿於陣。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief De'an attacked rebels at Tianchang, fared ill, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief De'an fought at Tianchang, was beaten, and killed.

sentences.zh: 勝保率軍進戰石梁，互有死傷，還屯舊鋪，扼盱眙前路捍北犯。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao led the army to battle at Shiliang; both sides suffered casualties; he returned to encamp at Jiupu, blocking the Xuyi front route to guard against northern invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao fought at Shiliang with heavy losses, then held Jiupu to block the Xuyi approach from the north.

sentences.zh: 駐汊澗軍為寇困，先後突圍出。

translations.literal: The army stationed at Chajian was trapped by rebels and broke out of the encirclement in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Chajian garrison was trapped and broke out in succession.

sentences.zh: 和春遣張玉良、安勇分六合軍赴防揚州，以固清、淮門戶。

translations.literal: He Chun dispatched Zhang Yuliang and An Yong to divide Liuhe forces to defend Yangzhou and secure the Qing and Huai gateway.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun sent Zhang Yuliang and An Yong to hold Yangzhou and guard the Qing-Huai corridor.

sentences.zh: 時池州、青陽寇逼石硊，窺灣沚。

translations.literal: At that time Chizhou and Qingyang rebels pressed Shizui and eyed Wanzi.
translations.idiomatic: Chizhou and Qingyang rebels pressed Shizui and threatened Wanzi.

sentences.zh: 當塗、蕪湖寇分壁青山、亭頭逼黃池。

translations.literal: Dangtu and Wuhu rebels divided forces at Qingshan and Tingtou to press Huangchi.
translations.idiomatic: Dangtu and Wuhu rebels pressed Huangchi from Qingshan and Tingtou.

sentences.zh: 我軍敗盱眙、汊澗及天長寇，天長寇分竄六合，並踞儀徵江干東溝，圖撲紅山窯。

translations.literal: Our army defeated rebels at Xuyi, Chajian, and Tianchang; Tianchang rebels split and fled to Liuhe and also held Yizheng's east-gorge on the river, plotting to strike Hongshan Kiln.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces beat rebels at Xuyi, Chajian, and Tianchang. Tianchang bands fled to Liuhe and seized Yizheng's east bank, threatening Hongshan Kiln.

sentences.zh: 其地距六合二十里，旁通瓜埠，為大營餉道咽喉。

translations.literal: The place was twenty li from Liuhe, connected to Guabu, and was the throat of the grand camp's supply route.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty li from Liuhe and linked to Guabu, it was the lifeline of the grand camp's supplies.

sentences.zh: 五月，鞠殿華督軍破平六合東路王子廟、太平集寇壘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Ju Dianhua supervised the army in breaking and pacifying Liuhe east-route Wangzi Temple and Taipingji rebel fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Ju Dianhua cleared rebel forts at Wangzi Temple and Taipingji on Liuhe's east route.

sentences.zh: 初，六合、儀徵連界二十里，寇壘四十餘，阻糧道。

translations.literal: Earlier, Liuhe and Yizheng bordered each other for twenty li with over forty rebel fortifications blocking the grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Liuhe and Yizheng had shared a twenty-li front with more than forty rebel forts choking supplies.

sentences.zh: 至是六合廓清。

translations.literal: By then Liuhe was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: By then Liuhe was cleared.

sentences.zh: 時六合以北、天長以南，寇麇集數萬，餉道危急，由烏家集繞犯各軍之背，世忠退保滁、來。

translations.literal: At that time north of Liuhe and south of Tianchang rebels gathered in tens of thousands; the supply route was critical; they circled around Wujiaji to strike the rear of each army; Shizhong retreated to secure Chuzhou and Lai'an.
translations.idiomatic: North of Liuhe and south of Tianchang tens of thousands of rebels threatened the supply line, struck from Wujiaji, and drove Shizhong back to Chuzhou and Lai'an.

sentences.zh: 寇趨舊鋪，直犯盱眙，圍勝保於桑樹，都興阿力戰解之。

translations.literal: Rebels hurried to Jiupu and pressed straight on Xuyi, besieging Sheng Bao at Sangshu; Du Xing'a fought hard to relieve him.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels rushed Jiupu and pressed Xuyi, trapping Sheng Bao at Sangshu until Du Xing'a fought through.

sentences.zh: 尋舊鋪寇犯紅子橋，勝保及穆騰阿馳援，而寇已分犯盱眙，盱眙故無城，倉猝遂失。

translations.literal: Soon Jiupu rebels attacked Hongzi Bridge; Sheng Bao and Mu Teng'a hurried to relieve, but rebels had already divided to invade Xuyi; Xuyi originally had no wall and was lost in haste.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Hongzi Bridge. Sheng Bao and Mu Teng'a hurried over, but other columns took wall-less Xuyi in the confusion.

sentences.zh: 六月，勝保攻克盱眙，追創之磨臍、天台諸山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Sheng Bao took Xuyi and pursued wounded rebels at Mojiao, Tiantai, and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Sheng Bao retook Xuyi and pursued broken rebels into the Mojiao and Tiantai hills.

sentences.zh: 揚州諸軍安勇等聞天長寇回竄六合，赴儀徵截擊，大破於沙河、大小銅山。

translations.literal: Yangzhou forces under An Yong and others, hearing Tianchang rebels had fled back toward Liuhe, went to Yizheng to intercept and greatly defeated them at Shahe and large and small Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: An Yong and other Yangzhou troops intercepted Tianchang rebels fleeing toward Liuhe and routed them at Shahe and the Tongshan hills.

sentences.zh: 玉成憤甚，圖報復，率死黨攻來安。

translations.literal: Yucheng was greatly enraged and plotted revenge, leading dare-to-die troops to attack Lai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Yucheng led his shock troops against Lai'an.

sentences.zh: 世忠守城，伏壯勇於兩門外，自督軍衝入寇營。

translations.literal: Shizhong defended the city, hid brave men outside both gates, and personally supervised the army charging into rebel camps.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong held the city, hid troops outside the gates, and led a charge into the rebel camp.

sentences.zh: 寇乘虛襲城，伏起攔擊，世忠返隊夾攻，寇大敗，夜走滁州。

translations.literal: Rebels exploited the opening to raid the city; ambush troops rose to intercept; Shizhong returned his column in pincer attack; rebels were greatly defeated and fled by night to Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels tried to rush the walls; ambushers rose, Shizhong wheeled back, and the rebels fled by night to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 世忠由水口焚燒寇壘，寇大潰，糾合捻匪圍定遠，再敗再進，我軍眾寡不敵，遂失陷。

translations.literal: Shizhong from the water mouth burned rebel fortifications; rebels collapsed in great rout, colluded with Nian to besiege Dingyuan, were defeated and advanced again; our army could not match numbers and the place was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong burned rebel camps at the water mouth. The rebels rallied with Nian bands, took Dingyuan after repeated blows, and outnumbered imperial troops.

sentences.zh: 七月，玉成率死黨攻來安，犯滁州，世忠擊之，稍卻；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Yucheng led dare-to-die troops to attack Lai'an and invade Chuzhou; Shizhong struck them and they fell back slightly;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yucheng struck Lai'an and Chuzhou. Shizhong beat him back;

sentences.zh: 尋復糾眾圍來安，並分屯城西北卓家巢等處，寇壘幾遍。

translations.literal: soon he again rallied masses to besiege Lai'an and also divided encampments northwest of the city at Zhuojia Chao and other places; rebel fortifications were nearly everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: then Yucheng besieged Lai'an again and ringed the northwest with forts.

sentences.zh: 世忠偵寇志已驕，潛伏兵挑戰，偽敗，寇笑官軍怯；

translations.literal: Shizhong, detecting rebel morale was already arrogant, hid troops and offered challenge, feigning defeat; rebels laughed that government troops were cowardly;
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong saw the rebels growing arrogant, sent out a challenge, and feigned defeat.

sentences.zh: 而世忠又環譟之，寇不為意，惟槍聲絕續作備而已。

translations.literal: Shizhong also surrounded them with shouts; rebels paid no heed, only making desultory gunfire as preparation.
translations.idiomatic: He surrounded them with shouts while they fired only sporadically.

sentences.zh: 世忠驟起鳴角而前，火其營，破二十八壘。

translations.literal: Shizhong suddenly rose, sounded horns, and advanced, setting fire to their camps and breaking twenty-eight fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong suddenly sounded the horn, charged, burned the camps, and took twenty-eight forts.

sentences.zh: 會勝保解其圍，世忠還滁州。

translations.literal: Just then Sheng Bao lifted the siege; Shizhong returned to Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao relieved the siege and Shizhong returned to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，敗寇西竄陷霍山，江長貴等擊敗太平郭邨、宏潭踞寇，尋竄石埭，陷烏石壠，防營游擊黃金祥退屯楊谿河。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, defeated rebels fled west and seized Huoshan; Jiang Changgui and others defeated Taiping Guo Village and Hongtan rebels; soon they fled to Shiling, seized Wushilong; Garrison Commander Huang Jinxiang retreated to encamp at Yangxi River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month broken rebels took Huoshan. Jiang Changgui beat Taiping bands at Guo Village and Hongtan; others seized Wushilong and drove Huang Jinxiang to Yangxi River.

sentences.zh: 自去歲三河失陷，寇造偽城高二丈餘，砲眼星列，環以深壕，樁籤密布，與太湖互相援應，兼通糧道。

translations.literal: Since last year's fall at Sanhe, rebels built a false city over two zhang high, gun ports like stars, ringed with deep moats and dense stakes, mutually supporting Taihu and also connecting the grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Since Sanhe, rebels had built a two-zhang false city with star-like gun ports, deep moats, stakes, links to Taihu, and open supply lines.

sentences.zh: 石牌鎮隸安徽懷寧，當宿、望、潛、太之交，為由皖入楚要衝。

translations.literal: Shipai Town was under Anhui Huaining, at the junction of Susong, Wangjiang, Qianshan, and Taihu, the vital pass from Anhui into Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Shipai in Huaining stood where Susong, Wangjiang, Qianshan, and Taihu met—the gateway from Anhui into Hubei.

sentences.zh: 官文以偽城不拔，終礙東征，乃令多隆阿統馬步軍會攻，拔偽城，擊斬霍天燕、石廷玉等四十七名，並拒敗潛山、安慶援寇。

translations.literal: Guan Wen, because the false city could not be taken and ultimately obstructed the eastern expedition, ordered Dolonga to command cavalry and infantry in joint attack, took the false city, killed in battle forty-seven including Huo Tianyan and Shi Tingyu, and also repelled and defeated Qianshan and Anqing relief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen ordered Dolonga to take the false city, killed forty-seven including Huo Tianyan and Shi Tingyu, and beat back Qianshan and Anqing relief.

sentences.zh: 偽顧王吳如孝者，寇之最悍者也，自鎮江逸出，至皖北，糾捻沿淮肆擾；

translations.literal: The false Prince Gu Wu Ruxiao was among the fiercest rebels; escaping from Zhenjiang he reached north Anhui and rallied Nian along the Huai to rampage;
translations.idiomatic: The false Prince Gu, Wu Ruxiao, among the fiercest rebels, fled from Zhenjiang to north Anhui and stirred Nian raids along the Huai;

sentences.zh: 尋撲盱眙之清壩，為格蘭額等槍斃，斷其首。

translations.literal: soon he struck Qingba of Xuyi and was shot dead by Gelan'e and others; his head was severed.
translations.idiomatic: he then struck Qingba at Xuyi and was shot dead by Gelan'e; his head was taken.

sentences.zh: 眾南潰，九月，擾霍山下符橋。

translations.literal: The masses fled south; in the ninth month they harassed Huoshan below Xifu Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: His followers fled south. In the ninth month they raided Huoshan below Xifu Bridge.

sentences.zh: 六安防軍盧又熊等擊敗之，破毛坦廠寇壘，而廬州、安慶寇同犯六安，乃引軍還盱眙。

translations.literal: Lu'an garrison Lu Youxiong and others defeated them, broke Maotan Factory rebel fortifications, but Luzhou and Anqing rebels together invaded Lu'an, so they led troops back to Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Youxiong beat them and broke Maotan Factory, but Luzhou and Anqing rebels invaded Lu'an and forced a return to Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 天長寇犯揚州，參將艾得勝、雙喜等敗死司徒廟。

translations.literal: Tianchang rebels invaded Yangzhou; Regiment Commanders Ai Desheng and Shuangxi and others were defeated and died at Sitiao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang rebels struck Yangzhou. Regiment Commanders Ai Desheng and Shuangxi were killed at Sitiao Temple.

sentences.zh: 玉成率大股自甘泉山西竄儀徵陳板橋，進援六合，圍李若珠壘。

translations.literal: Yucheng led a great column from west of Ganquan Mountain fleeing to Yizheng Chenbanqiao, advanced to relieve Liuhe, and besieged Li Ruozhu's fortification.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng marched from Ganquan toward Yizheng, relieved Liuhe, and besieged Li Ruozhu.

sentences.zh: 馮子材禦之失利，退屯段要口。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai met them and fared ill, retreating to encamp at Duanyaokou.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai met them, was beaten, and fell back to Duanyaokou.

sentences.zh: 寇踞紅山窯，斷李若珠營後路，餉運不通。

translations.literal: Rebels held Hongshan Kiln, cut Li Ruozhu's camp rear route, and supply transport could not pass.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Hongshan Kiln, cut Li Ruozhu's rear, and supplies stopped.

sentences.zh: 十月，若珠自八埠牆、陳家集潰圍出，中數創，退屯揚州，死傷馬步軍二千八百餘人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Ruozhu broke out of encirclement from Babuqiang and Chenjiaji, suffered several wounds, retreated to encamp at Yangzhou; cavalry and infantry dead and wounded numbered over twenty-eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Ruozhu broke out at Babuqiang and Chenjiaji, was wounded, withdrew to Yangzhou, and lost more than twenty-eight hundred men.

sentences.zh: 石埭夏邨寇分股糾青陽寇萬餘，竄踞涇縣查邨，防軍副將石玉龍敗死南山嶺。

translations.literal: Shiling Xia Village rebels divided forces and colluded with over ten thousand Qingyang rebels, fled to hold Jing county Zhachun; Garrison Vice Commander Shi Yulong was defeated and died at Nanshan Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Shiling rebels joined ten thousand Qingyang men at Zhachun in Jing. Vice Commander Shi Yulong was killed at Nanshan Ridge.

sentences.zh: 適周天受至自寧國，督天孚等力擊之，寇退還查邨。

translations.literal: Just then Zhou Tianshou arrived from Ningguo and supervised Tianfu and others in hard fighting; rebels retreated to Zhachun.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianshou came from Ningguo, fought hard, and drove the rebels back to Zhachun.

sentences.zh: 王浚破平陶美鎮寇壘，陣斬偽丞相孫瑞亨，鎮距秣陵關二十餘里。

translations.literal: Wang Jun broke and pacified Taomei Town rebel fortifications and slew in battle the false chancellor Sun Ruiheng; the town was over twenty li from Moling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun cleared Taomei and killed the false chancellor Sun Ruiheng twenty li from Moling Pass.

sentences.zh: 盧又熊克霍山，寇自太平、蕪湖犯寧國，陷黃池，高州鎮總兵蕭知音敗退新豐鎮。

translations.literal: Lu Youxiong took Huoshan; rebels from Taiping and Wuhu invaded Ningguo, seized Huangchi; Gaozhou Town Commander-in-Chief Xiao Zhiyin was defeated and retreated to Xinfeng Town.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Youxiong took Huoshan. Taiping and Wuhu rebels took Huangchi and drove Xiao Zhiyin to Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 玉成及秀成自天長、六合糾大股窺伺江浦，分屯南北兩岸。

translations.literal: Yucheng and Xiucheng from Tianchang and Liuhe rallied a great column to spy on Jiangpu, dividing encampments on north and south banks.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng and Xiucheng massed at Tianchang and Liuhe and probed Jiangpu from both banks.

sentences.zh: 張國樑渡江遣水師破壽德州寇壘，水師曹秉忠破六合、紅山窯、瓜埠寇七壘，彭常宣敗寇於儀徵泗源溝。

translations.literal: Zhang Guoliang crossed the river and dispatched the naval force to break Shoude Prefecture rebel fortifications; Naval Commander Cao Bingzhong broke seven Liuhe, Hongshan Kiln, and Guabu rebel fortifications; Peng Changxuan defeated rebels at Yizheng Siyuangou.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang sent the fleet to break Shoude forts. Cao Bingzhong took seven forts at Liuhe, Hongshan Kiln, and Guabu. Peng Changxuan won at Siyuangou.

sentences.zh: 時寇眾悉踞揚州西北，尋陷江浦防軍壘，周天培死之，大軍退保江浦。

translations.literal: At that time rebel masses all held northwest Yangzhou; soon they seized Jiangpu garrison fortifications; Zhou Tianpei died; the great army retreated to secure Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held northwest Yangzhou, took Jiangpu's forts, killed Zhou Tianpei, and forced the army back to Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 寇乘勢東伺揚、儀，西逼江浦，南窺溧水，勢復熾。

translations.literal: Rebels took advantage to spy east on Yang and Yi, press west on Jiangpu, and peek south at Lishui; momentum revived.
translations.idiomatic: They eyed Yangzhou and Yizheng to the east, Jiangpu to the west, and Lishui to the south, and momentum revived.

sentences.zh: 寇自洪、楊內亂，鎮江克復，秀全兇燄久衰，徒以陳玉成往來江北，句結捻匪，擾廬州、浦口、三河等處，迭挫我師。

translations.literal: Since the Hong and Yang internal strife, Zhenjiang was recovered, and Xiucheng's fierce flame had long declined; only because Chen Yucheng traveled back and forth north of the river, colluded with Nian, and harassed Luzhou, Pukou, Sanhe, and other places did he repeatedly defeat our armies.
translations.idiomatic: After the Hong and Yang purges and Zhenjiang's recovery, Xiucheng's power had faded, but Chen Yucheng shuttled north of the river, allied with Nian bands, and repeatedly beat imperial forces at Luzhou, Pukou, and Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 曾國藩以為廓清諸路，必先攻破江寧；

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan held that to clear all routes one must first storm Jiangning;
translations.idiomatic: Guofan argued that clearing the region required taking Nanjing first;

sentences.zh: 欲破江寧，必先駐重兵於滁、和，而後可去江寧之外屏，斷蕪湖之糧道。

translations.literal: to storm Jiangning one must first station heavy troops at Chuzhou and Hezhou, and only then could one remove Jiangning's outer screen and cut Wuhu's grain route.
translations.idiomatic: to take Nanjing required heavy forces at Chuzhou and He county to strip its outer defenses and sever Wuhu's grain route.

sentences.zh: 欲駐滁、和，必先圍安慶，以破陳玉成之老巢，兼擣廬州，以攻陳所必救。

translations.literal: To station at Chuzhou and Hezhou one must first besiege Anqing to break Chen Yucheng's old nest and also strike Luzhou to attack what Chen must rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Holding Chuzhou and He county required besieging Anqing to smash Yucheng's base and striking Luzhou to force him back.

sentences.zh: 誠能攻圍兩處，略取旁縣，備多力分，不特不敢悉力北竄齊、梁，並不敢一意東顧江浦、六合，蓋寇未有不悉力以護其根本者也。

translations.literal: If one could attack and besiege both places and seize nearby counties, with preparations many and strength divided, they would not only not dare send all strength north to flee to Qi and Liang, but also not dare focus east on Jiangpu and Liuhe—for rebels never fail to use full strength to protect their root.
translations.idiomatic: Besieging both places and taking nearby counties would split rebel strength, keep them from fleeing north or concentrating on Jiangpu and Liuhe, since rebels always defend their base.

sentences.zh: 於是定四路進兵之策：國藩任第一路，由宿松、石牌以窺安慶；

translations.literal: Thus they set a plan of advance on four routes: Guofan took the first route from Susong and Shipai toward Anqing;
translations.idiomatic: They fixed a four-route advance: Guofan from Susong and Shipai on Anqing;

sentences.zh: 多隆阿、鮑超任第二路，由太湖、潛山以取桐城；

translations.literal: Dolonga and Bao Chao the second route from Taihu and Qianshan to take Tongcheng;
translations.idiomatic: Dolonga and Bao Chao from Taihu and Qianshan on Tongcheng;

sentences.zh: 胡林翼任第三路，由英山、霍山取舒城；

translations.literal: Hu Linyi the third route from Yingshan and Huoshan to take Shucheng;
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi from Yingshan and Huoshan on Shucheng;

sentences.zh: 調回李續宜任第四路，由商、固以規廬州。

translations.literal: Li Xuyi recalled for the fourth route from Shang and Gu to plan Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Xuyi from Shangcheng and Gushi on Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 以後平寇之策，皆不出此。

translations.literal: Later strategies for pacifying rebels did not depart from this.
translations.idiomatic: Later pacification strategy never left this framework.

sentences.zh: 十一月，涇縣查村寇犯吳正熙壘，不利，而章家渡亦為我軍所挫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jing county Zhachun rebels attacked Wu Zhengxi's fortification without success, and Zhangjiadu was also defeated by our army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhachun rebels failed against Wu Zhengxi, and Zhangjiadu was beaten back.

sentences.zh: 揚州寇踞甘泉山，馬德昭破其壘。

translations.literal: Yangzhou rebels held Ganquan Mountain; Ma Dezhao broke their fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou rebels held Ganquan Mountain until Ma Dezhao broke them.

sentences.zh: 國樑督軍攻江浦寇壘不下，寇掘地道攻城，玉良遣將縋城出，焚其壘，填塞地道。

translations.literal: Guoliang supervised the army attacking Jiangpu rebel fortifications without success; rebels tunneled to attack the city; Yuliang sent generals lowered by rope from the wall, burned their fortifications, and filled the tunnels.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang could not take Jiangpu's forts. Rebels mined the walls; Yuliang's men sallied by rope, burned the works, and filled the tunnels.

sentences.zh: 寇築壘磨盤洲，我軍四路蹙之，寇眾大敗狂奔，北門寇營亦同時攻破。

translations.literal: Rebels built fortifications at Mopanzhou; our army pressed on four routes; rebel masses were greatly defeated and fled wildly; north-gate rebel camps were also broken at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fortified Mopanzhou. Four imperial columns routed them and took the north-gate camps.

sentences.zh: 其陳家集等處之寇竄回天長，南路之寇潛窺溧水，皆為防軍擊退。

translations.literal: Rebels at Chenjiaji and elsewhere fled back to Tianchang; southern-route rebels secretly eyed Lishui—all were beaten back by garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjiaji rebels fled to Tianchang; southern columns probing Lishui were driven off.

sentences.zh: 江長貴克太平，郭邨、查邨敗寇竄涇縣北路。

translations.literal: Jiang Changgui took Taiping; Guo Village and Zhachun defeated rebels fled to Jing county's north route.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Changgui took Taiping; beaten rebels from Guo Village and Zhachun fled north in Jing.

sentences.zh: 副將榮陞連破石柱坑、盤臺寇卡，寇竄踞董家村、白茅塘，犯萬級、黃柏兩嶺。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Rongsheng in succession broke Shizhukeng and Pantai rebel stockades; rebels fled to hold Dongjia Village and Baimaotang, invading Wanjie and Huangbai two ridges.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Rongsheng broke Shizhukeng and Pantai; rebels fled to Dongjia Village and Baimaotang and struck Wanjie and Huangbai ridges.

sentences.zh: 榮陞會徽軍破之，覆其巢。

translations.literal: Rongsheng joined Huizhou forces to defeat them and overturned their nest.
translations.idiomatic: Rongsheng joined Huizhou troops, routed them, and destroyed their nest.

sentences.zh: 寇又竄擾河西，為參將朱景山等所敗。

translations.literal: Rebels again fled to harass Hexi and were defeated by Regiment Commander Zhu Jingshan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels raided Hexi again and were beaten by Zhu Jingshan.

sentences.zh: 副將吳再升遂乘勝進剿黃池南岸牛頭山寇壘，北岸寇糾眾來援，分兵拒之，寇多死傷；

translations.literal: Vice Commander Wu Zaisheng then took advantage of victory to advance and suppress Huangchi south-bank Niutou Mountain rebel fortifications; north-bank rebels rallied masses to relieve them; he divided troops to resist; many rebels died and were wounded;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zaisheng pressed Niutou Mountain on Huangchi's south bank. North-bank relief was divided and bloodied;

sentences.zh: 北岸寇潰走渡河，我軍遂收南岸。

translations.literal: north-bank rebels collapsed, fled, and crossed the river; our army then recovered the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: north-bank rebels broke, fled across the river, and the south bank was recovered.

sentences.zh: 池州守城寇韋志俊獻城於楊載福，其部下古隆賢等不從，回撲府城，城復陷。

translations.literal: Chizhou defending-city rebel Wei Zhijun surrendered the city to Yang Zaifu; his subordinates Gu Longxian and others did not follow and turned back to assault the prefectural city; the city fell again.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhijun of Chizhou surrendered to Yang Zaifu. Gu Longxian and others refused, stormed back, and the city fell again.

sentences.zh: 桐、潛寇援太湖，將襲天堂後路，余繼昌會軍團分路敗之槎水畈，陣斬偽漢天侯、拱天豫二名，寇奔潰。

translations.literal: Tong and Qian rebels relieved Taihu, about to raid the rear of Tiantang; Yu Jichang joined militia on separate routes and defeated them at Chashuifan, slaying in battle the false Han Heavenly Marquis and Arch Heaven Yu, and rebels fled in collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Tongcheng and Qianshan rebels moved on Tiantang's rear. Yu Jichang and militia routed them at Chashuifan, killing the false Han Heavenly Marquis and Arch Heaven Yu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，侍賢由蕪湖金柱關率大股犯寧國，與黃池北岸寇合勢，連日分擾黃岡橋、牛頭山等處，再犯西河，蕭知音、熊廷芳退走寒亭。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Shixian from Wuhu Jinzhuguan led a great column to invade Ningguo, joining north-bank Huangchi rebels; day after day they harassed Huanggang Bridge, Niutou Mountain, and other places, again invading Xihe; Xiao Zhiyin and Xiong Tingfang retreated to Han ting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Shixian from Jinzhuguan invaded Ningguo with Huangchi north-bank rebels, raided Huanggang Bridge and Niutou Mountain, struck Xihe, and drove Xiao Zhiyin and Xiong Tingfang to Hanting.

sentences.zh: 寇圍游擊冉正祥壘，都司李培基馳援始解。

translations.literal: Rebels besieged Mobile Corps Ran Zhengxiang's fortification; Company Commander Li Peiji hurried to relieve before it was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels besieged Ran Zhengxiang until Li Peiji relieved him.

sentences.zh: 玉成以定遠、舒城、廬州寇眾北犯壽州，翁同書令副將尹善廷率精銳馳援，挫寇於東、南兩路。

translations.literal: Yucheng, with Dingyuan, Shucheng, and Luzhou rebel masses invading north Shouzhou, Weng Tongshu ordered Vice Commander Yin Shanting to lead elite troops in forced march to relieve them and defeated rebels on east and south routes.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng sent Dingyuan, Shucheng, and Luzhou rebels against Shouzhou. Yin Shanting rushed elite troops and beat them on the east and south.

sentences.zh: 時玉成以楚師甚盛，欲圖西竄六合拒楚師，因北犯壽州以牽掣我軍。

translations.literal: At that time Yucheng, seeing Chu forces very strong, wished to plot west fleeing to Liuhe to block Chu forces, and therefore invaded north Shouzhou to tie down our army.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Chu forces strong, Yucheng tried to slip west to Liuhe while pinning imperial troops with a thrust at Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋自江浦回援安慶、太平，糾合捻首龔得樹、張洛行等分道上犯，眾號十餘萬。

translations.literal: Soon from Jiangpu he returned to relieve Anqing and Taiping, colluded with Nian chiefs Gong Deshu and Zhang Luoxing and others to invade on separate upper routes, their force claiming over one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He then returned from Jiangpu to aid Anqing and Taiping, joined Gong Deshu and Zhang Luoxing, and marched upriver in columns said to exceed one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿、鮑超、蔣凝學禦之潛山，連破靈港寇壘。

translations.literal: Dolonga, Bao Chao, and Jiang Ningxue met them at Qianshan and in succession broke Linggang rebel fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Dolonga, Bao Chao, and Jiang Ningxue met them at Qianshan and broke Linggang's forts.

sentences.zh: 蕪湖寇進犯宣城、灣沚，周天受禦之，不得逞；

translations.literal: Wuhu rebels advanced to invade Xuancheng and Wanzi; Zhou Tianshou met them and they could not prevail;
translations.idiomatic: Wuhu rebels struck Xuancheng and Wanzi but Zhou Tianshou held them;

sentences.zh: 乃分眾四竄，我軍亦分拒於海南渡、浮橋口、清水潭、鹽官渡。

translations.literal: they then divided forces in four fleeing columns; our army also divided to resist at Hainandu, Fuqiaokou, Qingshuitan, and Yanduguan.
translations.idiomatic: they split four ways; imperial forces blocked them at Hainandu, Fuqiaokou, Qingshuitan, and Yanduguan.

sentences.zh: 寇退踞許邨埠，進犯西河，朱景山等創之，增軍守東西岸。

translations.literal: Rebels retreated to hold Xucunbu, advanced to invade Xihe; Zhu Jingshan and others wounded them; additional troops guarded east and west banks.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fell back to Xucunbu, struck Xihe, were hurt by Zhu Jingshan, and imperial troops reinforced both banks.

sentences.zh: 寇迭窺灣沚，我軍渡河擊之，寧國西北寇鋒稍斂。

translations.literal: Rebels repeatedly spied on Wanzi; our army crossed the river to strike them, and Ningguo northwest rebel momentum slightly abated.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels kept probing Wanzi until imperial troops crossed the river and eased pressure on northwest Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 先是銅陵、青陽寇常犯南陵、涇縣之交，我軍扼守雲嶺、蘇嶺，而設伏朝山要、三里甸，參將方國淮出奇擊之。
