sentences.zh: 寧國之陷也，玉成與賴裕新、古隆賢、楊輔清四面圍擊。

translations.literal: When Ningguo fell, Yucheng with Lai Yuxin, Gu Longxian, and Yang Fuqing besieged on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng, Lai Yuxin, Gu Longxian, and Yang Fuqing besieged Ningguo on four sides.

sentences.zh: 周天受戰守七十餘日，軍中食乏，餉阻不能達，寇破竹塘、廟埠諸壘，副將朱景山等皆戰死。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianshou fought and defended over seventy days; army food was scarce; pay blocked could not arrive; rebels took Zhutang, Miaobu, and other fortifications; Vice Commander Zhu Jingshan and others all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshou held seventy days until pay and food failed; Zhu Jingshan and others died as outer forts fell.

sentences.zh: 旌德、太平兩軍力單不能救，寇乘勢盡掃城外諸壘，城陷，天受遂遇害。

translations.literal: Jingde and Taiping two armies' strength was too thin to save; rebels exploited momentum and swept all outer fortifications; the city fell and Tianshou then met harm.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde and Taiping could not relieve him; outer works fell and Tianshou was killed.

sentences.zh: 寧國既失，南陵孤懸。

translations.literal: After Ningguo was lost, Nanling hung isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Nanling was left isolated.

sentences.zh: 總兵陳大富苦守閱半載，國藩檄令自拔出城，遣水師迎之，難民從者十餘萬。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Chen Dafu bitterly defended for half a year; Guofan ordered by edict to break out of the city himself; dispatched naval force to meet him; refugees following numbered over one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dafu held half a year until Guofan ordered a breakout; more than 100,000 refugees followed the fleet.

sentences.zh: 寇再陷太倉。

translations.literal: Rebels again seized Taicang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Taicang again.

sentences.zh: 玉成糾合江寧、丹陽、句容寇十餘萬，自九洑洲、新江頭掠船二百餘，日夜更番，意圖乘虛下竄，為軍團所敗，竄六合。

translations.literal: Yucheng rallied Jiangning, Danyang, and Jurong rebels over one hundred thousand, from Jiufuzhou and Xinjiangtou plundered over two hundred boats day and night in rotation, intending to exploit openings to flee downriver, were defeated by militia, fled to Liuhe.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng massed 100,000 men and hundreds of boats at Jiufuzhou until militia drove them to Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 鎮江寇船駛入丹徒、諫壁兩鎮港口，為水師李新明擊退。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang rebel boats sailed into Dantu and Jianbi two town harbors and were repelled by naval force Li Xinming.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang rebel boats entered Dantu and Jianbi until Li Xinming repelled them.

sentences.zh: 馮子材尋進解鎮江城圍。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai soon advanced to relieve Zhenjiang city's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai then lifted the siege of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 侍賢率寇四萬出廣德攻陷徽州，署皖南道李元度潰走開化。

translations.literal: Shixian led forty thousand rebels out of Guangde, attacked and seized Huizhou; Acting South Anhui Circuit Intendant Li Yuandu collapsed and fled to Kaihua.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian took forty thousand men from Guangde, seized Huizhou, and routed Li Yuandu to Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 寇趨祁門甚急，國藩檄邀運蘭屯霍縣，趣鮑超自太平還屯漁亭，以捍大營。

translations.literal: Rebels pressed Qimen urgently; Guofan ordered Yunlan to encamp at Huo county and urged Bao Chao from Taiping back to encamp at Yuting to shield the grand camp.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels threatened Qimen; Guofan sent Yunlan to Huo county and recalled Bao Chao to Yuting.

sentences.zh: 徽州既失，杭、嚴兩府防務益急。

translations.literal: After Huizhou was lost, Hang and Yan two prefectures' defenses grew ever more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou and Yanzhou defenses grew desperate after Huizhou fell.

sentences.zh: 寇之踞蘇城也，同時城邑陷者數十。

translations.literal: When rebels held Su city, at the same time cities and towns fallen numbered several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Dozens of towns fell when Suzhou was lost.

sentences.zh: 江陰居大江尾閭狼山對岸再陷於寇，寇踞之以窺江北，人心惶然。

translations.literal: Jiangyin lay at the great river's tail where Lang Mountain faced across; it fell again to rebels; rebels held it to spy on north of the river—people's hearts were fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin at the river's mouth fell again and threatened the north bank.

sentences.zh: 九月，通州知州張富年等會水師攻復其城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Tongzhou Magistrate Zhang Funian and others joined naval forces to attack and recover its city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhang Funian and the fleet retook Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 上月玉成率悍寇二十餘萬進陷白鑪橋尹善廷壘，旋至馬廠集，犯東津渡，黃鳴鐸擊卻之。

translations.literal: Last month Yucheng led fierce rebels over two hundred thousand, advanced and seized Bailuqiao Yin Shanting's fortification, soon reached Macunji, invaded Dongjin Ford; Huang Mingduo beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Last month Yucheng took Bailuqiao and Macunji until Huang Mingduo repelled him at Dongjin Ford.

sentences.zh: 至是圖取壽州內東肥河，跨山越谷，盤行抵淮河岸，聯營櫛比。

translations.literal: By then he plotted to take Shouzhou's inner East Fei River, crossed mountains and valleys, wound to reach Huai River bank, linked camps like comb teeth.
translations.idiomatic: He then marched on Shouzhou's East Fei River with camps lining the Huai bank.

sentences.zh: 餘黨竄入姚家灣，擄船，欲水陸會攻。

translations.literal: Remnant bands fled into Yaojia Bay, seized boats, intending land and water joint attack.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants seized boats at Yaojia Bay for a combined assault.

sentences.zh: 巡撫翁同書派砲艇沿河截擊，寇乘霧鳧水入小港，為黃慶仁圍殺；

translations.literal: Governor Weng Tongshu dispatched gunboats to intercept along the river; rebels exploited fog to swim into small harbor, were encircled and slaughtered by Huang Qingren;
translations.idiomatic: Weng Tongshu sent gunboats; rebels slipped through fog into a creek and were slaughtered by Huang Qingren;

sentences.zh: 復以步騎撲北關，城上彈丸雨下，夜縱火焚寇壘皆燼，城圍立解。

translations.literal: again with infantry and cavalry attacked north gate; shells rained from walls; at night set fires burning rebel fortifications to ashes—the siege was lifted at once.
translations.idiomatic: imperial troops stormed the north gate, shelled the walls, and burned the camps by night, lifting the siege.

sentences.zh: 寇竄南路：一還定遠山，一走廬江，一赴六安。

translations.literal: Rebels fled south route: one returned to Dingyuan mountains, one went to Luzhou, one went to Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled south in three columns toward Dingyuan, Luzhou, and Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 徽州寇自淳安竄陷嚴州，進踞烏龍嶺。

translations.literal: Huizhou rebels from Chun'an fled and seized Yanzhou, advanced to hold Wulong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou rebels from Chun'an took Yanzhou and held Wulong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 江寧寇糾九洑洲寇船二百餘艘下竄儀徵，我軍大敗之東溝。

translations.literal: Jiangning rebels rallied over two hundred Jiufuzhou boats downriver to raid Yizheng; our army greatly defeated them at Donggou.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing rebels sent 200 boats downriver to Yizheng and were routed at Donggou.

sentences.zh: 副將格洪額會破盱眙竹鎮集寇屯，擒斬偽檢點汪王發等，曾秉忠破青浦寇於米家角，攻城三日不下，秉忠中創。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Ge Hong'e jointly broke Zhuyi Zhuzhenji rebel encampment, captured and beheaded false inspector Wang Wangfa and others; Zeng Bingzhong broke Qingpu rebels at Mijiajiao, attacked city three days without success—Bingzhong was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Hong'e beat rebels at Zhuyi, Zeng Bingzhong wounded at Qingpu, and Li Tingju drove rebels from Baoshan to Jiading.

sentences.zh: 參將李廷舉攻寶山羅店，寇敗併嘉定，旋再竄羅店踞之。

translations.literal: Regiment Commander Li Tingju attacked Baoshan Luodian; rebels were defeated and merged at Jiading, soon again fled to hold Luodian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingju fought at Luodian; rebels fell back to Jiading then reoccupied Luodian.

sentences.zh: 寇攔入壽昌、金華，兵團復之。

translations.literal: Rebels intruded into Shouchang and Jinhua; militia recovered them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels raided Shouchang and Jinhua but militia retook them.

sentences.zh: 旋再陷再復。

translations.literal: Soon fell again and recovered again.
translations.idiomatic: They fell and were retaken again.

sentences.zh: 十月，寇自淳安擾及威坪，兵團禦之，回竄蜀口。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, rebels from Chun'an harassed as far as Weiping; militia resisted them; they fled back to Shukou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month rebels from Chun'an raided Weiping, met militia, and fled to Shukou.

sentences.zh: 徽州北路寇竄至杞樟里，逼昌化昱嶺二十里。

translations.literal: Huizhou north-route rebels fled to Qizhangli, pressing within twenty li of Changhua Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou rebels reached Qizhangli, twenty li from Changhua Pass.

sentences.zh: 先是江西瑞金、廣昌、新城、瀘溪大股寇窺伺福建，汀州、邵武防軍力禦之，遂折竄建昌，而瑞金一股竄踞福建之武平，尋陷汀州，兇焰甚張。

translations.literal: Earlier Jiangxi Ruijin, Guangchang, Xincheng, and Luxi great-column rebels spied on Fujian; Tingzhou and Shaowu defense troops resisted hard, then turned to flee Jianchang, while one Ruijin column fled to hold Fujian's Wuping, soon seized Tingzhou—fierce flame very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian defenses held until rebels from Ruijin took Wuping and Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 句容寇至鎮江湯岡築壘，馮子材擊之不下。

translations.literal: Jurong rebels reached Zhenjiang Tanggang and built fortifications; Feng Zicai attacked but could not take them.
translations.idiomatic: Jurong rebels fortified Tanggang; Feng Zicai failed to dislodge them.

sentences.zh: 寧國寇直趨四安，破長興長橋卡防，分竄廣坤、梅谿。

translations.literal: Ningguo rebels pressed straight on Si'an, broke Changxing Changqiao card defense, divided to flee Guangkun and Meixi.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo rebels struck Si'an, broke Changxing's river post, and split toward Guangkun and Meixi.

sentences.zh: 嚴州寇連陷桐廬、新城。

translations.literal: Yanzhou rebels in succession seized Tonglu and Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou rebels took Tonglu and Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 蘇州寇分股撲金山，我軍擊敗之，遂克楓涇鎮。

translations.literal: Suzhou rebels divided columns to strike Jinshan; our army defeated them and then took Fengjing Town.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou rebels hit Jinshan, were beaten, and Fengjing fell.

sentences.zh: 寇復糾蘇、常大股襲廣富林，圖犯松江。

translations.literal: Rebels again rallied Su and Chang great columns to raid Guangfulin, plotting to invade Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels massed from Suzhou and Changzhou against Guangfulin and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 守將向奎軍單，敗退。

translations.literal: Defending General Xiang Kui's army was thin and defeated in retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Defender Xiang Kui was outnumbered and routed.

sentences.zh: 曾秉忠回援，寇竄寶山羅店，都司姜德設伏敗之，還青浦。

translations.literal: Zeng Bingzhong returned to relieve; rebels fled to Baoshan Luodian; Company Commander Jiang De ambushed and defeated them; returned to Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bingzhong drove rebels to Luodian where Jiang De ambushed them back to Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 玉良克嚴州。

translations.literal: Yuliang took Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuliang retook Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 新城寇竄陷臨安。

translations.literal: Xincheng rebels fled and seized Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng rebels took Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 初，壽昌被陷，金華知府程兆綸督民團復之，桐廬亦同時收復。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shouchang fell, Jinhua Prefect Cheng Zhaolun supervised militia to recover it; Tonglu was also recovered at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Militia under Cheng Zhaolun had retaken Shouchang and Tonglu.

sentences.zh: 於是寇眾悉趨富陽，副將劉貴芳、總兵劉季三敗死，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Thus rebel masses all hurried to Fuyang; Vice Commander Liu Guifang and Commander-in-Chief Liu Jisan were defeated and died; the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels converged on Fuyang; Liu Guifang and Liu Jisan were killed and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 旋收復，燬江口浮橋。

translations.literal: Soon recovered; burned the floating bridge at river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon retaken and the river bridge burned.

sentences.zh: 侍賢復糾集臨安寇陷餘杭，逼杭州省城。

translations.literal: Shixian again rallied Lin'an rebels to seize Yuhang, pressing Hangzhou provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian took Yuhang and threatened Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 侍賢由嚴州還顧徽州，瑞昌等敗寇秦山亭、古蕩、觀音橋，追至留下，寇棄壘走。

translations.literal: Shixian returned from Yanzhou to look after Huizhou; Ruichang and others defeated rebels at Qinshan Pavilion, Gudang, and Guanyin Bridge, pursued to Liuxia; rebels abandoned fortifications and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian turned back to Huizhou while imperial forces cleared Qinshan and pursued to Liuxia.

sentences.zh: 省城解圍，遂復餘杭。

translations.literal: Provincial siege lifted; then recovered Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou was relieved and Yuhang recovered.

sentences.zh: 侍賢不得志於杭州，自餘杭直犯湖州。

translations.literal: Shixian, not succeeding at Hangzhou, from Yuhang directly invaded Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Failing at Hangzhou, Shixian struck Huzhou from Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 建昌寇間道犯鉛山河口鎮踞之。

translations.literal: Jianchang rebels by hidden route invaded Qianshan Hehekou Town and held it.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang rebels seized Qianshan's Hehekou by a hidden path.

sentences.zh: 福建浦城、崇安，浙江衢州、常山、開化邊防皆急。

translations.literal: Fujian Pucheng and Chong'an, Zhejiang Quzhou, Changshan, and Kaihua border defenses were all urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Zhejiang border posts were all in alarm.

sentences.zh: 時徽州寇自深渡街口下竄天長，防軍會水師大破於三河、衡陽等處。

translations.literal: At that time Huizhou rebels fled down from Shendu Street mouth to Tianchang; defense troops joined naval force in great defeat at Sanhe, Hengyang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou rebels fled toward Tianchang and were routed at Sanhe and Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 是股為天長葵天玉、陳天福會合秀成黨三萬餘眾，將謀渡河分擾淮陽。

translations.literal: This column was Tianchang Kui Tianyu and Chen Tianfu joining Xiucheng's band over thirty thousand, plotting to cross the river and divide to harass Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Some thirty thousand under Kui Tianyu and Chen Tianfu planned to cross and raid Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 秀成竄皖南，踰羊棧嶺，陷黟縣，鮑超大創之，城立復，再破之盧邨，陣斬偽丞相吳桂先，秀成受傷遁徽州。

translations.literal: Xiucheng fled south Anhui, crossed Yang Stack Ridge, seized Yixian; Bao Chao inflicted great wounds; city quickly recovered, again defeated them at Lucun, slew in battle false chancellor Wu Guixian; Xiucheng was wounded and fled to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng took Yixian, was smashed by Bao Chao at Lucun, lost Wu Guixian, and fled wounded.

sentences.zh: 國藩飭將屯守盧邨，邨距黟縣二十五里。

translations.literal: Guofan ordered generals to encamp and guard Lucun; the village was twenty-five li from Yixian.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan held Lucun, twenty-five li from Yixian.

sentences.zh: 是時侍賢自嚴還徽，輔清盤踞旌德，環二百里皆寇。

translations.literal: At that time Shixian returned from Yan to Huizhou; Fuqing held Jingde; for two hundred li all was rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian was back from Yanzhou, Fuqing held Jingde, and rebels covered two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 秀成復由江蘇上犯，越嶺肆擾。

translations.literal: Xiucheng again from Jiangsu invaded upward, crossed ranges and wantonly harassed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng invaded again from Jiangsu across the hills.

sentences.zh: 我軍疾馳百餘里，力戰兩日，驅出嶺，祁門大營始安。

translations.literal: Our army galloped over one hundred li, fought hard two days, drove them out of the range; Qimen grand camp was at last secure.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops chased them a hundred li in two days' fighting and secured Qimen.

sentences.zh: 趙景賢大破賊，解湖州城圍。

translations.literal: Zhao Jingxian greatly defeated bandits and lifted Huzhou city's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jingxian broke the rebels and relieved Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 湖州自三月以來，迭被賊困，此趙景賢第三次解圍也。

translations.literal: Huzhou since the third month had been repeatedly trapped by bandits; this was Zhao Jingxian's third time lifting the siege.
translations.idiomatic: This was the third time Zhao Jingxian had relieved Huzhou since the third month.

sentences.zh: 先是寇踞楊家莊為老巢，以礪山、仁黃山為犄角，焚掠雙林諸村鎮，蔓延長興、四安、太湖。

translations.literal: Earlier rebels held Yang Family Village as old nest, with Lishan and Ren Huang Mountain as horns, burned and plundered Shuanglin villages and towns, spreading to Changxing, Si'an, and Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had used Yang Family Village as a base, raiding Shuanglin and spreading toward Changxing and Taihu.

sentences.zh: 景賢會軍先攻礪山、仁黃，以孤老巢之勢。

translations.literal: Jingxian joined armies first attacking Lishan and Ren Huang to isolate the old nest's strength.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxian attacked Lishan and Ren Huang to isolate their base.

sentences.zh: 我軍踞仁黃，燬楊家莊，敗寇西竄。

translations.literal: Our army held Ren Huang, burned Yang Family Village, defeated rebels fleeing west.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces burned Yang Family Village and drove the rebels west.

sentences.zh: 天長寇掠下五莊舟船數百艘，欲犯湖路；

translations.literal: Tianchang rebels plundered several hundred boats at Xiawuzhuang, intending to invade the lake route;
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang rebels seized hundreds of boats at Xiawuzhuang to threaten the lake route;

sentences.zh: 我軍克河口鎮，復創之石谿；

translations.literal: our army took Hehekou Town, again wounded them at Shixi;
translations.idiomatic: imperial troops took Hehekou and beat them again at Shixi;

sentences.zh: 竄廣豐，道員段起禦之，寇間道走玉山。

translations.literal: fled to Guangfeng; Circuit Intendant Duan Qi resisted them; rebels by hidden route went to Yushan.
translations.idiomatic: they fled to Guangfeng and slipped toward Yushan despite Duan Qi.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿、李續宜會軍大破桐城寇陳玉成、龔得樹於掛車河、鶴墩、香鋪街等處，平寇壘四十餘，寇退奔舒城。

translations.literal: Dolonga and Li Xuyi joined armies in great defeat of Tongcheng rebels Chen Yucheng and Gong Deshu at Guahe River, Hedun, Xiangpu Street, and other places, leveling over forty rebel fortifications; rebels retreated to Shucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Dolonga and Li Xuyi routed Yucheng and Gong Deshu at Guahe and leveled forty forts.

sentences.zh: 安慶者，江表之咽喉，實平吳之根本也。

translations.literal: Anqing is the throat of the river region—the true root of pacifying Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing was the throat of the Yangtze and key to pacifying the southeast.

sentences.zh: 寇援安慶，水陸阻梗，不能直抵江寧。

translations.literal: Rebels relieving Anqing, land and water blocked, could not reach Jiangning straight.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel relief for Anqing could not break through to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 玉成眷屬悉在安慶城中，邀合髮、捻十餘萬人，圖解城圍。

translations.literal: Yucheng's dependents were all in Anqing city; he invited combination of hair and Nian over one hundred thousand to plot lifting the city siege.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng's family was in Anqing; he rallied more than 100,000 rebels and Nian to break the siege.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿、李續宜雖力挫之，仍分屯廬江、桐城，復糾集下游江寧、蘇、常援寇並力上犯，逼近樅陽、桐城鄉村，眈眈以伺我軍之隙，將挾江南寇勢全力謀楚軍。

translations.literal: Though Dolonga and Li Xuyi forcefully defeated them, they still divided encampments at Luzhou and Tongcheng, again rallied downstream Jiangning, Su, and Chang relief rebels to jointly invade upward, pressed close to Zongyang and Tongcheng villages, watching eagerly for gaps in our army, intending with Jiangnan rebel momentum to use full strength against Chu Army.
translations.idiomatic: They regrouped at Luzhou and Tongcheng and probed Zongyang, planning to crush the Chu Army with Jiangnan reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 時屆冬令，安徽城河水涸，道路紛歧。

translations.literal: At that time winter came; Anhui city river water dried; roads branched in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Winter dried the Anhui rivers and tangled the roads.

sentences.zh: 我軍四路告急之書應接不暇，皖南、浙江之寇分三大枝竄入江西，祁門各營圍裹於中，勢頗危急。

translations.literal: Our army's urgent reports on four routes came one after another without pause; south Anhui and Zhejiang rebels divided into three great branches fleeing into Jiangxi; Qimen camps were wrapped in the middle—momentum quite critical.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces were besieged at Qimen as three rebel columns poured into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 湖南道州寇亦竄江西。

translations.literal: Hunan Daozhou rebels also fled into Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Daozhou rebels entered Jiangxi as well.

sentences.zh: 寇既陷吳，勢必全力犯楚，此其深謀詭計。

translations.literal: With Wu fallen, rebels were sure to use full strength against Chu—this was their deep plot and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Wu meant they would throw everything at Hubei.

sentences.zh: 故安慶一城，寇以死力爭之。

translations.literal: Therefore for Anqing one city rebels contended with death force.
translations.idiomatic: They fought to the death for Anqing.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠之入景德也，聞南贛寇分黨由貴溪過安仁，直撲饒、景，遣軍迎敗之周坊，寇竄陷德興踞之。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang entered Jingde, hearing south Gan rebels divided bands from Guixi past Anren straight to strike Rao and Jing, he dispatched troops to meet and defeat them at Zhoufang; rebels fled and seized Deyi and held it.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang, entering Jingde, beat a Gan column at Zhoufang but Deyi fell.

sentences.zh: 十一月，宗棠進克德興，寇奔婺源，又克之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Zongtang advanced and took Deyi; rebels fled to Wuyuan, and it too was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zuo took Deyi and Wuyuan in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 十日內轉戰三百餘里，寇驚為神速。

translations.literal: Within ten days they fought over three hundred li; rebels were alarmed at the speed.
translations.idiomatic: In ten days they fought three hundred li and stunned the rebels.

sentences.zh: 彭斯舉解玉山城圍，寇竄衢境，犯常山，與兵團戰，敗走開化埠。

translations.literal: Peng Siju lifted Yushan city's siege; rebels fled to Quzhou border, invaded Changshan, fought militia, were defeated and fled to Kaihua Port.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Siju relieved Yushan; rebels fled through Quzhou to Changshan and Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 楊輔清自池州率黨竄陷東流，進陷建德。

translations.literal: Yang Fuqing from Chizhou led bands to flee and seize Dongliu, advanced and seized Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing from Chizhou took Dongliu and Jiande.

sentences.zh: 水師收東流，而建德防軍潰退。

translations.literal: Naval force recovered Dongliu, but Jiande defense troops collapsed in retreat.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet retook Dongliu while Jiande's garrison broke.

sentences.zh: 國藩遣唐義訓馳擊，至利涉口，寇築壘河洲，列隊以待，並以馬隊扼拒各卡。

translations.literal: Guofan dispatched Tang Yixun in forced march to strike; reaching Lisheshekou, rebels built fortifications on river islet, lined ranks to await, also used cavalry to block each stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan sent Tang Yixun to Lisheshekou where rebels fortified the river islet.

sentences.zh: 我軍分東西兩路緣山上，立破其卡；

translations.literal: Our army on east and west two routes climbed the mountain along the slopes and immediately broke their stockades;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops climbed from east and west and stormed the stockades;

sentences.zh: 前軍夾擊河洲寇，後軍抄其背，寇敗走。

translations.literal: front army pincer-attacked river islet rebels, rear army outflanked their back; rebels were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: the front struck the islet while the rear cut behind, routing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 我軍復分為三進攻，寇出東門逸，遂復其城。

translations.literal: Our army again divided into three to advance; rebels escaped out the east gate; the city was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Three columns retook the city as rebels fled out the east gate.

sentences.zh: 寇復陷彭澤，闌入浮梁，越一日復之。

translations.literal: Rebels again seized Pengze, intruded into Fuliang; after one day recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Pengze and raided Fuliang but lost it in a day.

sentences.zh: 寇趨馬影橋，逼湖口。

translations.literal: Rebels hurried to Maying Bridge, pressing Hukou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels pressed Hukou from Maying Bridge.

sentences.zh: 玉麟督水陸軍力擊之，遂收彭澤。

translations.literal: Yulin supervised land and naval forces in hard attack and recovered Pengze.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin retook Pengze by land and water.

sentences.zh: 寇宵遁，陷都昌、鄱陽。

translations.literal: Rebels fled by night, seized Duchang and Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled by night and took Duchang and Poyang.

sentences.zh: 我師馳至都昌，擊退踞寇，復之。

translations.literal: Our army hurried to Duchang, beat back holding rebels, and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops rushed to Duchang and retook it.

sentences.zh: 休寧寇犯上谿口，陷副將王夢麟壘。

translations.literal: Xiuning rebels invaded Shangxikou, seized Vice Commander Wang Menglin's fortification.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuning rebels took Shangxikou and Wang Menglin's fort.

sentences.zh: 屯谿寇犯江灣，陷副將楊名聲壘。

translations.literal: Tunxi rebels invaded Jiangwan, seized Vice Commander Yang Mingsheng's fortification.
translations.idiomatic: Tunxi rebels took Jiangwan and Yang Mingsheng's fort.

sentences.zh: 古隆賢、賴裕新糾大股犯羊棧、桐林二嶺，張運蘭會軍擊之，寇由新嶺退去，犯婺源。

translations.literal: Gu Longxian and Lai Yuxin rallied a great column to invade Yang Stack and Tonglin two ridges; Zhang Yunlan joined armies to strike them; rebels from New Ridge withdrew and invaded Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Longxian and Lai Yuxin struck the ridges until Zhang Yunlan drove them toward Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 國藩督飭鮑超大破於黟縣盧邨，別軍繞出羊棧，斷寇歸路。

translations.literal: Guofan supervised urging Bao Chao's great defeat at Yixian Lucun; separate army wound out Yang Stack, cutting rebel return route.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan directed Bao Chao's victory at Lucun while another column cut the retreat at Yang Stack.

sentences.zh: 寇沿崖逃走，追軍反出其前，迫之，墜崖死無算。

translations.literal: Rebels fled along cliffs; pursuing army unexpectedly got ahead of them, pressed them—falling cliff deaths beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuers trapped rebels on the cliffs and killed countless fugitives.

sentences.zh: 而休寧城寇以鮑超回剿景德，由藍田擾及小溪一帶，張運蘭擊敗之，別股屯鄭家橋者進逼漁亭。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Xiuning city rebels, because Bao Chao returned to suppress Jingde, from Lantian harassed to Xiaoxi stretch; Zhang Yunlan defeated them; separate column encamped at Zhengjia Bridge advanced pressing Yuting.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuning rebels raided Xiaoxi when Bao Chao left; Yunlan beat them at Zhengjia Bridge.

sentences.zh: 我軍兩路抄擊，寇狂奔，斃黃世瑚等；

translations.literal: Our army on two routes outflank-attacked; rebels fled wildly, killed Huang Shihu and others;
translations.idiomatic: Two columns routed them and killed Huang Shihu;

sentences.zh: 復敗上溪口寇，追至馬全街而還。

translations.literal: again defeated Shangxikou rebels, pursued to Maquan Street and returned.
translations.idiomatic: then cleared Shangxikou and pursued to Maquan Street.

sentences.zh: 自是嶺外寇不敢輕入。

translations.literal: From then rebels outside the ranges dared not enter lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels rarely crossed the passes after that.

sentences.zh: 玉成率眾萬餘犯桐城、樅陽，我軍鎮靜固守。

translations.literal: Yucheng led over ten thousand to invade Tongcheng and Zongyang; our army calmly defended firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng attacked Tongcheng and Zongyang with ten thousand men; imperial forces held firm.

sentences.zh: 寇踞七里亭，韋志俊扼樅陽街口。

translations.literal: Rebels held Qili Pavilion; Wei Zhijun blocked Zongyang street mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Qili Pavilion; Wei Zhijun blocked Zongyang.

sentences.zh: 李成謀舁三版入蓮花池護衛營卡，寇不得逞。

translations.literal: Li Chengmo carried three-plank boats into Lotus Pond to guard camp stockades; rebels could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengmo used boats on Lotus Pond to block the rebels.

sentences.zh: 寇再犯景德鎮，宗棠敗之。

translations.literal: Rebels again invaded Jingdezhen; Zongtang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Jingdezhen again and Zuo beat them back.

sentences.zh: 鮑超進扼洋塘，宗棠進扼梅源橋。

translations.literal: Bao Chao advanced to block Yangtang; Zongtang advanced to block Meiyuan Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao held Yangtang while Zuo held Meiyuan Bridge.

sentences.zh: 寇自下游糾大股屯洋塘對岸，我軍大破之，偽定南主將黃文金負創西奔。

translations.literal: Rebels from downstream rallied a great column encamped opposite Yangtang; our army greatly defeated them; false Dingnan chief general Huang Wenjin was wounded fleeing west.
translations.idiomatic: A downstream column camped at Yangtang and was routed; Huang Wenjin fled west wounded.

sentences.zh: 時祁門三面皆寇，僅留景德鎮一路以通接濟，寇盡銳攻撲，欲得甘心焉。

translations.literal: At that time Qimen had rebels on three sides; only Jingdezhen route left for relief; rebels used all elite to attack and press, wishing to have their full revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Qimen was surrounded on three sides with only Jingdezhen open; rebels threw everything at it.

sentences.zh: 時國荃圍安慶，寇勢漸窮。

translations.literal: At that time Guoquan besieged Anqing; rebel momentum gradually cornered.
translations.idiomatic: Guoquan besieged Anqing and rebels grew desperate.

sentences.zh: 十二月，玉成糾約秀成、輔清及捻匪併力西犯，其大股寇、捻俱從南岸渡江而北，會於無為、廬江，以圖急援懷寧、桐城，勢甚猖狓。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Yucheng colluded with Xiucheng, Fuqing, and Nian to jointly invade west; their great columns of rebels and Nian all crossed from south bank north of the river, met at Wuwei and Luzhou, plotting urgent relief of Huaining and Tongcheng—momentum very rampant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yucheng joined Xiucheng, Fuqing, and Nian, crossing north of the river to relieve Huaining and Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿等會於樅陽一帶，布署戰守。

translations.literal: Dolonga and others joined at Zongyang stretch, deploying battle and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Dolonga concentrated at Zongyang to fight.

sentences.zh: 皖南寇大股竄孝豐，又別股由昌化竄分水。

translations.literal: South Anhui rebels in great column fled to Xiaofeng; another column from Changhua fled to Fenshui.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui rebels raided Xiaofeng and Fenshui.

sentences.zh: 嘉興踞寇備具砲船，意圖南下，寇勢蔓延，浙東西同時告警。

translations.literal: Jiaxing holding rebels prepared gunboats, intending to march south; rebel momentum spread; east and west Zhejiang alarmed together.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing rebels armed boats to push south and alarmed all Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，傅忠信、譚體元、汪海洋、洪容海各挾眾數萬，棄石達開歸秀成。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, Fu Zhongxin, Tan Tiyuan, Wang Haiyang, and Hong Ronghai each led tens of thousands, abandoned Shi Dakai and returned to Xiucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year's first month four chiefs abandoned Shi Dakai and rejoined Xiucheng with tens of thousands each.

sentences.zh: 秀成驟增眾二十萬，勢大熾，由石埭分兩路趨祁門，防軍皆敗。

translations.literal: Xiucheng suddenly increased masses by two hundred thousand; momentum greatly flamed; from Shiling divided two routes toward Qimen; defense troops were all defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng swelled by 200,000 men and swept toward Qimen in two columns.

sentences.zh: 江長貴援大洪，唐義訓迎戰歷口，斬偽麟天豫古得金，寇潰走常山。

translations.literal: Jiang Changgui relieved Dahong; Tang Yixun met battle at Likou, beheaded false Lin Heaven Yu Gu Dejin; rebels collapsed and fled to Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Changgui aided Dahong; Tang Yixun killed Gu Dejin at Likou and drove rebels to Changshan.

sentences.zh: 富陽、新城、臨安皆為我軍所克，解廣信之圍。

translations.literal: Fuyang, Xincheng, and Lin'an were all taken by our army; lifted Guangxin's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces retook Fuyang, Xincheng, and Lin'an and relieved Guangxin.

sentences.zh: 寇竄鉛山、弋陽、貴溪、金谿，漸逼建昌。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Qianshan, Yiyang, Guixi, and Jinxi, gradually pressing Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels pressed toward Jianchang through Qianshan, Yiyang, Guixi, and Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 秀成自去冬犯皖南黟縣羊棧嶺不得志，竄浙江常山、江山等處；

translations.literal: Xiucheng from last winter invading south Anhui Yixian Yang Stack Ridge without success fled to Zhejiang Changshan, Jiangshan, and other places;
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng, beaten at Yang Stack, fled into Zhejiang;

sentences.zh: 今春以全力攻玉山，轉圍廣豐，犯廣信，志在踞守要地，以通徽、浙之路。

translations.literal: this spring with full strength attacked Yushan, turned to besiege Guangfeng, invaded Guangxin, aiming to hold key places to open Hui and Zhe routes.
translations.idiomatic: this spring he besieged Yushan and Guangfeng to hold the Hui-Zhe corridor.

sentences.zh: 犯建昌，作浮橋渡河，以大股屯水東，環城築二十餘壘，以浮橋通往來。

translations.literal: Invading Jianchang, made floating bridge to cross river, with great column encamped east of water, ringed city building over twenty fortifications, using floating bridge for traffic.
translations.idiomatic: At Jianchang he bridged the river, ringed the city with twenty forts, and held the crossing.

sentences.zh: 江西寇黃文金犯景德鎮，左宗棠、鮑超敗之石門、洋塘，斃許茂材、林世發。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebel Huang Wenjin invaded Jingdezhen; Zuo Zongtang and Bao Chao defeated them at Shimen and Yangtang, killed Xu Maocai and Lin Shifa.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin struck Jingdezhen and was beaten at Shimen and Yangtang.

sentences.zh: 文金踉蹌宵遁，銅陵援寇與敗匪合，復入建德，分踞黃麥鋪諸處。

translations.literal: Wenjin fled stumbling by night; Tongling relief rebels joined defeated bandits, again entered Jiande, divided holding Huangmaipu and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin fled by night; broken bands re-entered Jiande and held Huangmaipu.

sentences.zh: 鮑超督諸軍乘勝壓之，斃寇萬計，追至建德，會水師收復縣城，誅林天福。

translations.literal: Bao Chao supervised armies pressing advantage, killed rebels beyond counting, pursued to Jiande, joined naval force recovering county seat, executed Lin Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao slaughtered thousands, retook Jiande, and executed Lin Tianfu with the fleet.

sentences.zh: 秀成梯攻建昌，參將富安等縱火具創退之，復潛為地道修子城備之。

translations.literal: Xiucheng ladder-attacked Jianchang; Regiment Commander Fu An and others set fire implements and wounded them in repulse; again secretly made tunnels and repaired inner wall to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng stormed Jianchang; Fu An burned the assault and dug inner defenses.

sentences.zh: 寇船犯太湖，陷東西山。

translations.literal: Rebel boats invaded Taihu, seized east and west mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel boats took Taihu's east and west hills.

sentences.zh: 全湖失陷，湖州北路七十二漊港橫被竄擾。

translations.literal: The whole lake fell; Huzhou north route seventy-two harbor channels were横向 traversed and harassed.
translations.idiomatic: The whole lake fell and seventy-two Huzhou north harbors were ravaged.

sentences.zh: 太湖，巨浸也，襟帶蘇、常、湖三郡，港口紛歧，多至百餘。

translations.literal: Taihu is a vast flood, girdling Su, Chang, and Hu three prefectures; harbor mouths branch in confusion, reaching over one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Taihu linked Suzhou, Changzhou, and Huzhou through more than a hundred waterways.

sentences.zh: 自蘇、常陷後，沿湖要隘多為寇有。

translations.literal: After Su and Chang fell, along-lake key passes mostly were held by rebels.
translations.idiomatic: After Suzhou and Changzhou fell, rebels held most lake passes.

sentences.zh: 去冬間寇船自湖州出湖，迭犯西山、角頭等處，為副將王之敬砲船所敗。

translations.literal: Last winter rebel boats from Huzhou came out on the lake, repeatedly invaded west mountain, Jiaotou, and other places, were defeated by Vice Commander Wang Zhijing's gunboats.
translations.idiomatic: Last winter Huzhou rebel boats were beaten by Wang Zhijing's gunboats.

sentences.zh: 然所部不滿十艘，募民船佐之，卒以眾寡不敵敗死。

translations.literal: Yet his command numbered less than ten vessels; recruited civilian boats to assist; ultimately because numbers could not match were defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: With fewer than ten gunboats and hired craft, he was overwhelmed and killed.

sentences.zh: 二月，玉成圖援安慶，糾合捻首龔瞎子，率五萬人攻松子關。

translations.literal: In the second month, Yucheng plotted to relieve Anqing, colluded with Nian chief Gong Xiazi, led fifty thousand to attack Songzi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Yucheng and Gong Xiazi led fifty thousand against Songzi Pass to relieve Anqing.

sentences.zh: 成大吉兵僅二千五百，寇多二十倍，分兩路抄官軍後。

translations.literal: Cheng Daji's troops were only twenty-five hundred; rebels were twenty times as many, splitting into two routes to outflank the imperial army from behind.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Daji had only 2,500 men against rebels twenty times his strength, who split into two columns to strike the imperial army from the rear.

sentences.zh: 大吉令參將王名滔從左側山橫截而出，陣斬龔瞎子，寇驚潰，復選悍黨分五路進，再戰再敗，捻散亡三萬人。

translations.literal: Daji ordered Brigadier Wang Mingtao to burst out in a cross strike from the left hillside, beheading Gong the Blind on the field; rebels fled in panic, then picked fierce bands and advanced in five routes, were defeated again and again, and the Nian scattered with thirty thousand dead or fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mingtao charged from the left hill and killed Gong the Blind in battle; the rebels routed, regrouped in five columns, were beaten again, and thirty thousand Nian fighters were killed or dispersed.

sentences.zh: 初，玉成嗾龔瞎子犯松子關，而自率悍黨十餘萬，從霍山之黑石渡，襲余際昌營於樂兒嶺，相持四晝夜，力竭而潰，遂抵英山，入蘄水，襲陷黃州。

translations.literal: Earlier Yucheng had incited Gong the Blind to attack Songzi Pass, while he himself led more than a hundred thousand fierce bands from Heishidu on Huoshan to raid Yu Jichang's camp at Le'er Ridge; they grappled four days and nights, exhausted their strength and broke, then reached Yingshan, entered Qishui, and stormed and took Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng had sent Gong the Blind against Songzi Pass while he led 100,000 men from Heishidu to surprise Yu Jichang at Le'er Ridge; after four days of stalemate his force collapsed, fled through Yingshan and Qishui, and seized Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 分黨取蘄州，擾麻城，闌入黃安、黃坡、孝感、雲夢諸縣，並陷德安府、隨州，勢益猖獗，武昌戒嚴。

translations.literal: He sent bands to take Qizhou, harass Macheng, break into the counties of Huang'an, Huangpo, Xiaogan, and Yunmeng, and also seized De'an Prefecture and Suizhou; their momentum grew more rampant and Wuchang was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns took Qizhou, raided Macheng, overran Huang'an, Huangpo, Xiaogan, and Yunmeng, and captured De'an and Suizhou, prompting a security alert in Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 秀成聞玉成攻國荃久不下，分攻蘄、黃、廣濟，欲國藩赴援以分兵力。

translations.literal: Xiucheng heard that Yucheng had long failed to take Guo Quan and divided forces to attack Qi, Huang, and Guangji, wishing Guo Fan to go to the rescue and divide his strength.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Yucheng could not break Guo Quan's siege, Xiucheng struck Qizhou, Huangzhou, and Guangji to draw Zeng Guofan away and split his army.

sentences.zh: 秀成歎曰：「英王誤矣！

translations.literal: Xiucheng sighed and said: "The Hero King is mistaken!
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sighed: "The Hero King has erred!

sentences.zh: 正使國藩得全力以攻皖，彼豈暇救此閒城哉？

translations.literal: Even if Guo Fan could use his full strength to attack Anhui, how would he have leisure to save these idle towns?
translations.idiomatic: Even if Zeng Guofan could throw his full weight into Anhui, would he spare troops for these outlying towns?

sentences.zh: 彼有長江之利，而我無戰艦，安能絕其糧道？

translations.literal: They have the advantage of the Yangtze, while we have no warships—how can we cut off their grain route?
translations.idiomatic: They hold the Yangtze and we have no fleet—how can we sever their supply line?

sentences.zh: 不能以我攻浙救京師為例也。

translations.literal: One cannot take our attack on Zhejiang to save the capital as a precedent.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot repeat our Zhejiang campaign that was meant to relieve the capital.

sentences.zh: 」玉成屯孝感，而以德安、雲夢、隨州三處為長蛇陣，窺伺荊、襄。

translations.literal: " Yucheng encamped at Xiaogan, using De'an, Yunmeng, and Suizhou as a long-snake formation to spy on Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng held Xiaogan and strung De'an, Yunmeng, and Suizhou into a long-snake line to threaten Jingzhou and Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 官文飛調李續宜、舒保、彭玉麟率水陸諸軍回救。

translations.literal: Guan Wen urgently summoned Li Xuyi, Shu Bao, and Peng Yulin to lead land and water forces back to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen urgently recalled Li Xuyi, Shu Bao, and Peng Yulin with combined land and river forces.

sentences.zh: 侍賢竄踞休寧城，築壘上溪口、河邨、石田、小當等處，與休寧屯溪之寇互為犄角。

translations.literal: Shixian fled to hold Xiuning city, building forts at Shangxikou, Hecun, Shitian, Xiaodang, and other places, mutually supporting the rebels at Tunxi in Xiuning.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian seized Xiuning and fortified Shangxikou, Hecun, Shitian, and Xiaodang in mutual support with rebels at Tunxi.

sentences.zh: 國藩以休城不克，徽郡難圖，祁門終屬危地，檄朱品隆等進攻，焚諸壘，寇夜遁，收復縣城。

translations.literal: Guo Fan, seeing Xiuning could not be taken, Huizhou hard to seize, and Qimen still a dangerous place, ordered Zhu Pinlong and others to attack, burned the forts, rebels fled by night, and the county seat was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to take Xiuning or Huizhou and fearing for Qimen, Zeng Guofan sent Zhu Pinlong to burn the rebel forts; the rebels fled by night and Xiuning was recovered.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠進剿婺源寇，破侍賢於清華街，而城寇忽分黨由中雲竄入樂平界。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang advanced against Wuyuan rebels, defeated Shixian at Qinghuajie, but city rebels suddenly split a band that slipped through Zhongyun into Leping territory.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang routed Shixian at Qinghuajie in Wuyuan, but rebels from the city slipped through Zhongyun into Leping.

sentences.zh: 宗棠親率數營屯柳家灣，扼其衝，寇敗退；

translations.literal: Zongtang personally led several battalions to camp at Liujiawan, blocking their thrust, and rebels were defeated and withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: Zuo personally camped at Liujiawan to block them and drove the rebels back;

sentences.zh: 而援寇漫野至，返旆截殺，復大潰而去。

translations.literal: but relief rebels spread across the fields; he turned his banners to intercept and kill, and they were again routed and fled.
translations.idiomatic: when rebel reinforcements swarmed in he wheeled about, cut them down, and put them to rout again.

sentences.zh: 侍賢糾徽州悍黨圍王開林於婺源甲路，越三日，潰圍出，還景德。

translations.literal: Shixian gathered fierce Huizhou bands to besiege Wang Kailin at Wuyuan Jialu; after three days he broke the encirclement and returned to Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian besieged Wang Kailin at Jialu in Wuyuan with Huizhou hard fighters; after three days Wang broke out and retreated to Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 秀成率黨竄撫州，為知府鍾峻等擊敗，竄宜黃，復糾土匪陷遂安。

translations.literal: Xiucheng led bands to flee into Fuzhou, was defeated by Prefect Zhong Jun and others, fled to Yihuang, and again rallied local bandits to seize Suian.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng raided Fuzhou, was beaten by Prefect Zhong Jun, fled to Yihuang, and with local bandits took Suian.

sentences.zh: 國藩遣大富防景德。

translations.literal: Guo Fan sent Dafu to defend Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan posted Chen Dafu to guard Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 宗棠進軍鄱陽，次鯰魚山，聞寇偷渡昌江，圖合圍景德，旋移駐金橋。

translations.literal: Zongtang advanced to Poyang, halted at Nianyushan, heard rebels had secretly crossed the Chang River intending to surround Jingde, and soon moved camp to Jinqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo marched to Poyang and camped at Nianyushan; learning rebels had crossed the Chang River to encircle Jingdezhen, he shifted to Jinqiao.

sentences.zh: 寇竄平湖，分由西路櫸根嶺、北路禾黍嶺進犯。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Pinghu, splitting along the western route at Jugen Ridge and the northern route at Heshu Ridge to attack.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels moved on Pinghu, advancing by Jugen Ridge in the west and Heshu Ridge in the north.

sentences.zh: 副將沈寶成當西面，江長貴出北路拒之。

translations.literal: Brigadier Shen Baocheng faced the west, Jiang Changgui went out the north road to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Shen Baocheng held the west while Jiang Changgui blocked the northern approach.

sentences.zh: 國藩復檄朱品隆由祁門馳援，殲，寇越嶺而逃；

translations.literal: Guo Fan again ordered Zhu Pinlong to hurry from Qimen to reinforce, annihilated them, and rebels fled over the ridge;
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan rushed Zhu Pinlong from Qimen to reinforce; the rebels were cut down and fled over the hills;

sentences.zh: 宗棠擊破於樂平范家邨，陣斬偽謝天義黃勝才、偽嬈天福李佳普等。

translations.literal: Zongtang defeated them at Fanjiacun in Leping, beheading on the field the false Xie Tianyi Huang Shengcai, the false Rao Tianfu Li Jiapu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: At Fanjiacun in Leping, Zuo killed the rebel princes Xie Tianyi Huang Shengcai and Rao Tianfu Li Jiapu in battle.

sentences.zh: 侍賢率數萬眾潛匿於牛嶺、柳家灣、回龍嶺，翌日，齊進景德鎮，陳大富戰死，陷之。

translations.literal: Shixian led tens of thousands hidden at Niuling, Liujiawan, and Huilongling; the next day they advanced together on Jingdezhen, Chen Dafu died in battle, and it fell.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian hid tens of thousands at Niuling, Liujiawan, and Huilongling, then stormed Jingdezhen the next day; Chen Dafu was killed and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 金魚橋坐營後路已絕，遂移屯樂平。

translations.literal: The camp at Jinyuqiao found its rear route cut off and so moved to Leping.
translations.idiomatic: With his supply line severed at Jinyuqiao, Zuo withdrew to Leping.

sentences.zh: 初，國藩至皖南，設糧臺於江西，以景德鎮為轉運。

translations.literal: Earlier when Guo Fan reached southern Anhui he set up a grain bureau in Jiangxi, using Jingdezhen as a transfer point.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng Guofan entered southern Anhui he established a grain depot in Jiangxi with Jingdezhen as the hub.

sentences.zh: 寇之窺祁門者，屢遭挫敗，遂悉銳再犯景德，冀絕大軍餉道，至是陷之。

translations.literal: Rebels probing Qimen had repeatedly been defeated, so they gathered all their elite to attack Jingde again, hoping to cut the great army's supply route—and now they took it.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly beaten at Qimen, the rebels massed their best troops on Jingdezhen to starve Zeng's army of supplies—and now took the city.

sentences.zh: 國藩度糧路已斷，惟急復徽州，可通浙米，親至休寧攻徽寇不克，仍屯祁門；

translations.literal: Guo Fan judged the grain route already cut and that only urgent recovery of Huizhou could open Zhejiang rice; he went in person to Xiuning to attack Huizhou rebels without success and still camped at Qimen;
translations.idiomatic: With supplies cut off, Zeng Guofan saw Huizhou as the only way to Zhejiang grain; he attacked from Xiuning without success and remained at Qimen;

sentences.zh: 而寇環攻不已，誓以身殉。

translations.literal: while rebels besieged him without cease and he vowed to die with his post.
translations.idiomatic: surrounded by relentless rebel attacks, he vowed to die at his post.

sentences.zh: 宗棠大破寇於樂平，斬馘數萬。

translations.literal: Zongtang routed rebels at Leping, beheading tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: At Leping, Zuo routed the rebels and killed tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 侍賢遁，圍建昌、撫州，攻之不下，遂陷吉安，大軍旋復之，乃進陷瑞州。

translations.literal: Shixian fled, besieged Jianchang and Fuzhou without taking them, then seized Ji'an; the great army soon recovered it, and he advanced to take Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian fled, failed against Jianchang and Fuzhou, took Ji'an only to lose it, then captured Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 於是祁門之路始通。

translations.literal: Only then was the route to Qimen opened.
translations.idiomatic: The road to Qimen was open again.

sentences.zh: 三月，我軍克新淦，解麻城圍。

translations.literal: In the third month our army took Xingan and lifted the siege of Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month imperial forces took Xingan and relieved Macheng.

sentences.zh: 繁昌荻港、蕪湖魯港寇皆敗走。

translations.literal: Rebels at Digang in Fanchang and Lugang in Wuhu were all defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels at Digang and Lugang were beaten and driven off.

sentences.zh: 民團克雲夢，收應城、黃安、黃坡。

translations.literal: Militia took Yunmeng and recovered Yingcheng, Huang'an, and Huangpo.
translations.idiomatic: Local militia took Yunmeng and recovered Yingcheng, Huang'an, and Huangpo.

sentences.zh: 金國琛會水師克孝感，進攻德安，逼城為壘。

translations.literal: Jin Guochen joined the water force to take Xiaogan, advanced on De'an, and pressed the city with forts.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Guochen and the river fleet took Xiaogan, besieged De'an, and ringed the walls with camps.

sentences.zh: 嘉興寇竄陷海鹽、平湖，宗棠敗寇於龍珠、桃嶺。

translations.literal: Jiaxing rebels slipped in to seize Haiyan and Pinghu; Zongtang defeated rebels at Longzhu and Taoling.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Jiaxing seized Haiyan and Pinghu; Zuo beat them at Longzhu and Taoling.

sentences.zh: 寇渡吉水海灘，陷吉安，復為知府曾詠等攻復。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the Ji River beach, took Ji'an, and were again recovered by Prefect Zeng Yong and others.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels crossed the Ji River, took Ji'an, and were driven out again by Prefect Zeng Yong.

sentences.zh: 寇由吉安東犯，分股竄峽江，與新喻賊合併，屯陰岡嶺，臨江告警。

translations.literal: Rebels from Ji'an marched east, split bands slipped into Xiajiang, merged with Xinyu rebels, camped at Yingang Ridge, and Linjiang raised the alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels marching east from Ji'an split into Xiajiang, joined Xinyu forces at Yingang Ridge, and alarmed Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 玉成分股守德安、隨州，牽綴我軍，率悍黨由蘄州、黃、廣回宿松，進太湖大營後路，繞趨宿松桃花鋪，逕竄石牌，逼安慶集賢關築壘。

translations.literal: Yucheng split forces to hold De'an and Suizhou, tying down our army, led fierce bands from Qi, Huang, and Guang back through Susong, struck the rear of the great camp at Taihu, swung toward Taohuapu in Susong, slipped straight to Shipai, and pressed to build forts at Jixian Pass of Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng left garrisons at De'an and Suizhou to pin imperial troops, swept through Qizhou and Huangzhou back to Susong, turned Taihu's rear, and built forts at Shipai threatening Anqing's Jixian Pass.

sentences.zh: 未幾，桐城、廬江偽章王林紹璋、偽干王洪仁玕等率二萬自新安渡至橫山鋪、練潭一帶，連營三十餘里。

translations.literal: Before long from Tongcheng and Lujiang the false Zhang King Lin Shaozhang, the false Gan King Hong Rengan, and others led twenty thousand from Xinan ford to Hengshanpu and Liantan, encamping in a line of more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebel princes Lin Shaozhang and Hong Rengan led 20,000 from Xinan across the ford to Hengshanpu and Liantan, pitching camps for thirty li.

sentences.zh: 至馬踏石，竄安慶，與玉成會解城圍，多隆阿分擊敗之。

translations.literal: Reaching Mataishi they slipped into Anqing, joined Yucheng to lift the siege, and Duolong'a defeated them in divided attacks.
translations.idiomatic: At Mataishi they entered Anqing to join Yucheng in relieving the siege; Duolong'a beat them in separate engagements.

sentences.zh: 玉成闌入集賢關，攻圍師各壘；

translations.literal: Yucheng broke into Jixian Pass and attacked each fort of the besieging army;
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng forced Jixian Pass and assaulted the siege camps;

sentences.zh: 復於菱湖兩岸築壘，阻水師進攻。

translations.literal: he also built forts on both banks of Linghu to block the water force's advance.
translations.idiomatic: and fortified both banks of Linghu to block the river fleet.

sentences.zh: 楊載福遣軍舁砲船入湖，毀寇船筏，復立壘湖嘴，使寇不敢逼水陸大營。

translations.literal: Yang Zaifu sent troops to carry gunboats into the lake, destroyed rebel boats and rafts, rebuilt forts at Huzui, and kept rebels from pressing the land-water great camps.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaifu hauled gunboats into the lake, destroyed rebel craft, rebuilt Huzui forts, and kept rebels from the main camps.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿自桐城掛車河進攻安慶援寇林紹璋等於練潭、橫山，逼溺菜子湖無數。

translations.literal: Duolong'a from Tongcheng advanced along Guache River to attack Anqing relief rebels Lin Shaozhang and others at Liantan and Hengshan, driving countless into Caizi Lake to drown.
translations.idiomatic: From Tongcheng, Duolong'a struck Lin Shaozhang's relief force at Liantan and Hengshan and drowned countless rebels in Caizi Lake.

sentences.zh: 黃文金糾蕪湖寇及捻二萬，築壘天林莊二十餘座，謀入安慶城，多隆阿誘斃二千，國荃圍師不少動。

translations.literal: Huang Wenjin rallied Wuhu rebels and twenty thousand Nian, built more than twenty forts at Tianlinzhuang, plotted to enter Anqing city; Duolong'a lured and killed two thousand, and Guo Quan's besiegers did not stir.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin gathered 20,000 from Wuhu and the Nian and built twenty forts at Tianlinzhuang to break into Anqing; Duolong'a killed 2,000 in an ambush while Guo Quan's siege line held firm.

sentences.zh: 水師焚奪寇船，斷其接濟，以困城寇。

translations.literal: The water force burned and seized rebel boats, cut their relief, to distress the city rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet burned rebel boats and severed supplies to starve the garrison.

sentences.zh: 侍賢自廣信竄常山，陷之，入踞江山，旋由常山分股犯衢州。

translations.literal: Shixian from Guangxin fled into Changshan, took it, entered and held Jiangshan, and soon from Changshan split bands to attack Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian fled from Guangxin, took Changshan and Jiangshan, then sent columns from Changshan against Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 先是福建援師自衢防回援汀州，軍勢驟孤，故寇乘虛回竄。

translations.literal: Earlier Fujian relief troops had returned from Quzhou defense to aid Tingzhou, and military strength was suddenly thin—so rebels seized the void and came back.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian troops had left Quzhou for Tingzhou, leaving the garrison weak, and the rebels exploited the gap.

sentences.zh: 又別股由開化白沙關竄玉山童家坊，偽為難民呼城，砲創之；

translations.literal: Another band from Kaihua Baishaguan slipped to Tongjiafang in Yushan, feigned to be refugees calling at the wall, and were wounded by cannon;
translations.idiomatic: Another column slipped from Baishaguan in Kaihua to Tongjiafang in Yushan, posed as refugees at the gate, and were shelled;

sentences.zh: 常山寇復至，會攻城，詐為援兵，奮力擊之，退屯三里街、七里街，潛掘地道，道員王德榜縋城出，大破之，寇還常山。

translations.literal: Changshan rebels came again, joined the siege, feigned to be relief troops, were struck hard and withdrew to camp at Sanli Street and Qili Street, secretly dug a tunnel; Circuit Intendant Wang Debang was lowered from the wall and routed them, and rebels returned to Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: Changshan rebels joined the siege disguised as reinforcements, were driven to Sanli and Qili Streets, and began a tunnel; Wang Debang sallied from the wall and routed them back to Changshan.

sentences.zh: 遂安寇直抵淳安港口，副將余永春中創敗退；

translations.literal: Suian rebels went straight to Chun'an harbor; Brigadier Yu Yongchun was wounded and defeated in retreat;
translations.idiomatic: Suian rebels reached Chun'an port; Brigadier Yu Yongchun was wounded and driven back;

sentences.zh: 茶園寇踵至，再退桐關。

translations.literal: Chayuan rebels followed close and they again retreated to Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: rebels from Chayuan followed, forcing another retreat to Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 嚴州大震。

translations.literal: Yanzhou was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou was thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 四月，國藩自祁門移駐東流，多隆阿擊敗玉成，棄壘遁，屯集賢關。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Guo Fan moved headquarters from Qimen to Dongliu; Duolong'a defeated Yucheng, who abandoned forts and fled, encamping at Jixian Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zeng Guofan moved from Qimen to Dongliu; Duolong'a defeated Yucheng, who abandoned his forts and held Jixian Pass.

sentences.zh: 國藩復撥鮑超一軍，胡林翼撥成大吉一軍，同赴安慶。

translations.literal: Guo Fan again assigned one army of Bao Chao, Hu Linyi assigned one army of Cheng Daji, both going to Anqing together.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan sent Bao Chao's corps and Hu Linyi sent Cheng Daji's, both to Anqing.

sentences.zh: 初，玉成卽菱湖北岸築壘十三，城寇葉芸來出城接應，亦築五壘於南岸，以隔國荃與其弟貞幹之師。

translations.literal: Earlier Yucheng had built thirteen forts on the north bank of Linghu; city rebel Ye Yunlai came out to support and also built five forts on the south bank to separate Guo Quan from his brother Zhengan's army.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng had built thirteen forts on Linghu's north bank; Ye Yunlai sallied from Anqing and raised five on the south bank to split Guo Quan from his brother Zhengan.

sentences.zh: 國荃掘長壕，包寇壘於長壕之內。

translations.literal: Guo Quan dug a long trench, wrapping rebel forts inside the long trench.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan dug a long trench that enclosed the rebel forts within it.

sentences.zh: 玉成前阻圍師，後受鮑、成兩軍夾攻，計窮遁去，猶死守關內外寇壘，又於隨州、德安各留悍寇牽掣我兵。

translations.literal: Yucheng had blocked the besiegers in front and was pinched by Bao and Cheng's two armies from behind; his plans exhausted he fled, yet still stubbornly held rebel forts inside and outside the pass, and also left fierce rebels at Suizhou and De'an each to tie down our troops.
translations.idiomatic: Pinned between the siege line and Bao and Cheng's forces, Yucheng fled but still held the forts at the pass and left strong garrisons at Suizhou and De'an to tie down imperial troops.

sentences.zh: 官文派軍攻德安，築長圍困之。

translations.literal: Guan Wen sent troops to attack De'an and built a long encirclement to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen besieged De'an with a long encirclement.

sentences.zh: 秀成踞義寧州武寧縣，逼近湖南北邊境。

translations.literal: Xiucheng held Yining Prefecture's Wuning County, pressing close to northern Hunan's border.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng held Wuning in Yining Prefecture, threatening northern Hunan.

sentences.zh: 官文派軍分守興國及崇、通、山、冶四縣。

translations.literal: Guan Wen sent troops to guard separately Xingguo and the four counties of Chong, Tong, Shan, and Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen posted troops at Xingguo and the four counties of Chongyang, Tongcheng, Tongshan, and Daye.

sentences.zh: 寇裹脅七八萬人，一由苦竹、南樓二嶺犯通城，一由蛇箭嶺犯通山。

translations.literal: Rebels coerced seventy or eighty thousand people; one column by Kuchu and Nanlou two ridges attacked Tongcheng, one by Shejian Ridge attacked Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: With 70,000–80,000 coerced followers, rebels struck Tongcheng by the Kuchu and Nanlou ridges and Tongshan by Shejian Ridge.

sentences.zh: 我軍眾寡不敵，均被闌入，直抵崇陽之白霓橋。

translations.literal: Our army was too few to match them and was broken through on all sides, reaching straight to Baini Bridge in Chongyang.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered, imperial troops were overrun and the rebels reached Baini Bridge in Chongyang.

sentences.zh: 其窺伺興國之寇，撲余際昌營，官軍戰失利，退大冶。

translations.literal: Rebels watching Xingguo struck Yu Jichang's camp; the imperial army fought and lost, retreating to Daye.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels probing Xingguo attacked Yu Jichang's camp; imperial forces fell back to Daye.

sentences.zh: 寇隨至大冶，並擾武昌。

translations.literal: Rebels followed to Daye and also harassed Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued to Daye and raided toward Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 官文咨調李續宜等屯東湖、跕紙坊一帶，相機進剿。

translations.literal: Guan Wen consulted and transferred Li Xuyi and others to camp around East Lake and Dianzhifang, to advance and suppress as opportunity allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen stationed Li Xuyi near East Lake and Dianzhifang to strike when the moment was right.

sentences.zh: 秀成自孝豐竄四路，陷長興、壽昌，分犯三里亭、千家邨；

translations.literal: Xiucheng from Xiaofeng fled in four routes, took Changxing and Shouchang, and divided attacks on Sanliting and Qianjiacun;
translations.idiomatic: From Xiaofeng, Xiucheng struck in four columns, took Changxing and Shouchang, and raided Sanliting and Qianjiacun;

sentences.zh: 復自瑞州分竄西路，連陷上高、新昌，北路陷奉新擾義安，以阻援師。

translations.literal: again from Ruizhou split to the west route, successively took Shanggao and Xinchang; the north route took Fengxin and harassed Yi'an to block relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: from Ruizhou he sent western columns through Shanggao and Xinchang and northern forces through Fengxin toward Yi'an to block reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 連日曾秉忠等水陸諸軍破走乍浦、平湖寇於金山各隘。

translations.literal: For successive days Zeng Bingzhong and others' land-water forces routed Zhepu and Pinghu rebels at various passes of Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: For days Zeng Bingzhong's combined forces drove Zhepu and Pinghu rebels from the Jinshan passes.

sentences.zh: 金山與浙之平湖水陸交錯，薛煥與秉忠商籌，平湖一日不復，松江屬一日不安；

translations.literal: Jinshan and Zhejiang's Pinghu had interlaced land and water routes; Xue Huan and Bingzhong discussed plans—if Pinghu were not recovered in a day, Songjiang's districts would not be secure for a day;
translations.idiomatic: Jinshan and Pinghu's waterways intertwined; Xue Huan and Zeng Bingzhong agreed that Songjiang could not be safe until Pinghu was recovered;

sentences.zh: 謀越境會攻平湖，再圖乍浦。

translations.literal: they planned a cross-border joint attack on Pinghu, then to aim at Zhepu again.
translations.idiomatic: they planned a joint cross-border assault on Pinghu, then Zhepu.

sentences.zh: 當陳玉成之退走也，多隆阿已進軍磨盤山，遣溫德勒克西、曹克忠、金順等分途尾追。

translations.literal: When Chen Yucheng was retreating, Duolong'a had already advanced to Mopanshan, sending Wendelekexi, Cao Kezhong, Jin Shun, and others in separate paths to pursue the tail.
translations.idiomatic: As Chen Yucheng retreated, Duolong'a advanced to Mopanshan and sent Wendelekexi, Cao Kezhong, and Jin Shun in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 玉成復糾合林紹璋、洪仁玕、黃文金及格天義陳時永、捻首孫葵心共三萬餘，併力上犯，築八壘於掛車河、[山+考]峔尖迤西棋盤嶺；

translations.literal: Yucheng again gathered Lin Shaozhang, Hong Rengan, Huang Wenjin, and Ge Tianyi Chen Shiyong, Nian chief Sun Kuixin—more than thirty thousand in all—joined strength to attack upward, building eight forts at Guache River, Kaojian Peak westward to Qipan Ridge;
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng rallied Lin Shaozhang, Hong Rengan, Huang Wenjin, Chen Shiyong, and Nian chief Sun Kuixin—over 30,000—and built eight forts from Guache River west to Qipan Ridge;

sentences.zh: 率黨破山內黃山舖團卡，仍出山外調黃文金四千餘人伏山內，自率悍黨分道進犯我壘。

translations.literal: he led bands to break mountain-inner Huangshanpu militia posts, still came out of the mountains to position Huang Wenjin's four thousand-plus in ambush inside the mountains, and personally led fierce bands in separate routes to attack our forts.
translations.idiomatic: he overran militia posts at Huangshanpu, hid 4,000 under Huang Wenjin in the hills, and led elite columns against imperial forts.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿分軍設伏於棋盤嶺、老梅樹街，而自率馬步各軍分道拒戰，寇後隊忽自亂，老梅樹街伏騎乘之，勢不支。

translations.literal: Duolong'a divided the army to set ambush at Qipan Ridge and Laomeishu Street, while personally leading horse and foot in separate routes to resist; rebel rear ranks suddenly fell into disorder, Laomeishu Street's hidden cavalry seized the moment, and they could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a ambushed at Qipan Ridge and Laomeishu Street while engaging head-on; the rebel rear collapsed when hidden cavalry struck at Laomeishu Street.

sentences.zh: 玉成督敗黨抵敵，而項家河寇壘為舒亮伏兵襲焚，烟燄突起，寇大驚，敗奔桐城。

translations.literal: Yucheng supervised the defeated bands to resist, but Xiangjiahe rebel forts were raided and burned by Shu Liang's hidden troops; smoke and flame rose suddenly, rebels were greatly alarmed, defeated and fled to Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng tried to rally his beaten troops, but Shu Liang burned the Xiangjiahe forts; smoke and flame panicked the rebels into flight toward Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 八壘悉平，燒山內寇館數十處，斃八千餘。

translations.literal: All eight forts were leveled, dozens of mountain-inner rebel lodges burned, more than eight thousand killed.
translations.idiomatic: All eight forts fell, dozens of mountain camps were burned, and over 8,000 rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 上命左宗棠幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Zuo Zongtang to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The throne appointed Zuo Zongtang to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 寇越衢州陷龍游，連陷湯谿、金華，紹興、寧波皆大震。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed Quzhou and took Longyou, successively took Tangxi and Jinhua; Shaoxing and Ningbo were both greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels bypassed Quzhou, took Longyou, Tangxi, and Jinhua, and threw Shaoxing and Ningbo into alarm.

sentences.zh: 寧、紹為浙東完善之區，寇垂涎已久。

translations.literal: Ning and Shao were the intact districts of eastern Zhejiang; rebels had long coveted them.
translations.idiomatic: Ningbo and Shaoxing were the richest districts of eastern Zhejiang, long coveted by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 金華既陷，勢將內犯。

translations.literal: With Jinhua already fallen, their momentum would invade inward.
translations.idiomatic: With Jinhua fallen, they would drive deeper into Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 寇犯丹徒，水軍敗之，毀寇浮橋。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Dantu; the water force defeated them and destroyed rebel pontoon bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Dantu; the river fleet defeated them and destroyed their pontoon bridges.

sentences.zh: 曾秉忠自金山攻青浦，寇堅壁不出，敗嘉善援寇於章練塘。

translations.literal: Zeng Bingzhong from Jinshan attacked Qingpu; rebels held walls and would not come out, and defeated Jiashan relief rebels at Zhangliantang.
translations.idiomatic: From Jinshan, Zeng Bingzhong besieged Qingpu while beating Jiashan reinforcements at Zhangliantang.

sentences.zh: 寶山防軍姜德攻嘉定以分寇勢。

translations.literal: Baoshan defense troops under Jiang De attacked Jiading to divide rebel strength.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang De's Baoshan garrison attacked Jiading to divide rebel forces.

sentences.zh: 都興阿敗天長、六合竄寇於揚州西北鄉，盡毀甘泉山寇壘。

translations.literal: Duxing'a defeated Tianchang and Luhe fleeing rebels in Yangzhou's northwest countryside and utterly destroyed Ganquanshan rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Duxing'a routed rebels from Tianchang and Luhe northwest of Yangzhou and destroyed the Ganquanshan forts.

sentences.zh: 秉忠自金山洙涇率砲船進破白虎頭、金澤鎮寇巢，直抵浙境，敗西塘援寇，進毀俞匯卡，寇退入嘉善。

translations.literal: Bingzhong from Jinshan Zhujing led gunboats to break rebel nests at Baihutou and Jinze Town, reached straight to Zhejiang border, defeated Xitang relief rebels, advanced to destroy Yu Hui checkpoint, and rebels retreated into Jiashan.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhujing at Jinshan, Zeng Bingzhong's gunboats smashed rebel bases at Baihutou and Jinze, beat Xitang reinforcements, destroyed the Yu Hui checkpoint, and drove rebels into Jiashan.

sentences.zh: 金華寇分股陷蘭谿、武義。

translations.literal: Jinhua rebels split bands to take Lanxi and Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Jinhua seized Lanxi and Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 五月，鮑超、成大吉破集賢關外赤岡嶺寇壘三，殲寇三千餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Bao Chao and Cheng Daji broke three rebel forts at Chigang Ridge outside Jixian Pass, annihilating more than three thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Bao Chao and Cheng Daji took three forts at Chigang Ridge outside Jixian Pass and killed over 3,000 rebels.

sentences.zh: 偽屈天豫賈仁富、偽傅天安李仕福、偽垂天義朱孔棠等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: The false Qu Tianyu Jia Renfu, the false Fu Tian'an Li Shifu, the false Chui Tianyi Zhu Kongtang, and others were all executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leaders Qu Tianyu Jia Renfu, Fu Tian'an Li Shifu, and Chui Tianyi Zhu Kongtang were all executed.

sentences.zh: 大吉回援武昌，餘一壘超獨破之，擒斬劉瑲林。

translations.literal: Daji returned to aid Wuchang; one remaining fort Bao alone broke, capturing and beheading Liu Yinlin.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Daji returned to Wuchang; Bao Chao alone stormed the last fort and killed Liu Yinlin.

sentences.zh: 瑲林陷蘇、常為前鋒，自恃其勇，欲以孤壘遏官軍，既伏誅，國荃軍勢自倍。

translations.literal: Yinlin as vanguard in taking Su and Chang had relied on his bravery, wishing with a lone fort to check the imperial army; once executed according to law, Guo Quan's army momentum doubled of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yinlin, the spearhead of the Suzhou and Changzhou campaigns, had held a single fort to block the imperial army; his death doubled Guo Quan's momentum.

sentences.zh: 國藩之移東流也，皖南寇度嶺內空虛，糾眾由方干嶺樟樹衛防軍而入，潛陷黟縣，築壘西武嶺等處，窺伺祁門。

translations.literal: When Guo Fan moved to Dongliu, southern Anhui rebels judged the passes within empty, gathered crowds to enter by Fanggan Ridge through Zhangshuwei defense troops, secretly took Yixian, built forts at Xiwuling and other places, and watched for Qimen.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng Guofan moved to Dongliu, southern Anhui rebels slipped through Fanggan Ridge past the Zhangshuwei garrison, seized Yixian, fortified Xiwuling, and threatened Qimen.

sentences.zh: 張運蘭等克黟縣，寇併入盧邨十都，增壘抗拒。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunlan and others recovered Yixian; rebels merged into Lu Village Ten Districts and added forts to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunlan recovered Yixian; the rebels concentrated at Lu Village's ten districts and threw up more forts.

sentences.zh: 我軍克其七壘，寇悉駢誅。

translations.literal: Our army took seven of their forts and rebels were all executed together.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops took seven forts and executed the rebels en masse.

sentences.zh: 徽州寇聞之竄走。

translations.literal: Huizhou rebels hearing this fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou rebels fled on the news.

sentences.zh: 宗棠追剿侍賢至廣信，以建德再陷，竄入鄱陽視田街，急回景德。

translations.literal: Zongtang pursued Shixian to Guangxin; because Jiande fell again, rebels slipped into Poyang Shitian Street, and he hurried back to Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo pursued Shixian to Guangxin, but when Jiande fell again rebels entered Shitian Street in Poyang and he rushed back to Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 寇宵遁，宗棠截之，大戰棡樹嶺，寇走建德後河，遂復縣城。

translations.literal: Rebels fled by night; Zongtang intercepted them, fought a great battle at Gangshuling, rebels fled to Jiande Back River, and the county seat was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled by night; Zuo intercepted them at Gangshuling, drove them to Jiande's back river, and recovered the county seat.

sentences.zh: 運蘭進攻徽州，復之。

translations.literal: Yunlan advanced to attack Huizhou and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunlan attacked Huizhou and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 汀州寇由江西瑞金回竄。

translations.literal: Tingzhou rebels fled back from Ruijin in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhou rebels retreated from Ruijin in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 時江西寇竄江山，進陷遂昌。

translations.literal: At the time Jiangxi rebels slipped into Jiangshan and advanced to take Suichang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels entered Jiangshan and seized Suichang.

sentences.zh: 秀成以一股踞瑞州、義寧、武寧，分三路犯湖北，連陷南岸興國、崇陽、通城、大冶、通山、武昌、咸寧、蒲圻，寇鋒逼武昌省城。

translations.literal: Xiucheng with one column held Ruizhou, Yining, and Wuning, divided into three routes to invade Hubei, successively took the south-bank counties of Xingguo, Chongyang, Tongcheng, Daye, Tongshan, Wuchang, Xianning, and Puqi, and rebel spears pressed the Wuchang provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng held Ruizhou, Yining, and Wuning and struck Hubei in three columns, taking Xingguo, Chongyang, Tongcheng, Daye, Tongshan, Wuchang, Xianning, and Puqi until rebels threatened Wuchang itself.

sentences.zh: 官文、李續宜會遣水陸軍分道進剿，胡林翼亦自太湖移軍還省，先援南岸，再圖黃、蘄。

translations.literal: Guan Wen and Li Xuyi jointly sent land and water forces in separate routes to pursue and suppress; Hu Linyi also moved his army from Taihu back to the province, first aiding the south bank, then aiming at Huang and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen and Li Xuyi sent combined forces in pursuit; Hu Linyi returned from Taihu to relieve the south bank first, then turned toward Huangzhou and Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 寇之竄擾江西者，自去冬以來，前後凡五大股，其由皖境竄入，自北而南者三股：一曰黃文金，連陷建德、鄱陽六縣；

translations.literal: Of rebels raiding Jiangxi, since last winter there had been five great columns in all; those slipping in from Anhui, from north to south, were three columns: one was Huang Wenjin, who successively took Jiande and six counties of Poyang;
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had raided Jiangxi in five major waves since last winter. Three columns entered from Anhui southward: Huang Wenjin took Jiande and six Poyang counties;

sentences.zh: 一曰李侍賢，連陷浮梁、景德等處。

translations.literal: one was Li Shixian, who successively took Fuliang, Jingde, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian took Fuliang, Jingde, and neighboring towns.

sentences.zh: 此二股均經左宗棠擊退，未能深入江西腹地。

translations.literal: These two columns were both beaten back by Zuo Zongtang and could not penetrate deep into Jiangxi's interior.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang drove both columns back before they could penetrate inland Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 一曰李秀成，連圍玉山、廣信、廣豐三城，又深入內地，圍建昌，撲撫州，均未破，竄入崇仁樟樹鎮、吉安峽江，並踞瑞州府城，分竄奉新、靖安、武寧、義寧各州縣，又竄入湖北之興國、大冶、蒲圻、崇、通等處。

translations.literal: one was Li Xiucheng, who successively besieged Yushan, Guangxin, and Guangfeng, then went deep inland, besieged Jianchang, struck Fuzhou—none were taken—slipped into Chongren Zhangshu Town and Ji'an Xiajiang, held Ruizhou prefectural city, split into Fengxin, Jing'an, Wuning, and Yining, and again slipped into Hubei's Xingguo, Daye, Puqi, Chong, and Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng besieged Yushan, Guangxin, and Guangfeng, probed Jianchang and Fuzhou, held Ruizhou, raided Fengxin, Jing'an, Wuning, and Yining, and drove into Hubei's Xingguo, Daye, Puqi, Chongyang, and Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 此北三股也。

translations.literal: These were the northern three columns.
translations.idiomatic: These were the three northern columns.

sentences.zh: 其由兩廣竄入，自南而北者二股：一曰廣東股，其渠有周姓、許姓，上年由仁化、樂昌闌入江西，與李秀成聯合，圍攻廣信、南豐、建昌各城，連陷湖口、興安、婺源，經左宗棠攻克德、婺兩城，遂歸併徽州。

translations.literal: Those slipping in from the two Guang, from south to north, were two columns: one was the Guangdong column, its chiefs surnamed Zhou and Xu; the year before they had broken into Jiangxi from Renhua and Lechang, joined Li Xiucheng, besieged Guangxin, Nanfeng, and Jianchang, successively took Hukou, Xing'an, and Wuyuan; after Zuo Zongtang recovered De and Wu two cities, they merged back into Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Two southern columns came from Guangdong and Guangxi. The Guangdong band under Zhou and Xu entered from Renhua and Lechang, joined Xiucheng, took Hukou, Xing'an, and Wuyuan, and after Zuo recovered Dehua and Wuyuan merged into Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 一曰廣西股，其渠為朱衣點、彭大瞬，本石達開之餘黨也。

translations.literal: one was the Guangxi column, its chiefs Zhu Yidian and Peng Dashun, originally remnant bands of Shi Dakai.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi column under Zhu Yidian and Peng Dashun were remnants of Shi Dakai's force.

sentences.zh: 由江西竄出湖南，經過南贛，陷福建之汀州，回竄江西，蹂躪寧都、建昌、河口等處。

translations.literal: They slipped out of Jiangxi into Hunan, passed southern Gan, took Fujian's Tingzhou, fled back into Jiangxi, and trampled Ningdu, Jianchang, Hekou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed into Hunan, took Tingzhou in Fujian, returned to trample Ningdu, Jianchang, and Hekou.

sentences.zh: 其前隊已由婺源竄浙，後隊尚留撫州。

translations.literal: Their vanguard had already slipped through Wuyuan into Zhejiang; the rear guard still held Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The vanguard reached Zhejiang through Wuyuan while the rear still held Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 此南二股也。

translations.literal: These were the southern two columns.
translations.idiomatic: These were the two southern columns.

sentences.zh: 五大股中，又分為三支、四支，忽分忽合，時南時北。

translations.literal: Among the five great columns they again split into three or four branches, suddenly dividing and joining, now south now north.
translations.idiomatic: The five columns split and reunited, shifting between south and north.

sentences.zh: 國藩令鮑超回援江西，由九江直搗建昌，先保江西省城。

translations.literal: Guo Fan ordered Bao Chao to return and aid Jiangxi, from Jiujiang straight to Jianchang, first securing Jiangxi's provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan ordered Bao Chao back to Jiangxi from Jiujiang toward Jianchang to secure Nanchang first.

sentences.zh: 瑞州及各縣踞寇逼近南昌，毓科留張運桂等扼屯城外，劉于潯屯安義堡，後營屯生米，丁峻屯臨江，皆為省垣西路屏蔽。

translations.literal: Rebels holding Ruizhou and various counties pressed close to Nanchang; Yuke left Zhang Yungui and others to block camps outside the city, Liu Yuxun camped at Anyi Fort, rear camps at Shengmi, Ding Jun at Linjiang—all shields for the provincial capital's western road.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels near Ruizhou threatened Nanchang; Yuke posted Zhang Yungui outside the walls and Liu Yuxun, Ding Jun, and others along the western approaches.

sentences.zh: 李續宜克武昌，寇陷松陽、處州、永康、縉雲。

translations.literal: Li Xuyi took Wuchang; rebels took Songyang, Chuzhou, Yongkang, and Jinyun.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xuyi recovered Wuchang while rebels seized Songyang, Chuzhou, Yongkang, and Jinyun.

sentences.zh: 縉雲既復，寇竄永康。

translations.literal: With Jinyun recovered, rebels fled to Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinyun was retaken the rebels withdrew to Yongkang.

sentences.zh: 宗棠遣軍克建德，國藩移屯婺源，婺源者，界江、皖、浙三省之衝也。

translations.literal: Zongtang sent troops to take Jiande; Guo Fan moved camp to Wuyuan—the crossroads of Jiangxi, Anhui, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo took Jiande; Zeng Guofan moved to Wuyuan at the junction of Jiangxi, Anhui, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 賴裕新合汀州寇犯德興，分黨踞九都之新建，遣軍敗之。

translations.literal: Lai Yuxin joined Tingzhou rebels to attack Dexing, split bands to hold Xinjiang in Jiudu, and sent troops to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Yuxin and Tingzhou rebels attacked Dexing; imperial troops beat their detachment at Xinjiang in Jiudu.

sentences.zh: 寇渡江竄浙江開化華埠，德興、婺源肅清。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the river to slip into Zhejiang's Kaihua Huabu; Dexing and Wuyuan were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels crossed into Kaihua Huabu in Zhejiang; Dexing and Wuyuan were cleared.

sentences.zh: 游擊黃載清克遂昌，松陽踞寇亦聞風遁，載清進攻宣平克之，寇竄武義，處屬肅清。

translations.literal: Ranger Huang Zaiqing took Suichang; Songyang rebels also fled on the news; Zaiqing advanced on Xuanping and took it, rebels fled to Wuyi, and the Chuzhou region was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zaiqing recovered Suichang and Xuanping; rebels fled to Wuyi and the Chuzhou area was pacified.

sentences.zh: 金華知府王桐等克永康，寇併趨金華。

translations.literal: Jinhua Prefect Wang Tong and others took Yongkang; rebels all rushed toward Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Tong of Jinhua recovered Yongkang; rebels converged on Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 江陰、常熟寇由海壩竄壽星沙，大肆焚掠。

translations.literal: Jiangyin and Changshu rebels from the sea embankment slipped to Shouxing Sandbar and burned and plundered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Jiangyin and Changshu raided Shouxing Sandbar by sea and burned widely.

sentences.zh: 六月，曾國荃會水師破菱湖北岸十三壘、南岸五壘，斬馘九千餘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zeng Guoquan joined the water force to break thirteen forts on Linghu's north bank and five on the south bank, beheading more than nine thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Guo Quan and the river fleet took thirteen north-bank and five south-bank forts at Linghu, killing over 9,000 rebels.

sentences.zh: 寇之踞湖北咸寧、蒲圻、通城者，我軍均克復。

translations.literal: Rebels holding Xianning, Puqi, and Tongcheng in Hubei were all recovered by our army.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces recovered Xianning, Puqi, and Tongcheng in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 寇由武寧犯建昌。

translations.literal: Rebels from Wuning attacked Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Wuning struck Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 金華寇出擾曹宅等處，李元度克義寧。

translations.literal: Jinhua rebels raided Caozhai and other places; Li Yuandu took Yining.
translations.idiomatic: Jinhua rebels raided Caozhai; Li Yuandu recovered Yining.

sentences.zh: 張玉良等率水陸軍圍攻蘭谿不下。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuliang and others led land and water forces to besiege Lanxi without success.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuliang besieged Lanxi without success.

sentences.zh: 寇偵嚴州軍單，築壘女埠，下竄嚴州，陷之，尋為張玉良所復。

translations.literal: Rebels spied that Yanzhou's army was thin, built forts at Nubu, slipped down to Yanzhou and took it, soon recovered by Zhang Yuliang.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Yanzhou weak, rebels fortified Nubu, seized Yanzhou, and were soon driven out by Zhang Yuliang.

sentences.zh: 寇陷上高，擾萬載。

translations.literal: Rebels took Shanggao and harassed Wanzai.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Shanggao and raided Wanzai.

sentences.zh: 知縣翁延緒等克復武寧。

translations.literal: Magistrate Weng Yanxu and others recovered Wuning.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Weng Yanxu recovered Wuning.

sentences.zh: 水師李德麟等擊毀黃山、黃田、石牌三港寇船，壽星沙寇退回江陰。

translations.literal: The water force under Li Delin and others destroyed rebel boats at Huangshan, Huangtian, and Shipai harbors; Shouxing Sandbar rebels returned to Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Delin's fleet destroyed rebel craft at Huangshan, Huangtian, and Shipai; Shouxing Sandbar rebels withdrew to Jiangyin.
