sentences.zh: 蘇州寇擾青浦，李恆嵩自北簳山移屯塘橋，以固松江門戶。

translations.literal: Suzhou rebels harassed Qingpu; Li Hengsong moved from Beigan Hill to camp at Tangqiao to secure Songjiang's gateway.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou rebels raided Qingpu; Li Hengsong shifted to Tangqiao to guard Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉定寇糾蘇州寇犯上海，我軍禦於真如。

translations.literal: Jiading rebels rallied Suzhou rebels to attack Shanghai; our army met them at Zhenru.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading and Suzhou rebels attacked Shanghai; imperial troops met them at Zhenru.

sentences.zh: 寇渡河竄華漕，奪踞參將王占魁壘，薛煥遣軍奪還。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the river to slip into Huacao, seized Brigadier Wang Zhankui's fort; Xue Huan sent troops to retake it.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels crossed to Huacao and seized Wang Zhankui's fort until Xue Huan retook it.

sentences.zh: 寇走南翔，再敗退嘉定。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Nanxiang, were beaten again, and retreated to Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: They fled to Nanxiang, were beaten again, and withdrew to Jiading.

sentences.zh: 時江水盛漲，國藩檄楊載福圖池州，牽掣南岸。

translations.literal: As the river was in flood, Guo Fan ordered Yang Zaifu to target Chizhou and tie down the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: With the river high, Zeng Guofan ordered Yang Zaifu against Chizhou to pin the south bank.

sentences.zh: 載福攻十日不能下，乃率李成謀三營至舊縣，偵北岸無為瀕江壘寇避水移神塘裏河，駛擊破之，進攻州城。

translations.literal: Zaifu attacked ten days without success, then led Li Chengmo's three battalions to Jiuxian, spied that north-bank Wuwei riverside forts had moved inland to Shentangli River to avoid water, sailed to strike and break them, and advanced on the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: After ten days at Chizhou, Zaifu took three battalions to Jiuxian, caught Wuwei riverside rebels inland at Shentangli, smashed them, and advanced on the city.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成、楊輔清死力抗拒。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng and Yang Fuqing resisted with all their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng and Yang Fuqing resisted fiercely.

sentences.zh: 還軍次大通，敗青陽寇，還屯黃石磯。

translations.literal: Returning he halted at Datong, defeated Qingyang rebels, and camped again at Huangshiji.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew to Datong, beat Qingyang rebels, and encamped at Huangshiji.

sentences.zh: 七月，玉成糾輔清眾十餘萬自無為州犯英山，繞宿松，徑攻太湖，為救援安慶計。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yucheng rallied Fuqing's masses of more than a hundred thousand from Wuwei Prefecture to invade Yingshan, circled Susong, and struck straight at Taihu as a plan to relieve Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Yucheng led over 100,000 from Wuwei through Yingshan and Susong against Taihu to relieve Anqing.

sentences.zh: 寇排隊山岡作長蛇勢。

translations.literal: Rebels lined up on hill ridges in long-snake formation.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels formed a long-snake line along the ridges.

sentences.zh: 復有寇數萬自龍山宮對岸至塔下，袤延二十餘里，分路誘我軍，我軍堅守不動。

translations.literal: Again tens of thousands of rebels came from Longshangong opposite bank to below the tower, stretching more than twenty li, dividing routes to lure our army; our army held firm without moving.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands more came from Longshangong to the tower, spread over twenty li, and tried to lure imperial troops, who held firm.

sentences.zh: 夜大雨，賊洶湧潮進，城中飛丸隨雨落，至晨圍始解。

translations.literal: At night came great rain; rebels surged forward like a tide; projectiles from the city fell with the rain; by morning the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: A night storm brought a rebel surge; the garrison rained shot until dawn and the siege lifted.

sentences.zh: 玉成乃自小池驛進至清河高樓嶺，欲結桐城寇包裹我軍，以解安慶之圍。

translations.literal: Yucheng then advanced from Xiaochiyi to Gaolou Ridge at Qinghe, wishing to join Tongcheng rebels to wrap our army and lift Anqing's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng moved from Xiaochiyi to Gaolou Ridge to link with Tongcheng rebels and envelop the siege army.

sentences.zh: 攻撲六晝夜，玉成、輔清援桴鼓督軍，揮刀砍不前者。

translations.literal: They attacked and struck for six days and nights; Yucheng and Fuqing beat drums to direct the army, waving swords to cut down those who would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: For six days Yucheng and Fuqing beat drums and cut down waverers to drive assaults.

sentences.zh: 我軍奮擊，大挫其鋒。

translations.literal: Our army struck hard and greatly blunted their edge.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops struck hard and broke their momentum.

sentences.zh: 玉成、輔清率大隊竄至高河鋪、馬鞍山，桐城圍復合。

translations.literal: Yucheng and Fuqing led the great host to flee to Gaohepu and Ma'anshan; the Tongcheng encirclement closed again.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng and Fuqing fled to Gaohepu and Ma'anshan; the Tongcheng siege ring closed again.

sentences.zh: 安慶圍師悉平城外諸壘。

translations.literal: Anqing's besieging army leveled all forts outside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: The Anqing besiegers cleared every outer fort.

sentences.zh: 秀成自竄踞瑞州，分陷上高、新昌、奉新等縣，以瑞州為老巢。

translations.literal: Xiucheng since fleeing to hold Ruizhou had taken Shanggao, Xinchang, Fengxin, and other counties, taking Ruizhou as his old nest.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng made Ruizhou his base and seized Shanggao, Xinchang, and Fengxin.

sentences.zh: 官文檄元度會軍攻克新昌、奉新、上高，敗寇均趨瑞州。

translations.literal: Guan Wen ordered Yuandu to join forces and recover Xinchang, Fengxin, and Shanggao; defeated rebels all fled toward Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen had Yuandu recover Xinchang, Fengxin, and Shanggao, driving rebels toward Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 乃遣游擊賀接華等會軍直搗郡城，攻復之。

translations.literal: He then sent Ranger He Jiehua and others to join forces and strike straight at the prefectural city and recover it.
translations.idiomatic: He Jiehua and others stormed and recovered the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 官文以德安寇謀窺荊襄，派水陸諸軍節次嚴剿，寇堅守，有冒死突出者，諸軍擊潰，寇不得入城。

translations.literal: Guan Wen, because De'an rebels plotted to spy on Jing and Xiang, sent land and water forces in sequence to suppress strictly; rebels held firm; some burst out at the cost of death; the armies struck them routed and rebels could not enter the city.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen tightened the siege of De'an when rebels threatened Jingzhou and Xiangyang; sorties were beaten back.

sentences.zh: 寇復出抄我軍後以援前寇，乃斷其歸路，寇奔河西，伏兵四合，架梯入，立復府城。

translations.literal: Rebels again came out to cut our army's rear to aid the front rebels; they then cut rebel return routes; rebels fled to Hexi; hidden troops closed from four sides; ladders were raised to enter, and the prefectural city was quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels tried to hit the imperial rear; their retreat was cut; they fled west of the river, were trapped, and De'an was retaken at once.

sentences.zh: 程學啟克安慶北門外三石壘，北門寇路已絕。

translations.literal: Cheng Xueqi took three stone forts outside Anqing's north gate; the north gate rebel route was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi took three stone forts outside Anqing's north gate and severed the northern rebel route.

sentences.zh: 德安寇竄河南信陽，轉犯羅山、光山、商城，兵團截擊，退奔皖境。

translations.literal: De'an rebels slipped into Henan's Xinyang, turned to attack Luoshan, Guangshan, and Shangcheng; militia intercepted; they retreated into Anhui territory.
translations.idiomatic: De'an rebels raided Xinyang and the Guang-Shang region, then were driven back into Anhui.

sentences.zh: 鮑超督諸軍大破豐城西北岸寇壘，東岸屯寇驚潰，劉于潯乘之，收樟樹鎮。

translations.literal: Bao Chao supervised the armies to break great Fengcheng northwest-bank rebel forts; east-bank camp rebels fled in panic; Liu Yuxun seized the moment and recovered Zhangshu Town.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao smashed Fengcheng's northwest forts; east-bank rebels fled and Liu Yuxun recovered Zhangshu Town.

sentences.zh: 初，超自九江進軍，秀成聞風遠遁，率瑞州、奉新、清安、安義之寇，先分萬人擾撫州；

translations.literal: Earlier when Chao advanced from Jiujiang, Xiucheng fled far on the news, leading Ruizhou, Fengxin, Qing'an, and Anyi rebels, first splitting ten thousand to harass Fuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: When Bao advanced from Jiujiang, Xiucheng fled, sent 10,000 to harass Fuzhou,

sentences.zh: 令玉成率悍黨二萬攻豐城，而自領大隊由臨江踞樟樹、沙湖、豐城一帶，綿亙百餘里。

translations.literal: ordered Yucheng to lead twenty thousand fierce bands to attack Fengcheng, while he personally led the great host from Linjiang to hold Zhangshu, Shahu, and Fengcheng, stretching over a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: sent Yucheng with 20,000 against Fengcheng, and held Zhangshu and Fengcheng with his main force for a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 先一日，超至豐城對河，值寇在樟樹為浮橋，陣山岡，超分中、後、左、右四隊齊進，寇搖旗迎拒，戰一時許，大敗，馘八千餘人。

translations.literal: The day before, Chao reached Fengcheng opposite bank; rebels were at Zhangshu building a pontoon, arrayed on a hill; Chao divided center, rear, left, and right four teams to advance together; rebels waved flags to meet; after about an hour of battle they were greatly defeated, more than eight thousand beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Bao reached Fengcheng as rebels built a pontoon at Zhangshu; in an hour's fight he killed over 8,000.

sentences.zh: 八月，克安慶城，城外四偽王竄集賢關。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Anqing city was taken; four false kings outside fled to Jixian Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Anqing fell; four rebel kings outside fled to Jixian Pass.

sentences.zh: 安慶既復，東南之勢益促。

translations.literal: With Anqing recovered, the southeast situation grew more pressing.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing's fall tightened the noose on the southeast.

sentences.zh: 水軍進克池州，乘勝下剿，復銅陵縣。

translations.literal: The water force advanced to take Chizhou, pressed the pursuit downstream, and recovered Tongling County.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet took Chizhou and recovered Tongling downstream.

sentences.zh: 時偽右軍劉官才方盤踞池州，與安慶相犄角。

translations.literal: At the time the false Right Army Liu Guancai still held Chizhou, mutually supporting Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Right Army commander Liu Guancai still held Chizhou in support of Anqing.

sentences.zh: 內則堅守石埭、太平，阻徽師進兵之路；

translations.literal: Inwardly he firmly held Shicheng and Taiping, blocking the Huizhou army's advance;
translations.idiomatic: He held Shicheng and Taiping inland, blocking the Huizhou advance;

sentences.zh: 外則上犯德、建、鄱陽，為江省北邊之患。

translations.literal: outwardly he attacked upward into De, Jian, and Poyang, a scourge on Jiangxi's north border.
translations.idiomatic: outwardly he raided Dehua, Jiande, and Poyang, threatening northern Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 今與安慶相繼而下，皖南軍勢益張。

translations.literal: Now with Anqing taken in succession, southern Anhui military momentum grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: With Anqing gone, southern Anhui momentum surged.

sentences.zh: 國荃與多隆阿會議，以桐城為七省要道、安慶咽喉，寇死守待援；

translations.literal: Guoquan and Duolong'a conferred; Tongcheng was the vital route of seven provinces and Anqing's throat; rebels held firm awaiting relief;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan and Duolong'a agreed Tongcheng was the throat of seven provinces; rebels held on for relief;

sentences.zh: 玉成尚擁眾數萬，徘徊於集賢關內外，謀與桐城合併。

translations.literal: Yucheng still commanded tens of thousands, lingering inside and outside Jixian Pass, plotting to merge with Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng still had tens of thousands at Jixian Pass, seeking to join Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 乃會軍進擊，玉成、輔清皆大敗，越山而逸，遂復其城。

translations.literal: They then joined armies to attack; Yucheng and Fuqing were both greatly defeated, fled over the mountains, and the city was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: A joint assault routed Yucheng and Fuqing over the hills and Tongcheng was recovered.

sentences.zh: 宿松、黃梅、蘄州、廣濟相繼下。

translations.literal: Susong, Huangmei, Qizhou, and Guangji fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Susong, Huangmei, Qizhou, and Guangji followed.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿進屯蘄州曹家渡，扼下游敗寇，以絕黃州寇援。

translations.literal: Duolong'a advanced to camp at Caojiadu in Qizhou, blocking downstream defeated rebels to cut off Huangzhou rebel relief.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a camped at Caojiadu in Qizhou to block fugitives and Huangzhou relief.

sentences.zh: 李續燾等會同水師進攻黃州，寇築壘浚壕以抗我軍。

translations.literal: Li Xutan and others joined the water force to attack Huangzhou; rebels built forts and dredged moats to resist our army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xutan and the fleet besieged Huangzhou behind forts and deep moats.

sentences.zh: 蔣凝學令投誠劉維楨服寇衣，偽為援眾；

translations.literal: Jiang Ningxue ordered the surrendered Liu Weizhen to wear rebel clothes and feign to be relief masses;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ningxue had the defector Liu Weizhen pose as rebel reinforcements;

sentences.zh: 復造玉成偽文，誘寇出，而設伏以待，寇果出，為我軍所殲，立復黃州。

translations.literal: again forged a false document of Yucheng to lure rebels out, while setting ambush to wait; rebels indeed came out and were annihilated by our army; Huangzhou was quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: forged orders in Yucheng's name to lure the garrison out into an ambush; Huangzhou was retaken at once.

sentences.zh: 時秀成竄出豐城，踞白馬寨，遣黨攻撫州。

translations.literal: At the time Xiucheng slipped out of Fengcheng and held Baima Stockade, sending bands to attack Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng fled Fengcheng for Baima Stockade and sent raiders against Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 鮑超馳至，撫圍立解。

translations.literal: Bao Chao hurried there and the Fuzhou siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao arrived and lifted the Fuzhou siege immediately.

sentences.zh: 寇走貴谿，得廣東新寇，合大眾據湖防河口，勢甚洶湧。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Guixi, gained new Guangdong rebels, combined a great mass to hold Hukou estuary, momentum very surging.
translations.idiomatic: They fled to Guixi, swelled with Guangdong recruits, and held the Hukou estuary in force.

sentences.zh: 超分五路應之，蹋毀七十餘壘，進復鉛山。

translations.literal: Chao answered in five routes, trampled and destroyed more than seventy forts, advanced and recovered Qianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Bao struck in five columns, destroyed seventy forts, and recovered Qianshan.

sentences.zh: 國藩移駐安慶省城。

translations.literal: Guo Fan moved headquarters to Anqing provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan moved his headquarters into Anqing city.

sentences.zh: 初，侍賢攻嚴州，兩月不能下，乃於烏石、方門二灘連環築壘，逼近外壕。

translations.literal: Earlier when Shixian attacked Yanzhou, two months could not take it; he then at Wushi and Fangmen two fords built linked forts, pressing close to the outer moat.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian had besieged Yanzhou two months, then built linked forts at Wushi and Fangmen against the outer wall.

sentences.zh: 城內糧盡援絕，副將羅大春受重傷，率將士突北門出，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Inside the city grain was exhausted and relief cut off; Brigadier Luo Dachun was heavily wounded and led officers and soldiers to burst out the north gate; the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: With food gone, Luo Dachun was wounded leading a breakout through the north gate; Yanzhou fell.

sentences.zh: 秀成自桐廬、新城進陷餘杭。

translations.literal: Xiucheng from Tonglu and Xincheng advanced to take Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng took Yuhang from Tonglu and Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 寇之竄貴谿者，聞鮑超自撫州至，豫遁走。

translations.literal: Rebels fleeing to Guixi heard Bao Chao was coming from Fuzhou and fled beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Guixi rebels fled when they heard Bao Chao was coming from Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，閩寇三起，與花旗廣匪先後由建昌竄至廣信，與秀成併為一路。

translations.literal: Earlier Fujian rebels rose three times; with foreign-flag Guang bandits they had slipped from Jianchang to Guangxin and merged with Xiucheng on one route.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian rebels and foreign-flag Guang bandits had slipped from Jianchang to Guangxin and joined Xiucheng.

sentences.zh: 鮑超會屈蟠大破廣信寇壘，立解城圍。

translations.literal: Bao Chao joined Qu Pan to break Guangxin rebel forts and quickly lifted the city siege.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao and Qu Pan smashed Guangxin forts and lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 秀成敗走鉛山，築七壘，與城寇相守禦。

translations.literal: Xiucheng fled defeated to Qianshan, built seven forts, and with city rebels held mutual defense.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng fled to Qianshan, built seven forts, and held the city with the garrison.

sentences.zh: 超踵至，悉覆其壘，渡河攻城，克之。

translations.literal: Chao followed close, overthrew all forts, crossed the river to attack the city, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Bao followed, destroyed the forts, crossed the river, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 秀成竄圍廣豐，不克，分竄玉山，築壘十餘，復為道員王德榜所破。

translations.literal: Xiucheng slipped to besiege Guangfeng without success, split to slip into Yushan, built more than ten forts, and was again broken by Circuit Intendant Wang Debang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng failed at Guangfeng, raided Yushan, built ten forts, and was broken by Wang Debang.

sentences.zh: 秀成全股悉自江西竄犯浙境，一由玉山陷常山，一由廣豐犯江山，龍游踞寇同時出擾，衢州危迫。

translations.literal: Xiucheng's whole force all slipped from Jiangxi to invade Zhejiang territory—one column by Yushan took Changshan, one by Guangfeng attacked Jiangshan; Longyou-held rebels sallied together; Quzhou was critically pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng's entire force left Jiangxi for Zhejiang—through Yushan and Guangfeng toward Changshan and Jiangshan while Longyou rebels sallied, threatening Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月知府張詩華克復瀘谿、興安各城。

translations.literal: That month Prefect Zhang Shihua recovered Luxi and Xing'an cities.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prefect Zhang Shihua recovered Luxi and Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 福建援軍張啟煊擊寇浦江，失利，陷之。

translations.literal: Fujian relief troops under Zhang Qixuan attacked rebels at Pujiang, lost, and it fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixuan's Fujian relief force was beaten at Pujiang and the town fell.

sentences.zh: 寇直犯五指山，金華大股踵至，米興朝等迎擊失利。

translations.literal: Rebels struck straight at Wuzhi Mountain; a great Jinhua column followed close; Mi Xingchao and others met them in attack and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels hit Wuzhi Mountain as a large Jinhua force followed; Mi Xingchao was defeated.

sentences.zh: 義烏、東陽相繼不守。

translations.literal: Yiwu and Dongyang in succession could not be held.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu and Dongyang fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 啟煊退守諸暨辟水嶺，寇至再潰。

translations.literal: Qixuan retreated to defend Zhuji at Bishui Ridge; when rebels arrived he was routed again.
translations.idiomatic: Qixuan fell back to Bishui Ridge at Zhuji and was routed again.

sentences.zh: 九月，寇陷處州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month rebels took Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month rebels took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 大軍之破安慶也，無為州寇馬玉棠妻子居安慶，曾國荃生致之，密諭玉棠獻無為城。

translations.literal: When the great army broke Anqing, Wuwei Prefecture rebel Ma Yutang's wife and children lived in Anqing; Zeng Guoquan sent for them alive and secretly instructed Yutang to surrender Wuwei city.
translations.idiomatic: When Anqing fell, Zeng Guoquan took Ma Yutang's family hostage and secretly urged him to surrender Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 無為居皖北形勢，控金陵，引蕪湖，為寇必爭之路。

translations.literal: Wuwei occupies Anhui north's strategic terrain, controls Jinling, draws on Wuhu, and is a route rebels must fight for.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwei commanded northern Anhui, Nanjing, and Wuhu—a route the rebels had to hold.

sentences.zh: 附近泥汊口、神塘河諸處，石壘星列，以阻我軍。

translations.literal: Nearby at Nizhakou, Shentang River, and other places stone forts stood like stars to block our army.
translations.idiomatic: Stone forts at Nizhakou and Shentang River blocked the imperial advance.

sentences.zh: 曾國荃會同水師抵泥汊口，壘高難仰攻，乃令築寨安營，而自率勁旅迅赴楊家橋、鳳凰頸，決隄斷寇歸路。

translations.literal: Zeng Guoquan joined the water force to reach Nizhakou; forts were high and hard to attack from below, so he ordered camps built, while personally leading elite troops swiftly to Yangjia Bridge and Fenghuang Neck, breaking dikes to cut rebel return routes.
translations.idiomatic: At Nizhakou Guo Quan entrenched while leading elites to Yangjia Bridge and Fenghuang Neck to break dikes and sever rebel retreat.

sentences.zh: 寇大恐，遁入城。

translations.literal: Rebels were greatly afraid and fled into the city.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels panicked and fled into the city.

sentences.zh: 越日，攻神塘河，寇亦遁歸，乘勝直抵城下。

translations.literal: The next day they attacked Shentang River; rebels also fled back; pressing the victory they reached straight below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they took Shentang River and pressed to the walls.

sentences.zh: 至是玉棠事洩，偽頂王朱王陰幽之。

translations.literal: By then Yutang's affair leaked; the false Top King Zhu Wangyin imprisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yutang's plot was exposed and the rebel Top King Zhu Wangyin imprisoned him.

sentences.zh: 玉棠黨舉兵攻王陰，我軍乘之，寇大潰。

translations.literal: Yutang's party raised troops to attack Wangyin; our army seized the moment; rebels were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Yutang's men attacked Wangyin; imperial troops routed the garrison.

sentences.zh: 斃偽豫侯、丞相等，城立復。

translations.literal: The false Yu Hou, Chancellor, and others were killed; the city was quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel leaders including the false Yu Hou were killed and Wuwei was recovered.

sentences.zh: 秀成由臨浦陷蕭山，再由蕭山塘路竄杭州，陷諸暨、紹興府城，分竄新昌、嵊縣。

translations.literal: Xiucheng from Linpu took Xiaoshan, then by the Xiaoshan canal route slipped into Hangzhou, took Zhuji and Shaoxing prefectural city, and split into Xinchang and Sheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng took Xiaoshan, entered Hangzhou, seized Zhuji and Shaoxing, and raided Xinchang and Sheng County.

sentences.zh: 上虞、餘姚均先後失守。

translations.literal: Shangyu and Yuyao both fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyu and Yuyao fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 國荃連破運漕鎮及東關鎮，鎮在無為、含山之界，外瀕大江，內連巢湖，寇糧皆屯於此，上濟安慶、廬州，下輸金陵，為南北鎖鑰。

translations.literal: Guoquan successively broke Yuncao Town and Dongguan Town; the towns lay on the Wuwei-Hanshan border, faced the great river outward and linked Chaohu inward; rebel grain was all stored here, supplying Anqing and Luzhou above and Nanjing below—the north-south lock.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan took Yuncao and Dongguan, rebel grain depots on the Wuwei-Hanshan border that fed Nanjing and Anqing.

sentences.zh: 偽巨王洪某率眾五六千，並砲船數十，守之。

translations.literal: The false Giant King Hong someone led five or six thousand masses and dozens of gunboats to guard them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Giant King Hong held the towns with 5,000–6,000 men and dozens of gunboats.

sentences.zh: 寇失此益膽落。

translations.literal: Rebels losing this grew more faint-hearted.
translations.idiomatic: The loss broke rebel morale.

sentences.zh: 十月，楚軍克復隨州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Chu army recovered Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Chu army recovered Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 湖北自黃州、德安復後，惟隨州以孫捻援應，擾及襄陽，憑堅死抗。

translations.literal: In Hubei after Huangzhou and De'an were recovered, only Suizhou with Sun Nian relief, harassing Xiangyang, held firm and resisted to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Only Suizhou, aided by the Nian, still held out and threatened Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 官文擊退豫捻，復用降將劉維楨取黃州計，誘寇出城敗之，克復州城。

translations.literal: Guan Wen beat back Henan Nian, again used the surrendered Liu Weizhen's Huangzhou stratagem to lure rebels out and defeat them, and recovered the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen drove off Henan Nian bands and used Liu Weizhen's ruse to retake Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿收舒城、廬江，李續宜部將蔣凝學屯六安、霍山，宗棠屯婺源，張運蘭等屯徽州，李元度新軍出廣信，寇悉赴浙江，而皖南寇聚保廬州。

translations.literal: Duolong'a recovered Shucheng and Lujiang; Li Xuyi's officer Jiang Ningxue camped at Lu'an and Huoshan; Zongtang at Wuyuan; Zhang Yunlan and others at Huizhou; Li Yuandu's new army out of Guangxin; rebels all rushed to Zhejiang while southern Anhui rebels gathered to hold Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a took Shucheng and Lujiang; imperial forces spread across Lu'an, Wuyuan, Huizhou, and Guangxin while rebels flooded Zhejiang and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 宗棠議大舉援浙，浙寇猖獗，全省糜爛，逼近省垣。

translations.literal: Zongtang discussed a major relief of Zhejiang; Zhejiang rebels were rampant, the whole province ravaged, pressing the provincial walls.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo planned a major relief as Zhejiang burned and rebels neared the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 上命曾國藩管轄江蘇、安徽、江西、浙江軍務。

translations.literal: The throne ordered Zeng Guofan to oversee military affairs of Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: The court placed Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang under Zeng Guofan's command.

sentences.zh: 秀全見各省攻討嚴劇，迭克名城，金陵唾手可下，乃大懼，令秀成、侍賢分途竄擾，分我兵力。

translations.literal: Xiuquan saw each province attacked severely, famous cities taken in succession, Jinling within easy reach, and was greatly afraid; he ordered Xiucheng and Shixian to flee and harass on separate routes to divide our strength.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan, fearing Nanjing's fall, sent Xiucheng and Shixian to raid widely and split imperial forces.

sentences.zh: 秀成竄浙江，疊陷各郡邑，直至餘杭，浙省戒嚴。

translations.literal: Xiucheng fled into Zhejiang, took prefectures and counties in succession, reaching Yuhang; Zhejiang province was on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng overran Zhejiang to Yuhang and put the province on alert.

sentences.zh: 寇從塘路抵杭州，撲武林門外賣魚橋，踞我營卡。

translations.literal: Rebels from the canal route reached Hangzhou, struck outside Wulin Gate at Maiyu Bridge, and seized our camp posts.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels reached Hangzhou, hit Maiyu Bridge outside Wulin Gate, and seized imperial outposts.

sentences.zh: 寇隊尋大至，運糧道阻。

translations.literal: Rebel columns soon grew large; grain transport routes were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel numbers swelled and supply lines were cut.

sentences.zh: 提督張玉良來援，與城軍夾守。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Governor Zhang Yuliang came to aid and with city troops held jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuliang reinforced the city in a joint defense.

sentences.zh: 寇乃自海潮寺至鳳凰山，環木柵實土其中為堅壁，使城外隔絕，日以槍砲轟城。

translations.literal: Rebels then from Haichao Temple to Fenghuang Hill ringed wooden palisades and packed earth within as strong walls, isolating the suburbs, daily bombarding the city with muskets and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: From Haichao Temple to Fenghuang Hill they built earth-filled palisades and shelled the city daily.

sentences.zh: 玉良攻木柵，中砲死。

translations.literal: Yuliang attacked the palisades and was killed by cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Yuliang was killed assaulting the palisades.

sentences.zh: 內外兵益懼，而城中久乏糧，人多餓死。

translations.literal: Inside and outside troops grew more fearful; inside the city grain had long been scarce and many starved.
translations.idiomatic: Defenders panicked as famine killed many in the city.

sentences.zh: 自蕭山、諸暨等城陷後，援兵路絕。

translations.literal: After Xiaoshan, Zhuji, and other cities fell, relief routes were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: With Xiaoshan and Zhuji lost, relief could not reach Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 寇尋陷奉化、台州，十一月，由慈谿犯陷鎮海。

translations.literal: Rebels soon took Fenghua and Taizhou; in the eleventh month from Cixi they invaded and took Zhenhai.
translations.idiomatic: They took Fenghua and Taizhou, and in the eleventh month seized Zhenhai from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 台州寇分股陷黃巖、寧波，會同輔清由浙江嚴州遂安踰嶺回竄徽州，復蔓延衢屬開化，其謀在深入江、皖腹地，阻我援浙之師。

translations.literal: Taizhou rebels split to take Huangyan and Ningbo; joining Fuqing they crossed from Zhejiang's Yanzhou Suian over the ridge back into Huizhou, again spreading through Quzhou's Kaihua—their plan to penetrate Jiang-Anhui interior and block our Zhejiang relief.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou and Ningbo columns re-entered Huizhou and Kaihua to block imperial relief into Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 宗棠於廣德奉督辦浙江軍務之命，以寇圍徽郡，當入浙後路，遣軍至婺源，會防軍援剿。

translations.literal: Zongtang at Guangde received orders to supervise Zhejiang military affairs; with rebels besieging Huizhou he must guard Zhejiang's rear route, sent troops to Wuyuan, and joined defense forces in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangde, Zuo was ordered to supervise Zhejiang affairs and sent troops through Wuyuan to guard the rear.

sentences.zh: 輔清大舉分犯徽州、休寧，兩敗於屯谿、篁墩，遂趨南路，逕逼嚴郡；

translations.literal: Fuqing launched a great divided attack on Huizhou and Xiuning, was twice defeated at Tunxi and Huangdun, then turned south and pressed straight on Yan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Fuqing twice failed at Tunxi and Huangdun, then drove on Yanzhou;

sentences.zh: 而秀成已陷杭州，滿城亦相繼失守。

translations.literal: while Xiucheng had already taken Hangzhou and the Manchu quarter also fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: while Xiucheng had taken Hangzhou and the Manchu quarter fell.

sentences.zh: 輔清率寧國寇圍攻徽州、休寧兩城，偽成天安竄休寧之屯谿，尋又竄篁墩。

translations.literal: Fuqing led Ningguo rebels to besiege Huizhou and Xiuning; the false Chengtian'an slipped to Tunxi in Xiuning, then again to Huangdun.
translations.idiomatic: Fuqing besieged Huizhou and Xiuning while the rebel Chengtian'an shifted from Tunxi to Huangdun.

sentences.zh: 十二月，總兵張運桂堅守徽城待援，乘間出擊破寇壘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Brigadier Zhang Yungui held Huizhou city awaiting relief and seized an interval to sally and break rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhang Yungui held Huizhou and sallied to smash rebel forts.

sentences.zh: 寇復踞屯谿、市街、潛口一帶，以絕徽軍糧道。

translations.literal: Rebels again held Tunxi, Market Street, and Qian Mouth to cut Huizhou army grain routes.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Tunxi and Qian Mouth to starve the Huizhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 國藩調總兵朱品隆馳赴休寧，與唐義訓先破屯谿街口寇卡，毀河邊四壘，進平石橋、潛口寇巢，尋派軍護糧赴徽。

translations.literal: Guo Fan transferred Brigadier Zhu Pinlong to hurry to Xiuning; with Tang Yixun he first broke Tunxi Street rebel posts, destroyed four riverside forts, leveled Shiqiao and Qian Mouth nests, then sent troops to escort grain to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng sent Zhu Pinlong and Tang Yixun to clear Tunxi and escort grain to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 寇由萬安街分股包抄，我軍奮擊之，寇不敢遏。

translations.literal: Rebels from Wan'an Street split to outflank; our army struck hard and rebels did not dare block.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial counterattack at Wan'an Street stopped the rebel encirclement.

sentences.zh: 張運桂以嚴市街為寇踞，糧道梗阻，與休寧軍會商兜剿，燬寇十餘壘，輔清受傷。

translations.literal: Zhang Yungui, with Yanshi Street held by rebels and grain routes blocked, conferred with Xiuning forces for a converging strike, burned more than ten rebel forts, and Fuqing was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yungui and Xiuning troops burned a dozen forts; Fuqing was wounded.

sentences.zh: 值除夕大雪，寇掠無所得，悉遁去，圍立解。

translations.literal: On New Year's Eve came great snow; rebels plundered nothing and all fled; the siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: A New Year's Eve blizzard left the rebels empty-handed and the siege lifted.

sentences.zh: 是月，提督李世忠克復天長、六合。

translations.literal: That month Provincial Military Governor Li Shizhong recovered Tianchang and Luhe.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Shizhong recovered Tianchang and Luhe.

sentences.zh: 寇自八年踞六合，屢攻不下。

translations.literal: Rebels since the eighth year had held Luhe and could not be taken despite repeated attacks.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had held Luhe since the eighth year against repeated assaults.

sentences.zh: 黃雅冬思反正，潛約世忠先削其外壘，而己為內應。

translations.literal: Huang Yadong wished to defect, secretly agreeing with Shizhong first to reduce outer forts while he would act as inside collaborator.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yadong plotted defection, promising Shizhong to take the outer forts from within.

sentences.zh: 世忠自滁州至六合，遂大破寇壘，斬馮𢤀林，直造城下。

translations.literal: Shizhong from Chuzhou to Luhe greatly broke rebel forts, beheaded Feng Yulin, and reached straight below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong marched from Chuzhou, smashed the forts, killed Feng Yulin, and reached the walls.

sentences.zh: 黃雅冬倒戈，縱火拔關，我軍擁入城，擒斬衝天福林國安、頂天燕江玉城、攀天福魏正福五十餘人，皆悍黨也。

translations.literal: Huang Yadong turned his blades, set fire and opened the gate; our army poured in, capturing and beheading Chongtianfu Lin Guoan, Dingtianyan Jiang Yucheng, Pantianfu Wei Zhengfu, more than fifty—all fierce bands.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yadong opened the gates; imperial troops entered and executed fifty rebel chiefs including Lin Guoan.

sentences.zh: 詔黃雅冬更名朝棟。

translations.literal: An edict renamed Huang Yadong to Chaodong.
translations.idiomatic: The throne renamed Huang Yadong Chaodong.

sentences.zh: 世忠以黃朝棟密約天長寇陳世明為內應，朝棟所部未盡薙髮，詐為援寇進城下，世明拔關納軍，遂克之。

translations.literal: Shizhong had Huang Chaodong secretly agree with Tianchang rebel Chen Shiming as inside collaborator; Chaodong's troops had not all shaved heads, feigned to be relief rebels at the walls; Shiming opened the gate and admitted the army, and it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong used Chaodong and Chen Shiming to feign relief and seize Tianchang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，汀州寇竄陷連城，分竄上杭。

translations.literal: That year Tingzhou rebels slipped to take Liancheng and split into Shanghang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tingzhou rebels took Liancheng and raided Shanghang.

sentences.zh: 江西寇復闌入武平境，時寇謀分股：一圖窺龍、巖，一由清流、寧化擾延平、邵武。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebels again broke into Wuping territory; at the time rebels planned to split: one column to spy on Long and Yan, one from Qingliu and Ninghua to harass Yanping and Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels entered Wuping, planning raids toward Longyan and the Yanping-Shaowu line.

sentences.zh: 總督慶端以延平為全省關鍵，馳往駐紮；

translations.literal: Governor-General Qing Duan, seeing Yanping as the whole province's key, hurried to camp there;
translations.idiomatic: Governor Qing Duan rushed to Yanping, the province's key point;

sentences.zh: 克連城，進攻汀州，創洪容海，克之。

translations.literal: took Liancheng, advanced on Tingzhou, wounded Hong Ronghai, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: he recovered Liancheng, attacked Tingzhou, wounded Hong Ronghai, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 而江西續竄武平之寇，亦為副將林文察等擊敗。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebels continuing into Wuping were also defeated by Brigadier Lin Wenzha and others.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Wenzha beat Jiangxi rebels entering Wuping.

sentences.zh: 國藩疏請飭慶端嚴守浦城，俾寇不得由閩境竄江西。

translations.literal: Guo Fan memorialized urging Qing Duan to hold Pucheng strictly so rebels could not slip through Fujian into Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan urged Qing Duan to hold Pucheng and block a Fujian-Jiangxi corridor.

sentences.zh: 同治元年正月，是時浙、蘇兩省膏腴盡為寇有，全浙所存，尚有湖州、海寧兩城，又孤懸賊中，獨衢州一府尚可圖存。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi, at the time the fertile lands of Zhe and Su were all held by rebels; all that remained in Zhejiang were Huzhou and Haining, isolated in rebel territory; only Quzhou Prefecture could still be hoped to survive.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi year one only Huzhou, Haining, and Quzhou still held out in ruined Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 國藩疏薦福建延邵建寧道李鴻章署理江蘇巡撫，別立一軍，由滬圖蘇；

translations.literal: Guo Fan memorialized recommending Fujian's Yan-Shao-Jian-Ning Circuit Intendant Li Hongzhang as acting Jiangsu governor, establishing a separate army from Shanghai toward Su;
translations.idiomatic: Zeng recommended Li Hongzhang for Jiangsu and a Shanghai-based army to recover Su.

sentences.zh: 以圍攻金陵屬曾國荃，以浙事屬左宗棠。

translations.literal: siege of Jinling was assigned to Zeng Guoquan, Zhejiang affairs to Zuo Zongtang.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan would besiege Nanjing; Zuo would handle Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 於是東南寇勢日就衰熄。

translations.literal: Thus southeast rebel momentum daily approached decline and extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern rebel power began to collapse.

sentences.zh: 世忠攻江浦，約劉元成、單玉功為內應，殺偽報王、偽宗王、操天福等七十餘名，立復江浦；

translations.literal: Shizhong attacked Jiangpu, arranged Liu Yuancheng and Shan Yugong as inside collaborators, killed the false Bao King, false Zong King, Caotianfu, and more than seventy others, and quickly recovered Jiangpu;
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong retook Jiangpu with inside help, killing over seventy rebel officers.

sentences.zh: 至浦口，復克其城。

translations.literal: reaching Pukou, again recovered that city.
translations.idiomatic: He then recovered Pukou.

sentences.zh: 自江、浙兩省寇糾眾數十萬，併力東犯，連陷奉賢、南匯、川沙等廳縣，烽火遍浦東，逼上海。

translations.literal: From Jiang and Zhe provinces rebels gathered hundreds of thousands, combined eastward, successively took Fengxian, Nanhui, Chuansha, and other districts; beacon fires filled Pudong, pressing Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Hundreds of thousands from Jiangsu and Zhejiang overran Pudong and threatened Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 各隘防軍遇寇輒潰走。

translations.literal: Defense troops at each pass fled whenever rebels appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops fled at rebel contact.

sentences.zh: 寇既為法船所擊退，踞天馬山陳防橋，復為李恆嵩所破，敗入青浦城中。

translations.literal: Rebels having been beaten back by French ships, held Tianma Hill at Chenfang Bridge, were again broken by Li Hengsong, and fled defeated into Qingpu city.
translations.idiomatic: Beaten by French vessels, rebels held Tianma Hill, then were driven into Qingpu by Li Hengsong.

sentences.zh: 其浦東大股踞高橋，欲斷我要隘。

translations.literal: Their great Pudong column held Gaoqiao, wishing to cut our vital pass.
translations.idiomatic: A large Pudong force at Gaoqiao tried to sever Shanghai's lifeline.

sentences.zh: 美人華爾、白齊文撲寇巢，毀其壁，進攻浦東、浦南，大破之。

translations.literal: Americans Ward and Burgevine struck rebel nests, destroyed their walls, advanced on Pudong north and south, and broke them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Ward and Burgevine destroyed rebel bases in Pudong and routed them.

sentences.zh: 尋嘉定、青浦寇進逼七寶，以窺上海圍防軍郭太平營。

translations.literal: Soon Jiading and Qingpu rebels pressed Qibao to spy on Shanghai encirclement-defense troops under Guo Taiping's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading and Qingpu rebels probed Qibao toward Guo Taiping's Shanghai lines.

sentences.zh: 薛煥督軍解其圍，甫還軍，寇復大至。

translations.literal: Xue Huan directed troops to lift the siege; just as the army returned, rebels came again in force.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huan relieved the siege, but rebels returned as soon as troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章率湘淮軍援江蘇，營上海城南。

translations.literal: Hongzhang led Xiang-Huai armies to aid Jiangsu, camping south of Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang brought the Xiang-Huai army to camp south of Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 黃翼升統水師相繼至。

translations.literal: Huang Yisheng commanding the water force arrived in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yisheng's fleet followed.

sentences.zh: 宗棠出嶺攻開化，楊輔清糾眾踞張邨、銀坑、石佛嶺，窺伺衢州，連戰走之，陣斬藍以道，開化肅清。

translations.literal: Zongtang crossed the ridge to attack Kaihua; Yang Fuqing gathered masses at Zhangcun, Yinkeng, and Shifo Ridge, watching Quzhou; after successive battles they were driven off; Lan Yidao was beheaded on the field; Kaihua was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo cleared Kaihua after killing Lan Yidao and driving Yang Fuqing from Quzhou's approaches.

sentences.zh: 九洑洲寇竄江浦、浦口、和州，分黨犯橋林。

translations.literal: Jiufuzhou rebels slipped to Jiangpu, Pukou, and Hezhou, split bands to attack Qiaolin.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Jiufuzhou raided Jiangpu, Pukou, Hezhou, and Qiaolin.

sentences.zh: 二月，嘉善、平湖寇水陸犯金山、洙涇，七日，陷之。

translations.literal: In the second month Jiashan and Pinghu rebels by land and water attacked Jinshan and Zhujing; on the seventh day they fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Jiashan and Pinghu forces took Jinshan and Zhujing.

sentences.zh: 松江、上海俱震。

translations.literal: Songjiang and Shanghai were both shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang and Shanghai were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 東梁山偽愛王黃崇發、西梁山偽親王某、裕谿口偽善王陳觀意糾合雍家鎮寇，分股上竄五顯廟、水家邨、湯家溝，水師李成謀登岸破之，斬黃崇發。

translations.literal: East Liangshan false Ai King Huang Chongfa, West Liangshan false Qin King someone, Yuxikou false Shan King Chen Guanyi rallied Yongjia Town rebels, split columns up to Wuxian Temple, Shuijiacun, and Tangjiagou; the water force Li Chengmo landed and broke them, beheading Huang Chongfa.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengmo's marines killed Huang Chongfa and broke rebel columns at Wuxian Temple and Tangjiagou.

sentences.zh: 初，宗棠既克開化，進軍常山璞石，偵李侍賢嗾壽昌蘭谿寇糾遂安恭天義賴連繡犯開化馬金，謀長圍困我。

translations.literal: Earlier when Zongtang had taken Kaihua he advanced to Changshan Pushi, spied that Li Shixian incited Shouchang and Lanxi rebels with Suian Gongtianyi Lai Lianxiu to attack Kaihua Majin, planning a long encirclement to trap us.
translations.idiomatic: After Kaihua, Zuo learned Shixian was sending Lai Lianxiu against Majin to encircle his army.

sentences.zh: 宗棠回攻遂安，乘援寇未集，先剿克之。

translations.literal: Zongtang returned to attack Suian, and before relief rebels gathered, first pursued and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo turned on Suian and took it before reinforcements arrived.

sentences.zh: 三月，李元度敗寇於江山碗窯，再敗小青湖援寇。

translations.literal: In the third month Li Yuandu defeated rebels at Jiangshan Wanyao, again defeated Xiaoqing Lake relief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Yuandu won at Wanyao in Jiangshan and beat Xiaoqing Lake reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 江山賊進陷峽口閩軍曾元福壘，踞之，連營數十里。

translations.literal: Jiangshan rebels advanced to take Xiakou Fujian army Zeng Yuanfu's fort, held it, and encamped in a line of several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangshan rebels seized Zeng Yuanfu's fort at Xiakou and camped for miles.

sentences.zh: 宗棠自常山遣軍進剿。

translations.literal: Zongtang from Changshan sent troops to pursue and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo sent troops from Changshan in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 林文察之克遂昌也，寇併聚松陽，蔓延雲和、景寧，尋以次擊退，進規處州，破寇松陽平港頭寇壘，寇奔處州碧湖。

translations.literal: When Lin Wenzha took Suichang, rebels gathered at Songyang, spread through Yunhe and Jingning, were beaten back in succession, advanced on Chuzhou, broke rebel Songyang Pinggangtou fort, and rebels fled to Chuzhou Bihu.
translations.idiomatic: After Suichang, Lin Wenzha drove rebels from Songyang toward Chuzhou Bihu.

sentences.zh: 上年國藩檄鮑超平青陽城外寇壘，作長圍困之。

translations.literal: The year before Guo Fan ordered Bao Chao to level Qingyang outer forts and made a long encirclement to besiege.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zeng Guofan had Bao Chao besiege Qingyang's outer forts.

sentences.zh: 偽奉王古隆賢潛糾浙江死黨三萬餘人進撲銅陵，分我軍勢。

translations.literal: The false Feng King Gu Longxian secretly rallied more than thirty thousand Zhejiang diehards to strike Tongling and divide our army's strength.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Feng King Gu Longxian sent 30,000 Zhejiang hard fighters against Tongling.

sentences.zh: 超率援軍盡掃橫塘等處百餘卡三十六壘。

translations.literal: Chao led relief troops and swept more than a hundred posts and thirty-six forts at Hengtang and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Bao swept over a hundred posts and thirty-six forts at Hengtang.

sentences.zh: 古隆賢偵知大軍北出，陰統涇、太悍寇築九壘於青陽豬婆店阻我師，以通糧道。

translations.literal: Gu Longxian spied that the great army had marched north, secretly commanded Jing-Tai fierce rebels to build nine forts at Qingyang Zhupodian to block our army and open grain routes.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Longxian built nine forts at Zhupodian to reopen Qingyang's supplies.

sentences.zh: 適超凱旋，進逼青陽，克之。

translations.literal: Just as Chao returned victorious, he pressed Qingyang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Bao returned and took Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 國荃既募湘勇回安慶，國藩飭令攻取巢縣、含山、和州、西梁山等處，以為欲制寇死命，先自巢始，遂進屯縣城東北。

translations.literal: Guoquan having recruited Xiang braves back to Anqing, Guo Fan ordered taking Chaoxian, Hanshan, Hezhou, West Liangshan, and other places, thinking to grip rebels' life-and-death, starting from Chao; he then advanced to camp northeast of the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng ordered Guo Quan from Anqing against Chaoxian, Hanshan, Hezhou, and West Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 劉連捷等赴望山岡以扼南路，寇乘我壘未定來犯，拒敗之。

translations.literal: Liu Lianjie and others went to Wangshangang to block the south route; rebels attacked while our forts were not yet fixed and were repelled and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lianjie held Wangshangang and repelled a rebel attack on unfinished works.

sentences.zh: 初，寇踞江岸以北，上援廬州，下衛江寧，分布堅城，拒守要塞，通上下之氣，杜我進兵要路。

translations.literal: Earlier rebels held north of the riverbank to aid Luzhou above and guard Jiangning below, distributing strong cities, holding vital passes, linking upper and lower breath, blocking our advance routes.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had fortified the north bank to link Luzhou and Nanjing and block imperial advances.

sentences.zh: 至是攻破巢縣銅城閘、雍家鎮，旋收巢縣，復含山，再會水師大破裕溪口寇屯。

translations.literal: Now they broke Chaoxian Tongcheng Pass and Yongjia Town, soon recovered Chaoxian, again Hanshan, and again joined the water force to break Yuxikou rebel camps greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces took Tongcheng Pass, Yongjia Town, Chaoxian, Hanshan, and smashed Yuxikou.

sentences.zh: 寇之踞金陵也，以全力扼東西梁山，兩山對峙，大江至此一束，水急流洄，視小孤山尤為形勝。

translations.literal: When rebels held Jinling they used full strength to choke East and West Liangshan; the two mountains faced each other; the great river here narrowed; water ran swift with eddies—more strategically formidable than Little Gushan.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had choked the Yangtze at East and West Liangshan, a narrows more vital than Little Gushan.

sentences.zh: 國荃以此關為金陵鎖鑰，循江上逼西梁山而陣。

translations.literal: Guoquan took this pass as Jinling's lock and advanced upriver pressing West Liangshan into formation.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan treated West Liangshan as Nanjing's key and advanced upriver.

sentences.zh: 寇走江州，水陸爭起搏擊，遂克之。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Jiangzhou; land and water rose together to grapple; it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled to Jiangzhou and were defeated on land and water.

sentences.zh: 自是金陵重鎮已失其半。

translations.literal: From this Jinling's vital strongpoints had lost half.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing's outer defenses were half gone.

sentences.zh: 偽匡王賴文鴻竄繁昌縣，糾約踞寇撲我三山峽營。

translations.literal: The false Kuang King Lai Wenhong slipped into Fanchang County, colluded with holding rebels to strike our Sanshan Gorge camp.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Kuang King Lai Wenhong raided Fanchang and struck the Sanshan Gorge camp.

sentences.zh: 曾貞幹乘寇未逼，督軍分道馳剿，寇大亂，殪其渠吳大嘴，遂克繁昌。

translations.literal: Zeng Zhengan before rebels pressed close supervised troops in separate routes to pursue; rebels fell into great disorder; their chief Wu Dazui was killed; Fanchang was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Zhengan routed them and killed Wu Dazui, recovering Fanchang.

sentences.zh: 蕪湖援寇潛屯魯港以圖抗拒，貞幹會同水師奪其船百餘艘，夷三壘十餘卡，餘悉遁蕪湖；

translations.literal: Wuhu relief rebels secretly camped at Lugang to resist; Zhengan joined the water force to seize more than a hundred of their boats, leveled three forts and more than ten posts; the rest all fled to Wuhu;
translations.idiomatic: Zhengan and the fleet seized a hundred boats at Lugang and cleared the forts;

sentences.zh: 貞幹督各軍馳抵南陵，立復其城。

translations.literal: Zhengan supervised each army to hurry to Nanling and quickly recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengan then recovered Nanling.

sentences.zh: 鮑超既克青陽，議先取石埭、太平以固徽州之防，繼取涇縣以達寧國之路；

translations.literal: Bao Chao having taken Qingyang, discussed first taking Shicheng and Taiping to secure Huizhou's defense, then Jing County to reach the Ningguo route;
translations.idiomatic: After Qingyang, Bao planned to take Shicheng and Taiping, then Jing County toward Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 乃分軍五路，由龍口直抵石埭，寇矢石交下，總兵婁雲慶從西、北二門攻入，立復縣城。

translations.literal: He then divided the army into five routes from Longkou straight to Shicheng; rebels rained arrows and stones; Brigadier Lou Yunqing entered from west and north gates and quickly recovered the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Bao's five columns took Shicheng; Lou Yunqing stormed the west and north gates.

sentences.zh: 寇大懼，糾集南陵援寇大至，屯甘棠鎮阻我師。

translations.literal: Rebels were greatly afraid, gathered Nanling relief rebels in force, camped at Gantang Town to block our army.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels massed at Gantang Town to block the advance.

sentences.zh: 我軍分三路進擊，破十七壘，遂復太平，擒斬偽主將徐國華等三十七人。

translations.literal: Our army advanced in three routes, broke seventeen forts, recovered Taiping, and captured and beheaded the false chief general Xu Guohua and thirty-seven others.
translations.idiomatic: In three columns imperial troops broke seventeen forts, recovered Taiping, and executed Xu Guohua and thirty-six other rebel generals.

sentences.zh: 先是超攻青陽時，有偽佐將張遇春率眾萬餘乞降，超納之，令暫屯景德三谿。

translations.literal: Earlier when Chao attacked Qingyang, the false Assistant General Zhang Yuchun led more than ten thousand to beg surrender; Chao accepted them and ordered temporary camp at Jingde Sanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingyang campaign the rebel Assistant General Zhang Yuchun surrendered 10,000 men to Bao Chao.

sentences.zh: 至是太平賊寇將北走，張遇春驟起殲之。

translations.literal: At this time Taiping rebel bands were about to flee north; Zhang Yuchun suddenly rose and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: As Taiping rebels fled north, Zhang Yuchun turned and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 超回軍挾之，進攻涇縣，復其城，遂東渡清弋江，進規寧國。

translations.literal: Chao returned with them in support, advanced on Jing County, recovered the city, then crossed east over the Qingyi River toward Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: Bao took Jing County, crossed the Qingyi, and advanced on Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢自陷常山，與龍游寇同撲衢州，總兵李定泰等敗之，復常山，解衢州之圍。

translations.literal: Li Shixian since taking Changshan joined Longyou rebels to strike Quzhou; Brigadier Li Dingtai and others defeated them, recovered Changshan, and lifted Quzhou's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian's assault on Quzhou failed; Li Dingtai recovered Changshan and relieved the siege.

sentences.zh: 宗棠馳至常山，攻克招賢關，以通衢州糧道。

translations.literal: Zongtang hurried to Changshan, took Zhaoxian Pass to open Quzhou's grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo took Zhaoxian Pass and reopened Quzhou's supply line.

sentences.zh: 其撲江山之寇，檄李元度會攻石門花園港寇巢，毀十四壘，寇勢不支，乘夜向台州潛遁。

translations.literal: Rebels striking Jiangshan were ordered by Yuan Du to join attack on Shimen Huayuan Harbor nest, destroyed fourteen forts; rebel momentum could not hold and by night they slipped toward Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel attacks on Jiangshan collapsed; they fled toward Taizhou by night.

sentences.zh: 是時楊輔清由淳化犯遂安，宗棠自常山進屯開化圖之，尋遣劉典進攻遂安；

translations.literal: At the time Yang Fuqing from Chunhua attacked Suian; Zongtang from Changshan camped at Kaihua to target him, soon sent Liu Dian to attack Suian;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing raided Suian; Zuo moved through Kaihua and sent Liu Dian against him;

sentences.zh: 輔清退走淳安、昌化，竄皖南犯寧國。

translations.literal: Fuqing retreated to Chun'an and Changhua, slipped into southern Anhui to attack Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: Fuqing withdrew through Chun'an toward Ningguo in southern Anhui.

sentences.zh: 四月，儀徵寇敗後，竄擾沙漫洲等處，水師擊走之，揚境肅清。

translations.literal: In the fourth month after Yizheng rebels were defeated they harassed Shamanzhou and other places; the water force drove them off and the Yang region was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the fleet cleared rebel raids around Yizheng.

sentences.zh: 浙軍會民團克復台州仙居、黃巖、太平、寧海，縉雲、樂清、慈谿等縣，擒斬延天義李元徠，偽王李洪藻、李遇茂，偽主將李尚揚。

translations.literal: Zhejiang forces with militia recovered Taizhou's Xianju, Huangyan, Taiping, Ninghai, Jinyun, Yueqing, Cixi, and other counties, capturing and beheading Yantianyi Li Yuanlai, false kings Li Hongzao and Li Yumao, and false chief general Li Shangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe forces recovered eastern Zhejiang towns and killed Li Yuanlai and other rebel leaders.

sentences.zh: 尋進克寧波府鎮海、青田二縣。

translations.literal: Soon they advanced to take Ningbo Prefecture's Zhenhai and Qingtian counties.
translations.idiomatic: They then took Zhenhai and Qingtian near Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 台、處寇上竄溫州，踞太平嶺及任橋、瞿谿，尋分竄瑞安，張啟煊營陷，退守縣城。

translations.literal: Taizhou and Chuzhou rebels fled up to Wenzhou, held Taiping Ridge and Renqiao and Quxi, soon split to Ruian; Zhang Qixuan's camp fell and he retreated to hold the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels threatened Wenzhou; Zhang Qixuan's camp fell and he held Ruian.

sentences.zh: 楚皖軍會克廬州，秀成竄擾蘇、常，玉成則盤踞皖、楚之交。

translations.literal: Chu-Anhui armies jointly took Luzhou; Xiucheng harassed Su and Chang; Yucheng held the Anhui-Hubei border.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces took Luzhou while Xiucheng raided Jiangsu and Yucheng held the Anhui-Hubei frontier.

sentences.zh: 自大軍克復安慶，玉成率黨自石牌而上，調宿松、黃梅之寇同至野雞河，欲赴湖北德安、襄陽招集其黨，群酋不從，乘夜由六安走廬州，眾漸攜貳。

translations.literal: Since the great army recovered Anqing, Yucheng led bands up from Shipai, called Susong and Huangmei rebels to Yejie River, wished to go to Hubei's De'an and Xiangyang to rally his bands; chieftains would not follow; by night he went through Lu'an to Luzhou and the masses gradually wavered.
translations.idiomatic: After Anqing fell, Yucheng tried to rally Hubei, was refused, and fled toward Luzhou as his army wavered.

sentences.zh: 秀全復督責甚切，玉成懼，力守廬州不敢走，皖、楚諸軍困之，日盼外援。

translations.literal: Xiuquan again supervised and blamed severely; Yucheng feared, held Luzhou firmly without fleeing; Anhui-Hubei armies besieged him, daily hoping for outside relief.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan rebuked him; Yucheng held Luzhou under siege awaiting aid.

sentences.zh: 而潁郡解圍後，偽扶王陳得才西竄，偽天將馬融和隨張洛行遠遁，外援遂絕。

translations.literal: After Ying Prefecture's siege lifted, the false Fu King Chen Decai fled west; the false Heaven General Ma Ronghe followed Zhang Luoxing far away; outside relief was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Decai and Ma Ronghe fled west; outside relief ended.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿與皖軍張得勝設伏誘賊出戰，兩軍合擊，寇大敗，遂克府城，誅偽官二百十三名。

translations.literal: Duolong'a with Anhui army Zhang Desheng set ambush to lure rebels to battle; two armies joined strike; rebels were greatly defeated; the prefectural city was taken; two hundred thirteen false officials were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a and Zhang Desheng took Luzhou and executed 213 rebel officials.

sentences.zh: 玉成奔壽州，尚有死黨二千，以苗沛霖陰受偽封，往乞援；

translations.literal: Yucheng fled to Shouzhou, still had two thousand diehards, and because Miao Peilin secretly accepted a false title went to beg relief;
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng reached Shouzhou with 2,000 men and sought help from Miao Peilin.

sentences.zh: 沛霖縛之，獻潁州勝保大營，並擒偽導王陳士才、偽從王陳德、偽統天義陳聚成、偽天軍主將向士才、偽虔天義陳安成、偽禱天義梁顯新，及親隨偽官二十餘，並正法。

translations.literal: Peilin bound him and presented him to Sheng Bao's great camp at Yingzhou, also capturing the false Dao King Chen Shicai, false Cong King Chen De, false Tongtianyi Chen Jucheng, false Tianjun chief Xiang Shicai, false Qiantianyi Chen Ancheng, false Daotianyi Liang Xianxin, and more than twenty close false officials—all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Peilin delivered Yucheng and twenty rebel leaders to Sheng Bao for execution.

sentences.zh: 秀成聞玉成死，頓足歎曰：「吾無助矣！

translations.literal: Xiucheng hearing Yucheng was dead stamped his foot and sighed: "I have no help!
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng learned of Yucheng's death and cried, "I am lost!

sentences.zh: 」玉成兇狠亞楊秀清，而戰略尤過之，軍中號「四眼狗」。

translations.literal: " Yucheng was fierce and cruel next to Yang Xiuqing, yet strategy surpassed him; the army called him "Four-Eyed Dog."
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng, called the Four-Eyed Dog, had been fiercer and shrewder than Yang Xiuqing.

sentences.zh: 自玉成伏誅，楚、皖稍得息肩，而金陵勢益孤矣。

translations.literal: Since Yucheng was executed, Chu and Anhui could slightly rest shoulders, while Jinling's situation grew more isolated.
translations.idiomatic: With Yucheng dead, Hubei and Anhui breathed easier and Nanjing stood more alone.

sentences.zh: 民團克寧海、象山、奉化。

translations.literal: Militia took Ninghai, Xiangshan, and Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: Militia recovered Ninghai, Xiangshan, and Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 李世忠大破寇於六合八步橋，寇竄滁州來安，又大敗。

translations.literal: Li Shizhong greatly broke rebels at Luhe's Babu Bridge; rebels fled to Chuzhou and Lai'an and were again defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong routed rebels at Babu Bridge and again at Chuzhou and Lai'an.

sentences.zh: 寇勢大餒。

translations.literal: Rebel momentum greatly withered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel momentum collapsed.

sentences.zh: 華爾等克柘林，謀搗金山衞。

translations.literal: Ward and others took Zhelin, planning to strike Jinshan Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Ward took Zhelin and planned to hit Jinshan Wei.

sentences.zh: 知府李慶琛攻太倉，秀成率偽聽王陳炳文、偽納王郜雲官來援，逼青浦。

translations.literal: Prefect Li Qingchen attacked Taicang; Xiucheng led the false Listening King Chen Bingwen and false Na King Gao Yunguan to relieve, pressing Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingchen attacked Taicang; Xiucheng sent Chen Bingwen and Gao Yunguan to relieve and press Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 李恆嵩失利，退走塘橋。

translations.literal: Li Hengsong lost and retreated to Tangqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hengsong was beaten back to Tangqiao.

sentences.zh: 嘉定、寶山皆震。

translations.literal: Jiading and Baoshan were both shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading and Baoshan were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 寇別隊由婁塘攻陷嘉定，英、法二提督及我軍突圍走上海。

translations.literal: Another rebel column by Loutang took Jiading; British and French admirals and our army broke out to flee to Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Jiading; Allied and imperial forces broke out to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 鴻章飭軍駐法華鎮，扼滬西，寇遂踰青浦，逕逼松江。

translations.literal: Hongzhang ordered troops at Fahua Town to choke west of Shanghai; rebels then crossed Qingpu and pressed straight on Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang held Fahua Town; rebels crossed Qingpu toward Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 秀全自竄踞金陵，以東西梁山為鎖鑰，以蕪湖為屏蔽，而尤以金柱關為關鍵。

translations.literal: Xiuquan since fleeing to hold Jinling took East-West Liangshan as lock, Wuhu as screen, and especially Jingzhuguan as the key.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan held East-West Liangshan, Wuhu, and Jingzhuguan as Nanjing's keys.

sentences.zh: 自國荃破太平府，彭玉麟破金柱關，黃翼升往襲東梁山一戰而下，貞幹循江進克蕪湖，提督王明山等復攻破烈山石壘，未逾三日，上下要隘悉為我有。

translations.literal: Since Guoquan broke Taiping Prefecture, Peng Yulin broke Jingzhuguan, Huang Yisheng raided East Liangshan and took it in one battle, Zhengan advanced along the river to take Wuhu, and Provincial Military Governor Wang Mingshan and others again broke Lieshan stone fort—in less than three days all vital passes above and below were ours.
translations.idiomatic: In days Guo Quan, Peng Yulin, and Huang Yisheng took Taiping, Jingzhuguan, Wuhu, and Lieshan.

sentences.zh: 從此上而寧國，下而江寧，寇均失所恃矣。

translations.literal: From this upward to Ningguo, downward to Jiangning, rebels all lost what they relied on.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo above and Nanjing below no longer sustained the rebels.

sentences.zh: 國荃進軍江寧鎮，屯板橋，潛襲秣陵關，進破大勝關、三汊河，直抵雨花臺軍焉。

translations.literal: Guoquan advanced to Jiangning Town, camped at Banqiao, secretly struck Moling Pass, advanced to break Dasheng Pass and Sancha River, reaching straight to Yuhuatai army.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan camped at Banqiao, took Moling Pass and Dasheng Pass, and reached Yuhuatai.

sentences.zh: 江北浦口、六合敗寇悉聚江邊，李世忠蹙之，渡還九洑洲。

translations.literal: North-bank Pukou and Luhe defeated rebels all gathered on the riverbank; Li Shizhong pressed them; they crossed back to Jiufuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Defeated north-bank rebels clustered at the river; Li Shizhong drove them to Jiufuzhou.

sentences.zh: 江北肅清。

translations.literal: The north bank was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank was cleared.

sentences.zh: 五月，偽什天安吳建瀛統眾聚南匯，與淋天福劉二林屢為秀成養子所凌，至是來降，我軍整隊入城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the false Shi Tian'an Wu Jianying gathered masses at Nanhui with Lintianfu Liu Erlin, often bullied by Xiucheng's adopted sons; now they came to surrender and our army entered the city in formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wu Jianying and Liu Erlin surrendered Nanhui.

sentences.zh: 秀成養子方踞金山衞，來犯，復糾川沙寇回撲，復為我軍所敗，直逼川沙。

translations.literal: Xiucheng's adopted son still held Jinshan Wei and came to attack; again rallied Chuansha rebels to strike back; again defeated by our army, pressed straight to Chuansha.
translations.idiomatic: An adopted son of Xiucheng failed at Jinshan Wei and Chuansha.

sentences.zh: 寇由海塘竄出，遂復川沙，進攻松江。

translations.literal: Rebels slipped out along the sea embankment; Chuansha was recovered and they advanced on Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces recovered Chuansha and advanced on Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 寇逼泗涇，防軍游擊林叢文敗退北門。

translations.literal: Rebels pressed Sijing; defense Ranger Lin Congwen was beaten back at the north gate.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels pressed Sijing; Lin Congwen was driven from the north gate.

sentences.zh: 華爾由青浦回援，鴻章令程學啟扼虹橋，分青浦、松江後路。

translations.literal: Ward returned from Qingpu to aid; Hongzhang ordered Cheng Xueqi to hold Hongqiao, dividing Qingpu and Songjiang rear routes.
translations.idiomatic: Ward returned; Li Hongzhang posted Cheng Xueqi at Hongqiao.

sentences.zh: 寇陷湖州，福建糧儲道趙景賢拔刀自刎，賊奪之，囚一年餘，秀成禮待之極厚，終日罵不絕口，譚紹光舉槍一擊而殞。

translations.literal: Rebels took Huzhou; Fujian grain commissioner Zhao Jingxian drew his sword and killed himself; rebels seized him, imprisoned more than a year; Xiucheng treated him extremely well; he cursed without cease all day; Tan Shaoguang shot him once and he perished.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Huzhou; Zhao Jingxian killed himself, was captured, and was shot by Tan Shaoguang after a year of defiance.

sentences.zh: 初，寇圍逼松江，鴻章以松江扼青浦東、西之中，為最要地，自赴新橋，令程學啟時出兵綴寇。

translations.literal: Earlier when rebels pressed Songjiang, Hongzhang saw Songjiang choked east and west of Qingpu as the most vital place and went in person to Xinqiao, ordering Cheng Xueqi to sally and delay rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang held Songjiang as vital and had Cheng Xueqi harass the besiegers from Xinqiao.

sentences.zh: 寇初營西門妙嚴寺土城，華爾以砲毀之。

translations.literal: Rebels first camped at Miaoyan Temple earthen wall west of the gate; Ward destroyed it with cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Ward shelled the rebel camp at Miaoyan Temple west of the gate.

sentences.zh: 寇復攫據之，增築砲臺，環合四門。

translations.literal: Rebels seized it again, added gun platforms, and ringed all four gates.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels retook the site, built batteries, and ringed the walls.

sentences.zh: 常勝軍戰寇竇福濱，城軍乘夜分門出擊，寇竄遁。

translations.literal: The Ever-Victorious Army fought rebels at Doufubin; city troops sallied by night from divided gates; rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Ever-Victorious Army and a night sally drove rebels from Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 乃簡精卒破天馬山寇營，突入青浦，盡焚輜重。

translations.literal: They then picked elite troops to break Tianma Hill rebel camp and burst into Qingpu, burning all baggage.
translations.idiomatic: Elites broke Tianma Hill and burned Qingpu's stores.

sentences.zh: 寇死戰，併力守松江。

translations.literal: Rebels fought to the death and together held Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels concentrated on defending Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 其分屯廣福林及泗涇之寇，鴻章進擊敗之。

translations.literal: Rebel detachments at Guangfulin and Sijing were struck and defeated by Hongzhang's advance.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang defeated detachments at Guangfulin and Sijing.

sentences.zh: 寇遁入營，斷橋以拒。

translations.literal: Rebels fled into camp and broke bridges to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels broke bridges from their camps.

sentences.zh: 劉銘傳等克奉賢，陳炳文、郜雲官等率眾數萬圍新橋程學啟營，填壕拔鹿角，學啟不及以槍砲禦，擲磚石擊之，寇藉屍登壕，學啟開壁突擊，寇始卻，而分股踰新橋逼上海。

translations.literal: Liu Mingchuan and others took Fengxian; Chen Bingwen and Gao Yunguan led tens of thousands to besiege Cheng Xueqi's camp at Xinqiao, filled moats and pulled antlers; Xueqi could not answer with muskets and cannon, threw bricks and stones; rebels used corpses to scale the moat; Xueqi opened the wall in a sudden strike and rebels first withdrew, while a split column crossed Xinqiao to press Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan took Fengxian while Chen Bingwen besieged Cheng Xueqi at Xinqiao and sent a column toward Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 鴻章將七營往援，大破之，追至新橋，學啟大呼夾擊，寇解圍遁。

translations.literal: Hongzhang led seven battalions to aid, broke them greatly, pursued to Xinqiao; Xueqi shouted in pincer strike; rebels lifted the siege and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang relieved Xinqiao; Cheng Xueqi's counterattack lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 陳炳文、郜雲官皆負傷竄走。

translations.literal: Chen Bingwen and Gao Yunguan both fled wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bingwen and Gao Yunguan fled wounded.

sentences.zh: 進軍泗涇，寇大潰，盡燒其壘。

translations.literal: Advancing to Sijing rebels were greatly routed and all camps burned.
translations.idiomatic: At Sijing the rebels were routed and their camps burned.

sentences.zh: 廣福林、塘橋寇亦退。

translations.literal: Guangfulin and Tangqiao rebels also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfulin and Tangqiao rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 上海、松江俱解嚴。

translations.literal: Shanghai and Songjiang were both relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai and Songjiang were safe again.

sentences.zh: 初，李世忠遣軍自六合通江集南渡，連破石埠橋、龍潭、東陽寇壘，寇悉遁句容。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Shizhong sent troops from Luhe through Tongjiang to cross south, successively broke Shibuqiao, Longtan, and Dongyang rebel forts; rebels all fled to Jurong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong cleared the south bank from Tongjiang through Longtan to Jurong.

sentences.zh: 自是九洑洲寇外援盡絕。

translations.literal: From this Jiufuzhou rebel outside relief was utterly cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Jiufuzhou rebels lost all outside relief.

sentences.zh: 秀全遣江寧寇大攻石埠橋曾玉梁壘，世忠遣義子李顯發往援，入壘會守。

translations.literal: Xiuquan sent Jiangning rebels in great attack on Shibuqiao Zeng Yuliang's fort; Shizhong sent adopted son Li Xianfa to aid and entered the fort to join defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan assaulted Shibuqiao; Li Shizhong sent Li Xianfa to reinforce Zeng Yuliang.

sentences.zh: 陳坤書自句容進攻龍潭、東陽諸壘，守軍黃國棟等退併石埠，而寇攻益急，顯發會水師力戰，盡平其壘，解石埠圍。

translations.literal: Chen Kunshu from Jurong attacked Longtan and Dongyang forts; garrison Huang Guodong and others retreated to merge at Shibu, while rebel attack grew more urgent; Xianfa joined the water force in hard battle, leveling all forts and lifting Shibu siege.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu and Li Xianfa broke the Longtan-Shibu attacks.

sentences.zh: 時李秀成自松、滬敗還，謀連合杭、湖寇眾救援江寧。

translations.literal: At the time Li Xiucheng returned defeated from Song and Hu, plotting to join Hang and Hu rebel masses to relieve Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng, beaten in Jiangsu, sought to rally Zhejiang forces for Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 秀全遣悍黨二萬攻大營，國荃設伏敗之。

translations.literal: Xiuquan sent twenty thousand fierce bands to attack the great camp; Guoquan set ambush and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan sent 20,000 men; Guo Quan ambushed and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 連日宗棠督軍攻衢州，東、南、北三路寇壘皆盡。

translations.literal: For successive days Zongtang supervised troops attacking Quzhou; east, south, and north rebel forts were all exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo pressed Quzhou until eastern, southern, and northern forts fell.

sentences.zh: 初，秀全以大軍驟逼城下，日出撲犯，輒被創，趣浙酋李侍賢、蘇酋李秀成還救江寧，而宗棠攻衢州，與李侍賢相拒遂安、龍游間。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiuquan, because the great army suddenly pressed below the walls and sallied daily only to be wounded, urged Zhejiang chief Li Shixian and Su chief Li Xiucheng to return and save Jiangning; while Zongtang attacked Quzhou and with Li Shixian faced each other between Suian and Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan recalled Shixian and Xiucheng from Zhejiang while Zuo besieged Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 鴻章新克松江廳縣，秀成奔命未遑，乃與諸黨議曰：「曾國荃兵力厚集於金陵，為久困之計。

translations.literal: Hongzhang newly took Songjiang districts; Xiucheng had no leisure to respond; he discussed with chiefs: "Zeng Guoquan's troops are thickly massed at Jinling in a long-trap plan.
translations.idiomatic: With Songjiang falling, Xiucheng told his chiefs Guo Quan's siege was tightening Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 我勢日蹙，不如先圍寧國、太平，斷其後路。

translations.literal: Our momentum daily narrows; better first besiege Ningguo and Taiping and cut their rear route.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed cutting imperial supply lines at Ningguo and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 我軍勢既振，敵乃可圖也。

translations.literal: Once our army's momentum is stirred, the enemy can then be targeted.
translations.idiomatic: Only then could the enemy be fought on favorable terms.

sentences.zh: 」秀全以久困，慮糧不繼，仍促其入援。

translations.literal: " Xiuquan, long trapped, feared grain would not follow, still urged them to enter and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan, starving, still demanded relief.

sentences.zh: 秀成不得已，乃先遣悍黨數萬自蘇西援。

translations.literal: Xiucheng had no choice and first sent tens of thousands of fierce bands from western Su as relief.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sent tens of thousands west from Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 時寧國餘寇竄併江寧，屯於淳化鎮者亦不下二萬餘。

translations.literal: At the time Ningguo remnant rebels merged into Jiangning; those camped at Chunhua Town also numbered no less than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand rebels still held Chunhua near Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 六月，宗棠自衢州進軍龍潭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zongtang advanced from Quzhou to Longtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zuo advanced from Quzhou to Longtan.

sentences.zh: 侍賢自遂安敗後，復糾合金華及溫、處悍黨，分屯南岸湖鎮、羅埠，北岸蘭谿之永昌、太平、祝家堰、諸葛邨、孟塘、油埠、裘家堰。

translations.literal: After Shixian's defeat at Suian he again rallied Jinhua and Wen-Chu fierce bands, dividing camp at south-bank Huzhen and Luobu, north-bank Lanxi's Yongchang, Taiping, Zhujiayan, Zhugecun, Mengtang, Youbu, and Qiujiayan.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian regrouped at Huzhen, Luobu, and Lanxi crossings.

sentences.zh: 宗棠駐潭石望，距城十五里，遣眭金城會劉培元駐城西圭塘山，屈蟠、王德榜駐紫金旺，崔大光駐城北對河茶圩，劉典駐高橋。

translations.literal: Zongtang camped at Tanshiwang fifteen li from the city, sent Sui Jincheng with Liu Peiyuan at west-city Guitang Hill, Qu Pan and Wang Debang at Zijinwang, Cui Daguang at north-bank opposite Tea Market, Liu Dian at Gaoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo invested the city from Guitang Hill, Zijinwang, and Gaoqiao.

sentences.zh: 先是李侍賢偵我軍平衢州寇壘，將進軍龍游，糾黨潛趨蘭谿、嚴淳，乘虛襲遂安，為就糧江、浙斷我餉道計。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Shixian spied our army leveling Quzhou forts about to advance on Longyou, rallied bands to slip toward Lanxi and Yanchun, seized Suian by void to strike, planning to cut our grain route by feeding on Jiang-Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian tried to seize Suian and cut Zuo's Zhejiang supply line.

sentences.zh: 宗棠遣軍大破之，寇由壽昌退還金華。

translations.literal: Zongtang sent troops to break them greatly; rebels from Shouchang returned to Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo defeated the maneuver; rebels fled to Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 七月，我軍進敗龍游寇，毀蘭谿、油埠寇屯，陣斬偽駿天義鄧積士等。

translations.literal: In the seventh month our army advanced and defeated Longyou rebels, destroyed Lanxi and Youbu rebel camps, beheading on the field the false Jun Tianyi Deng Jishi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month imperial troops broke Longyou and killed Deng Jishi.

sentences.zh: 宣平、處州、餘姚、壽昌均以次收復。

translations.literal: Xuanping, Chuzhou, Yuyao, and Shouchang were all recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanping, Chuzhou, Yuyao, and Shouchang were recovered.

sentences.zh: 是時楊輔清糾眾十餘萬竄踞寧國府城，復分黨屯聚團山、寒亭等處，阻我進兵之路。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Fuqing rallied more than a hundred thousand to hold Ningguo prefectural city, again split bands at Tuanshan, Hanting, and other places to block our advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing held Ningguo with 100,000 men and blocked the roads.

sentences.zh: 鮑超飭將卒撲寒亭，寇出巢猛拒，總兵宋國永橫躍入陣，伏起扼歸路，寇驚潰，平寒亭管家橋、楠家甸、獅子山寇館數十處，寇壘三十五座。

translations.literal: Bao Chao ordered officers and soldiers to strike Hanting; rebels sallied fiercely; Brigadier Song Guoyong leaped horizontally into the array; ambush rose to choke return routes; rebels fled in panic; Hanting, Guanjia Bridge, Nanjiadian, Shizishan, and dozens of rebel lodges were leveled; thirty-five rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao routed Fuqing at Hanting and destroyed thirty-five forts.

sentences.zh: 偽衞王楊雄清糾合餘眾遁回寧郡。

translations.literal: The false Wei King Yang Xiongqing rallied remaining masses and fled back to Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Wei King Yang Xiongqing fled into Ningguo city.

sentences.zh: 輔清聞寒亭戰敗，即糾黨繞城結壘，延三十餘里。

translations.literal: Fuqing hearing Hanting defeat immediately rallied bands to ring the city with forts stretching thirty-plus li.
translations.idiomatic: Fuqing built a thirty-li ring of forts around Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 鮑超進壁烏紗鋪，飭婁雲慶設伏望城岡，以輕兵誘寇。

translations.literal: Bao Chao advanced to camp at Wushapu, ordered Lou Yunqing to set ambush at Wangchenggang, using light troops to lure rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Bao camped at Wushapu and ambushed at Wangchenggang.

sentences.zh: 寇以我兵寡，直壓山岡而下，我軍張兩翼卻之。

translations.literal: Rebels seeing our troops few pressed straight down the hill; our army spread two wings to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels charged downhill into a pincer.

sentences.zh: 寇見旌幟遍山谷，誤為援寇，反鬥中伏，我軍復斷其後，斃無算。

translations.literal: Rebels seeing banners all over the valleys mistook them for relief; in mid-fight they hit ambush; our army again cut their rear; countless were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Ambush and encirclement annihilated the rebel column.

sentences.zh: 望城岡及抱龍岡十數邨皆平。

translations.literal: Wangchenggang and Baolongang and more than ten villages were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Wangchenggang and Baolongang were cleared.

sentences.zh: 寇復陰結別股築壘堅拒，鮑超率各軍逼壘而營。

translations.literal: Rebels again secretly joined other columns to build forts and resist firmly; Bao Chao led each army to press camps against the forts.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels rebuilt; Bao pressed the siege.

sentences.zh: 各偽王出大隊於南、北兩門夾攻，鮑超分軍進搏，寇敗走浮橋，我軍焚橋截殺，無得脫者。

translations.literal: Each false king led great columns from south and north gates in pincer attack; Bao Chao divided the army to grapple; rebels fled to the pontoon bridge; our army burned the bridge and intercepted; none escaped.
translations.idiomatic: False kings pincered the camp; Bao burned the pontoon and slaughtered the fugitives.

sentences.zh: 寇復收餘燼，再戰再敗，輔清單騎脫走。

translations.literal: Rebels gathered remaining embers, fought again and were again defeated; Fuqing alone rode to escape.
translations.idiomatic: A second assault failed; Fuqing escaped alone.

sentences.zh: 立收寧國府、縣二城。

translations.literal: Ningguo prefectural and county two cities were quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo prefecture and county were recovered.

sentences.zh: 初，輔清聞超軍至，數遣使乞援於江寧，秀全遣偽保王洪容海率悍寇赴之，容海者石達開死黨也，旣至，懾超威，乞降，超許之，而郡城已克。

translations.literal: Earlier when Fuqing heard Chao's army arrived he repeatedly sent envoys begging relief from Jiangning; Xiuquan sent the false Bao King Hong Ronghai with fierce rebels; Ronghai was Shi Dakai's diehard; once arrived he feared Chao's might and begged surrender; Chao permitted it while the prefectural city was already taken.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Ronghai's relief column surrendered after Ningguo fell.

sentences.zh: 容海奔廣德，襲獻州城，率眾六萬就撫，復本姓童。

translations.literal: Ronghai fled to Guangde, raided and took Xianzhou city, led sixty thousand to accept pacification, and resumed surname Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Ronghai later surrendered at Guangde with 60,000 men.

sentences.zh: 江寧援寇大舉犯壘，分二十餘隊牽掣各軍，而以銳卒突雨花臺。

translations.literal: Jiangning relief rebels attacked forts in force, divided into twenty-plus teams to tie down each army, while elite troops rushed Yuhuatai.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing relief forces tied down the siege line and struck Yuhuatai.

sentences.zh: 國荃拔卡縱擊，大破之，解圍去。

translations.literal: Guoquan pulled posts to strike; greatly broke them; they lifted siege and left.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan sallied and broke the relief attack on Yuhuatai.

sentences.zh: 潘鼎新等會克金山衞城，地界江、浙，為浦東門戶，至是一律肅清。

translations.literal: Pan Dingxin and others jointly took Jinshan Wei city—the gateway of Pudong on the Jiang-Zhe border—now entirely cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Dingxin recovered Jinshan Wei, Pudong's gateway.

sentences.zh: 是月鴻章督諸軍會攻青浦，克其城。

translations.literal: That month Hongzhang supervised armies in joint attack on Qingpu and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Hongzhang took Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 譚紹光方踞湖州，聞青浦已失，恐官軍躡其後，乃合嘉、湖、蘇、崑寇犯松、滬西北，進窺青浦，學啟會水師擊卻之。

translations.literal: Tan Shaoguang was holding Huzhou; hearing Qingpu was lost, fearing imperial troops would follow his rear, he combined Jia-Hu-Su-Kun rebels to invade northwest Song and Hu, spying on Qingpu; Xueqi with the water force beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shaoguang raided toward Qingpu after its fall; Cheng Xueqi drove him back.

sentences.zh: 寇攻北簳山壘不獲逞，遂東趨攻北新涇，北新涇為上海西路之蔽，防軍大戰卻之。

translations.literal: Rebels attacking Beigan Hill fort could not succeed and turned east to attack Beixinjing; Beixinjing shielded Shanghai's western road; defense troops fought greatly and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels failed at Beigan Hill and were repelled at Beixinjing.

sentences.zh: 寇分竄法華，逼上海。

translations.literal: Rebels split to slip into Fahua, pressing Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel column pressed Fahua toward Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 鴻章調諸軍自金山衞、青浦、松陵回援，悍寇二萬圍官軍，學啟戰逾時，寇大潰。

translations.literal: Hongzhang transferred armies from Jinshan Wei, Qingpu, and Songling back to aid; twenty thousand fierce rebels encircled imperial troops; Xueqi fought over time and rebels were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang recalled forces; Cheng Xueqi routed 20,000 rebels encircling the relief army.

sentences.zh: 北新涇之寇憑河據壘，伏左右以待我軍。

translations.literal: Beixinjing rebels relied on the river and held forts, with ambush left and right awaiting our army.
translations.idiomatic: Beixinjing rebels held river forts with ambushes on both flanks.

sentences.zh: 鴻章親督陣，與學啟軍合，盡毀寇營，紹光遁嘉定。

translations.literal: Hongzhang personally supervised the formation; joining Xueqi's army they destroyed all rebel camps; Shaoguang fled to Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang and Cheng Xueqi destroyed the camps; Tan Shaoguang fled to Jiading.

sentences.zh: 上海危而復安。

translations.literal: Shanghai was in peril and again secure.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai was safe again.

sentences.zh: 八月，寇陷慈谿，華爾復之，受創，尋卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month rebels took Cixi; Ward recovered it, was wounded, and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month rebels took Cixi; Ward recovered it, was wounded, and died.

sentences.zh: 嵊縣、新昌寇陷奉化。

translations.literal: Sheng County and Xinchang rebels took Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Sheng and Xinchang seized Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 閏八月，奉化寇窺寧波，宗棠飭蔣益澧等進平蘭谿裘家堰寇壘，斃偽元天福萬興仁、偽疌天福劉茂林等。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month Fenghua rebels spied on Ningbo; Zongtang ordered Jiang Yizhen and others to level Lanxi Qiujiayan rebel forts, killing the false Yuan Tianfu Wan Xingren, the false Chi Tianfu Liu Maolin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo cleared Lanxi forts and killed Wan Xingren and Liu Maolin.

sentences.zh: 羅埠踞寇偽戎天義李世祥乞降，益澧攻羅埠，世祥應之，破五壘。

translations.literal: Luobu holding rebel false Rong Tianyi Li Shixiang begged surrender; Yizhen attacked Luobu and Shixiang cooperated, breaking five forts.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixiang surrendered at Luobu and helped break five forts.

sentences.zh: 湖鎮寇聞之遁，我軍渡河破五星街。
