translations.literal: Huzhen rebels hearing this fled; our army crossed the river and broke Wuxing Street.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhen rebels fled; imperial troops took Wuxing Street.

sentences.zh: 此皆龍游、湯谿要衝也。

translations.literal: These were all vital passes of Longyou and Tangxi.
translations.idiomatic: These were key passes for Longyou and Tangxi.

sentences.zh: 益澧屢攻湯谿不下，軍多死傷。

translations.literal: Yizhen repeatedly attacked Tangxi without success; the army suffered many dead and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen's assaults on Tangxi cost heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 宗棠進營新涼亭，逼龍游城五里，飭益澧由羅埠進攻湯谿。

translations.literal: Zongtang advanced camp to Xinliang Pavilion five li from Longyou city, ordered Yizhen from Luobu to attack Tangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo camped five li from Longyou and ordered Jiang Yizhen against Tangxi.

sentences.zh: 劉典屯扼油埠、湖鎮，以堵蘭谿、金華援寇。

translations.literal: Liu Dian camped to choke Youbu and Huzhen, blocking Lanxi and Jinhua relief rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dian blocked Lanxi and Jinhua relief at Youbu and Huzhen.

sentences.zh: 九月，鴻章會常勝軍攻嘉定，克之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Hongzhang with the Ever-Victorious Army attacked Jiading and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Hongzhang and the Ever-Victorious Army took Jiading.

sentences.zh: 紹光及偽聽王陳炳文復糾援寇十餘萬，分道自太倉、崑山來犯，北由蟠龍鎮至四江口，圖據黃渡以當青浦；

translations.literal: Shaoguang and the false Listening King Chen Bingwen again rallied more than a hundred thousand relief rebels, dividing from Taicang and Kunshan; north from Panlong Town to Sijiang mouth, plotting to hold Huangdu against Qingpu;
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shaoguang and Chen Bingwen led 100,000 men from Taicang and Kunshan toward Sijiang and Huangdu.

sentences.zh: 南由安亭至方泰鎮，圖入南翔。

translations.literal: south from Anting to Fangtai Town, plotting to enter Nanxiang.
translations.idiomatic: another column aimed at Nanxiang from Anting.

sentences.zh: 尋我軍卻寇南翔，寇乃於三江口、四江口立左右大寨，設浮橋潛渡，困我水師；

translations.literal: Soon our army repelled rebels at Nanxiang; rebels then at Sanjiang mouth and Sijiang mouth set left and right great camps, built pontoon bridges for secret crossing, trapping our water force;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops held Nanxiang; rebels bridged Sanjiang and Sijiang to trap the fleet.

sentences.zh: 而青浦西北洋新涇、趙屯橋、白鶴江寇益蔓延，擾及重固鎮張堰，距青浦十餘里。

translations.literal: while northwest of Qingpu foreign Newijing, Zhaotun Bridge, and Baihe River rebels spread further, harassing Chonggu Town and Zhangyan within ten-odd li of Qingpu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns spread within ten li of Qingpu at Newijing and Baihe River.

sentences.zh: 黃翼升率水師自青浦出衝敵舟，寇扼白鶴江不得進，別隊犯黃渡，李鶴章會擊敗之。

translations.literal: Huang Yisheng led the water force from Qingpu to ram enemy boats; rebels choked Baihe River so he could not advance; another column attacked Huangdu and Li Hezhang joined to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yisheng's fleet fought at Qingpu; Li Hezhang beat rebels at Huangdu.

sentences.zh: 時四江口久被圍，紹光屯吳淞江口，炳文踞南岸。

translations.literal: At the time Sijiang mouth had long been besieged; Shaoguang camped at Wusong River mouth and Bingwen held the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: Sijiang was besieged; Tan Shaoguang held the river mouth and Chen Bingwen the south bank.

sentences.zh: 鴻章督諸軍至黃渡，分三路進擊，自辰至未，屢衝不動。

translations.literal: Hongzhang supervised armies to Huangdu, divided three routes to attack, from chen to wei repeatedly charged without moving them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang attacked Huangdu in three columns from morning to afternoon without breaking the line.

sentences.zh: 鴻章督戰益急，諸軍逾壕直逼寇營，學啟礮傷胸，復裹創疾戰，寇由南岸潰而北。

translations.literal: Hongzhang supervised battle more urgently; armies crossed moats straight to rebel camps; Xueqi was wounded in the chest by cannon, wrapped wounds and fought on; rebels on the south bank routed north.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang pressed the assault; Cheng Xueqi fought wounded; the south bank collapsed.

sentences.zh: 四江營守將皆衝圍而出，寇退崑山。

translations.literal: Sijiang camp defenders all broke encirclement and came out; rebels retreated to Kunshan.
translations.idiomatic: Sijiang defenders broke out; rebels fled to Kunshan.

sentences.zh: 我軍毀其浮橋石卡殆盡，斃數萬，夷壘二百座。

translations.literal: Our army destroyed their pontoon bridges and stone posts nearly all, killed tens of thousands, leveled two hundred forts.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces destroyed bridges and two hundred forts, killing tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 寇自是不復窺松、滬，悉力堅守崑山、太倉，尤為蘇州門戶，寇所必爭者也。

translations.literal: Rebels from then no longer spied on Song and Hu, all strength firmly held Kunshan and Taicang—the gates of Suzhou that rebels must fight for.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels abandoned Songjiang and Shanghai and concentrated on Kunshan and Taicang.

sentences.zh: 寧國再陷，寇復由句容進薄鎮江，壁湯岡。

translations.literal: Ningguo fell again; rebels again from Jurong advanced close to Zhenjiang, walled at Tanggang.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo fell again; rebels from Jurong threatened Zhenjiang at Tanggang.

sentences.zh: 馮子材督軍破湯岡九壘，寇歸青山老巢，乘勝拔之，竄還句容。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai supervised troops to break nine Tanggang forts; rebels returned to Qingshan old nest; pressing victory it was taken; they fled back to Jurong.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai broke nine forts at Tanggang and drove rebels back to Jurong.

sentences.zh: 初，偽護王陳坤書糾眾四五萬圖犯金柱關，彭玉麟禦之花津，五戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Earlier the false Protect King Chen Kunshu rallied forty or fifty thousand to plot attacking Jingzhuguan; Peng Yulin defended at Huajin, five battles all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu tried Jingzhuguan; Peng Yulin won five fights at Huajin.

sentences.zh: 尋寇以戰艦數百從東壩拖出，我軍毀其浮橋，寇乃不敢渡河。

translations.literal: Soon rebels with several hundred warships towed out from East Dam; our army destroyed their pontoon bridge and rebels dared not cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet destroyed a rebel pontoon at East Dam.

sentences.zh: 至是悍寇結筏偷渡，屢逼金柱關，我軍水陸大舉，敗之花山。

translations.literal: Now fierce rebels rafted secretly across, repeatedly pressing Jingzhuguan; our army land and water advanced greatly and defeated them at Huashan.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel rafts pressed Jingzhuguan until a land-water attack defeated them at Huashan.

sentences.zh: 寇遁上駟坡，而水師已先毀浮橋，寇回戈轉鬥，諸軍合擊，殲萬餘。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Shangsipu while the water force had already destroyed the pontoon; rebels turned blades to fight; armies joined strike and annihilated more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: More than 10,000 rebels were killed at Shangsipu.

sentences.zh: 其窯頭等處尚延袤百餘里，我軍環攻，焚其壘。

translations.literal: Yaotou and other places still stretched a hundred-plus li; our army encircled attack and burned their forts.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces burned rebel lines a hundred li along the river.

sentences.zh: 花津、清山、象山、采石磯諸寇巢悉數平毀。

translations.literal: Huajin, Qingshan, Xiangshan, Caishiji, and other rebel nests were all leveled and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Huajin, Qingshan, Xiangshan, and Caishiji were cleared.

sentences.zh: 自是蕪湖、金柱關六十里之間寇蹤以絕。

translations.literal: From this between Wuhu and Jingzhuguan for sixty li rebel tracks were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: For sixty li between Wuhu and Jingzhuguan no rebels remained.

sentences.zh: 時大營軍士患疫方稍止，秀成親率十三偽王，號稱六十萬，麇集金陵，東自方山，西至板橋鎮，旗幟林立，直逼我軍營壘，尤趨重於東西兩隅。

translations.literal: At the time the great camp's soldiers' plague had just slightly ceased; Xiucheng personally led thirteen false kings, claiming six hundred thousand, massed at Jinling from Fangshan east to Banqiao Town, banners and flags dense, pressing straight on our camp forts, especially stressing east and west corners.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng massed 600,000 rebels around Nanjing and assaulted the siege camps.

sentences.zh: 曾貞幹等擊敗之小河邊城寇援，寇尋由東西兩路進攻，分黨趨洲上，抄出猛字等營後，我軍分路擊退之。

translations.literal: Zeng Zhengan and others defeated city-rebel relief at Xiaohebian; rebels soon advanced from east and west routes; split bands toward Zhou Shang, circling behind Mengzi and other camps; our army in separate routes beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengan beat relief at Xiaohebian and repelled pincers on the siege camps.

sentences.zh: 寇之圍逼西路者，歷六晝夜，為我軍擊敗。

translations.literal: Rebels pressing the west route fought six days and nights and were defeated by our army.
translations.idiomatic: The six-day western assault failed.

sentences.zh: 寇悉向東路，逼營而陣，潛通地道，百計環攻。

translations.literal: Rebels all turned to the east route, pressed camps in formation, secretly connected tunnels, attacking by every stratagem in encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels shifted east, mining and ring-attacking the camps.

sentences.zh: 各軍將士負牆露立，擲火球擊寇。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers stood exposed on the walls, throwing fire balls at rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Defenders threw fireballs from the walls.

sentences.zh: 寇負板蛇行而進，填壕欲上。

translations.literal: Rebels carried boards and crawled forward, filling moats wishing to mount.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels filled the moats with bodies and boards.

sentences.zh: 我軍叢矛擊刺，寇拽尸復進，抵死不退。

translations.literal: Our army with clustered spears stabbed; rebels dragged corpses and advanced again, resisting to the death without retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Spearmen killed wave after wave at the parapet.

sentences.zh: 飛彈傷國荃頰，血流交頤，仍裹創上壕守禦。

translations.literal: A flying shot wounded Guoquan's cheek; blood streamed across his face; he still wrapped wounds and mounted the rampart to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan was shot in the cheek but kept commanding the defense.

sentences.zh: 侍賢自浙東來援，急攻吉後營砲臺。

translations.literal: Shixian came from eastern Zhejiang to aid, urgently attacking Jihou camp gun platform.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian arrived from Zhejiang and stormed the Jihou battery.

sentences.zh: 國荃引軍馳救，寇來益眾，用箱匱實土排砌壕間，暗鑿地道。

translations.literal: Guoquan led troops to the rescue; rebels came in greater numbers, using crates packed with earth along the moat, secretly digging tunnels.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan reinforced Jihou while rebels mined the moats.

sentences.zh: 我軍以火箭攢射，隨出銳卒擊之，賊鋒稍挫，遂毀西路寇壘。

translations.literal: Our army with fire arrows volleyed, then sent sharp troops to strike; rebel edge slightly blunted; then destroyed west-route rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Rocket fire and sallies broke the western mines and forts.

sentences.zh: 東路之寇環逼不已，嘉字、吉後兩營地道轟發，寇擁入塌口，我軍分路衝出決戰，塌口以內之寇誅戮無遺。

translations.literal: East-route rebels pressed encirclement without cease; Jia and Jihou two camps' tunnels exploded; rebels swarmed into the breach; our army in separate routes rushed out for decisive battle; rebels inside the breach were slaughtered without remnant.
translations.idiomatic: Mines blew the Jia and Jihou camps; imperial troops slaughtered rebels in the breaches.

sentences.zh: 壕外寇復舉旗督戰，各營同出抄殺，寇精銳悉挫折。

translations.literal: Outside the moat rebels again raised flags to direct battle; each camp sallied together in flanking kill; rebel elite was all blunted.
translations.idiomatic: A final sally shattered the rebel elite outside the moats.

sentences.zh: 復於東路別開地道，西路決江水淹絕運糧之路。

translations.literal: Again on the east route they opened another tunnel; on the west route they broke river water to flood grain transport routes.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels opened new tunnels east and tried to flood supplies west.

sentences.zh: 貞幹在高坡增築小營，令水師駐雙牐護餉道。

translations.literal: Zhengan at Gaopo added small camps, ordered the water force to station at Shuangchuang to guard the grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengan fortified Gaopo and stationed the fleet to protect supplies.

sentences.zh: 我軍凡破寇地道五處，寇計益窮。

translations.literal: Our army altogether broke five rebel tunnels; rebel plans grew more exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Five rebel tunnels were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 國荃乘勢進拔十餘卡，破東路四壘，西南諸壘望風驚潰，追至南路牛首山一帶，平壘數十座，搜剿至方山之西。

translations.literal: Guoquan seized momentum to advance and take more than ten posts, break four east-route forts; southwest forts fled in wind and alarm; pursued to south-route Niushou Hill, leveled dozens of forts, searched and suppressed to west of Fangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan took posts to Niushou Hill and cleared dozens of forts.

sentences.zh: 雨花臺守眾句結城寇絕我軍歸路，我軍左右盪決，寇分路而遁，重圍始解。

translations.literal: Yuhuatai garrison colluded with city rebels to cut our army's return route; our army swept left and right; rebels fled in separate routes; the heavy encirclement was finally lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhuatai collusion failed; the great siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 是役也，秀成自蘇，侍賢自浙，先後圍攻大營四十六晝夜。

translations.literal: In this campaign Xiucheng came from Su and Shixian from Zhe, successively besieging the great camp forty-six days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng and Shixian had besieged the camp for forty-six days.

sentences.zh: 國荃率諸將居圍中，設奇破之，弟貞幹力顧餉道，將士獰目髹面，皮肉幾盡。

translations.literal: Guoquan led generals within the encirclement, setting strange tactics to break them; younger brother Zhengan strove to guard the grain route; officers and soldiers glared with lacquered faces, flesh nearly gone.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan and Zhengan broke the siege at terrible cost.

sentences.zh: 大營解圍後，秀成仍屯秣陵關、六郎橋一帶。

translations.literal: After the great camp siege lifted, Xiucheng still camped at Moling Pass and Liulang Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng remained at Moling Pass and Liulang Bridge.

sentences.zh: 侍賢謂秀成曰：「今江北方空虛，出其不料，馳攻揚州、六合，括其糧以濟軍；

translations.literal: Shixian told Xiucheng: "Now the north of the river is empty; strike Yangzhou and Luhe where they do not expect, gather their grain to supply the army;
translations.idiomatic: Shixian urged a surprise strike on Yangzhou and Luhe for grain.

sentences.zh: 復分兵攻國藩於安慶，彼必分軍馳救。

translations.literal: again divide troops to attack Guofan at Anqing—he must divide the army to rush relief.
translations.idiomatic: and a feint on Zeng Guofan at Anqing to split imperial forces.

sentences.zh: 我今屯秣陵、溧水之師，乘虛擊之，鮮不濟矣。

translations.literal: Our forces now camped at Moling and Lishui can strike their void—few will not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Moling-Lishui armies could strike the weakened siege line.

sentences.zh: 」秀成納之，別遣偽納王郜永寬、偽對王洪元春等自九洑洲渡江，竄越江浦、浦口者五六萬。

translations.literal: Xiucheng accepted it and separately sent the false Na King Gao Yongkuan, the false Dui King Hong Yuanchun, and others from Jiufuzhou to cross the river; more than fifty or sixty thousand slipped through Jiangpu and Pukou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sent Gao Yongkuan and Hong Yuanchun with 50,000–60,000 across the river.

sentences.zh: 洪元春陷巢縣、含山、和州，遂踞運漕鎮、銅城牐、東關各隘，知無為州米足兵單，徑撲州城。

translations.literal: Hong Yuanchun took Chaoxian, Hanshan, and Hezhou, then held Yuncao Town, Tongcheng Pass, and Dongguan passes; knowing Wuwei Prefecture had grain but few troops, pressed straight on the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yuanchun took Chaoxian and Hanshan and stormed Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 提督蕭慶衍攻運漕、銅城，會彭玉麟水師焚毀三石卡，進破運漕鎮，連覆陶家嘴、崑山岡寇壘，繞出銅城牐後。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Governor Xiao Qingyan attacked Yuncao and Tongcheng; joining Peng Yulin's water force they burned three stone posts, advanced and broke Yuncao Town, successively recovered Tao Family Mouth and Kunshan Hill rebel forts, swung behind Tongcheng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qingyan and Peng Yulin smashed Yuncao and Tongcheng Pass.

sentences.zh: 牐口寇衝圍而出，岡東、牐西寇皆遁走。

translations.literal: Pass-mouth rebels burst encirclement and came out; east of the hill and west of the pass rebels all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels broke out of Tongcheng Pass then fled.

sentences.zh: 國荃遣軍守東西梁山顧江隘，令李昭慶帶五營自蕪湖北渡援無為，以保皖南各軍運道。

translations.literal: Guoquan sent troops to guard East-West Liangshan and Gu River pass, ordered Li Zhaoqing with five battalions from north of Wuhu to aid Wuwei, securing southern Anhui armies' transport routes.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan secured the river passes and sent Li Zhaoqing to Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 國藩調李續宜、毛有銘移防廬州。

translations.literal: Guofan transferred Li Xuyi and Mao Youming to shift defense to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan shifted Li Xuyi and Mao Youming to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 賴文鴻、古隆賢等自廣德、寧國竄入旌德，總兵朱品隆敗之，解圍去。

translations.literal: Lai Wenhong, Gu Longxian, and others from Guangde and Ningguo slipped into Jingde; Brigadier Zhu Pinlong defeated them and lifted siege.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Pinlong beat Lai Wenhong and Gu Longxian at Jingde.

sentences.zh: 其攻涇縣之寇，亦被援軍擊退。

translations.literal: Rebels attacking Jing County were also beaten back by relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing County attack was repulsed.

sentences.zh: 先是昌化寇率眾數萬竄入績溪，冀絕旌德防軍糧路。

translations.literal: Earlier Changhua rebels led tens of thousands into Jixi, hoping to cut Jingde defense grain routes.
translations.idiomatic: Changhua rebels entered Jixi to cut Jingde's supplies.

sentences.zh: 唐義訓會浙軍克之。

translations.literal: Tang Yixun joined Zhejiang forces to take it.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yixun and Zhe forces recovered Jixi.

sentences.zh: 十月，我軍連復上虞、嵊縣、新昌。

translations.literal: In the tenth month our army successively recovered Shangyu, Sheng County, and Xinchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Shangyu, Sheng, and Xinchang were recovered.

sentences.zh: 宗棠屢攻龍游、湯谿、蘭谿、嚴州諸處，破壘卡三十餘，惟附城諸壘不可破。

translations.literal: Zongtang repeatedly attacked Longyou, Tangxi, Lanxi, and Yanzhou, breaking more than thirty fort posts; only city-adjacent forts could not be broken.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo broke thirty outposts but city forts at Longyou and Tangxi held.

sentences.zh: 寇以死守城，穴牆開砲，軍士多傷亡。

translations.literal: Rebels with death held the cities, bored walls to open cannon; soldiers suffered many casualties.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel mining and gunfire inflicted heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 龍游、湯谿兩城為金華要道，必兩城下，後路清，而後可攻金華。

translations.literal: Longyou and Tangxi two cities were Jinhua's vital route; both must fall before the rear was clear and Jinhua could be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Longyou and Tangxi had to fall before Jinhua could be taken.

sentences.zh: 蘭谿一水直達嚴州，必蘭谿下，餉道通，而後可收嚴郡。

translations.literal: Lanxi one waterway reached Yanzhou straight; Lanxi must fall and the grain route open before Yan Prefecture could be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Lanxi controlled the supply line to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 此三城者，所謂如骨之梗在喉也。

translations.literal: These three cities were what was called a bone stuck in the throat.
translations.idiomatic: These three cities were the choke point.

sentences.zh: 十一月，寇竄太平、黟縣，進陷祁門，將窺伺江西饒州、景德。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month rebels slipped to Taiping and Yixian, advanced to take Qimen, plotting to spy on Jiangxi Raozhou and Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month rebels took Qimen and threatened Raozhou and Jingde.

sentences.zh: 宗棠恐阻糧路，檄軍助剿，未至而祁門已克。

translations.literal: Zongtang fearing blocked grain routes ordered troops to aid pursuit; before arrival Qimen was already taken.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo sent aid; Qimen was recovered before reinforcements arrived.

sentences.zh: 魏喻義攻嚴州，嚴州形勢，外通懷寧，內達杭州。

translations.literal: Wei Yuyi attacked Yanzhou; Yanzhou's terrain outward connected Huaining, inward reached Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuyi attacked Yanzhou, the gateway between Anhui and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 宗棠援浙，謀首下嚴州，而寇在三衢，圖犯江西，斷我餉道。

translations.literal: Zongtang aided Zhejiang, planning first to take Yanzhou while rebels at Sanqu plotted to invade Jiangxi and cut our grain route.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo aimed at Yanzhou while rebels at Sanqu threatened his supply line.

sentences.zh: 乃先清衢郡，飭劉典攻蘭谿以分寇勢，踞寇偽朝將譚富與蘭谿譚星為兄弟，互相首尾。

translations.literal: He first cleared Qu Prefecture, ordered Liu Dian to attack Lanxi to divide rebel strength; holding rebel false Court General Tan Fu and Lanxi Tan Xing were brothers, mutually head and tail.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo cleared Quzhou and sent Liu Dian against Lanxi while Tan Fu and Tan Xing coordinated defense.

sentences.zh: 喻義屯銅關，據險設卡。

translations.literal: Yuyi camped at Tong Pass, holding dangerous terrain and setting posts.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuyi fortified Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 譚富糾桐廬、浦江諸寇屢來犯，喻義伏兵鐘嶺腳，殲寇前鋒，寇驚還，閉城固守。

translations.literal: Tan Fu rallied Tonglu and Pujiang rebels to attack repeatedly; Yuyi ambushed at Zhongling foot, annihilated rebel vanguard; rebels fled in alarm back and closed the city to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Fu's assaults failed; Wei Yuyi ambushed his vanguard at Zhongling.

sentences.zh: 是夜我軍梯城而入，殲寇萬餘，立克府城，焚船三百餘艘，獲偽印二百九十三顆，餘棄械投誠。

translations.literal: That night our army scaled the wall and entered, annihilated more than ten thousand rebels, quickly took the prefectural city, burned more than three hundred boats, obtained two hundred ninety-three false seals; the rest discarded weapons and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops stormed Yanzhou that night, killing 10,000 rebels and capturing hundreds of boats.

sentences.zh: 是時紹興偽首王范汝增、偽戴王黃呈忠、偽梯王練業紳率大股由諸暨、東陽、義烏、永康西竄金華，號稱十萬，以援湯谿、龍游。

translations.literal: At the time Shaoxing false chiefs Wang Fan Ruzeng, false Dai King Huang Chenzhong, and false Ti King Lian Yeshen led a great column from Zhuji, Dongyang, Yiwu, and Yongkang west into Jinhua, claiming one hundred thousand, to aid Tangxi and Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fan Ruzeng, Huang Chenzhong, and Lian Yeshen led 100,000 toward Jinhua to relieve Tangxi and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 分黨竄武義，林文察敗之。

translations.literal: Split bands slipped to Wuyi; Lin Wenzha defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: A column toward Wuyi was beaten by Lin Wenzha.

sentences.zh: 丹陽、句容寇竄鎮江，馮子材督軍大破於丁邨、薛邨諸處。

translations.literal: Danyang and Jurong rebels slipped to Zhenjiang; Feng Zicai supervised troops and greatly broke them at Dingcun, Xuecun, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai routed Danyang and Jurong rebels near Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 寇踞常熟、昭文二縣以窺江北。

translations.literal: Rebels held Changshu and Zhao Wen two counties to spy on the north bank.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Changshu and Zhao Wen to threaten the north bank.

sentences.zh: 距城十八里有福山者，為江南重鎮，與江北狼山鎮對峙，由江入海之鎖鑰也。

translations.literal: Eighteen li from the city was Fushan—the great town of Jiangnan, facing Langshan Town of the north bank, the lock where the river enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan, eighteen li from the city, guarded the Yangtze estuary opposite Langshan.

sentences.zh: 二縣守寇錢桂仁、駱國忠、董正勤與太倉酋錢壽仁密通款我軍，李鶴年攻城，寇約內應。

translations.literal: The two counties' defending rebels Qian Guiren, Luo Guozhong, Dong Zhengqin, and Taicang chief Qian Shouren secretly communicated surrender terms with our army; Li Henian attacked the city and rebels agreed inside collaboration.
translations.idiomatic: Defectors Qian Guiren and Luo Guozhong plotted with Li Henian to surrender Changshu.

sentences.zh: 國忠夜飲桂仁酒，就座斫殺偽馮天安錢嘉仁、偽逮天福姚得時，以城降。

translations.literal: Guozhong at night feasted Gui Ren wine, at the seat cut and killed the false Feng Tian'an Qian Jiaren and false Dai Tianfu Yao Deshi, surrendering the city with it.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Guozhong killed rebel officers at a feast and opened Changshu.

sentences.zh: 明日，會水師周興隆破平福山滸，白、徐六涇諸海口寇壘，進規太倉，而蘇州內應事泄。

translations.literal: The next day joining the water force Zhou Xinglong broke Ping Fushan ford, Bai and Xu six river mouths rebel forts, advanced on Taicang, while Suzhou inside-collaboration affair leaked.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xinglong cleared the river mouths; the Suzhou plot leaked.

sentences.zh: 譚永光悉眾爭常熟，招江陰、無錫寇六七萬來會，又令楊舍寇乘隙陷福山。

translations.literal: Tan Yongguang gathered all masses to contest Changshu, called Jiangyin and Wuxi rebels sixty or seventy thousand to join, again ordered Yangshe rebels to seize the gap and take Fushan.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Yongguang rallied 60,000–70,000 men and seized Fushan.

sentences.zh: 官軍固守常、昭。

translations.literal: Imperial armies held firm at Chang and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces held Changshu and Zhao Wen.

sentences.zh: 十二月，寇圍而攻之，團勇潰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month rebels encircled and attacked; militia collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month militia collapsed under rebel assault.

sentences.zh: 周興隆告急，鴻章遣援，而江陰楊厙寇已竄福山各口阻援師；

translations.literal: Zhou Xinglong reported urgency; Hongzhang sent relief, but Jiangyin Yangshe rebels had slipped to Fushan mouths blocking relief;
translations.idiomatic: Relief was blocked at Fushan by Yangshe rebels.

sentences.zh: 遣常勝軍及水師攻福山口河西寇壘不下。

translations.literal: sent Ever-Victorious Army and water force to attack Fushan river-mouth west rebel forts without success.
translations.idiomatic: The Ever-Victorious Army failed to break Fushan's west mouth.

sentences.zh: 寇攻常熟急，西北門營壘已失，常勝軍阻寇福山不得達。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Changshu urgently; northwest gate camps were already lost; Ever-Victorious Army was blocked by Fushan rebels and could not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Changshu's northwest camps fell; Gordon could not reach the city.

sentences.zh: 李鶴年攻太倉，寇援甚眾，亦難驟進。

translations.literal: Li Henian attacked Taicang; rebel relief was very numerous and hard to advance quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Li Henian stalled at Taicang against heavy relief.

sentences.zh: 鴻章增調浦東軍由海道繞赴福山，會師援剿。

translations.literal: Hongzhang also transferred Pudong troops by sea route around to Fushan, joining armies in relief pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang sent additional Pudong troops by sea to relieve Fushan.

sentences.zh: 鶴年等自望仙橋進攻太倉，敗之。

translations.literal: Henian and others from Wangxian Bridge advanced on Taicang and defeated rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Li Henian advanced from Wangxian Bridge and beat Taicang's defenders.

sentences.zh: 時蔣益澧攻湯谿不下，劉璈會攻蘭谿寇壘亦失利，劉典合水陸進攻，寇堅伏不出。

translations.literal: At the time Jiang Yizhen could not take Tangxi; Liu Kan jointly attacked Lanxi rebel forts also without success; Liu Dian combined land and water to attack; rebels hid firmly and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen and Liu Kan stalled at Tangxi and Lanxi.

sentences.zh: 龍游、湯谿援寇適大至，乘間西趨擾江、皖，益澧等迎擊湯谿援寇於金華白龍橋，大創之。

translations.literal: Longyou and Tangxi relief rebels just arrived in force, seized the interval to rush west and harass Jiang-Anhui; Yizhen and others met and struck Tangxi relief rebels at Jinhua Bailong Bridge, inflicting great wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Relief columns were crushed at Bailong Bridge near Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 偽扶王陳得才、偽端王藍成春、偽增王賴文光、偽顧王梁成富、偽主將馬融初，皆陳玉成悍黨也。

translations.literal: The false Fu King Chen Decai, false Duan King Lan Chenchun, false Zeng King Lai Wenguang, false Gu King Liang Chengfu, and false chief general Ma Rongchu were all Chen Yucheng's fierce bands.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Decai, Lan Chenchun, Lai Wenguang, Liang Chengfu, and Ma Rongchu were Yucheng's hard fighters.

sentences.zh: 玉成命北犯牽掣官軍，而得才見廬州被圍急，欲南援，為防軍所扼，奔竄於河南、湖北、山、陝之間，與諸捻合，遂成流寇。

translations.literal: Yucheng ordered northern invasion to tie down imperial troops; Decai seeing Luzhou besieged urgently wished to aid south, was blocked by defense troops, fled through Henan, Hubei, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, joined various Nian, and became roving rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Decai tried to relieve Luzhou, was blocked, and became a roving bandit in the north.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，秀成調集常州、丹陽諸寇屯江寧下關、中關，號二十萬，自九洑洲陸續渡江，意欲假道皖北，竄擾鄂疆，截斷江、皖各軍運道，圖解江寧之困，蓋近攻不如取遠勢也。

translations.literal: In the first month of year two Xiucheng gathered Changzhou and Danyang rebels at Jiangning's lower and middle passes, claiming two hundred thousand, from Jiufuzhou crossing the river in succession, intending to use Anhui north as a route to harass Hubei, cut Jiang-Anhui transport, and lift Jiangning's plight—near attack was inferior to taking distant momentum.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi year two Xiucheng sent 200,000 across the river to raid Hubei and sever supplies to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 既渡江，陷浦口，李世忠退入江浦。

translations.literal: Having crossed the river they took Pukou; Li Shizhong retreated into Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: They took Pukou; Li Shizhong withdrew to Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 偽匡王賴文鴻、偽奉王古隆賢、偽襄王劉官方糾合花旗廣寇數萬圍涇縣。

translations.literal: The false Kuang King Lai Wenhong, false Feng King Gu Longxian, and false Xiang King Liu Guanfang rallied foreign-flag Guang rebels numbering tens of thousands to besiege Jing County.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Wenhong, Gu Longxian, and Liu Guanfang besieged Jing County with Guang bandits.

sentences.zh: 鮑超自寧國馳援，誘之入伏，寇敗還壘，而壘已為我軍所焚，寇大奔，立解城圍。

translations.literal: Bao Chao hurried from Ningguo to aid, lured them into ambush; rebels were defeated returning to forts already burned by our army; rebels fled greatly; the siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao ambushed them and lifted the Jing County siege.

sentences.zh: 及還軍，而西河寇乘虛犯壘，見超幟，倉皇遁去。

translations.literal: On returning, west-river rebels seized the void to attack forts; seeing Chao's banners they fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: West-river rebels fled when Bao Chao returned.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧、康國器克湯谿，金華寇恃湯谿、龍游、蘭谿三城為犄角，我軍攻湯谿，寇勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen and Kang Guoqi took Tangxi; Jinhua rebels relied on Tangxi, Longyou, and Lanxi as horns; our army attacked Tangxi and rebel momentum gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen and Kang Guoqi took Tangxi, tightening the Jinhua triangle.

sentences.zh: 偽朝將彭禹蘭詣營乞降，益澧令內應，誘誅偽天將李尚揚等八名。

translations.literal: The false Court General Peng Yulan came to camp to beg surrender; Yizhen ordered inside collaboration, luring execution of the false Heaven General Li Shangyang and eight others.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulan surrendered and helped kill Li Shangyang and seven other rebel generals.

sentences.zh: 是夜彭禹蘭啟西門納軍，殺九千餘，城寇遂盡。

translations.literal: That night Peng Yulan opened the west gate to admit troops, killed more than nine thousand; city rebels were then exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulan opened Tangxi's west gate; 9,000 rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 偽戴王黃呈忠、偽首王范汝增、偽梯王練業紳自白龍橋退奔金華，龍游寇聞風而遁，左宗棠收之，劉典收蘭谿，高連陞等收金華，而武義、永康、東陽、義烏、浦江皆相繼收復。

translations.literal: The false Dai King Huang Chenzhong, false Chief King Fan Ruzeng, and false Ti King Lian Yeshen retreated from Bailong Bridge to Jinhua; Longyou rebels fled on the news; Zuo Zongtang recovered it; Liu Dian recovered Lanxi; Gao Liansheng and others recovered Jinhua; Wuyi, Yongkang, Dongyang, Yiwu, and Puyang were all recovered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chenzhong and Fan Ruzeng fled; Zuo, Liu Dian, and Gao Liansheng recovered Longyou, Lanxi, Jinhua, and surrounding counties.

sentences.zh: 浙東敗寇從於潛、昌化越叢山關，竄皖南績溪，復踰箬嶺，歸旌德，并句容、太平大股麇集石埭，謀西上。

translations.literal: Defeated eastern Zhe rebels from Yuqian and Changhua crossed Congshan Pass, slipped into southern Anhui Jixi, again crossed Ruoling, returned to Jingde, and with Jurong and Taiping great columns massed at Shicheng plotting to go west.
translations.idiomatic: Beaten Zhejiang rebels crossed into Jixi and Jingde while Jurong and Taiping forces massed at Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 建德大震，江西饒州、九江邊亦急。

translations.literal: Jiande was greatly shaken; Jiangxi Raozhou and Jiujiang borders were also urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Jiande and the Jiangxi border were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 劉典等克諸暨，譚星自浦江敗後，竄踞桐廬，宗棠飭劉培元會水軍合擊之，遏其西趨。

translations.literal: Liu Dian and others took Zhuji; Tan Xing after defeat at Puyang fled to hold Tonglu; Zongtang ordered Liu Peiyuan with the water force jointly to strike, blocking his westward rush.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dian took Zhuji; Zuo blocked Tan Xing at Tonglu.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧乘勢進攻紹興，提督葉炳忠會英、法軍克之。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen pressed the attack on Shaoxing; Provincial Military Governor Ye Bingzhong with British and French armies took it.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen and Ye Bingzhong with Allied forces took Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 敗寇萬餘，與桐廬踞寇沿江築壘抗拒，我軍水陸合攻，遂復桐廬。

translations.literal: More than ten thousand defeated rebels with Tonglu holding rebels built forts along the river to resist; our army land and water jointly attacked and recovered Tonglu.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial land and river forces recovered Tonglu.

sentences.zh: 蕭山寇亦竄走，浙東肅清。

translations.literal: Xiaoshan rebels also fled; eastern Zhejiang was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoshan rebels fled; eastern Zhejiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠遣益澧進攻杭州。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang sent Yizhen to advance on Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo sent Jiang Yizhen against Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 先是楊輔清糾合群黨，嘯聚西河、紅楊樹、麒麟山一帶，十餘萬人，以一大股抄出高祖山，先以一小隊繞過山背，揚言上犯涇縣，實欲圖鮑超老營。

translations.literal: Earlier Yang Fuqing rallied chiefs, roaring together at West River, Red Yang Tree, and Qilin Hill—more than a hundred thousand—with a great column copying out Gaozu Hill, first a small team circling behind the mountain, claiming to attack upward into Jing County, actually plotting Bao Chao's old camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing massed 100,000 at Qilin Hill and feinted at Jing County to strike Bao Chao's base.

sentences.zh: 二月，寇分三四萬眾圍高祖山八營，鮑超分軍三路，伏兵茯苓山傍以斷其後。

translations.literal: In the second month rebels divided thirty or forty thousand to besiege eight Gaozu Hill camps; Bao Chao divided the army three routes with ambush at Fuling Hill side to cut their rear.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Bao Chao ambushed 30,000–40,000 rebels at Gaozu Hill.

sentences.zh: 戰逾時，寇譁亂奔，近茯苓山，伏起，寇駭懼，遂平高嶺、周家橋、馬家園、小淮窯諸壘。

translations.literal: After more than an hour of battle rebels clamored in disorder and fled; near Fuling Hill ambush rose; rebels were terrified; Gaoling, Zhoujia Bridge, Majia Garden, and Xiao Huaiyao forts were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns were destroyed at Fuling Hill and nearby forts.

sentences.zh: 寇之由河西遁入灣沚者，為水師擊敗，併入梅嶺、麒麟山。

translations.literal: Rebels fleeing west of the river into Wanzi were beaten by the water force and merged into Meiling and Qilin Hill.
translations.idiomatic: River rebels were driven into Meiling and Qilin Hill.

sentences.zh: 鮑超遣將分攻之，積屍若阜，並收復仰賢圩各處，餘分道竄逸。

translations.literal: Bao Chao sent generals in divided attack; corpses piled like mounds; Yangxianwei and other places were recovered; the rest fled in separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao cleared Meiling; corpses heaped at Yangxianwei.

sentences.zh: 偽懷王周逆等糾眾竄至句容城外，會合丹陽偽效天義陳酋，圖由九洑洲北渡。

translations.literal: The false Huai King Zhou Ni and others rallied masses to slip to Jurong city outside, joined Danyang false Xiaotianyi Chen Qiu, plotting to cross north from Jiufuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Ni and Chen Qiu plotted a northward crossing from Jiufuzhou.

sentences.zh: 馮子材扼橋據險，分隊進攻，直趨牧馬口，沿村十餘里敵卡林立，官軍直突，屹不稍動。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai held the bridge and dangerous terrain, divided teams to attack, pressed straight to Muma Mouth; along villages for ten-plus li enemy posts stood dense; imperial troops charged straight, unmoved slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai stormed Muma Mouth through a line of enemy posts.

sentences.zh: 守備李耀光陣斬執旗寇，搗中堅，官軍無不以一當百，立燬牧馬口敵卡。

translations.literal: Ranger Li Yaoguang beheaded the flag-bearer on the field, struck the center; imperial troops each fought as one against a hundred; Muma Mouth enemy posts were immediately burned.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yaoguang killed the standard-bearer and burned Muma Mouth.

sentences.zh: 東湖寇亦敗潰，進毀南路柏林邨老巢，斬陳酋馬下，卽四眼狗玉成之叔也，寇駭奔，向西南竄走。

translations.literal: East Lake rebels also fled in defeat; advancing they destroyed south-route Bolin Village old nest, beheading Chen Qiu under his horse—Yucheng's uncle; rebels fled in alarm southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qiu, Yucheng's uncle, was killed at Bolin Village.

sentences.zh: 皖西寇犯休寧，分掠建德，西侵江西鄱陽、彭澤，東擾池州，圍青陽，續由江浦縣新河口迤邐西竄巢、含、全椒之間。

translations.literal: Western Anhui rebels attacked Xiuning, split to plunder Jiande, invaded west into Jiangxi Poyang and Pengze, harassed east into Chizhou, besieged Qingyang, then from Jiangpu Xinkou wound west through Chao, Han, and Quanjiao.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels raided Xiuning, Jiande, Poyang, Pengze, and the Chao-Han-Quanjiao line.

sentences.zh: 南岸則金柱關，時踞皖南寇約有三起：一為胡、黃、古、賴諸寇，即踞寧國、太平、石埭、旌德者也；

translations.literal: On the south bank at Jingzhuguan, rebels holding southern Anhui had about three groups: one was Hu, Huang, Gu, and Lai rebels holding Ningguo, Taiping, Shicheng, and Jingde;
translations.idiomatic: Three rebel groups held southern Anhui around Jingzhuguan:

sentences.zh: 一為花旗，此廣東匪，前由廣東、湖南、江西入浙、皖者也；

translations.literal: one was foreign-flag—Guang bandits earlier from Guangdong, Hunan, and Jiangxi into Zhe and Wan;
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong foreign-flag bandits,

sentences.zh: 一為譚星，即蘭谿抗官軍者也。

translations.literal: one was Tan Xing—who resisted imperial troops at Lanxi.
translations.idiomatic: and Tan Xing's Lanxi force.

sentences.zh: 徽防諸軍紛紛告警。

translations.literal: Huizhou defense armies reported alarm one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou defenses were on alert.

sentences.zh: 當曾國藩之視師東下也，寇攻常熟益急，譚紹光又益以砲船二百艘，突地攻城，降將駱國忠悉力扼守。

translations.literal: When Zeng Guofan supervised the army eastward, rebels attacked Changshu more urgently; Tan Shaoguang also added two hundred gunboats, bursting ground to attack the city; surrendered Luo Guozhong held with all strength.
translations.idiomatic: At Changshu, Tan Shaoguang shelled the city while Luo Guozhong held firm.

sentences.zh: 鴻章遣軍攻太倉、崑山分寇勢，別遣英將戈登助剿福山，會潘鼎新等水陸軍奪石城，夜毀城壘，翌日寇入西山，而福山火起，乃開門悉銳出擊，寇盡潰，擒斬悍酋孝天義朱衣點。

translations.literal: Hongzhang sent troops to attack Taicang and Kunshan to divide rebel strength, separately sent British general Gordon to aid Fushan; joining Pan Dingxin and others' land-water army they seized Stone City, burned forts by night; next day rebels entered West Hill while Fushan fire rose; then opened gates with all elite to strike out; rebels were all routed; fierce chief Xiaotianyi Zhu Yidian was captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Gordon and Pan Dingxin took Stone City; a sortie from Fushan killed Zhu Yidian and lifted the Changshu siege.

sentences.zh: 常熟、昭文城圍立解。

translations.literal: Changshu and Zhao Wen city sieges were quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The sieges of Changshu and Zhao Wen were lifted.

sentences.zh: 太平踞寇圖祁門。

translations.literal: Taiping holding rebels plotted Qimen.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping rebels threatened Qimen.

sentences.zh: 江西軍王沐敗寇於徽州屯谿。

translations.literal: Jiangxi army Wang Mu defeated rebels at Huizhou Tunxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mu beat rebels at Tunxi.

sentences.zh: 草市寇再敗於嚴寺街、長林、潛口等處，死近萬人，退奔休寧、藍田一帶，西通漁亭。

translations.literal: Caoshi rebels were again defeated at Yansi Street, Changlin, and Qian Mouth; nearly ten thousand dead; retreated toward Xiuning and Lantian, west connecting Yuting.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels lost nearly 10,000 at Qian Mouth and retreated toward Xiuning.

sentences.zh: 未幾，寇復進踞潛口，祁門防軍禦之黟縣漁亭，大破之，陣斬偽天將劉官福。

translations.literal: Before long rebels again advanced to hold Qian Mouth; Qimen defense met them at Yixian Yuting, broke them greatly, beheading on the field the false Heaven General Liu Guanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Qimen troops killed Liu Guanfu at Yuting.

sentences.zh: 寇之初起也，禁令嚴明，聽民耕種，故取江南數郡之糧出金柱關，江北數郡之糧出裕谿口，並輸江寧。

translations.literal: When rebels first rose, prohibitions were strict and clear, allowing people to farm; thus grain from several Jiangnan counties exited Jingzhuguan and from several north-bank counties exited Yuxikou, all supplied to Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Early rebels farmed and shipped grain to Nanjing through Jingzhuguan and Yuxikou.

sentences.zh: 今耕者廢業，煙火斷絕，寇行無人之境，而安慶、蕪湖、廬州、寧國、東西梁山、金柱關、裕谿口，暨浙之金華、紹興，山川筋絡必爭之地，寇悉喪失，我軍足制其死命。

translations.literal: Now farmers abandoned occupation, fires and smoke cut off, rebels marched through no-man's land; while Anqing, Wuhu, Luzhou, Ningguo, East-West Liangshan, Jingzhuguan, Yuxikou, and Zhe's Jinhua and Shaoxing—all mountain-river sinews rebels must fight for—were all lost; our army could grip their life and death.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel territory shrank to wasteland as imperial forces held every strategic depot.

sentences.zh: 昔年寇之所至，築壘如城，掘濠如川，近乃日近草率，群酋受封至九十餘王之多，各爭雄長，敗不相救，識者知其亡無日矣。

translations.literal: In former years where rebels went they built forts like cities and moats like rivers; recently works grew daily more careless; chiefs enfeoffed reached more than ninety kings, each contending for supremacy, not aiding each other in defeat—observers knew their extinction was near.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety rebel kings quarreled while fortifications grew slipshod—observers foresaw collapse.

sentences.zh: 寇復由寧國繞出青陽，分擾建德、東流。

translations.literal: Rebels again from Ningguo circled out to Qingyang, split to harass Jiande and Dongliu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from Ningguo raided Qingyang, Jiande, and Dongliu.

sentences.zh: 三月，由東流犯江西彭澤，進逼祁門；

translations.literal: In the third month from Dongliu they invaded Jiangxi Pengze, pressing Qimen;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they struck Pengze and Qimen;

sentences.zh: 由建德窺饒州，犯梅林營壘。

translations.literal: from Jiande spied on Raozhou, attacking Meilin camp forts.
translations.idiomatic: and from Jiande probed Raozhou at Meilin.

sentences.zh: 劉典督軍敗之，遂大破潛口寇屯。

translations.literal: Liu Dian supervised troops to defeat them, then greatly broke Qian Mouth rebel camps.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dian broke them at Qian Mouth.

sentences.zh: 徽州、休寧解嚴。

translations.literal: Huizhou and Xiuning were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou and Xiuning were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乃赴漁亭，會克黟縣，斬偽絇天義古文佑。

translations.literal: He then went to Yuting, jointly recovered Yixian, beheading the false Qiu Tianyi Gu Wengyou.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuting he recovered Yixian and killed Gu Wengyou.

sentences.zh: 追寇出嶺外，平寇壘二十餘，嶺內一律肅清。

translations.literal: Pursuing rebels outside the pass, leveled more than twenty rebel forts; inside the pass was entirely cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty forts beyond the pass were cleared.

sentences.zh: 太倉踞寇偽會王蔡元隆詐降郊迎，我軍至城下，伏起，槍傷李鶴章，程學啟殿軍而退。

translations.literal: Taicang holding rebel false Hui King Cai Yuanlong feigned surrender to greet outside the suburbs; when our army reached below the walls ambush rose; Li Hezhang was wounded by gun; Cheng Xueqi covered the rear and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yuanlong's false surrender wounded Li Hezhang at Taicang.

sentences.zh: 鴻章檄戈登會攻太倉，克之。

translations.literal: Hongzhang ordered Gordon jointly to attack Taicang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang and Gordon took Taicang.

sentences.zh: 黃文金合許家山各處寇十餘萬，由祁門進逼，與參將韓進春血戰四時，陣斬偽孝王胡鼎文，群寇奪氣。

translations.literal: Huang Wenjin combined Xujiashan and other place rebels of more than a hundred thousand, from Qimen pressed close; with Brigadier Han Jinchun fought bloody battle four hours, beheading on the field the false Xiao King Hu Dingwen; rebel masses lost spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin's 100,000 men were blunted at Qimen; Hu Dingwen was killed.

sentences.zh: 寇攻廬州，犯舒城。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Luzhou and invaded Shucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Luzhou and Shucheng.

sentences.zh: 李秀成將由舒城、六安上竄，一出黃州，一出漢口，擾犯湖北，掣我南岸之師以援北岸，掣我下游之師以援上游，皆為解金陵圍計也。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng would from Shucheng and Lu'an slip up—one column out Huangzhou, one out Hankou—to harass Hubei, pulling our south-bank army to aid the north bank and our downstream army to aid upstream—all to lift Jinling's siege.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng planned to raid Hubei from Shucheng and Lu'an to split the Nanjing siege.

sentences.zh: 湖北為數省樞紐，曾國藩調成大吉回屯灄口，檄水師赴武漢嚴防。

translations.literal: Hubei was several provinces' hub; Zeng Guofan transferred Cheng Daji back to camp at Huangpi, ordered the water force to Hankou for strict defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reinforced Hankou and Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 秀成來犯石澗埠，進逼我軍，晝夜猛攻，相持不下。

translations.literal: Xiucheng came to attack Shijianbu, pressed our army, day and night fierce attack, stalemate without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng assaulted Shijianbu without success.

sentences.zh: 寇復於前營增百壘，層層合圍。

translations.literal: Rebels again at the front camp added a hundred forts, layer upon layer enclosing.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels ringed the camp with a hundred new forts.

sentences.zh: 彭玉麟派隊來援，會軍夾擊，盡平群壘，秀成遁走。

translations.literal: Peng Yulin sent teams to aid; joining armies pincered, leveling all mass forts; Xiucheng fled.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin's relief leveled the forts and drove Xiucheng off.

sentences.zh: 其犯廬江、舒城者悉敗走。

translations.literal: Those invading Lujiang and Shucheng were all defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Raids on Lujiang and Shucheng failed.

sentences.zh: 悍寇馬融和自豫間道犯桐城，我軍敗之三里街，遁往孔城，與秀成合而為一。

translations.literal: Fierce rebel Ma Ronghe from Henan by-path invaded Tongcheng; our army defeated him at Sanli Street; he fled toward Kongcheng and merged with Xiucheng as one.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ronghe joined Xiucheng after defeat at Sanli Street in Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 秀成遣偽富天豫張承得等圍六安，敗死，六安者淮南要衝也。

translations.literal: Xiucheng sent the false Futianyu Zhang Chengde and others to besiege Lu'an; they were defeated and died; Lu'an was Huainan's vital pass.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chengde failed against Lu'an, Huainan's key town.

sentences.zh: 餘寇走廬州，鮑超追擊，會攻巢縣，先破東關、銅城牐二隘，遂克其城。

translations.literal: Remaining rebels fled to Luzhou; Bao Chao pursued, jointly attacked Chaoxian, first broke East Pass and Tongcheng Pass two barriers, then took the city.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao took Chaoxian after breaking East Pass and Tongcheng Pass.

sentences.zh: 金山、和州相繼皆下。

translations.literal: Jinshan and Hezhou fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshan and Hezhou fell.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢自金陵敗遁，糾悍黨數萬屢犯金柱關。

translations.literal: Li Shixian since defeat at Jinling fled, rallied tens of thousands of fierce bands repeatedly attacking Jingzhuguan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian repeatedly struck Jingzhuguan after Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 花津、上駟渡、萬頃湖、涂家渡及燕子磯、伏龍橋、護駕墩、灣沚、黃池諸處寇壘，皆為我軍所覆。

translations.literal: Huajin, Shangsipu, Wanqing Lake, Tujia Ford, and Yanzi Ji, Fulong Bridge, Hujia Dun, Wanzi, Huangchi rebel forts were all overturned by our army.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces cleared forts from Huajin to Huangchi.

sentences.zh: 自是寇不敢輕渡西岸，遁溧水、丹陽一帶。

translations.literal: From this rebels dared not lightly cross the west bank, fleeing to Lishui and Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels no longer crossed west, fleeing to Lishui and Danyang.

sentences.zh: 四月，水師楊政謨襲破杭州閘口寇船，登岸進毀望江門寇壘，寇大震，急招新城寇還救。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the water force Yang Zhengmo raided and broke Hangzhou sluice-mouth rebel boats, landed to advance and destroy Wangjiang Gate rebel forts; rebels were greatly shaken and urgently recalled Xincheng rebels to return.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhengmo raided Hangzhou's sluice and Wangjiang Gate.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧進攻富陽，富陽一城為杭州上游關鍵，賊嚴防禦，船壘相輔。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen advanced on Fuyang; Fuyang one city was Hangzhou's upstream key; rebels defended strictly, boats and forts mutually aiding.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen besieged Fuyang, the upstream key to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 杭州援寇屯新橋，與城寇相為犄角。

translations.literal: Hangzhou relief rebels camped at Xinqiao, mutually horned with city rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Relief rebels at Xinqiao supported Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秀成令陳炳文等舍蘇州、常、昭，急援富陽，並糾蘇、常、嘉興悍黨由餘杭趨臨安，竄新城，擾富陽軍後路。

translations.literal: Xiucheng ordered Chen Bingwen and others to abandon Suzhou, Chang, and Zhao, urgently aid Fuyang, and also rallied Su-Chang-Jiaxing fierce bands from Yuhang toward Lin'an, slipped to Xincheng, harassing Fuyang army's rear.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sent Chen Bingwen to Fuyang and raided the imperial rear through Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 魏喻義等督兵進擊，寇復乘霧分道攻撲新城，大敗，向臨安遁走。

translations.literal: Wei Yuyi and others supervised troops in advance attack; rebels again used fog to divide routes and strike Xincheng, were greatly defeated, fled toward Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuyi beat a fog attack on Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 偽慕王譚紹光、偽來王陸順德等率大股犯太倉雙鳳鎮，攻崑山後路，圖解城圍。

translations.literal: The false Mu King Tan Shaoguang and false Lai King Lu Shunde led a great column to invade Taicang Shuangfeng Town, attacked Kunshan's rear route, plotting to lift city siege.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shaoguang and Lu Shunde threatened Kunshan's rear at Shuangfeng.

sentences.zh: 我軍鏖戰三晝夜，破之。

translations.literal: Our army fought fierce battle three days and nights and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of fighting broke the assault.

sentences.zh: 偽天將夏天義率悍黨數萬久踞崑山、新陽縣城，鴻章督率程學啟、戈登會水師大破崑山寇壘二十四，斃萬餘。

translations.literal: The false Heaven General Xia Tianyi led tens of thousands of fierce bands long holding Kunshan and Xinyang county seats; Hongzhang supervised Cheng Xueqi and Gordon with the water force to break twenty-four Kunshan rebel forts, killing more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang, Cheng Xueqi, and Gordon broke twenty-four Kunshan forts and killed 10,000 rebels.

sentences.zh: 有正義鎮者，為蘇城援崑山必由之路，學啟攻之，破石壘二。

translations.literal: There was Zhengyi Town—the route Suzhou must use to aid Kunshan; Xueqi attacked it and broke two stone forts.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi took Zhengyi Town and two stone forts.

sentences.zh: 寇見歸路已斷，奪路狂奔，遂進克同城崑山新陽。

translations.literal: Rebels seeing return route cut seized routes in wild flight; then advanced to take Tongcheng Kunshan Xinyang.
translations.idiomatic: With their retreat cut, rebels fled and Kunshan-Xinyang fell.

sentences.zh: 王沐自黟縣回援景德，寇敗於陳家畈、包家塅，竄安寧嶺外。

translations.literal: Wang Mu from Yixian returned to aid Jingde; rebels were defeated at Chenjiafan and Baojiawan, fled outside Anning Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mu beat rebels at Chenjiafan on the way to Jingde.

sentences.zh: 時江寧攻圍久，百計欲解城圍，既分股由徽、寧窺伺江西，由含、和一帶圖犯湖北，而由湖北下竄之捻，自蘄水分為四枝，一回竄黃州，一撲宿松，越潛、太，以撲廬、桐。

translations.literal: At the time Jiangning siege was long; by every plan they wished to lift city siege—already split columns from Hui and Ning to spy on Jiangxi, from Han and He to plot Hubei invasion, while Nian slipping down from Hubei at Qishui divided into four branches—one returning to Huangzhou, one striking Susong, crossing Qian and Tai to hit Lu and Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng split forces toward Jiangxi and Hubei while Nian bands struck Lu'an and Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 寇、捻句合，兇燄甚張。

translations.literal: Rebels and Nian joined; fierce flame very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel and Nian forces combined fiercely.

sentences.zh: 此皆李秀成所規畫也。

translations.literal: All this was Li Xiucheng's planning.
translations.idiomatic: All were Li Xiucheng's designs.

sentences.zh: 我軍克復福山後，江陰縣屬揚厙汛為江邊險要，寇糾眾死守，以蔽江陰。

translations.literal: After our army recovered Fushan, Jiangyin County's Yangshe post was a riverside vital point; rebels rallied masses to hold firm to screen Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Yangshe to shield Jiangyin after Fushan fell.

sentences.zh: 我軍水陸會攻，斬趙尚林等，立復汛城，而漍北、漍西、塘市屯寇均棄壘遁還無錫、常州。

translations.literal: Our army land and water jointly attacked, beheaded Zhao Shanglin and others, quickly recovered the post city; north and west of Yangshe and Tangshi camp rebels all abandoned forts and fled back to Wuxi and Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces took Yangshe and cleared the Tangshi camps.

sentences.zh: 我軍克復建德，連復巢、含、和三城。

translations.literal: Our army recovered Jiande and in succession Chaoxian, Hanshan, and Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiande, Chaoxian, Hanshan, and Hezhou were recovered.

sentences.zh: 於是皖北寇全遁，皖南寇勢亦衰。

translations.literal: Thus north Anhui rebels all fled; south Anhui rebel momentum also declined.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Anhui was cleared; southern Anhui rebels weakened.

sentences.zh: 初，秀成自六安敗後，率眾東竄，聲言回救蘇州。

translations.literal: Earlier Xiucheng after defeat at Lu'an led masses east in flight, claiming to return and save Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Lu'an, Xiucheng feigned a return to save Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 國荃急爭江寧老巢，攻其必救，使城下之寇不暇遠趨蘇郡，而北岸之寇亦不敢專注揚州；

translations.literal: Guoquan urgently contested Jiangning's old nest, attacking where they must save, so city rebels had no leisure to rush far to Su Prefecture, and north-bank rebels also dared not focus solely on Yangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan struck Nanjing itself to pin rebels from Suzhou and Yangzhou;

sentences.zh: 乃率軍分六路併進，潛襲雨花臺及聚寶南門石壘，肉薄登城，遂奪雨花臺，乘勝猛攻東、西、南各卡九壘，皆克之。

translations.literal: then led the army in six routes advancing together, secretly struck Yuhuatai and Treasure-Gathering South Gate stone forts, pressed close and mounted the walls, seized Yuhuatai, pressed victory in fierce attack on east, west, and south nine forts each—all taken.
translations.idiomatic: he stormed Yuhuatai and nine southern forts in six columns.

sentences.zh: 群寇潰奔，我軍追擊於長干橋，蹙入水者無數。

translations.literal: Rebel masses fled in rout; our army pursued at Changgan Bridge, crowding into the water countless.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit at Changgan Bridge drowned many rebels.

sentences.zh: 未幾，城寇出，又敗退，斃六千餘，寇勢從此衰減。

translations.literal: Before long city rebels came out, were again defeated and withdrew; more than six thousand killed; rebel momentum from this daily declined.
translations.idiomatic: Another sally cost the garrison 6,000 men.

sentences.zh: 秀成在江北，聞雨花臺失，益惶懼，又以崑山新克，蘇州亦受逼，乃與諸偽王改圖南渡。

translations.literal: Xiucheng on the north bank hearing Yuhuatai was lost grew more fearful; also with Kunshan newly taken and Suzhou pressed, then with various false kings changed plan to cross south.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng on the north bank planned a southern crossing after Yuhuatai and Kunshan fell.

sentences.zh: 於是天長、六合、來安次第解圍。

translations.literal: Thus Tianchang, Luhe, and Lai'an were relieved in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang, Luhe, and Lai'an were relieved.

sentences.zh: 而寇之分踞喬林小店者，冒雨掠舟，喧闐不絕。

translations.literal: Rebels divided at Qiaolin and Xiaodian looted boats in rain, clamor unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel detachments looted boats at Qiaolin in the rain.

sentences.zh: 五月，浦口寇棄城遁走，而江浦寇忽獻書乞降，鮑超等察其詐，引軍急進，水師次江浦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Pukou rebels abandoned the city and fled; Jiangpu rebels suddenly presented a letter begging surrender; Bao Chao and others saw through the fraud and led troops in urgent advance; the water force halted at Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Pukou was abandoned; Jiangpu's surrender offer was recognized as a ruse.

sentences.zh: 寇聞風亦宵遁，九洑洲偽城踞寇閉門不納，寇駭竄蘆葦中，溺死者無算。

translations.literal: Rebels hearing the wind also fled by night; Jiufuzhou false-city holding rebels closed gates and would not admit them; rebels fled in terror into reeds; drowned were countless.
translations.idiomatic: Night fugitives were refused at Jiufuzhou and drowned in the reeds.

sentences.zh: 江浦、浦口兩城寇，盡蹙之入江，江北肅清。

translations.literal: Jiangpu and Pukou two cities' rebels were all crowded into the river; the north bank was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangpu and Pukou rebels were driven into the river; the north bank was cleared.

sentences.zh: 曾國荃連日破平下關、草鞋峽、燕子磯，收寶金圩，距蕪湖、金柱關百里內已無寇蹤。

translations.literal: Zeng Guoquan for successive days broke and pacified Xia Pass, Caoxie Gorge, and Yanzi Ji, recovered Baojinwei; within a hundred li of Wuhu and Jingzhuguan there were no rebel tracks.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan cleared the approaches to Wuhu within a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 進攻克九洑洲，寇之在中關者，附城為壘，卒不稍動。

translations.literal: Advancing he took Jiufuzhou; rebels at Middle Pass attached to the city as forts and did not stir slightly.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced on Jiufuzhou while Middle Pass forts held firm.

sentences.zh: 其堅踞九洑洲者，下有列船，上有偽城，群砲轟發不息；

translations.literal: Those stubbornly holding Jiufuzhou had boats below and a false city above, mass cannon firing without cease;
translations.idiomatic: Jiufuzhou had a river fleet, a hilltop stronghold, and ceaseless gunfire;

sentences.zh: 復於東、西、南三面分伏洋槍隊，伺間出擊，我軍多損傷。

translations.literal: again on east, west, and south three sides divided hidden foreign-gun teams to strike at intervals; our army suffered many casualties.
translations.idiomatic: foreign-gun teams sallied from three sides, inflicting heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 彭楚漢等負創角戰，乘風縱火，夜二鼓，撲牆而入，聚殲無一脫者。

translations.literal: Peng Chuhan and others fought wounded in corner battle, seized wind to set fire; at the second watch of night they scaled the wall and entered, gathering annihilation without one escaping.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Chuhan stormed Jiufuzhou at night with fire; none escaped.

sentences.zh: 九洑洲既克，謀者謂浙軍攻富陽，滬軍攻蘇州，江寧亦宜速合圍，使備多力分。

translations.literal: With Jiufuzhou taken, advisers said Zhe armies attacked Fuyang, Shanghai armies Suzhou, and Jiangning should also quickly complete encirclement so defenders would divide strength.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiufuzhou fell, strategists urged completing the Nanjing encirclement while forces were split.

sentences.zh: 國藩亦主合圍制敵為上策。

translations.literal: Guofan also held that encirclement to control the enemy was the superior strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan favored full encirclement as the best strategy.

sentences.zh: 秀成南渡後，連營於江陰、無錫數十里，聲言援江陰攻常熟。

translations.literal: After Xiucheng crossed south he linked camps at Jiangyin and Wuxi for tens of li, claiming to aid Jiangyin and attack Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng camped along Jiangyin and Wuxi, feigning relief for Changshu.

sentences.zh: 鴻章督諸軍攻破七十五壘，顧山以西寇皆盡。

translations.literal: Hongzhang supervised armies to break seventy-five forts; west of Gushan rebels were all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang cleared seventy-five forts west of Gushan.

sentences.zh: 寇自失九洑洲，下關江上接濟已斷，糧食漸乏，諜赴蘇州、嘉興，力圖接濟。

translations.literal: Since losing Jiufuzhou, Xia Pass river relief was cut; grain grew scarce; spies went to Suzhou and Jiaxing striving for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Cut off from the river, Nanjing starved while rebels sought Suzhou grain.

sentences.zh: 秀全以城圍日逼，留秀成共守老巢，緩援蘇州。

translations.literal: Xiuquan, as siege daily pressed, kept Xiucheng to guard the old nest together and slowed relief to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan kept Xiucheng at Nanjing and delayed Suzhou relief.

sentences.zh: 六月，秀全遣黨出儀鳳門犯鮑超營，出太平門犯劉連捷營，不克而退。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Xiuquan sent bands out Yifeng Gate against Bao Chao's camp and Taiping Gate against Liu Lianjie's camp; could not take them and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month sorties against Bao Chao and Liu Lianjie failed.

sentences.zh: 七月，犯下關，亦為我軍擊卻。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they attacked Xia Pass and were also repelled by our army.
translations.idiomatic: A July assault on Xia Pass was repelled.

sentences.zh: 八月，國荃攻印子山，破其石壘，陣斬偽佩王馮真林。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Guoquan attacked Yinzi Hill, broke its stone fort, beheading on the field the false Pei King Feng Zhenlin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Guo Quan took Yinzi Hill and killed Feng Zhenlin.

sentences.zh: 明日，破七橋甕石壘一、土壘三，偽梯王練茶發伏誅。

translations.literal: The next day he broke Seven-Bridge Jar one stone fort and three earth forts; the false Ti King Lian Chafa was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he took Seven-Bridge Jar and executed Lian Chafa.

sentences.zh: 國荃調江浦、浦口防軍，別募萬人，為火舉圍城之計。

translations.literal: Guoquan transferred Jiangpu and Pukou defense troops, separately recruited ten thousand, for a fire-attack encirclement plan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan reinforced the siege with ten thousand recruits.

sentences.zh: 是日程學啟會水師逼婁、葑，規取蘇州。

translations.literal: At the time Cheng Xueqi joined the water force to press Lou and Feng, planning to take Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi and the fleet pressed Suzhou's Lou and Feng gates.

sentences.zh: 初，建德南竄寇敗於汪邨，偽匡王賴文鴻創而墮馬，群寇衛之遁。

translations.literal: Earlier Jiande south-fleeing rebels were defeated at Wang Village; the false Kuang King Lai Wenhong was wounded and fell from his horse; rebel masses guarded him in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Wenhong was wounded fleeing south from Jiande.

sentences.zh: 越二日，復敗於分流木塔曹家渡，自是浮梁北路稍靖。

translations.literal: Two days later again defeated at Fenliu Wood Tower Caojiadu; from this Fuliang north route was slightly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later he was beaten again at Caojiadu.

sentences.zh: 先是黃文金糾合諸酋由皖入江，分擾鄱陽、浮梁、祁門、都昌境內，每為我軍所扼，不得深入；

translations.literal: Earlier Huang Wenjin rallied chiefs from Wan into Jiang, harassing Poyang, Fuliang, Qimen, and Duchang borders; each time blocked by our army, unable to penetrate deep;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin's raids in Jiangxi were repeatedly blocked;

sentences.zh: 乃折而西趨湖口，分三路：上路由文橋，中路由梧桐嶺，下路由太平關，而文橋寇勢最盛，文金親踞其中。

translations.literal: then turned west toward Hukou, dividing three routes: upper by Wen Bridge, middle by Wutong Ridge, lower by Taiping Pass; Wen Bridge rebels were strongest and Wenjin personally held the center.
translations.idiomatic: he turned to Hukou in three columns centered on Wen Bridge.

sentences.zh: 尋自文橋撲犯堅山大營，江忠義會諸軍直前迎擊，破其七壘，文金竄皖南，江西肅清。

translations.literal: Soon from Wen Bridge he struck Jianshan great camp; Jiang Zhongyi joined armies to meet head-on, broke seven forts; Wenjin fled to southern Anhui; Jiangxi was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyi broke seven forts at Wen Bridge and cleared Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 文金繞越池州圍青陽。

translations.literal: Wenjin circled past Chizhou to besiege Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin besieged Qingyang after circling Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，富陽寇與新橋寇互相犄角，抗我圍師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fuyang rebels and Xinqiao rebels mutually horned, resisting our besieging army.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyang and Xinqiao rebels held against the siege.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧督諸軍日夜轟擊，先破寇援，毀倚城大壘及大小諸卡，城寇不支，逃入新橋，城立復。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen supervised day-and-night bombardment, first broke rebel relief, destroyed city-adjacent great fort and large and small posts; city rebels could not hold, fled into Xinqiao; the city was quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen shelled Fuyang until the garrison fled to Xinqiao.

sentences.zh: 我軍復由雞籠山繞出新橋，併力追殺，寇壘悉數芟夷。

translations.literal: Our army again from Chicken Cage Hill circled out to Xinqiao, joined strength in pursuit; rebel forts were all mowed down.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops cleared rebel forts from Chicken Cage Hill to Xinqiao.

sentences.zh: 江陰踞寇日久負嵎，我軍攻之，勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: Jiangyin holding rebels long relied on terrain; our army attacked and momentum gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangyin siege tightened.

sentences.zh: 是月陳坤書及潮武齊區五大股眾十餘萬分道來援，亙數十里，西自江邊，東至山口，沿途紥木城十餘，其中營壘大小百餘，守禦堅固。

translations.literal: That month Chen Kunshu and Chao-Wu Qi five great columns of more than a hundred thousand came in separate routes to aid, stretching tens of li from the river west to the mountain mouth, along the way building more than ten wooden walls, within them large and small camps over a hundred, defense firm.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu brought 100,000 reinforcements along the Jiangyin line.

sentences.zh: 我軍水陸分攻，郭松林潛自山後噪而入，縱橫衝突。

translations.literal: Our army land and water divided attack; Guo Songlin secretly from behind the mountain clamored in and charged crosswise.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songlin stormed in from the rear.

sentences.zh: 銘傳直擣中堅，寇大潰。

translations.literal: Mingchuan struck straight at the center; rebels were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan broke the center.

sentences.zh: 有內應者，夜三鼓，梯城而入。

translations.literal: With inside collaborators, at the third watch of night they scaled the wall and entered.
translations.idiomatic: Collaborators opened the walls at the third watch.

sentences.zh: 偽廣王李愷順墜水死，遂克其城。

translations.literal: The false Guang King Li Kaishun fell into water and died; the city was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kaishun drowned; Jiangyin fell.

sentences.zh: 秀成自江寧返蘇，謀解城圍，與程學啟、戈登戰蘇州寶帶橋，敗北，奔至盤門。

translations.literal: Xiucheng returned from Jiangning to Su, plotting to lift city siege; fought Cheng Xueqi and Gordon at Suzhou Baodai Bridge, defeated north, fled to Pan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng lost to Cheng Xueqi and Gordon at Baodai Bridge and fled to Pan Gate.

sentences.zh: 我軍毀沿途諸卡，秀成率大股來爭，我軍力擊敗之。

translations.literal: Our army destroyed posts along the route; Xiucheng led a great column to contest; our army struck hard and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops destroyed Suzhou outposts and beat Xiucheng's counterattack.

sentences.zh: 初，寇於婁門外附城築十九壘，學啟屯外跨塘，砲力不能及寇壘，乃移壁永安橋，城中出夷人百餘，發炸砲助之。

translations.literal: Earlier rebels at Lou Gate outside built nineteen attached forts; Xueqi camped at Outer Kuatang; cannon could not reach rebel forts, so he moved walls to Yong'an Bridge; more than a hundred foreigners came out of the city firing explosive shells to aid.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi shifted to Yong'an Bridge as foreign gunners shelled from the city.

sentences.zh: 未幾，寇分門大出，水陸軍力禦，寇敗退。

translations.literal: Before long rebels sallied from divided gates; land and water armies resisted firmly; rebels were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel sortie from Suzhou was repelled.

sentences.zh: 學啟以寇壘既多且固，不得前；

translations.literal: Xueqi because rebel forts were many and solid could not advance;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi could not advance past the outer forts;

sentences.zh: 而城東南寶帶橋為太湖鎖鑰，寇立石營一、土營三，悉力拒守，遂謀先破之以挫其勢。

translations.literal: but southeast Baodai Bridge was Tai Lake's lock; rebels built one stone camp and three earth camps, resisting with all strength; he planned first to break them to blunt their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: he targeted Baodai Bridge, Tai Lake's key.

sentences.zh: 乃分水陸軍為三路，先破土營，寇棄壘走，石營亦旋潰。

translations.literal: He divided land and water armies into three routes, first broke earth camps; rebels abandoned forts and fled; stone camps also soon collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Three columns took the earth forts, then the stone forts.

sentences.zh: 秀成親率援師抵禦，學啟督軍卻之。

translations.literal: Xiucheng personally led relief to resist; Xueqi supervised troops and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng's relief was driven off.

sentences.zh: 我軍攻無錫賊，敗之芙蓉山。

translations.literal: Our army attacked Wuxi rebels, defeated them at Furong Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxi rebels were beaten at Furong Hill.

sentences.zh: 偽潮王黃子隆出拒，再敗走，刃及其肩，幾成擒；

translations.literal: The false Chao King Huang Zilong came out to resist, was again defeated and fled, blade reached his shoulder, nearly captured;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zilong was wounded and nearly captured at Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 郭松林追及城下，破平西北兩城壘，燒寇船百餘艘。

translations.literal: Guo Songlin pursued to below the walls, broke and leveled northwest two city forts, burned more than a hundred rebel boats.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songlin burned a hundred rebel boats below Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧既克富陽，移師杭州，康國器趨餘杭。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen having taken Fuyang moved army to Hangzhou; Kang Guoqi pressed Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: After Fuyang, Jiang Yizhen moved on Hangzhou and Kang Guoqi on Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 偽歸王鄧光明、偽聽王陳炳文、偽享王劉酋及偽朝將汪海洋，於附城要隘築壘樹棚，自前倉橋、女兒橋、老人畈、東塘、西谿埠、觀音橋、三墩，直至武林門、北新關，橫至古蕩，連營四十餘里，以拒我軍。

translations.literal: The false Gui King Deng Guangming, false Listening King Chen Bingwen, false Xiang King Liu Qiu, and false Court General Wang Haiyang at attached-city vital passes built forts and stockades from Qiancang Bridge, Daughter Bridge, Old Man's Field, East Pond, West Creek Ford, Guanyin Bridge, Sandun, reaching Wulin Gate and Beixin Pass, across to Gudang, linked camps forty-plus li to resist our army.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel princes fortified a forty-li ring around Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 海洋自杭州上援餘杭，為我軍擊敗。

translations.literal: Haiyang from Hangzhou aided Yuhang and was defeated by our army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Haiyang's Yuhang relief failed.

sentences.zh: 寇旋由前倉渡河，結壘西葛村，我軍再擊走之。

translations.literal: Rebels soon crossed from Qiancang, built forts at West Ge Village; our army again struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels were driven from West Ge Village.

sentences.zh: 我軍攻杭州江干十里街，破街口寇壘。

translations.literal: Our army attacked Hangzhou Jianggan Ten-Li Street, broke street-mouth rebel fort.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops broke the Jianggan street fort.

sentences.zh: 我水陸軍大舉攻青陽。

translations.literal: Our land and water armies advanced greatly to attack Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Land and water forces besieged Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 初，黃文金在都昌、湖口等處戰敗而東，遂略地池州，直薄青陽城外，近城半里，環築六十六壘；

translations.literal: Earlier Huang Wenjin after defeat at Duchang and Hukou turned east, then overran Chizhou territory, pressed straight below Qingyang walls; half a li from the city he ringed sixty-six forts;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin ringed Qingyang with sixty-six nearby forts;

sentences.zh: 又數里，築七十餘壘。

translations.literal: again several li out, built seventy-plus forts.
translations.idiomatic: and seventy more beyond.

sentences.zh: 曾國藩調水陸軍進攻，江忠義督所部渡河，從山後緣巖而上，驟攻寇壘。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan transferred land and water armies to attack; Jiang Zhongyi supervised his command crossing the river, from behind the mountain along cliffs upward, suddenly attacking rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyi stormed the hill forts from the rear.

sentences.zh: 寇糾眾抄我軍後路，忠義揮眾蕩決，寇敗若潮湧，平一百三十餘壘，殄萬餘，寇遁歸石埭一帶，城圍立解。

translations.literal: Rebels rallied masses to cut our army's rear route; Zhongyi waved troops to sweep through; rebels were defeated like a tide; leveled more than 130 forts, annihilated more than ten thousand; rebels fled to Shicheng region; city siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyi leveled 130 forts, killed 10,000, and relieved Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢、林紹璋等合股內犯，由無錫南門至坊前梅邨三十里；

translations.literal: Li Shixian and Lin Shaozhang combined columns invading inward from Wuxi South Gate to Fangqian Mei Village thirty li;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian and Lin Shaozhang advanced thirty li from Wuxi's south gate;

sentences.zh: 高橋大股亦分眾七八千人擾至西高山，出芙蓉山後；

translations.literal: Gaoqiao great column also split seven or eight thousand to harass West High Hill, exiting behind Furong Hill;
translations.idiomatic: 7,000–8,000 rebels flanked through Furong Hill;

sentences.zh: 城寇出北門犯塘頭東亭。

translations.literal: city rebels exited north gate to attack Tangtou Dongting.
translations.idiomatic: and the garrison sallied at Tangtou.

sentences.zh: 官軍分路迎剿，設伏誘擊，寇大亂，敗走，陸寇殲誅殆盡，奪寇船六十餘、民船五百餘。

translations.literal: Imperial troops met in separate routes, set ambush to lure strike; rebels fell into great disorder, fled defeated; land rebels were annihilated nearly all; seized sixty-plus rebel boats and five hundred civilian boats.
translations.idiomatic: Ambushes annihilated the land columns and captured hundreds of boats.

sentences.zh: 秀成自蘇州率偽納王郜雲官、偽來王陸順德、偽趨王黃章桂、偽祥王黃隆芸、偽紀王黃金愛來援，進逼大橋角營。

translations.literal: Xiucheng from Suzhou led the false Na King Gao Yunguan, false Lai King Lu Shunde, false Qu King Huang Zhanggui, false Xiang King Huang Longyun, and false Ji King Huang Jin'ai to aid, pressing close to Daqiao Corner camp.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng led five rebel kings to Daqiao Corner.

sentences.zh: 夷酋白齊文以輪船大砲為寇前驅，李鶴章以連珠噴筒破之。

translations.literal: Foreign chief Burgevine with steamer great cannon as rebel vanguard; Li Hezhang with continuous-bead spray tubes broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hezhang's repeaters beat Burgevine's steam guns.

sentences.zh: 寇水陸皆敗，斃萬餘。

translations.literal: Rebels land and water were all defeated; more than ten thousand killed.
translations.idiomatic: Over 10,000 rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 別股犯緱山，亦敗走。

translations.literal: Another column invaded Qoushan and was also defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: A column at Qoushan was also routed.

sentences.zh: 秀成子及宿祥玉、黃隆芸皆溺死，秀成頓足大哭。

translations.literal: Xiucheng's son and Su Xiangyu and Huang Longyun all drowned; Xiucheng stamped his feet and wept greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng's son and two kings drowned; he wept in despair.

sentences.zh: 程學啟再敗寇於齊、婁、葑三門，追至護城河邊始斂軍。

translations.literal: Cheng Xueqi again defeated rebels at Qi, Lou, and Feng three gates, pursued to the moat edge before collecting the army.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi cleared the Qi, Lou, and Feng gates to the moat.

sentences.zh: 九月，杭州城寇大出，由蠻頭山、鳳凰山、九耀山、雷峯塔犯我軍新壘，蔣益澧督諸軍迎擊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Hangzhou city rebels came out greatly from Mantou Hill, Fenghuang Hill, Jiuyao Hill, and Leifeng Pagoda to attack our new forts; Jiang Yizhen supervised armies to meet and greatly broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou's September sortie was crushed at Leifeng Pagoda.

sentences.zh: 我軍進壁天馬山、南屏山、翁家山。

translations.literal: Our army advanced to wall at Tianma Hill, Nanping Hill, and Wengjia Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops walled at Tianma, Nanping, and Wengjia hills.

sentences.zh: 時杭寇凶狡者，以鄧光明、汪海洋為最，陳炳文次之。

translations.literal: At the time among fierce cunning Hangzhou rebels, Deng Guangming and Wang Haiyang were foremost, Chen Bingwen next.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Guangming and Wang Haiyang led Hangzhou's toughest defenders.

sentences.zh: 其計以杭州為老巢，以餘杭為犄角，均賴嘉興、湖州之援，便資其接濟。

translations.literal: Their plan took Hangzhou as old nest and Yuhang as horn, both relying on Jiaxing and Huzhou relief for supply.
translations.idiomatic: They depended on Jiaxing and Huzhou for supplies.

sentences.zh: 嘉興入杭之路，則在餘杭，故我軍議先克餘杭，扼截嘉、湖之路，以並合圍。

translations.literal: The Jiaxing-Hangzhou route lay through Yuhang; therefore our army discussed first taking Yuhang to choke Jia-Hu routes and complete encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial strategy was to take Yuhang and sever Jiaxing's line to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧一軍逼紥鳳山、清波各門，扼其西面；

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen's one army pressed at Phoenix and Qingbo gates, choking the west;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yizhen blocked the western gates;

sentences.zh: 餘杭一城已圍其東南，而北路無重兵，兩城之寇往來如故。

translations.literal: Yuhang city was already encircled southeast, but the north lacked heavy troops; traffic between the two cities continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhang was partly besieged but the north remained open.

sentences.zh: 寇自大橋角戰敗，勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: After defeat at Daqiao Corner rebel momentum gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: After Daqiao Corner the rebels weakened.

sentences.zh: 秀成糾無錫、溧陽、宜興賊八九萬、船千餘艘，泊運河口；

translations.literal: Xiucheng rallied Wuxi, Liyang, and Yixing rebels eighty or ninety thousand and more than a thousand boats, moored at Transport River mouth;
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng massed 80,000–90,000 men and 1,000 boats at the Transport River.

sentences.zh: 而自率悍黨踞金匱縣后宅，連營互進。

translations.literal: while personally leading fierce bands to hold Jinkui County Houzhai, linked camps advancing together.
translations.idiomatic: He held Houzhai in Jinkui with linked camps.

sentences.zh: 李鶴章謂寇以河為固，不宜浪戰，宜結營制之。

translations.literal: Li Hezhang said rebels used the river as firm ground—should not fight recklessly, should build camps to control them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hezhang entrenched rather than risk a river battle.

sentences.zh: 我軍疊敗坊前、梅村、安鎮、鴻山之寇，而寇之大股全集西路，志在保無錫以援蘇州。

translations.literal: Our army successively defeated rebels at Fangqian, Mei Village, An Town, and Hongshan; rebel great columns all gathered on the west route, intent on holding Wuxi to aid Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial victories at Mei Village and Hongshan pinned rebels to Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 郎中潘增瑋進攻蠡口、黃埭之策，程學啟乃與戈登攻破蠡口，進擊黃埭，毀其四壘，擒斬偽天將萬國鎮。

translations.literal: Courtier Pan Zengwei advanced the strategy of attacking Likou and Huangdai; Cheng Xueqi then with Gordon broke Likou, advanced on Huangdai, destroyed four forts, captured and beheaded the false Heaven General Wan Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi and Gordon took Likou and Huangdai and killed Wan Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 五龍橋者在寶帶橋西五里，由澹臺湖鯰魚口達太湖以通浙之要隘也。

translations.literal: Wulong Bridge lay five li west of Baodai Bridge; from Tantai Lake Nianyu mouth it reached Tai Lake—the vital pass connecting Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Wulong Bridge was the Zhejiang gateway west of Baodai Bridge.

sentences.zh: 學啟率戈登會水師先後破寇六營。

translations.literal: Xueqi led Gordon with the water force to break six rebel camps in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi and Gordon broke six camps at Wulong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 於是我軍紥永安橋而婁門路斷，紥寶帶橋而葑門路斷，克五龍橋而盤門、太湖之路又斷。

translations.literal: Thus our army camped at Yong'an Bridge and Lou Gate route was cut, camped at Baodai Bridge and Feng Gate route was cut, took Wulong Bridge and Pan Gate and Tai Lake routes were again cut.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an, Baodai, and Wulong cut Suzhou's supply routes.

sentences.zh: 寇乃句結浙黨，圖撲吳江，以擾我後。

translations.literal: Rebels then colluded with Zhe bands, plotting to strike Wujiang and harass our rear.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels sought to hit Wujiang in the rear.

sentences.zh: 學啟率水陸軍擊破嘉、湖援寇，擒斬偽貴王陳得勝及悍黨四十餘，追至平望，斷其橋。

translations.literal: Xueqi led land and water armies to break Jia-Hu relief rebels, captured and beheaded the false Gui King Chen Desheng and more than forty fierce bands, pursued to Pingwang, broke their bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi killed Chen Desheng and broke the bridge at Pingwang.

sentences.zh: 從此攻蘇之軍無牽掣之患。

translations.literal: From this armies attacking Su had no tying concerns.
translations.idiomatic: The Suzhou assault was no longer distracted.

sentences.zh: 偽平東王何明亮等以劉典屯績溪，不克上犯徽、歙，遂由寧國千秋關竄浙江，陷昌化，擾於潛。

translations.literal: The false Ping East King He Mingliang and others, seeing Liu Dian camped at Jixi could not invade upward into Hui and She, then from Ningguo Qianqiu Pass slipped into Zhejiang, took Changhua, and harassed Yuqian.
translations.idiomatic: He Mingliang slipped through Qianqiu Pass into Changhua and Yuqian.

sentences.zh: 其前竄廣德者，復折踞孝豐。

translations.literal: Those earlier fleeing to Guangde again turned to hold Xiaofeng.
translations.idiomatic: Guangde fugitives held Xiaofeng again.

sentences.zh: 劉典遣軍出績溪昱嶺關援剿。

translations.literal: Liu Dian sent troops out from Jixi Yuling Pass in relief pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dian pursued from Yuling Pass.

sentences.zh: 江寧軍自攻克江東橋、上方橋，而城東數隘未下。

translations.literal: Jiangning army since taking Jiangdong Bridge and Shangfang Bridge, several east passes were still not down.
translations.idiomatic: East of Nanjing several passes still held.

sentences.zh: 近城者曰中和橋，曰雙橋，曰七橋甕，稍遠者曰方山、土山，曰上方門、高橋門，迤南則為秣陵，以至博望鎮，皆金陵外輔也。

translations.literal: Near the city were Zhonghe Bridge, Shuang Bridge, and Seven-Bridge Jar; slightly farther Fang Hill, Tu Hill, Shangfang Gate and Gaoqiao Gate; winding south to Moling and Bo Wang Town—all outer supports of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe, Shuang, Seven-Bridge Jar, and Moling were Nanjing's outer defenses.

sentences.zh: 國荃以東路未平，不能制寇死命，令諸軍東渡。
