translations.literal: Guoquan because the east route was not pacified could not grip rebel life and death, ordered generals to cross east.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan ordered an east-bank crossing to finish the outer defenses.

sentences.zh: 提督蕭衍慶過河破五壘，城寇出爭，擊退之，遂克上方門、高橋門、雙橋門。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Governor Xiao Yanqing crossed the river and broke five forts; city rebels came out to contest; they were struck back; then took Shangfang Gate, Gaoqiao Gate, and Shuang Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yanqing took Shangfang, Gaoqiao, and Shuang bridges.

sentences.zh: 右路方山、土山之寇亦棄壘而奔。

translations.literal: Right-route Fang Hill and Tu Hill rebels also abandoned forts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Fang and Tu hills were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 七橋甕踞寇倉皇欲遁，而城中忽出大股來援，兩軍相搏，總兵蕭孚泗乘夜縱火，寇冒火突出，遂克七橋甕。

translations.literal: Seven-Bridge Jar holding rebels wished to flee in panic, but suddenly a great column came out of the city to aid; two armies grappled; Brigadier Xiao Fusi by night set fire; rebels burst through flame; Seven-Bridge Jar was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fusi burned through the fight for Seven-Bridge Jar.

sentences.zh: 其博望鎮，總兵朱南桂已先五日襲取之。

translations.literal: Bo Wang Town Brigadier Zhu Nangui had already seized it five days before.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Nangui had taken Bo Wang Town five days earlier.

sentences.zh: 博望鎮既失，則秣陵關之勢孤；

translations.literal: With Bo Wang lost, Moling Pass's position was isolated;
translations.idiomatic: Moling Pass was isolated;

sentences.zh: 七橋甕既失，則中和橋之勢孤。

translations.literal: with Seven-Bridge Jar lost, Zhonghe Bridge's position was isolated.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhonghe Bridge was isolated.

sentences.zh: 總兵伍維壽等南略秣陵關，寇棄壘奔潰。

translations.literal: Brigadier Wu Weishou and others marched south to take Moling Pass; rebels abandoned forts and fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Weishou took Moling Pass.

sentences.zh: 自是鍾山西南無一寇巢。

translations.literal: From this southwest of Bell Mountain had not one rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Bell Mountain was cleared.

sentences.zh: 偽奉王古隆賢詣朱品隆降，收復石埭、太平、景德三城，徽州肅清。

translations.literal: The false Feng King Gu Longxian came to Zhu Pinlong to surrender; Shicheng, Taiping, and Jingde three cities were recovered; Huizhou was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Longxian surrendered; Shicheng, Taiping, and Jingde were recovered.

sentences.zh: 餘寇竄踞寧國、廣德、孝豐之間，勢甚渙散。

translations.literal: Remaining rebels held between Ningguo, Guangde, and Xiaofeng, momentum very scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Scattered rebels remained between Ningguo, Guangde, and Xiaofeng.

sentences.zh: 宗棠飭劉典由昌化、於潛趨臨安，進剿孝豐，為規取湖州之地。

translations.literal: Zongtang ordered Liu Dian from Changhua and Yuqian toward Lin'an, advancing on Xiaofeng, planning to take Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo sent Liu Dian toward Lin'an and Xiaofeng to target Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，易開俊克寧國縣城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Yi Kaijun took Ningguo county seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yi Kaijun took Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 自是東壩黎立新上書請為內應，建平張勝祿上書請獻城池。

translations.literal: From this East Dam Li Lixin wrote offering inside collaboration; Jianping Zhang Shenglu wrote offering to present the city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Lixin and Zhang Shenglu offered to defect at East Dam and Jianping.

sentences.zh: 鮑超等遂合趨東壩，繞壘環攻。

translations.literal: Bao Chao and others then jointly pressed East Dam, circling forts in ring attack.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao besieged East Dam.

sentences.zh: 楊輔清從亂軍中逸出，寇立獻偽城。

translations.literal: Yang Fuqing escaped from the disorderly army; rebels immediately presented the false city.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing fled; the garrison surrendered East Dam.

sentences.zh: 東壩既克，建平張勝祿等即於是日斬偽跟王藍仁得，舉城降，而溧水寇楊英清亦繳械降，遂收二城。

translations.literal: With East Dam taken, Jianping Zhang Shenglu and others that same day beheaded the false Gen King Lan Rendé and surrendered the city; while Lishui rebel Yang Yingqing also turned in arms and surrendered; two cities were then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: East Dam and Jianping fell the same day; Yang Yingqing surrendered Lishui.

sentences.zh: 國荃克淳化鎮、解谿、龍都、湖墅、三岔鎮等隘，燬寇壘二十餘。

translations.literal: Guoquan took Chunhua Town, Jiexi, Longdu, Hushu, and Sancha Town and other passes, burning more than twenty rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan cleared Chunhua, Jiexi, and twenty forts southeast of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 江寧城東南百里內寇巢略盡。

translations.literal: Within a hundred li southeast of Jiangning city rebel nests were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel nests within a hundred li southeast of Nanjing were gone.

sentences.zh: 蘇州軍自黃埭攻滸墅關，破王瓜涇、觀音廟寇壘，直抵滸墅，擊走偽來王陸順德，進毀十里亭。

translations.literal: Suzhou army from Huangdai attacked Xushu Pass, broke Wangguajing and Guanyin Temple rebel forts, reached straight to Xushu, struck away the false Lai King Lu Shunde, advanced to destroy Ten-Li Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: From Huangdai imperial troops cleared Xushu Pass and Ten-Li Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 虎丘、楓橋寇皆遁。

translations.literal: Tiger Hill and Maple Bridge rebels all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger Hill and Maple Bridge rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 躡至閶門，寇大恐。

translations.literal: Pressing to Chang Gate rebels were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels panicked at Chang Gate.

sentences.zh: 李鶴章敗寇無錫鴨城橋，破西倉寇壘，直抵茅塘橋。

translations.literal: Li Hezhang defeated rebels at Wuxi Duck City Bridge, broke Xicang rebel fort, reached straight to Maotang Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hezhang broke Wuxi rebels at Duck City Bridge.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢調常州陳坤書來援，城寇黃子澄出迎，我軍縱擊敗之。

translations.literal: Li Shixian transferred Changzhou Chen Kunshu to aid; city rebel Huang Zicheng came out to meet; our army struck and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian's Changzhou relief was beaten at the walls.

sentences.zh: 秀成聞滸關已失，退屯北望亭，謀返蘇州老巢。

translations.literal: Xiucheng hearing Xushu Pass was lost retreated to camp at North Wangting, plotting to return to Suzhou old nest.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng withdrew to North Wangting after Xushu Pass fell.

sentences.zh: 坤書還走常州，侍賢遁宜興、溧陽，我軍乘之，下寇壘百餘。

translations.literal: Kunshu returned to Changzhou; Shixian fled to Yixing and Liyang; our army seized the moment and took more than a hundred rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu retreated; imperial troops took a hundred forts.

sentences.zh: 鴻章督軍攻婁門寇。

translations.literal: Hongzhang supervised troops attacking Lou Gate rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang assaulted Lou Gate.

sentences.zh: 蘇州四年自我軍連克要隘，乃於胥、葑、婁等門憑河築壘數十，婁門外石壘尤堅。

translations.literal: Suzhou four years since our army successively took vital passes; rebels then at Xu, Feng, Lou and other gates built dozens of forts along the river; Lou Gate outer stone fort was especially firm.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels had fortified Suzhou's river gates for four years.

sentences.zh: 至是我軍由南北岸而進，秀成等突出婁門拒戰，程學啟與常勝軍分隊以應，援寇遁入城。

translations.literal: Now our army advanced from north and south banks; Xiucheng and others sallied from Lou Gate to resist; Cheng Xueqi with the Ever-Victorious Army divided teams to answer; relief rebels slipped into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng sallied at Lou Gate but relief was driven inside.

sentences.zh: 水師會攻婁葑門外寇壘二十餘皆下。

translations.literal: The water force jointly attacked more than twenty Lou-Feng outer forts—all fell.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet cleared twenty outer forts at Lou and Feng.

sentences.zh: 我軍連克齊盤門各壘，三面薄城，寇眾恟懼，而秀成及譚紹光猶圖固守，他酋郜雲官等皆有貳心，密請於鴻章乞反正，許之。

translations.literal: Our army successively took Qi and Pan gate forts, pressed the city on three sides; rebel masses were alarmed and fearful; yet Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang still plotted firm defense; other chiefs Gao Yunguan and others all had divided hearts, secretly begging Hongzhang for defection—he permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Three sides pressed Suzhou; rebel chiefs secretly negotiated surrender.

sentences.zh: 學啟、戈登單舸見雲官等，命斬秀成、紹光以獻；

translations.literal: Xueqi and Gordon in a single boat met Yunguan and others, ordering them to behead Xiucheng and Shaoguang as offering;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi and Gordon demanded Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang's heads;

sentences.zh: 而雲官不忍殺秀成，許圖紹光。

translations.literal: but Yunguan could not bear to kill Xiucheng and agreed to plot Shaoguang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yunguan agreed to kill Tan Shaoguang but spared Xiucheng.

sentences.zh: 秀成覺之，涕泗握紹光手為別，乘夜率萬人自胥門出走嘉善。

translations.literal: Xiucheng perceived it, weeping and gripping Shaoguang's hand in farewell, by night leading ten thousand from Xu Gate to flee toward Jiashan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng fled through Xu Gate toward Jiashan with 10,000 men.

sentences.zh: 郜雲官殺譚紹光，率偽比王伍貴文，偽康王汪安均，偽寧王周文佳，偽天將范起發、張大洲、汪瓌武、汪有為，開齊化門迎降，鴻章受之。

translations.literal: Gao Yunguan killed Tan Shaoguang, leading the false Bi King Wu Guiwen, false Kang King Wang Anjun, false Ning King Zhou Wenjia, and false Heaven Generals Fan Qifa, Zhang Dazhou, Wang Guiwu, and Wang Youwei to open Qihua Gate in welcome surrender; Hongzhang accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yunguan killed Tan Shaoguang and opened Qihua Gate to Li Hongzhang.

sentences.zh: 雲官等未薙髮，要總兵、副將等官，並請自領其眾屯守盤、齊、胥、閶四門。

translations.literal: Yunguan and others had not shaved heads, demanded brigadier and vice-brigadier ranks, and asked to lead their masses to camp guarding Pan, Qi, Xu, and Chang four gates.
translations.idiomatic: The defectors demanded ranks and garrison of four gates.

sentences.zh: 程學啟慮其不可制，密請於鴻章誅之，立復蘇省。

translations.literal: Cheng Xueqi feared they could not be controlled, secretly asked Hongzhang to execute them, and quickly recovered Su Province.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi had the defectors executed and secured Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 秀成以輪船炸砲越無錫水師北竄。

translations.literal: Xiucheng with steamer explosive cannon crossed north over Wuxi water force in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng fled north by steamer past Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，李鶴章克同城無錫、金匱，追擒黃子隆與子德懋並誅之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Li Hezhang took Tongcheng Wuxi and Jinkui, pursued and captured Huang Zilong and son Demao and executed them both.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Hezhang took Wuxi and executed Huang Zilong and his son.

sentences.zh: 劉秉璋等攻浙西，平湖寇陳殿選獻城乞降。

translations.literal: Liu Bingzhang and others attacked western Zhe; Pinghu rebel Chen Dianxuan presented the city begging surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Pinghu surrendered to Liu Bingzhang.

sentences.zh: 連日乍浦賊熊建勳、海鹽𣹂浦賊皆反正。

translations.literal: For successive days Zhepu rebel Xiong Jianxun and Haiyan Shepu rebels all turned righteous.
translations.idiomatic: Zhepu and Haiyan rebels defected.

sentences.zh: 十二月，秀成留蘇州敗黨分布丹陽、句容間，自率數百騎潛入江寧太平門，苦勸秀全棄城同走。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Xiucheng left Suzhou defeated bands distributed between Danyang and Jurong; he personally led several hundred horsemen to slip into Jiangning Taiping Gate, bitterly urging Xiuquan to abandon the city and flee together.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiucheng entered Nanjing and urged Hong Xiuquan to flee.

sentences.zh: 秀全侈然高座曰：「我奉天父、天兄命，令為天下萬國獨立真主，天兵眾多，何懼之有？

translations.literal: Xiuquan sat loftily on high throne and said: "I received Heaven Father and Heaven Brother's command to be the true lord of all nations under heaven alone; heavenly soldiers are many—what is there to fear?
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan refused: "Heaven chose me—why should I fear?"

sentences.zh: 」秀成又曰：「糧道已絕，饑死可立待也！

translations.literal: Xiucheng again said: "Grain routes are already cut—starvation can be awaited standing!
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng warned that starvation was imminent.

sentences.zh: 」秀全曰：「食天生甜露，自能救饑。

translations.literal: Xiuquan said: "Eating heaven-sent sweet dew can itself save from hunger."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan claimed heaven-sent sweet dew would feed them.

sentences.zh: 」甜露，雜草也。

translations.literal: Sweet dew was wild grass.
translations.idiomatic: The "sweet dew" was wild grass.

sentences.zh: 秀成以秀全戀老巢不肯去，非口舌所能爭，乃貽書溧陽約李侍賢，銳意走江西。

translations.literal: Xiucheng, seeing Xiuquan clung to the old nest and would not go, not something tongue could dispute, then wrote to Liyang arranging Li Shixian, keenly planning to flee to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to move Hong Xiuquan, Xiucheng arranged flight to Jiangxi with Li Shixian.

sentences.zh: 初，寇自咸豐十年破江寧長圍，迭陷蘇、常、嘉、湖，上竄江西、湖北，擄脅潰兵、游匪以百萬計，盡得東南財賦之區，日以強大。

translations.literal: Earlier rebels since Xianfeng ten broke Jiangning's long encirclement, successively took Su, Chang, Jia, and Hu, slipped up into Jiangxi and Hubei, coerced routed troops and roaming bandits to the million, fully gained the southeast revenue region, daily growing stronger.
translations.idiomatic: After 1860 the Taiping realm seized the wealthy southeast and swelled to a million followers.

sentences.zh: 自去歲屢戰屢敗，各城精銳散亡不下十萬。

translations.literal: Since last year repeated battles and defeats, each city's elite scattered and lost no less than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's defeats cost 100,000 elite fighters.

sentences.zh: 今年春夏間竄皖北，我軍截殺解散又十數萬。

translations.literal: This year spring and summer they fled into north Anhui; our army intercepted and dispersed another hundred-plus thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and summer campaigns in Anhui dispersed another 100,000.

sentences.zh: 其自九洑洲過江，僅存四五萬人。

translations.literal: Those crossing the river from Jiufuzhou retained only forty or fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Only 40,000–50,000 remained after Jiufuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秀全驚惶失措，賴秀成回江寧主持守局；

translations.literal: Xiuquan was alarmed and at a loss, relying on Xiucheng returning to Jiangning to preside over defense;
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan depended on Xiucheng's return to hold Nanjing;

sentences.zh: 而秀成以蘇州為分地，事急回援。

translations.literal: while Xiucheng took Suzhou as his domain and returned in urgency when matters were critical.
translations.idiomatic: while Xiucheng treated Suzhou as his own and rushed back when it fell.

sentences.zh: 今巢穴已失，黨羽又孤，踉蹌而走，隨行僅兩萬餘人，欲赴金陵，解圍無術。

translations.literal: Now nests were lost and followers isolated; they fled stumbling, following with only twenty-plus thousand, wishing to reach Jinling without method to lift siege.
translations.idiomatic: With nests lost, Xiucheng fled with only 20,000 men and no way to relieve Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 力勸秀全突圍上竄回粵，以圖再舉。

translations.literal: He strongly urged Xiuquan to break encirclement and flee up to Guangdong to plot rising again.
translations.idiomatic: He urged Hong Xiuquan to break out toward Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 常州陳坤書、溧陽李侍賢皆聽秀成為進止，而杭州陳炳文係安徽人，鄧光明湖南人，聞秀成有回粵之謀，皆不願從，秀全亦屢勸不聽。

translations.literal: Changzhou Chen Kunshu and Liyang Li Shixian all followed Xiucheng's advance and halt; while Hangzhou Chen Bingwen was Anhui man and Deng Guangming Hunan man—hearing Xiucheng planned return to Guangdong, all were unwilling to follow; Xiuquan also repeatedly urged without listening.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu and Li Shixian followed Xiucheng; Chen Bingwen and Deng Guangming refused to go to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 國荃自四月間掘地道，至是始成，而寇附城築牆號「月圍」，下穿橫洞以防隧道。

translations.literal: Guoquan since the fourth month dug tunnels; only now were they complete, while rebels attached to the walls built a wall called "moon encirclement," digging horizontal caves beneath to guard against tunnels.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan's tunnels were ready; rebels built "moon walls" with counter-mines.

sentences.zh: 故城崩，而猶阻月圍橫洞不能克。

translations.literal: Thus when walls collapsed they were still blocked by moon encirclement horizontal caves and could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Wall breaches were blocked by the moon walls.

sentences.zh: 劉銘傳進攻常州西路，奔牛踞寇邵志倫，羅墅灣踞寇夏登山、萬錫階，石橋灣踞寇張邦振皆詣我軍乞降，收眾萬六千人。

translations.literal: Liu Mingchuan advanced on Changzhou west route; Benniu holding rebel Shao Zhilun, Luowan holding Xia Dengshan and Wan Xijie, Shiqiao Bay holding Zhang Bangzhen all came to our army begging surrender, receiving masses sixteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen thousand rebels surrendered on Changzhou's west route.

sentences.zh: 惟孟河賊尚踞汛城，輒出犯降人壘，銘傳一鼓下之。

translations.literal: Only Menghe rebels still held the post city, often coming out to attack surrenderers' forts; Mingchuan took it in one drum.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan took Menghe in one assault.

sentences.zh: 潘鼎新克嶼城，李鴻章等破常州東門、南門石壘。

translations.literal: Pan Dingxin took Yucheng; Li Hongzhang and others broke Changzhou east and south gate stone forts.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Dingxin took Yucheng; Li Hongzhang broke Changzhou's east and south gates.

sentences.zh: 明日，張樹聲傍城東北築壘，破小門、土門。

translations.literal: The next day Zhang Shusheng beside the city northeast built forts, broke Small Gate and Earth Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shusheng broke the Small and Earth gates.

sentences.zh: 連日嘉興、桐鄉、石門寇犯嶼城，海寧寇犯澉浦、海鹽，偽章王林紹璋自句容援常州，均為我軍擊走。

translations.literal: For successive days Jiaxing, Tongxiang, and Shimen rebels invaded Yucheng; Haining rebels invaded Jianpu and Haiyan; the false Zhang King Lin Shaozhang from Jurong aided Changzhou—all were driven off by our army.
translations.idiomatic: Raids on Yucheng, Jianpu, and Changzhou relief were all repelled.

sentences.zh: 程學啟克平望鎮。

translations.literal: Cheng Xueqi took Pingwang Town.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi took Pingwang.

sentences.zh: 平望東連嘉興，西接湖州，南通杭郡，為蘇、浙樞紐，浙寇精銳多聚守此，今被我軍攻克，嘉興藩籬已失，踞寇奪氣。

translations.literal: Pingwang east connected Jiaxing, west joined Huzhou, south connected to Hang Prefecture—it was the Su-Zhe hub; Zhe rebels' elite mostly gathered here; now taken by our army, Jiaxing's screen was lost and holding rebels lost spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Pingwang's fall exposed Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 寇犯鎮江甘棠橋張文德壘，馮子材等助擊破之，斬李秀成養子偽岡天義黃酋。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked Zhenjiang Gantang Bridge Zhang Wende's fort; Feng Zicai and others aided strike and broke them, beheading Xiucheng's adopted son the false Gang Tianyi Huang Qiu.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai killed Xiucheng's adopted son Huang Qiu at Gantang Bridge.

sentences.zh: 十二月，偽會王蔡元隆獻城降，左宗棠受之，改名元吉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the false Hui King Cai Yuanlong presented the city in surrender; Zuo Zongtang accepted him and renamed him Yuanji.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Cai Yuanlong surrendered Haining to Zuo Zongtang.

sentences.zh: 海寧瀕海，為杭州東北屏蔽。

translations.literal: Haining faced the sea, screening Hangzhou's northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Haining guarded Hangzhou's northeast coast.

sentences.zh: 元吉擁眾，致攻杭之師未能合圍；

translations.literal: Yuanji held masses, causing armies attacking Hang to be unable to complete encirclement;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji's garrison had blocked the Hangzhou encirclement;

sentences.zh: 今幡然附款，杭州之勢益孤，東北兩面圍漸合。

translations.literal: now suddenly attaching in good faith, Hangzhou's situation grew more isolated; northeast and east encirclements gradually closed.
translations.idiomatic: his surrender tightened the ring around Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉興賊偽榮王廖發受呈降書，程學啟慮有狡謀，誡軍嚴備。

translations.literal: Jiaxing rebel the false Rong King Liao Fashou presented surrender letter; Cheng Xueqi feared crafty plot and warned the army to guard strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Fashou's surrender at Jiaxing was treated with caution.

sentences.zh: 杭州踞寇偽聽王陳炳文遣人詣降，而無降書，宗棠趣蔣益澧攻城益急。

translations.literal: Hangzhou holding rebel the false Listening King Chen Bingwen sent men to negotiate surrender but without surrender document; Zongtang urged Jiang Yizhen to attack the city more urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bingwen negotiated without formal surrender; Zuo pressed the assault.

sentences.zh: 秀成會李侍賢犯江西，既以溧陽至饒州浮梁數百里處處乏食，慮裹糧疾趨為難；

translations.literal: Xiucheng joined Li Shixian invading Jiangxi; since Liyang to Raozhou Fuliang several hundred li everywhere lacked food, he feared swift march with grain on back was hard;
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng and Li Shixian invaded Jiangxi but lacked food along the route;

sentences.zh: 因趣侍賢持二十日糧，道長興、廣德、寧國入江西，先踞腴區待己。

translations.literal: therefore he urged Shixian to carry twenty days' grain, route through Changxing, Guangde, and Ningguo into Jiangxi, first holding fertile districts awaiting him.
translations.idiomatic: he ordered Shixian to take twenty days' grain through Guangde into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 於是侍賢遣黨西竄，行甚疾。

translations.literal: Thus Shixian sent bands west in flight, marching very swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian's column raced west.

sentences.zh: 曾國藩遣軍屯休寧，沈寶楨遣軍屯婺源、玉山拒之。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan sent troops camped at Xiuning; Shen Baozhen sent troops camped at Wuyuan and Yushan to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan and Shen Baozhen blocked the route at Xiuning and Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 四月，川督駱秉璋破賊天全，生擒偽翼王石達開，磔於市。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Sichuan Governor Luo Bingzhang broke rebels at Tianquan, captured alive the false Wing King Shi Dakai, and dismembered him in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Luo Bingzhang captured and executed Shi Dakai at Tianquan.

sentences.zh: 自洪秀全倡亂，封五偽王：馮雲山、蕭朝貴皆敗死，楊秀清、韋昌輝自相賊殺，石達開避禍出奔，自樹一幟，歷犯浙江、福建、兩湖、兩廣諸省，並擾及滇、黔，蓄意入川，以圖竊據，至是為川軍擒戮。

translations.literal: Since Hong Xiuquan raised rebellion he enfeoffed five false kings: Feng Yunshan and Xiao Chaogui both died in defeat, Yang Xiuqing and Wei Changhui mutually killed as rebels, Shi Dakai fled calamity and raised his own banner, successively invading Zhe, Fujian, Hunan, Hubei, and the two Guang, also harassing Yunnan and Guizhou, intent on entering Sichuan to plot seizure—now captured and executed by Sichuan army.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai, the last of the five founding kings, was executed in Sichuan after years of wandering.

sentences.zh: 凡偽五王前後皆誅滅矣。

translations.literal: All five false kings before and after were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: All five founding kings were dead.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，蔣益澧飭降人蔡元吉襲桐鄉不下。

translations.literal: In the first month of year three Jiang Yizhen ordered surrenderer Cai Yuanji to raid Tongxiang without success.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yuanji failed to take Tongxiang by raid.

sentences.zh: 桐鄉為杭、嘉要道，益澧遣將分屯東北門，偽朝將何培章來降，遂收桐鄉，令培章率降眾屯烏鎮、雙橋，阻杭、嘉道，絕寇糧。

translations.literal: Tongxiang was the Hang-Jia vital route; Yizhen sent generals to camp at northeast gate; the false Court General He Peizhang came to surrender; Tongxiang was then recovered; Peizhang was ordered to lead surrendered masses at Wuzhen and Shuangqiao, blocking Hang-Jia route and cutting rebel grain.
translations.idiomatic: He Peizhang surrendered Tongxiang and blocked the Hang-Jia road.

sentences.zh: 湖、杭寇皆來爭，擊走之。

translations.literal: Hu and Hang rebels all came to contest and were struck away.
translations.idiomatic: Relief columns for Huzhou and Hangzhou were driven off.

sentences.zh: 我軍進屯嘉興，聯絡蘇師，規復郡城。

translations.literal: Our army advanced to camp at Jiaxing, linking with Su forces, planning to recover the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops camped at Jiaxing to recover the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廣德、寧國寇竄犯浙江昌化，副將劉明珍不知寇眾寡，進擊，創矛，退扼河橋。

translations.literal: Guangde and Ningguo rebels invaded Zhejiang Changhua; Brigadier Liu Mingzhen not knowing rebel numbers few or many advanced to attack, was wounded by spear, retreated to hold River Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingzhen was wounded repelling Guangde rebels at Changhua.

sentences.zh: 寇尋分黨：一竄徽州績溪，一竄淳安，謀渡威坪河進窺遂安。

translations.literal: Rebels soon split bands: one slipped into Huizhou Jixi, one into Chun'an, plotting to cross Weiping River to spy on Suian.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns split toward Jixi and Chun'an.

sentences.zh: 時侍賢上犯，冀衝過徽州，就食江西。

translations.literal: At the time Shixian invaded upward hoping to rush past Huizhou to find food in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian aimed through Huizhou for food in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 其大勢趨重遂安，擾及開化馬金街，其地與休寧、婺源、常山、玉山接壤。

translations.literal: His great momentum stressed Suian, harassing Kaihua Majin Street—the place bordered Xiuning, Wuyuan, Changshan, and Yushan.
translations.idiomatic: He stressed Suian and Majin on the Anhui-Zhejiang border.

sentences.zh: 王開琳自徽州進遂安，連破寇於中州昏口。

translations.literal: Wang Kailin from Huizhou advanced to Suian, successively broke rebels at Zhongzhou and Hunkou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kailin beat rebels at Zhongzhou and Hunkou.

sentences.zh: 黃少春馳入縣城，敗寇遂安城北，蹙入郭邨，殲之。

translations.literal: Huang Shaochun rushed into the county seat, defeated rebels north of Suian city, pressed into Guo Village, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shaochun annihilated rebels at Guo Village north of Suian.

sentences.zh: 寇後隊仍由章邨竄昏口，少春擊破之新橋，開琳復繞出昏口敗之。

translations.literal: Rebel rear guard still slipped from Zhang Village to Hunkou; Shaochun broke them at Xinqiao; Kailin again circled out to defeat them at Hunkou.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit destroyed the rear guard at Hunkou and Xinqiao.

sentences.zh: 其竄往開化華埠僅千餘。

translations.literal: Those slipping to Kaihua Huabu were only a thousand-plus.
translations.idiomatic: Only a thousand rebels reached Kaihua Huabu.

sentences.zh: 侍賢句合黃文金及廣德餘黨由寧國上竄，陷績溪，退踞雄路、孔靈等處，圖撲徽州。

translations.literal: Shixian joined Huang Wenjin and Guangde remnant bands upward in flight, took Jixi, retreated to hold Xionglu, Kongling, and other places, plotting to strike Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian and Huang Wenjin took Jixi and threatened Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 唐義訓自徽州出紮吳山鋪，敗之，毀雄路寇館。

translations.literal: Tang Yixun from Huizhou camped at Wushanpu, defeated them, destroyed Xionglu rebel lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yixun destroyed Xionglu lodges from Wushanpu.

sentences.zh: 援寇至，我軍奮擊，再破之，縣城立復。

translations.literal: Relief rebels arrived; our army struck hard, broke them again; the county seat was quickly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: A second assault recovered the county seat.

sentences.zh: 鴻章派郭松林、戈登等攻宜興、荊溪，寇開城出拒，槍子傷松林右肘。

translations.literal: Hongzhang sent Guo Songlin, Gordon, and others to attack Yixing and Jingxi; rebels opened the city to resist; a bullet wounded Songlin's right elbow.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songlin was wounded assaulting Yixing.

sentences.zh: 我軍屯三里橋，與常勝軍會擊，偽代王黃精忠由溧陽來援，拚死相撲，我軍屹立不動，以洋槍排擊之，寇死傷相繼，無退志。

translations.literal: Our army camped at Sanli Bridge, joined the Ever-Victorious Army in strike; the false Acting King Huang Jingzhong from Liyang came to aid, fighting to the death in mutual grapple; our army stood firm unmoved, repelling with foreign-gun volleys; rebels dead and wounded followed in succession without retreating will.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Jingzhong's fierce Liyang relief was stopped by rifle fire at Sanli Bridge.

sentences.zh: 我軍三路包抄，寇始奪路狂奔，城寇勢益不支，開西門而逸，遂復兩縣城。

translations.literal: Our army in three routes outflanked; rebels then seized routes in wild flight; city rebel momentum grew more unable to hold; they opened west gate and fled; both county seats were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: A three-way encirclement took Yixing and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 是城瀕太湖西岸，當江、浙衝道，為常郡後路。

translations.literal: The cities faced Tai Lake's west bank at the Jiang-Zhe crossroads—the rear route of Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They commanded Changzhou's rear on the Tai Lake shore.

sentences.zh: 自是常郡寇益蹙，蘇州、無錫之防益固。

translations.literal: From this Chang Prefecture rebels grew more pressed; Suzhou and Wuxi defenses grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou tightened; Suzhou and Wuxi were secured.

sentences.zh: 戈登進圍溧陽。

translations.literal: Gordon advanced to besiege Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gordon besieged Liyang.

sentences.zh: 溧陽為李侍賢老巢，又江寧後路要隘。

translations.literal: Liyang was Li Shixian's old nest and also Jiangning's rear vital pass.
translations.idiomatic: Liyang was Shixian's base and Nanjing's rear gate.

sentences.zh: 常州、金壇在其北，句容、丹陽值其西，長興、廣德當其南，面面寇巢，前與鮑超東壩、溧水之師相隔絕，後距李鴻章常州軍亦稍遠。

translations.literal: Changzhou and Jintan lay north, Jurong and Danyang west, Changxing and Guangde south—on every face rebel nests; ahead separated from Bao Chao's East Dam and Lishui armies, behind also somewhat far from Li Hongzhang's Changzhou army.
translations.idiomatic: Liyang was surrounded by rebel strongholds and isolated from friendly forces.

sentences.zh: 孤軍深入，李鴻章戒戈登慎進止。

translations.literal: A lone army advanced deep; Li Hongzhang warned Gordon to advance and halt cautiously.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang cautioned Gordon against overextension.

sentences.zh: 尋溧陽酋吳人杰降，戈登復其城。

translations.literal: Soon Liyang chief Wu Renjie surrendered; Gordon recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Renjie surrendered Liyang to Gordon.

sentences.zh: 郭松林等進攻金壇，敗偽列王古宗成、偽襄王劉官方於楊巷。

translations.literal: Guo Songlin and others advanced on Jintan, defeated the false Lie King Gu Zongcheng and false Xiang King Liu Guanfang at Yang Lane.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songlin beat Gu Zongcheng and Liu Guanfang at Yang Lane.

sentences.zh: 是時常州陳坤書合丹陽、句容之寇十餘萬，由西路繞出常州之北，日犯我軍，李鶴章督軍擊敗之。

translations.literal: At the time Changzhou Chen Kunshu combined Danyang and Jurong rebels of more than a hundred thousand, from west route circling out north of Changzhou, daily invading our army; Li Hezhang supervised troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hezhang defeated Chen Kunshu's 100,000 men north of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 寇以我軍城圍日緊，分犯江陰、常熟、無錫，以圖分我兵勢。

translations.literal: Rebels because our city encirclement daily tightened divided to attack Jiangyin, Changshu, and Wuxi, plotting to divide our military strength.
translations.idiomatic: Besieged rebels raided Jiangyin, Changshu, and Wuxi to divide imperial forces.

sentences.zh: 李鶴章撤圍師，堅守勿戰，別調軍援三縣。

translations.literal: Li Hezhang withdrew siege troops, held firm without battle, separately transferred troops to aid the three counties.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hezhang held the siege line and sent relief to the three counties.

sentences.zh: 李鶴章等尋解無錫城圍。

translations.literal: Li Hezhang and others soon lifted Wuxi city siege.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxi's siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 江陰守將駱秉忠與楊鼎勳等內外夾攻，寇亦敗走；

translations.literal: Jiangyin defender Luo Bingzhong with Yang Dingxun and others attacked inside and outside in pincer; rebels were also defeated and fled;
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhong relieved Jiangyin in a pincer attack;

sentences.zh: 乃並趨常熟，北自楊舍、福山，南自顏山、王莊，數十里皆寇。

translations.literal: then all pressed toward Changshu; north from Yangshe and Fushan, south from Yanshan and Wangzhuang, for tens of li all were rebels.
translations.idiomatic: then turned on Changshu where rebels lined the route for tens of li.

sentences.zh: 黃翼升會同城軍夾擊，克王莊、顏山、陳市寇壘，追殺二十餘里。

translations.literal: Huang Yisheng joined Tongcheng army in pincer strike, took Wangzhuang, Yanshan, and Chenshi rebel forts, pursued and killed more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yisheng cleared the Changshu approaches for twenty li.

sentences.zh: 寇由大河回撲常熟，水師截之，首尾不能相顧，掩殺無算。

translations.literal: Rebels by great river turned back to strike Changshu; the water force intercepted; head and tail could not coordinate; masking kill was countless.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet intercepted a Changshu counterattack and killed countless rebels.

sentences.zh: 常熟之圍立解。

translations.literal: Changshu's siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The Changshu siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 初，秀成入江寧說秀全出走，不聽，秀成憂糧食不繼，遣黨百計偷運。

translations.literal: Earlier when Xiucheng entered Jiangning urged Xiuquan to flee and was not heeded, Xiucheng worried grain would not continue and sent bands by every plan to smuggle transport.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng tried to smuggle grain into besieged Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 國荃約楊岳斌水陸巡邏，遇奸民運米入城，輒奪之。

translations.literal: Guoquan arranged Yang Yuebin land and water patrol; meeting traitor civilians transporting grain into the city, they were always seized.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan and Yang Yuebin seized smuggled grain.

sentences.zh: 秀成遣養子李士貴率黨數千出太平門赴句容接糧入城，伏兵要之，寇棄糧走。

translations.literal: Xiucheng sent adopted son Li Shigui leading several thousand bands out Taiping Gate toward Jurong to connect grain into the city; ambush troops intercepted; rebels abandoned grain and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shigui's grain convoy from Jurong was ambushed at Taiping Gate.

sentences.zh: 國荃銳意合圍，江寧城延亙百餘里，自我軍駐師雨花臺，奪取附近諸隘，東、西、南三面為官軍所據，惟鍾山石壘未克，城北兩門尚未合圍。

translations.literal: Guoquan was keen to complete encirclement; Jiangning city stretched more than a hundred li; since our army camped at Yuhuatai and seized nearby passes, east, west, and south three sides were held by imperial troops; only Bell Mountain stone fort was not taken; north two gates were not yet enclosed.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan nearly encircled Nanjing; only Bell Mountain and the north gates remained.

sentences.zh: 秀成自將出鍾山南，攻朱洪章營，敗退登山。

translations.literal: Xiucheng personally led troops out south of Bell Mountain to attack Zhu Hongzhang's camp, was defeated and retreated up the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Xiucheng failed against Zhu Hongzhang south of Bell Mountain.

sentences.zh: 沈鴻賓等挾火毬箭擲壘中，寇突火跳，遂克鍾山石壘，寇所署偽天保城者也。

translations.literal: Shen Hongbin and others carried fire balls and arrows into the fort; rebels burst through flame and jumped; Bell Mountain stone fort was then taken—the false Heavenly Fortress City.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Hongbin took Bell Mountain—the rebels' Heavenly Fortress.

sentences.zh: 國荃分檄諸將屯太平門、洪山、北固山，塞神策門，餘玄武湖阻水為圍。

translations.literal: Guoquan divided orders to generals to camp at Taiping Gate, Hongshan, and Beigu Hill, block Divine Strategy Gate, the rest with Xuanwu Lake blocking water as encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan sealed Taiping, Hongshan, and Divine Strategy gates.

sentences.zh: 於是江寧四面成包舉之勢，寇援及糧路皆絕。

translations.literal: Thus Jiangning on four sides formed a wrapping momentum; rebel relief and grain routes were all cut.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing was fully encircled without relief.

sentences.zh: 二月，寇以運糧路絕，日驅婦孺出城以謀節食。

translations.literal: In the second month rebels because grain transport routes were cut daily drove women and children out of the city to plan economizing food.
translations.idiomatic: Starving Nanjing expelled civilians to save food.

sentences.zh: 城西北多園圃，豫種麥濟饑。

translations.literal: Northwest of the city were many gardens; they beforehand planted wheat to relieve hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Wheat was planted in the gardens inside the northwest walls.

sentences.zh: 初，程學啟進攻嘉興，破小西門、北門寇營，殲除淨盡，擒偽天將劉得福、慕天義賈慕仁。

translations.literal: Earlier Cheng Xueqi advanced on Jiaxing, broke small west gate and north gate rebel camps, annihilated clean; captured the false Heaven General Liu Defu and Mu Tianyi Jia Muren.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi cleared Jiaxing's outer gates and captured Liu Defu.

sentences.zh: 而湖州寇屢竄南木、壇丘、四亭子、新塍，思犯盛澤、平望，以圖嘉興，不得逞；

translations.literal: While Huzhou rebels repeatedly slipped to Nanmu, Tanqiu, Sitingzi, and Xincheng, thinking to invade Shengze and Pingwang to target Jiaxing, they could not succeed;
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou raids toward Jiaxing were blocked;

sentences.zh: 又犯盛澤，圍王江涇後路營，亦為我軍所敗，而城守甚固，我軍多傷亡；

translations.literal: again invaded Shengze, besieged Wang Jiangjing rear-route camp, also defeated by our army; yet city defense was very firm and our army suffered many casualties;
translations.idiomatic: Shengze was also held, at heavy cost;

sentences.zh: 又遇雨不能進攻，學啟急思復嘉興，分門攻擊，增築月牆，寇拚死抗拒；

translations.literal: again met rain and could not advance attack; Xueqi urgently thought to recover Jiaxing, divided gates to attack, added moon walls; rebels fought to the death resisting;
translations.idiomatic: rain stalled the assault until Cheng Xueqi ringed Jiaxing with moon walls;

sentences.zh: 又以地雷巨砲轟蹋城垣百餘丈，擊毀砲臺，賊爭負土填城缺。

translations.literal: again used land mines and great cannon to bombard and collapse walls more than a hundred zhang; struck destroyed gun platforms; rebels competed to carry earth filling wall gaps.
translations.idiomatic: Mines breached the walls but rebels filled the gaps under fire.

sentences.zh: 湖州賊又自新塍來援，學啟會軍猛攻，肉薄登城，丸創其首，部將大憤，縱橫刺射，寇眾潰，遂克嘉興。

translations.literal: Huzhou rebels again came from Xincheng to aid; Xueqi joined armies in fierce attack, pressed close and mounted the walls; a bullet wounded his head; subordinate generals were greatly angered, stabbed and shot crosswise; rebel masses collapsed; Jiaxing was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xueqi took Jiaxing after a wall assault despite a head wound.

sentences.zh: 偽榮王廖發受、偽挺王劉得功皆伏誅。

translations.literal: The false Rong King Liao Fashou and false Ting King Liu Degong were both executed.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Fashou and Liu Degong were executed.

sentences.zh: 援寇黃文金還湖州。

translations.literal: Relief rebel Huang Wenjin returned to Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin withdrew to Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 寇之分竄江西者，疊經我軍截殺，闌入金溪。

translations.literal: Rebels split fleeing into Jiangxi had been repeatedly intercepted and killed by our army, breaking into Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns entering Jiangxi were driven into Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 道員席寶田由安仁馳擊，復其縣城。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Xi Baotian from Anren hurried to strike and recovered the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Baotian recovered Jinxi from Anren.

sentences.zh: 寇由瀘溪趨建昌，寶田會軍敗之，寇蔓延於新城、南豐。

translations.literal: Rebels from Luxi rushed toward Jianchang; Baotian joined armies and defeated them; rebels spread through Xincheng and Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels spread through Xincheng and Nanfeng after defeat at Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 提督黃仁翼進攻新城，克之，餘竄入福建建寧縣境。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Governor Huang Renyi advanced on Xincheng and took it; the rest slipped into Fujian Jianning county territory.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Renyi took Xincheng; remnants fled to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 南豐之寇亦經寶田擊敗，斬偽天侯張在朋，寇棄壘狂奔，退至城下，合圍攻之。

translations.literal: Nanfeng rebels were also defeated by Baotian, beheading the false Heaven Marquis Zhang Zaipeng; rebels abandoned forts in wild flight, retreated below the walls; combined encirclement attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zaipeng was killed; Nanfeng was besieged.

sentences.zh: 蔣益澧克杭州，康國器等同日收餘杭，寇分竄德清、武康等處。

translations.literal: Jiang Yizhen took Hangzhou; Kang Guoqi and others the same day recovered Yuhang; rebels split to flee Deqing, Wukang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou and Yuhang fell the same day; rebels fled to Deqing and Wukang.

sentences.zh: 宗棠飭軍分路進取。

translations.literal: Zongtang ordered armies in separate routes to advance and take.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo ordered pursuit in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 三月，羅大春等各率所部撲壘環攻，降人楊芸桂開門迎納官軍。

translations.literal: In the third month Luo Dachun and others each led commands to storm forts in encirclement; surrenderer Yang Yungui opened the gate to admit imperial troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yungui opened the gates in the third month.

sentences.zh: 援賊回鬥，砲擊之，敗走。

translations.literal: Relief rebels turned to fight; cannon struck them; they were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was shelled and driven off.

sentences.zh: 德清寇鏖戰四時亦大敗。

translations.literal: Deqing rebels fought fierce battle four hours and were also greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Deqing fell after four hours of fighting.

sentences.zh: 武康、德清皆復。

translations.literal: Wukang and Deqing were both recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Wukang and Deqing were recovered.

sentences.zh: 我軍進逼石門，踞寇鄧光明降。

translations.literal: Our army pressed Shimen; holding rebel Deng Guangming surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Guangming surrendered at Shimen.

sentences.zh: 其圖竄孝義之寇，亦截殺無算。

translations.literal: Rebels plotting to flee to Xiaoyi were also intercepted and killed without count.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fleeing to Xiaoyi were slaughtered.

sentences.zh: 鮑超等會克句容，偽漢王項大英、偽列王方成宗皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Bao Chao and others jointly took Jurong; the false Han King Xiang Daying and false Lie King Fang Chengzong were both executed.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao took Jurong and executed Xiang Daying and Fang Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 偽守王方海宗遁金壇寶堰，寶堰南距金壇城四十五里，北達丹陽。

translations.literal: The false Guard King Fang Haizong fled to Jintan Baoyan; Baoyan south was forty-five li from Jintan city, north reaching Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Haizong fled to Baoyan south of Jintan.

sentences.zh: 方海宗與偽顯王袁得厚合謀阻進兵之路，鮑超攻之，閉壘不出；

translations.literal: Fang Haizong with the false Xian King Yuan Dehou plotted to block the advance route; Bao Chao attacked; they closed forts and would not come out;
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao besieged Baoyan when the garrison refused to sortie;

sentences.zh: 乃負草填壕，一躍而入，寇向金壇、丹陽遁去。

translations.literal: then carried grass to fill moats, leaped in one bound; rebels fled toward Jintan and Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: he filled the moat with straw and stormed the walls; rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 鮑超進攻金壇，設伏茅山，大敗追寇，城寇喪膽，啟南門遁走，遂復其城。

translations.literal: Bao Chao advanced on Jintan, set ambush at Maoshan, greatly defeated pursuing rebels; city rebels lost courage, opened south gate and fled; the city was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao took Jintan after an ambush at Maoshan.

sentences.zh: 敗寇二三千，屯踞南渡，偽植王林得英約會常州西路孟河、呂城諸寇，欲由金壇歸併廣德，同踞南渡。

translations.literal: Defeated rebels two or three thousand held Nandu; the false Plant King Lin Deying arranged with Changzhou west-route Menghe and Lücheng rebels, wishing by Jintan to merge into Guangde and together hold Nandu.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Deying tried to rally Nandu from Guangde.

sentences.zh: 鴻章檄道員吳毓芬等會水陸軍分三路夜襲其巢，陣斬林得英及秫天安黃有才等，殄寇殆盡。

translations.literal: Hongzhang ordered Circuit Intendant Wu Yufen and others to join land-water armies in three routes in night raid on the nest, beheading on the field Lin Deying and Shutian'an Huang Youcai and others, annihilating rebels nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: A night raid at Nandu killed Lin Deying and Huang Youcai.

sentences.zh: 其攻丹陽者，為鎮江、揚州防軍，援寇一由常州運河，一由江陰孟河大至，詹啟綸、張文德會擊敗之，援寇退屯丹陽東北一帶。

translations.literal: Those attacking Danyang were Zhenjiang and Yangzhou defense troops; relief rebels one column from Changzhou canal, one from Jiangyin Menghe arrived in force; Zhan Qilun and Zhang Wende joined to defeat them; relief rebels retreated to camp northeast of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan Qilun and Zhang Wende beat relief at Danyang.

sentences.zh: 丹陽一城多聚巨酋，偽然王陳時永為陳玉成叔父，偽來王賴桂芳為洪秀全妻弟。

translations.literal: Danyang one city gathered many great chiefs; the false Ran King Chen Shiyong was Chen Yucheng's uncle; the false Lai King Lai Guifang was Hong Xiuquan's wife's brother.
translations.idiomatic: Danyang held Chen Shiyong and Lai Guifang among other chiefs.

sentences.zh: 因其內鬨，我軍乘之，陳時永創仆，斬之。

translations.literal: Because of internal strife our army seized the moment; Chen Shiyong was wounded and fell; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shiyong was killed in internal strife.

sentences.zh: 其黨自縛賴桂芳及偽廣王李愷瞬、偽列王金友順、偽梁王淩郭鈞、偽鄒王周林保，並偽義安福、燕、豫諸目，獻軍前乞降，皆駢誅，遂克其城。

translations.literal: His party bound Lai Guifang and the false Guang King Li Kaishun, false Lie King Jin Youshun, false Liang King Ling Guojun, false Zou King Zhou Linbao, and false Yi'an Fu, Yan, and Yu chiefs, presented before the army begging surrender—all were executed together; the city was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Defectors handed over chiefs; Danyang was taken and the leaders executed.

sentences.zh: 至是常州、鎮江各屬俱告肅清。

translations.literal: By then Changzhou and Zhenjiang subordinate districts all reported cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou and Zhenjiang were pacified.

sentences.zh: 寇自德清、武康、石門克後，李侍賢及偽聽王陳炳文、偽康王汪海洋等仍堅踞湖州。

translations.literal: After Deqing, Wukang, and Shimen were taken, Li Shixian and the false Listening King Chen Bingwen and false Kang King Wang Haiyang still firmly held Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou still held under Shixian, Chen Bingwen, and Wang Haiyang.

sentences.zh: 是時浙江惟湖州、長興、安吉三城未下，湖州寇於附城二三十里修築堅壘，復於長興、安吉各隘連營數十里，相為犄角。

translations.literal: At the time in Zhejiang only Huzhou, Changxing, and Anji three cities were not down; Huzhou rebels within twenty or thirty li of the attached city built firm forts, again at Changxing and Anji each pass linked camps tens of li, mutually horned.
translations.idiomatic: Only Huzhou, Changxing, and Anji remained in Zhejiang, heavily fortified.

sentences.zh: 高連陞擊之於湖州境，寇分竄昌化、分水，防軍劉明珍截斬數百。

translations.literal: Gao Liansheng struck them at Huzhou border; rebels split to flee Changhua and Fenshui; defense troops Liu Mingzhen intercepted and beheaded several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Liansheng drove rebels toward Changhua; Liu Mingzhen killed hundreds.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢繞越老竺嶺，竄皖南績溪，復間道走歙西，竄屯溪；

translations.literal: Li Shixian circled past Old Zhu Ridge, slipped into southern Anhui Jixi, again by hidden route went to She west, slipped into Tunxi;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian slipped through Jixi to Tunxi;

sentences.zh: 陳炳文、汪海洋由歙北竄浙境，分犯淳化、遂安。

translations.literal: Chen Bingwen and Wang Haiyang from north of She slipped into Zhe territory, divided to invade Chunhua and Suian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bingwen and Wang Haiyang raided Chunhua and Suian.

sentences.zh: 遂安防軍截擊歙南小川，竄寇敗還楊邨。

translations.literal: Suian defense intercepted and struck south of She at Xiaochuan; fleeing rebels were defeated back to Yang Village.
translations.idiomatic: Suian troops beat rebels at Xiaochuan.

sentences.zh: 唐義訓等進剿失利，於是嶺內遍地皆寇，徽、休、祁、黟岌岌難保。

translations.literal: Tang Yixun and others advanced in pursuit and lost; thus inside the passes everywhere were rebels; Hui, Xiu, Qi, and Yi were critically hard to preserve.
translations.idiomatic: A failed pursuit left Huizhou in peril.

sentences.zh: 寇前隊由龍灣、婺源竄江西，後之續至者絡繹不絕。

translations.literal: Rebel vanguard from Longwan and Wuyuan slipped into Jiangxi; those continuing behind came in endless succession.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel columns poured into Jiangxi through Longwan and Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 國藩調石埭、青陽防軍入嶺援徽，檄鮑超率全軍援江西。

translations.literal: Guofan transferred Shicheng and Qingyang defense troops into the passes to aid Hui, ordered Bao Chao to lead the full army to aid Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reinforced Huizhou and sent Bao Chao to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 陳坤書之踞常州四年矣，自蘇軍力攻，以炸砲毀城，寇死守，取舊棺敗船堵城缺，以槍砲拒我軍。

translations.literal: Chen Kunshu had held Changzhou four years; since Su army attacked with force, using explosive shells to destroy walls, rebels held firm to the death, took old coffins and rotten boats to plug wall gaps, using muskets and cannon to resist our army.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu held Changzhou four years behind ruined boats and coffins in the breaches.

sentences.zh: 時城西寇壘二十里夾河環列，劉銘傳等攻破十四壘，餘壘皆不戰而潰，而河干寇壘二十餘又為張樹聲等所破，於是寇西道皆絕，惟小南門、西門附城十餘壘，我軍復擊平之。

translations.literal: At the time west of the city rebel forts twenty li flanked the river in a ring; Liu Mingchuan and others broke fourteen forts; remaining forts all collapsed without battle; while riverside twenty-plus forts were again broken by Zhang Shusheng and others; thus rebel west routes were all cut; only Small South Gate and West Gate attached-city ten-plus forts remained; our army again struck and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingchuan cleared the western forts; only the south and west gates remained.

sentences.zh: 陳坤書塞門不納敗黨，恐官軍奪入，悍賊皆死城下。

translations.literal: Chen Kunshu blocked gates and would not admit defeated bands, fearing imperial troops would seize entry; fierce rebels all died below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Kunshu refused fugitives; his hard fighters died at the walls.

sentences.zh: 城圍既合，築長牆，伏奇兵，備大舉，水陸軍發砲轟城，風煙迷漫，寇如墜霧中。

translations.literal: City encirclement already complete, they built long walls, set hidden troops, prepared great assault; land-water armies fired cannon bombarding the city; wind and smoke blinding, rebels as if falling in fog.
translations.idiomatic: The final assault ringed Changzhou with cannon fire.

sentences.zh: 俄，城壞數十丈，寇以人塞缺口，炸丸迸裂，人與磚石齊起天際，然旋散旋集，蓋蘇省各路敗寇，積年麇聚於此，猶圖萬死一生計也。

translations.literal: Suddenly walls broke several tens of zhang; rebels used men to plug the gap; explosive charges burst, men and bricks rose to the sky together, yet scattered and gathered again—Suzhou routes defeated rebels for years had massed here, still plotting a gamble between ten thousand deaths and one life.
translations.idiomatic: Breaches were filled again and again as defeated rebels fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 鴻章益揮軍迫登，我軍偕籐牌噴筒直前，寇傾火藥，以長矛格刺，軍士十墜六七。

translations.literal: Hongzhang further waved troops to press mounting; our army with rattan shields and spray tubes advanced straight; rebels poured gunpowder, used long spears to block thrust; soldiers fell seven or eight in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang pressed the assault at terrible cost.

sentences.zh: 龔生陽突入，擒陳坤書，周盛波擒偽列王費天將，戰城上良久，寇大潰，縋城出者復為我軍所殲，我軍亦死亡千數百人。

translations.literal: Gong Shengyang burst in, captured Chen Kunshu; Zhou Shengbo captured the false Lie King Fei Tianjiang; fighting on the walls long; rebels were greatly routed; those lowering from walls by rope were again annihilated by our army; our army also dead numbered in thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu was captured; thousands died on both sides.

sentences.zh: 常州之失以咸豐十年四月初六日，越四年而復，日月皆不爽，亦一奇也。

translations.literal: Changzhou's loss was Xianfeng ten fourth month sixth day; after four years it was recovered—the sun and moon without discrepancy—is also a marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou fell on the same calendar date it was recovered four years later.

sentences.zh: 陳坤書淩遲處死，梟示東門。

translations.literal: Chen Kunshu was executed by slicing; his head was displayed at East Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kunshu was dismembered and displayed.

sentences.zh: 時常州敗寇竄徽州，我軍擊破之。

translations.literal: At the time Changzhou defeated rebels fled to Huizhou; our army broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou fugitives were beaten at Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 餘竄江西，圍玉山，副將劉明珍等陣斬珊天安等，斃寇二千。

translations.literal: The rest slipped into Jiangxi, besieged Yushan; Brigadier Liu Mingzhen and others beheaded Shantian'an and others on the field, killing two thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand rebels were killed at Yushan.

sentences.zh: 李侍賢越金谿犯撫州河東灣，猛攻東門，為我軍擊退。

translations.literal: Li Shixian crossed Jinxi to invade Fuzhou Hedong Bay, fiercely attacking east gate, was repelled by our army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixian was repelled at Fuzhou's east gate.

sentences.zh: 忽突起攻橋，環呼城中內應，冀亂我軍，劉于淳砲斃多名，餘遁金溪，城圍立解。

translations.literal: Suddenly he rose to attack the bridge, surrounding cries for inside collaboration in the city hoping to disorder our army; Liu Yuchun's cannon killed many names; the rest fled to Jinxi; city siege was quickly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: A bridge assault failed; Liu Yuchun's guns broke the sortie.

sentences.zh: 偽列王林彩新竄江西弋陽，我軍追抵湖西，揮軍抄擊，寇敗竄黃沙港。

translations.literal: The false Lie King Lin Caixin fled to Jiangxi Yiyang; our army pursued to west of the lake, waved troops in flanking strike; rebels were defeated and fled to Huangsha Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Caixin was driven to Huangsha Harbor.

sentences.zh: 對岸楊家坡寇黨從上游渡寇千餘來援，諸軍沿河截擊，鏖戰逾時，寇始蹙，多落水死。

translations.literal: Opposite-bank Yangjiapo rebel party crossed a thousand-plus from upstream to aid; armies along the river intercepted; fierce battle over time; rebels then pressed; many fell into water and died.
translations.idiomatic: River ambushes drowned many rebels at Yangjiapo.

sentences.zh: 侍賢等先後由浙犯徽，由徽入江西。

translations.literal: Shixian and others successively from Zhe invaded Hui, from Hui entered Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian's route ran from Zhe through Hui into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 江陰楊舍及常州城外之寇，由丹陽、湖州上竄徽南，其酋為林彩新及偽麟王朱某、偽爵潘忠義等，從昌化進老竹嶺，闌入歙境。

translations.literal: Jiangyin Yangshe and Changzhou outer rebels from Danyang and Huzhou slipped up into south Hui; their chiefs were Lin Caixin and the false Qilin King Zhu someone, the false Noble Pan Zhongyi, and others, from Changhua entering Old Bamboo Ridge, breaking into She territory.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Caixin and others entered She from Changhua.

sentences.zh: 唐義訓伏兵鍾塘嶺後，以五營進，遇寇大戰，伏起，殲其前鋒。

translations.literal: Tang Yixun hid troops behind Zhongtang Ridge, advanced with five battalions, met rebels in great battle; ambush rose and annihilated their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yixun ambushed the vanguard at Zhongtang Ridge.

sentences.zh: 時金國琛等行抵富陽，隔河而屯，寇眾列山岡上下，我軍俟寇涉水將半，突出奮擊；

translations.literal: At the time Jin Guochen and others reached Fuyang, camped across the river; rebel masses lined hill ridges above and below; our army waited until rebels waded halfway, then burst out striking hard;
translations.idiomatic: Jin Guochen struck rebels mid-river at Fuyang;

sentences.zh: 唐義訓尾而至，夾擊之，寇不支，遁向黃山小路。

translations.literal: Tang Yixun followed the tail and arrived, pincer striking; rebels could not hold, fled toward Huangshan small path.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yixun pincered them toward Huangshan.

sentences.zh: 我軍馳抵五弓橋，再敗寇，因循河埋伏兵。

translations.literal: Our army hurried to Wugong Bridge, again defeated rebels, then along the river set hidden ambush troops.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial troops won again at Wugong Bridge and set an ambush.

sentences.zh: 寇正渡時，伏突起，寇大驚亂，生擒林彩新等十名，陣斬潘忠義等十四酋，死亡者二萬餘人。

translations.literal: As rebels were crossing, ambush suddenly rose; rebels were greatly alarmed and disorderly; Lin Caixin and ten others were captured alive; on the field Pan Zhongyi and fourteen chiefs were beheaded; dead numbered more than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The ambush captured Lin Caixin and killed 20,000 rebels.

sentences.zh: 是月，洪秀全以金陵危急，服毒死。

translations.literal: That month Hong Xiuquan because Jinling was critically perilous took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hong Xiuquan poisoned himself as Nanjing fell.

sentences.zh: 群酋用上帝教殮法，綉緞裹屍，無棺槨，瘞偽宮內，秘不發喪。

translations.literal: Chiefs used God-Worship burial law, wrapped the corpse in brocade satin without coffin, buried in the false palace, secret without issuing mourning.
translations.idiomatic: They buried him secretly in the palace by Taiping rites.

sentences.zh: 其子年十六，襲偽位。

translations.literal: His son at age sixteen inherited the false throne.
translations.idiomatic: His sixteen-year-old son succeeded.

sentences.zh: 秀全生時即號其子為幼主，或曰本名天貴福。

translations.literal: Xiuquan at birth called his son the Young Lord, or said original name was Tiangui Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The heir was known as the Young Lord or Tiangui Fu.

sentences.zh: 其刻印稱洪福，旁列「真王」二文，誤合為「瑱」，其稱洪福瑱以此。

translations.literal: His carved seal said Hong Fu, with beside it the two characters "true king," mistakenly combined as "Zhen"—his being called Hong Fuzhen came from this.
translations.idiomatic: His seal read Hong Fu with "true lord" misread as "true king."

sentences.zh: 然諦觀印文，實「真主」二小字，非真王也。

translations.literal: Yet examining the seal closely, it was actually the two small characters "true lord," not true king.
translations.idiomatic: The seal actually said "true lord," not "true king."

sentences.zh: 時湖州寇方竄湖濱楊漊大錢口，潘鼎新分軍屯南潯，而寇恃長興為聲援。

translations.literal: At the time Huzhou rebels were slipping at Hubin Yanglian Daqian Mouth; Pan Dingxin divided troops camped at Nanxun, while rebels relied on Changxing as vocal support.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou rebels held Yanglian while Changxing supported them.

sentences.zh: 長興在湖州西，毗連宜興、溧陽及廣德州。

translations.literal: Changxing lay west of Huzhou, bordering Yixing, Liyang, and Guangde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Changxing bordered Yixing, Liyang, and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 宗棠貽書鴻章，移嘉興之師助攻長興。

translations.literal: Zongtang wrote to Hongzhang, shifting Jiaxing's army jointly to attack Changxing.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo asked Li Hongzhang to shift Jiaxing troops to Changxing.

sentences.zh: 鴻章遣諸軍分道往取，水師入夾浦口。

translations.literal: Hongzhang sent armies in separate routes to take it; the water force entered Jiapu mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang sent columns and the fleet into Jiapu.

sentences.zh: 五月，鼎新進紥吳漊，水師破平夾浦石壘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Dingxin advanced to camp at Wulian; the water force broke and pacified Jiapu stone fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Pan Dingxin camped at Wulian and took Jiapu.

sentences.zh: 鼎新連破吳漊、殷瀆邨，毀其卡壘。

translations.literal: Dingxin successively broke Wulian and Yindu Village, destroyed their posts and forts.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Dingxin cleared Wulian and Yindu.

sentences.zh: 郭松林毀長興城東上莘橋、跨塘橋寇壘。

translations.literal: Guo Songlin destroyed Changxing city east Shangxinqiao and Kuatang Bridge rebel forts.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Songlin destroyed east Changxing forts.

sentences.zh: 湖州、廣德、四安寇率數萬分路來援，依山築壘，綿亙林谷。

translations.literal: Huzhou, Guangde, and Si'an rebels led tens of thousands in separate routes to aid, building forts along mountains, stretching through forest valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands reinforced Changxing from Huzhou and Guangde.

sentences.zh: 松林等擊湖州援寇，劉士奇擊廣德、四安援寇，寇壘悉平毀，殲溺萬餘人。

translations.literal: Songlin and others struck Huzhou relief rebels; Liu Shiqi struck Guangde and Si'an relief rebels; rebel forts were all leveled and destroyed, drowning and killing more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was destroyed with over 10,000 killed.

sentences.zh: 而湖北廣德寇復添撥大股折回，我軍乘賊眾喘息未定，合力痛剿，追殺二十餘里，寇乃遠遁。

translations.literal: While Hubei Guangde rebels again added a great column turning back; our army while rebel masses gasped not yet settled jointly struck hard in pain, pursued more than twenty li; rebels then fled far.
translations.idiomatic: A Guangde counterattack was pursued twenty li.

sentences.zh: 我軍乘夜攻城，以炸砲轟塌城垣十餘丈，松林等首先衝入，遂復長興縣城。

translations.literal: Our army by night attacked the city, using explosive shells to bombard and collapse walls more than ten zhang; Songlin and others first rushed in; Changxing county seat was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: A night assault with mines took Changxing.

sentences.zh: 江西貴溪盛源洞等處寇分踞小巷一帶，築壘修卡，我軍飭砲船馳赴黃土墩，以槍砲擊之，寇倉皇敗竄，水陸諸軍撲卡而入，擒斬多名，寇大潰。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Guixi Shengyuan Cave and other place rebels divided to hold Xiaoxiang stretch, building forts and repairing posts; our army ordered gunboats to hurry to Huangtu Mound, striking with muskets and cannon; rebels fled in panic; land-water armies stormed posts and entered, capturing and beheading many names; rebels were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Gunboats cleared Guixi rebel posts at Huangtu Mound.

sentences.zh: 貴溪寇壘一律肅清。

translations.literal: Guixi rebel forts were entirely cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Guixi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 浙軍進規湖州，攻復孝豐縣城，生擒偽感王陳榮，斃千餘。

translations.literal: Zhe army advanced on Huzhou, attacked and recovered Xiaofeng county seat, capturing alive the false Gan King Chen Rong; more than a thousand killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe forces recovered Xiaofeng and captured Chen Rong.

sentences.zh: 是月偽扶王陳得才等合捻竄擾孝感、雲夢等縣。

translations.literal: That month the false Fu King Chen Decai and others joined Nian to harass Xiaogan, Yunmeng, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Decai and Nian bands raided Xiaogan and Yunmeng.

sentences.zh: 上以江寧垂克，而河南捻犯麻城、皖城，深入江西，恐掣全局，趣國荃迅取金陵。

translations.literal: The throne because Jiangning was about to fall while Henan Nian invaded Macheng and Anhui cities and penetrated deep into Jiangxi, fearing pulling the overall situation, urged Guoquan to swiftly take Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: The court urged Guo Quan to take Nanjing quickly despite Nian raids elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 國荃進攻鍾山龍脖子，寇所稱地保城也。

translations.literal: Guoquan advanced to attack Bell Mountain Dragon Neck—what rebels called Earth Fortress City.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan assaulted Dragon Neck on Bell Mountain.

sentences.zh: 我軍自得偽天保城後，城寇防守益嚴。

translations.literal: Our army since taking the false Heavenly Fortress City, city rebel defense grew stricter.
translations.idiomatic: After the Heavenly Fortress fell, the garrison fought harder.

sentences.zh: 是城扼建要害，尋為李祥和所破。

translations.literal: That city choked Jian's vital point; soon Li Xianghe broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianghe soon broke the Earth Fortress.

sentences.zh: 國荃築砲臺其上，日發巨砲轟擊，居高臨下，全城形勢皆在掌中。

translations.literal: Guoquan built gun platforms on it, daily firing great cannon bombardment, high overlooking low; the whole city's situation was all in the palm.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan shelled the city from the heights.

sentences.zh: 六月十六日，國荃飭諸軍發太平門地雷，塌城垣二十餘丈，前敵總兵李臣典、朱洪章等九人先登，諸將分門合力，攻克江寧省城，獲偽玉璽二方、金印一方。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the sixth month Guoquan ordered armies to fire Taiping Gate land mine; walls collapsed more than twenty zhang; vanguard Brigadier Li Chen dian, Zhu Hongzhang, and nine others mounted first; generals divided gates jointly; Jiangning provincial city was taken; obtained two false jade seals and one gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth of the sixth month a mine at Taiping Gate took Nanjing; Li Chen dian led the storm.

sentences.zh: 是夜，寇自焚偽天王府，秀成攜秀全幼子從城垣倒口遁去，並以己馬與之乘以行。

translations.literal: That night rebels self-burned the false Heavenly King palace; Xiucheng carried Xiuquan's young son from the wall collapse opening and fled, also giving his own horse for him to ride together.
translations.idiomatic: That night the palace burned; Xiucheng fled with the Young Lord.

sentences.zh: 國荃令閉門封缺口，搜殺三日，斃寇十餘萬，凡偽王以下大小酋目約三千餘。

translations.literal: Guoquan ordered gates closed and the gap sealed, searched and killed three days; more than a hundred thousand rebels killed; all false kings and below great and small chiefs about three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Three days of slaughter killed 100,000 rebels and 3,000 chiefs.

sentences.zh: 最後城西北隅清涼山伏寇數千出與官軍死戰，卒殲之。

translations.literal: Finally northwest corner Qingliang Hill several thousand hidden rebels came out to fight imperial troops to the death; they were finally annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: The last holdouts at Qingliang Hill were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 其偽天王府婦女多自縊，及溺城河而死。

translations.literal: Many women in the false Heavenly King palace hanged themselves or drowned in the city moat and died.
translations.idiomatic: Many palace women hanged themselves or drowned in the moat.

sentences.zh: 國荃派馬隊追至淳化鎮，生擒偽列王李萬才。

translations.literal: Guoquan sent cavalry in pursuit to Chunhua Town, capturing alive the false Lie King Li Wancai.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry captured Li Wancai at Chunhua Town.

sentences.zh: 其自城破後逸出者，洪秀全之兄偽巨王、偽幼西王、偽幼南王、偽定王、偽崇王、偽璋王悉為馬隊殺斃。

translations.literal: Those who escaped after the city fell—Hong Xiuquan's elder brother the false Giant King, false Young West King, false Young South King, false Ding King, false Chong King, and false Zhang King—were all killed by the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Escaped princes including the Giant King were run down by cavalry.

sentences.zh: 蕭孚泗搜獲李秀成及洪仁發、洪仁達於江寧天印山，搜掘洪秀全屍於偽宮，戮而焚之。

translations.literal: Xiao Fusi searched out and captured Li Xiucheng and Hong Renfa and Hong Renda at Jiangning Tianyin Hill, searched out and excavated Hong Xiuquan's corpse in the false palace, dismembered and burned it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fusi captured Li Xiucheng and Hong Rengan and burned Hong Xiuquan's body.

sentences.zh: 國藩親訊秀成等，供讞成，駢誅於市。

translations.literal: Guofan personally interrogated Xiucheng and others; confession completed; they were executed together in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan tried Xiucheng and had him executed in public.

sentences.zh: 七月，鮑超連克東鄉、金谿，楊岳斌等連克崇仁、宜黃，潘鼎新會克湖州，楊昌濬等克安吉，斬偽駙馬列王徐朗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Bao Chao successively took Dongxiang and Jinxi; Yang Yuebin and others successively took Chongren and Yihuang; Pan Dingxin jointly took Huzhou; Yang Changjun and others took Anji, beheading the false Imperial Son-in-Law Lie King Xu Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Bao Chao, Yang Yuebin, and Pan Dingxin took cities across Jiangxi and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 寇併竄廣德、長興，守軍吳毓芬克四安鎮，劉銘傳克廣德。

translations.literal: Rebels together fled Guangde and Changxing; garrison Wu Yufen took Si'an Town; Liu Mingchuan took Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled to Guangde and Changxing; Wu Yufen and Liu Mingchuan recovered towns.

sentences.zh: 初，秀全幼子自江寧出亡，悍黨衛至州城；

translations.literal: Earlier Xiuquan's young son fled from Jiangning; fierce bands guarded him to the prefectural city;
translations.idiomatic: The Young Lord had fled Nanjing under guard;

sentences.zh: 至是城克，偽昭王黃文英等挾之走寧國。

translations.literal: now with the city taken, the false Zhao King Huang Wenying and others carried him toward Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: after the fall Huang Wenying escorted him toward Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 八月，唐義訓等敗湖州餘寇於歙縣，殲酋目偽幼孝王等九人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Tang Yixun and others defeated remaining Huzhou rebels at She County, annihilating chiefs including the false Young Xiao King and nine others.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yixun killed nine rebel chiefs including the Young Xiao King at She County.

sentences.zh: 連日劉光明等大破寇於昌化、淳安，偽堵王黃文金、偽偕王譚體元伏誅。

translations.literal: For successive days Liu Guangming greatly broke rebels at Changhua and Chun'an; the false Du King Huang Wenjin and false Jie King Tan Tiyuan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangming killed Huang Wenjin and Tan Tiyuan in Changhua and Chun'an.

sentences.zh: 李遠繼挾秀全幼子奔江西廣信，於是浙江平。

translations.literal: Li Yuanji carried Xiuquan's young son to flee Jiangxi Guangxin; thus Zhejiang was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanji fled with the Young Lord to Guangxin; Zhejiang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 初，秀全幼子及黃、李諸酋由寧國趨昌化之白牛橋，譚酋及偽樂王之子莫桂先、偽首王范汝增等由寧國趨淳安威坪，約同竄徽境，眾尚十數萬。

translations.literal: Earlier the Young Lord and Huang, Li, and other chiefs from Ningguo toward Changhua's White Ox Bridge; Tan chief and the false Music King's son Mo Guixian and false Chief King Fan Ruzeng and others from Ningguo toward Chun'an Weiping, agreed together to slip into Hui territory—masses still numbered more than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Over 100,000 fugitives converged on Huizhou from two routes.

sentences.zh: 劉光明擊白牛橋寇，黃酋中砲死，弟文英代領其眾，踉蹌西奔。

translations.literal: Liu Guangming struck White Ox Bridge rebels; Huang chief was wounded by cannon and died; younger brother Wenying took command of the masses, stumbling west in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangming killed Huang chief at White Ox Bridge; Wenying fled west.

sentences.zh: 黃少春斬譚體元於洪橋，併誅莫桂先等酋百五十餘人。

translations.literal: Huang Shaochun beheaded Tan Tiyuan at Hong Bridge, also executing Mo Guixian and more than 150 chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shaochun killed Tan Tiyuan and 150 chiefs at Hong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 劉明珍率所部由淳化上趨，值黃文英、李遠繼來犯，明珍偕魏喻義等分兵禦之，創黃文英於陣。

translations.literal: Liu Mingzhen led his command from Chunhua upward; meeting Huang Wenying and Li Yuanji coming to attack, Mingzhen with Wei Yuyi and others divided troops to resist, wounding Huang Wenying on the field.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mingzhen wounded Huang Wenying meeting the Young Lord's escort.

sentences.zh: 李遠繼挾秀全幼子遁至徽、歙之交。

translations.literal: Li Yuanji carrying Xiuquan's young son fled to the Hui-She border.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanji fled with the Young Lord toward Huizhou and She County.

sentences.zh: 寇由建口渡河，我軍乘其半濟擊之，大潰，斬偽列王邱國文等，收降卒六千餘。

translations.literal: Rebels crossed the river at Jian Mouth; our army struck while they were half across; greatly routed; beheaded the false Lie King Qiu Guowen and others; received surrender of more than six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Half the rebels were destroyed crossing Jian Mouth; 6,000 surrendered.

sentences.zh: 餘黨向績溪而逸。

translations.literal: Remaining bands fled toward Jixi.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants fled toward Jixi.

sentences.zh: 其已度建口者，竄至遂安，黃少春等復擊走之。

translations.literal: Those already past Jian Mouth fled to Suian; Huang Shaochun and others again struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shaochun drove the rest from Suian.

sentences.zh: 偽列王劉得義、蕭雅泗等率二萬人投誠。

translations.literal: The false Lie King Liu Deyi, Xiao Yasu, and others led twenty thousand to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Deyi and Xiao Yasu surrendered 20,000 men.

sentences.zh: 洪氏勢益孤，乃由遂安昏口遁走開化，竄入江西。

translations.literal: Hong clan momentum grew more isolated; then from Suian Hunkou fled toward Kaihua, slipped into Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong cause dwindled; fugitives entered Jiangxi through Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 九月，鮑超擊偽康王汪海洋於寧郡，大破之，擒斬偽朝將王金瑞等百二十餘人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Bao Chao struck the false Kang King Wang Haiyang at Ning Prefecture, greatly broke him, capturing and beheading the false Court General Wang Jinrui and more than 120 others.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao routed Wang Haiyang at Ningguo and killed 120 officers.

sentences.zh: 席寶田追剿湖州逃寇，大殲於廣昌白水嶺，擒偽干王洪仁玕、偽卹王洪仁政及偽昭王黃文英，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Xi Baotian pursued fleeing Huzhou rebels, greatly annihilating at Guangchang Baishui Ridge, capturing the false Gan King Hong Rengan, the false Xu King Hong Renzheng, and the false Zhao King Huang Wenying—all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Baotian at Baishui Ridge captured Hong Rengan, Hong Renzheng, and Huang Wenying and executed them.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨克雩都、會昌，練勇克瑞金。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen took Yudu and Huichang; militia took Ruijin.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen took Yudu and Huichang; militia took Ruijin.

sentences.zh: 寶田追寇於石城，游擊周家良搜獲秀全幼子於黃谷，檻致南昌省城，誅之。

translations.literal: Baotian pursued rebels at Shicheng; Ranger Zhou Jialiang searched out and captured Xiuquan's young son at Huanggu, caged and sent to Nanchang provincial city, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Young Lord was captured at Huanggu and executed in Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 各路官軍截剿餘寇殆盡，於是洪氏遂滅。

translations.literal: Imperial armies on every route intercepted and suppressed remaining rebels nearly all; thus the Hong clan was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces hunted down the last rebels; the Taiping dynasty was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 論曰：秀全以匹夫倡革命，改元易服，建號定都，立國逾十餘年，用兵至十餘省，南北交爭，隱然敵國。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Xiuquan with a common man's stature raised revolution, changed era and altered dress, established title and fixed capital, established a state more than ten years, used armies reaching more than ten provinces, north and south contending, seemingly a rival state.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Hong Xiuquan rose from common birth, reigned over ten provinces for a decade, and for a time rivaled the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 當時竭天下之力，始克平之，而元氣遂已傷矣。

translations.literal: At the time exhausting the empire's strength barely overcame them, yet vital energy was thereby injured.
translations.idiomatic: The empire exhausted itself to suppress him and was deeply wounded.

sentences.zh: 中國危亡，實兆於此。

translations.literal: China's peril and ruin truly originated from this.
translations.idiomatic: China's later catastrophe began here.

sentences.zh: 成則王，敗則寇，故不必以一時之是非論定焉。

translations.literal: Succeed and you are king, fail and you are bandit—therefore one need not judge by a moment's right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Success makes kings, failure makes rebels—history resists a simple verdict.

sentences.zh: 唯初起必託言上帝，設會傳教，假「天父」之號，應「紅羊」之讖，名不正則言不順，世多疑之；

translations.literal: Only at the start they had to claim God, establish societies and spread teaching, borrow the title "Heaven Father," answer the omen of the "Red Sheep"—when the name is not correct speech is not in order, the age was much doubtful;
translations.idiomatic: They claimed divine mandate and the Red Sheep omen, yet their legitimacy was widely doubted;

sentences.zh: 而攻城略地，殺戮太過，又嚴種族之見，人心不屬。

translations.literal: yet in attacking cities and seizing territory they killed too greatly, and also held strict ethnic views—hearts did not belong to them.
translations.idiomatic: their slaughter and ethnic exclusivity cost them the people's allegiance.

sentences.zh: 此其所以敗歟？

translations.literal: Was this not why they were defeated?
translations.idiomatic: Was that not why they fell?
